            (== (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0) v))
  (ensures (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) (get (idx (idx g u) e) 1)))
  (decreases (- e i))
  (body
    (if (< i e)
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0)))
        (call weight_from_unique g u v e (+ i 1))
        (assert (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) (weight_from (idx g u) v (+ i 1)))))
      (assert (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))))
(lemma edge_connected (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (e int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g u))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) e) 1) w))
  (ensures (has_edge g u v w) (connected g u v) (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
  (body
    (assert (has_edge g u v w))
    (call weight_from_unique g u v e 0)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) (weight_from (idx g u) v 0)))))
(lemma conn_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (wf g) (connected g a b))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))))
  (body
    (obtain ((w0 int)) (has_edge g a b w0))
    (obtain ((e0 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 e0) (< e0 (len (idx g a)))))
                            (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) e0) 0) b) (== (get (idx (idx g a) e0) 1) w0))))))
(lemma relax_use (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (od (seq (option int))) (nd (seq (option int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (wf g) (== (len od) (len g)) (== (len nd) (len g)) (relaxed g od nd (len g) 0)
            (connected g a b) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (is some (idx od a)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))) (is some (idx nd b))
           (<= (field (idx nd b) value) (+ (field (idx od a) value) (get_edge_weight g a b))))
  (body
    (obtain ((w1 int)) (has_edge g a b w1))
    (obtain ((e1 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 e1) (< e1 (len (idx g a)))))
                            (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) e1) 0) b) (== (get (idx (idx g a) e1) 1) w1))))
    (call edge_connected g a e1 b w1)
    (assert (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))))))

(lemma path_link (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx p x) (idx p (+ x 1))))
  (body))
(lemma last_link (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (is_path g p) (>= (len p) 2))
  (ensures (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
  (body
    (call path_link g p (- (len p) 2))
    (assert (== (idx p (+ (- (len p) 2) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
(lemma prefix_link (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (m int) (x int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (<= 1 m) (<= m (len p))) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (- m 1))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (take p m) x) (idx (take p m) (+ x 1))))
  (body
    (call path_link g p x)
    (assert (== (idx (take p m) x) (idx p x)))
    (assert (== (idx (take p m) (+ x 1)) (idx p (+ x 1))))))
(lemma path_take (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (<= 1 m) (<= m (len p))))
  (ensures (is_path g (take p m)) (== (len (take p m)) m)
           (== (idx (take p m) 0) (idx p 0)) (== (idx (take p m) (- m 1)) (idx p (- m 1))))
  (body
    (forall ((x int)) (call prefix_link g p m x))
    (assert (== (len (take p m)) m))))
(lemma snoc_link (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len p))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) x) (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ x 1))))
  (body
    (if (< x (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (call path_link g p x)
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) x) (idx p x)))
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ x 1)) (idx p (+ x 1)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) x) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ x 1)) v))))))
(lemma path_snoc (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
           (== (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) (+ (len p) 1))
           (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
           (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1)) v)
           (== (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v))) (+ (path_weight g p) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))))
  (body
    (forall ((x int)) (call snoc_link g p v x))
    (ghost-let s (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (assert (== (len s) (+ (len p) 1)))
    (assert (== (take s (- (len s) 1)) p))
    (assert (== (idx s 0) (idx p 0)))
    (assert (== (idx s (- (len s) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert (== (idx s (- (len s) 1)) v))
    (assert (== (path_weight g s)
                (+ (path_weight g (take s (- (len s) 1))) (get_edge_weight g (idx s (- (len s) 2)) (idx s (- (len s) 1))))))))
(lemma vertex_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (wf g) (is_path g p) (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len p))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p x)) (< (idx p x) (len g))))
  (body
    (if (< x (- (len p) 1))
      (block (call path_link g p x) (call conn_range g (idx p x) (idx p (+ x 1))))
      (assert (== (idx p x) (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))))
(lemma path_in_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (wf g) (is_path g p) (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len g))))
  (ensures (in_range p (len g)))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call vertex_range g p x))))

(lemma split (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len s))))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g s) (+ (path_weight g (take s (+ m 1))) (path_weight g (drop s m)))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== m (- (len s) 1))
      (block
        (assert (== (take s (+ m 1)) s))
        (assert (== (len (drop s m)) 1))
        (assert (== (path_weight g (drop s m)) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let r (seq int) (take s (- (len s) 1)))
        (ghost-let d (seq int) (drop s m))
        (call split g r m)
        (assert (== (take r (+ m 1)) (take s (+ m 1))))
        (assert (== (len d) (- (len s) m)))
        (assert (== (take d (- (len d) 1)) (drop r m)))
        (assert (== (idx d (- (len d) 2)) (idx s (- (len s) 2))))
        (assert (== (idx d (- (len d) 1)) (idx s (- (len s) 1))))
        (assert (== (path_weight g s)
                    (+ (path_weight g r) (get_edge_weight g (idx s (- (len s) 2)) (idx s (- (len s) 1))))))
        (assert (== (path_weight g d)
                    (+ (path_weight g (take d (- (len d) 1))) (get_edge_weight g (idx d (- (len d) 2)) (idx d (- (len d) 1))))))))))
(lemma splice (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (q (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len q))) (== (idx q i) (idx q j)))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g q)
               (+ (path_weight g (concat (take q i) (drop q j))) (path_weight g (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1))))))
  (body
    (ghost-let dq (seq int) (drop q i))
    (ghost-let q2 (seq int) (concat (take q i) (drop q j)))
    (call split g q i)
    (call split g dq (- j i))
    (assert (== (drop dq (- j i)) (drop q j)))
    (assert (== (len q2) (+ i (- (len q) j))))
    (call split g q2 i)
    (assert (== (take q2 (+ i 1)) (take q (+ i 1))))
    (assert (== (drop q2 i) (drop q j)))))
(lemma slice_link (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (q (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (x int))
  (requires (is_path g q) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len q))) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (- j i))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)) x) (idx (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)) (+ x 1))))
  (body
    (call path_link g q (+ i x))
    (assert (== (idx (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)) x) (idx q (+ i x))))
    (assert (== (idx (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)) (+ x 1)) (idx q (+ (+ i x) 1))))))
(lemma join_link (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (q (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (y int))
  (requires (is_path g q) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len q))) (== (idx q i) (idx q j))
            (and (<= 0 y) (< y (- (- (len q) (- j i)) 1))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) y) (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) (+ y 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (concat (take q i) (drop q j))) (- (len q) (- j i))))
    (if (< (+ y 1) i)
      (block
        (call path_link g q y)
        (assert (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) y) (idx q y)))
        (assert (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) (+ y 1)) (idx q (+ y 1)))))
      (if (== (+ y 1) i)
        (block
          (call path_link g q y)
          (assert (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) y) (idx q y)))
          (assert (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) (+ y 1)) (idx q j)))
          (assert (== (idx q (+ y 1)) (idx q i))))
        (block
          (call path_link g q (+ (- y i) j))
          (assert (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) y) (idx q (+ (- y i) j))))
          (assert (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) (+ y 1)) (idx q (+ (+ (- y i) j) 1)))))))))
(lemma splice_path (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (q (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (is_path g q) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len q))) (== (idx q i) (idx q j)))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)))
    (> (len (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1))) 1)
    (== (idx (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)) 0)
        (idx (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)) (- (len (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1))) 1)))
    (is_path g (concat (take q i) (drop q j)))
    (== (len (concat (take q i) (drop q j))) (- (len q) (- j i)))
    (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) 0) (idx q 0))
    (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) (- (len (concat (take q i) (drop q j))) 1)) (idx q (- (len q) 1))))
  (body
    (forall ((x int)) (call slice_link g q i j x))
    (forall ((y int)) (call join_link g q i j y))
    (assert (== (len (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1))) (+ (- j i) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)) 0) (idx q i)))
    (assert (== (idx (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)) (- j i)) (idx q j)))
    (assert (== (len (concat (take q i) (drop q j))) (- (len q) (- j i))))
    (assert (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) 0) (idx q 0)))
    (assert (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) (- (- (len q) (- j i)) 1)) (idx q (- (len q) 1))))))
(lemma pigeon (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (>= n 0) (in_range s n) (distinct s))
  (ensures (<= (len s) n))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if (== n 0)
      (if (> (len s) 0) (assert (and (<= 0 (idx s 0)) (< (idx s 0) n))) (block))
      (block
        (call law_contains s (- n 1))
        (if (contains s (- n 1))
          (block
            (obtain ((k int)) (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s))) (== (idx s k) (- n 1))))
            (ghost-let t (seq int) (seq-build (- (len s) 1) (fn (m) (if (< m k) (idx s m) (idx s (+ m 1))))))
            (assert (== (len t) (- (len s) 1)))
            (assert (in_range t (- n 1)))
            (assert (distinct t))
            (call pigeon t (- n 1)))
          (block
            (assert (in_range s (- n 1)))
            (call pigeon s (- n 1))))))))
(lemma neg_witness (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)))
  (requires (is_path g c) (> (len c) 1) (== (idx c 0) (idx c (- (len c) 1))) (< (path_weight g c) 0))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body))

(lemma lower_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (k int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (lower g start d k) (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) start) (<= (len p) (+ k 1)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len d)))
           (is some (idx d (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
           (<= (field (idx d (idx p (- (len p) 1))) value) (path_weight g p)))
  (body))
(lemma lower_step_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (od (seq (option int))) (nd (seq (option int))) (k int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (wf g) (== (len od) (len g)) (== (len nd) (len g)) (>= k 0)
            (lower g start od k) (le_all nd od) (relaxed g od nd (len g) 0)
            (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) start) (<= (len p) (+ k 2)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len nd)))
           (is some (idx nd (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
           (<= (field (idx nd (idx p (- (len p) 1))) value) (path_weight g p)))
  (body
    (if (<= (len p) (+ k 1))
      (call lower_at g start od k p)
      (block
        (ghost-let r (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call path_take g p (- (len p) 1))
        (call lower_at g start od k r)
        (call last_link g p)
        (ghost-let a int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let b int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) a))
        (call conn_range g a b)
        (call relax_use g od nd a b)
        (assert (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g r) (get_edge_weight g a b))))))))
(lemma lower_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (od (seq (option int))) (nd (seq (option int))) (k int))
  (requires (wf g) (== (len od) (len g)) (== (len nd) (len g)) (>= k 0)
            (lower g start od k) (le_all nd od) (relaxed g od nd (len g) 0))
  (ensures (lower g start nd (+ k 1)))
  (body (forall ((p (seq int))) (call lower_step_one g start od nd k p))))
(lemma init_state (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (wit (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (== (len d) (len g)) (== (len wit) (len g)) (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
            (== (idx d start) (some 0))
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len d))) (!= x start)) (is none (idx d x))))
            (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len wit))) (== (idx wit y) (seq-lit start)))))
  (ensures (lower g start d 0) (valid_wit g start d wit 0) (bounded d 0))
  (body
    (assert (is_path g (seq-lit start)))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start)) 0))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit start) 0) start))
    (assert (== (len (seq-lit start)) 1))))
(lemma start_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (k int))
  (requires (lower g start d k) (>= k 0) (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g))) (== (len d) (len g)))
  (ensures (is some (idx d start)) (<= (field (idx d start) value) 0))
  (body
    (assert (is_path g (seq-lit start)))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit start) 0) start))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start)) 0))
    (call lower_at g start d k (seq-lit start))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit start) (- (len (seq-lit start)) 1)) start))))

(lemma le_refl (params (d (seq (option int))))
  (ensures (le_all d d))
  (body))
(lemma le_upd (params (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (od (seq (option int))) (v int) (c int))
  (requires (le_all d0 od) (upd_opt d0 d1 v) (== (idx d1 v) (some c))
            (or (is none (idx d0 v)) (< c (field (idx d0 v) value))))
  (ensures (le_all d1 d0) (le_all d1 od))
  (body))
(lemma bounded_at (params (d (seq (option int))) (b int) (x int))
  (requires (bounded d b) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len d))) (is some (idx d x)))
  (ensures (and (<= (* -100000 b) (field (idx d x) value)) (<= (field (idx d x) value) (* 100000 b))))
  (body))
(lemma bounded_upd (params (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (v int) (c int) (b int))
  (requires (bounded d0 b) (upd_opt d0 d1 v) (== (idx d1 v) (some c))
            (<= (* -100000 b) c) (<= c (* 100000 b)))
  (ensures (bounded d1 b))
  (body))
(lemma relaxed_next (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (od (seq (option int))) (nd (seq (option int))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (relaxed g od nd u i) (== (len od) (len g)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (or (is none (idx od u)) (>= i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (relaxed g od nd (+ u 1) 0))
  (body))
(lemma relaxed_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (od (seq (option int))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int)))
                           (u int) (i int) (v int))
  (requires (relaxed g od d0 u i) (le_all d1 d0) (== (len od) (len g)) (== (len d0) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d1)))
            (is some (idx od u))
            (is some (idx d1 v))
            (<= (field (idx d1 v) value) (+ (field (idx od u) value) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
  (ensures (relaxed g od d1 u (+ i 1)))
  (body))
(lemma wit_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (od (seq (option int))) (wit0 (seq (seq int)))
                       (d0 (seq (option int))) (w0 (seq (seq int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (w1 (seq (seq int)))
                       (k int) (u int) (e int) (v int) (w int) (c int))
  (requires (wf g) (== (len od) (len g)) (== (len d0) (len g))
            (valid_wit g start od wit0 k) (valid_wit g start d0 w0 (+ k 1))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g u))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) e) 1) w)
            (is some (idx od u)) (== c (+ (field (idx od u) value) w))
            (upd_opt d0 d1 v) (== (idx d1 v) (some c))
            (upd_seq w0 w1 v) (== (idx w1 v) (concat (idx wit0 u) (seq-lit v))))
  (ensures (valid_wit g start d1 w1 (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (call edge_connected g u e v w)
    (assert (is_path g (idx wit0 u)))
    (assert (== (idx (idx wit0 u) (- (len (idx wit0 u)) 1)) u))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (idx wit0 u)) (field (idx od u) value)))
    (call path_snoc g (idx wit0 u) v)))

(lemma neg_cycle (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (wit (seq (seq int)))
                         (k int) (u int) (e int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (wf g) (== k (- (len g) 1)) (>= k 0) (== (len d) (len g)) (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (lower g start d k) (valid_wit g start d wit k)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g u))))
    (== (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) e) 1) w) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (is some (idx d u))
    (not (and (is some (idx d v)) (<= (field (idx d v) value) (+ (field (idx d u) value) w)))))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (ghost-let wu (seq int) (idx wit u))
    (assert (is_path g wu))
    (assert (and (== (idx wu 0) start) (== (idx wu (- (len wu) 1)) u)))
    (assert (== (path_weight g wu) (field (idx d u) value)))
    (assert (<= (len wu) (+ k 1)))
    (call edge_connected g u e v w)
    (call path_snoc g wu v)
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat wu (seq-lit v)))
    (assert (== (path_weight g q) (+ (field (idx d u) value) w)))
    (if (<= (len q) (+ k 1))
      (call lower_at g start d k q)
      (block
        (call path_in_range g q)
        (if (distinct q) (call pigeon q (len g)) (block))
        (obtain ((i int) (j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len q))) (== (idx q i) (idx q j))))
        (call splice g q i j)
        (call splice_path g q i j)
        (call lower_at g start d k (concat (take q i) (drop q j)))
        (call neg_witness g (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)))))))

(lemma fix_lower (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (wf g) (== (len d) (len g)) (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))

        (and (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len d)))
             (and (is some (idx d (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
                  (<= (field (idx d (idx p (- (len p) 1))) value) (path_weight g p))))))))
(ghost-fn valid_wit ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (wit (seq (seq int))) (k int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len wit) (len d))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d))) (is some (idx d v)))
          (and (is_path g (idx wit v))
               (and (and (== (idx (idx wit v) 0) start) (== (idx (idx wit v) (- (len (idx wit v)) 1)) v))
                    (and (== (path_weight g (idx wit v)) (field (idx d v) value))
                         (<= (len (idx wit v)) (+ k 1))))))))))
(ghost-fn bounded ((d (seq (option int))) (b int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len d))) (is some (idx d x)))
        (and (<= (* -100000 b) (field (idx d x) value)) (<= (field (idx d x) value) (* 100000 b)))))))
(ghost-fn upd_opt ((d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (v int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len d1) (len d0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d0))))
    (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len d0))) (!= x v)) (== (idx d1 x) (idx d0 x)))))))
(ghost-fn upd_seq ((w0 (seq (seq int))) (w1 (seq (seq int))) (v int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len w1) (len w0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len w0))))
    (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len w0))) (!= x v)) (== (idx w1 x) (idx w0 x)))))))
(ghost-fn in_range ((s (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len s))) (and (<= 0 (idx s x)) (< (idx s x) n))))))
(ghost-fn distinct ((s (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((i int) (j int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len s))) (!= (idx s i) (idx s j))))))

(lemma init_facts (params (graph weighted_graph))
  (requires (well_formed graph) (weights_and_size_bounded (view graph)))
  (ensures (== (view graph) (field graph adj)) (wf (view graph)) (<= (len (view graph)) 100000))
  (body (assert (== (view graph) (field graph adj)))))
(lemma edge_info (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (wf g) (weights_and_size_bounded g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len g)))
           (and (<= -100000 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)) (<= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 100000)))
  (body (assert (has_edge g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
(lemma weight_from_unique (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (e int) (i int))
  (requires (wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (and (<= 0 i) (<= i e)) (< e (len (idx g u))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0) v))
  (ensures (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) (get (idx (idx g u) e) 1)))
  (decreases (- e i))
  (body
    (if (< i e)
      (block
        (assert (!= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0)))
        (call weight_from_unique g u v e (+ i 1))
        (assert (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) (weight_from (idx g u) v (+ i 1)))))
      (assert (== (weight_from (idx g u) v i) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))))
(lemma edge_connected (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (e int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g u))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) e) 1) w))
  (ensures (has_edge g u v w) (connected g u v) (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
  (body
    (assert (has_edge g u v w))
    (call weight_from_unique g u v e 0)
    (assert (== (get_edge_weight g u v) (weight_from (idx g u) v 0)))))
(lemma conn_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (wf g) (connected g a b))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))))
  (body
    (obtain ((w0 int)) (has_edge g a b w0))
    (obtain ((e0 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 e0) (< e0 (len (idx g a)))))
                            (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) e0) 0) b) (== (get (idx (idx g a) e0) 1) w0))))))
(lemma relax_use (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (od (seq (option int))) (nd (seq (option int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (wf g) (== (len od) (len g)) (== (len nd) (len g)) (relaxed g od nd (len g) 0)
            (connected g a b) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (is some (idx od a)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))) (is some (idx nd b))
           (<= (field (idx nd b) value) (+ (field (idx od a) value) (get_edge_weight g a b))))
  (body
    (obtain ((w1 int)) (has_edge g a b w1))
    (obtain ((e1 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 e1) (< e1 (len (idx g a)))))
                            (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) e1) 0) b) (== (get (idx (idx g a) e1) 1) w1))))
    (call edge_connected g a e1 b w1)
    (assert (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))))))

(lemma path_link (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx p x) (idx p (+ x 1))))
  (body))
(lemma last_link (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (is_path g p) (>= (len p) 2))
  (ensures (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
  (body
    (call path_link g p (- (len p) 2))
    (assert (== (idx p (+ (- (len p) 2) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))))
(lemma prefix_link (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (m int) (x int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (<= 1 m) (<= m (len p))) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (- m 1))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (take p m) x) (idx (take p m) (+ x 1))))
  (body
    (call path_link g p x)
    (assert (== (idx (take p m) x) (idx p x)))
    (assert (== (idx (take p m) (+ x 1)) (idx p (+ x 1))))))
(lemma path_take (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (and (<= 1 m) (<= m (len p))))
  (ensures (is_path g (take p m)) (== (len (take p m)) m)
           (== (idx (take p m) 0) (idx p 0)) (== (idx (take p m) (- m 1)) (idx p (- m 1))))
  (body
    (forall ((x int)) (call prefix_link g p m x))
    (assert (== (len (take p m)) m))))
(lemma snoc_link (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (v int) (x int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len p))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) x) (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ x 1))))
  (body
    (if (< x (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (call path_link g p x)
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) x) (idx p x)))
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ x 1)) (idx p (+ x 1)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) x) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (+ x 1)) v))))))
(lemma path_snoc (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (is_path g p) (connected g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))
  (ensures (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
           (== (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) (+ (len p) 1))
           (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
           (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1)) v)
           (== (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v))) (+ (path_weight g p) (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))))
  (body
    (forall ((x int)) (call snoc_link g p v x))
    (ghost-let s (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (assert (== (len s) (+ (len p) 1)))
    (assert (== (take s (- (len s) 1)) p))
    (assert (== (idx s 0) (idx p 0)))
    (assert (== (idx s (- (len s) 2)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
    (assert (== (idx s (- (len s) 1)) v))
    (assert (== (path_weight g s)
                (+ (path_weight g (take s (- (len s) 1))) (get_edge_weight g (idx s (- (len s) 2)) (idx s (- (len s) 1))))))))
(lemma vertex_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (wf g) (is_path g p) (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len p))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p x)) (< (idx p x) (len g))))
  (body
    (if (< x (- (len p) 1))
      (block (call path_link g p x) (call conn_range g (idx p x) (idx p (+ x 1))))
      (assert (== (idx p x) (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))))
(lemma path_in_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (wf g) (is_path g p) (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len g))))
  (ensures (in_range p (len g)))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call vertex_range g p x))))

(lemma split (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len s))))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g s) (+ (path_weight g (take s (+ m 1))) (path_weight g (drop s m)))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== m (- (len s) 1))
      (block
        (assert (== (take s (+ m 1)) s))
        (assert (== (len (drop s m)) 1))
        (assert (== (path_weight g (drop s m)) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let r (seq int) (take s (- (len s) 1)))
        (ghost-let d (seq int) (drop s m))
        (call split g r m)
        (assert (== (take r (+ m 1)) (take s (+ m 1))))
        (assert (== (len d) (- (len s) m)))
        (assert (== (take d (- (len d) 1)) (drop r m)))
        (assert (== (idx d (- (len d) 2)) (idx s (- (len s) 2))))
        (assert (== (idx d (- (len d) 1)) (idx s (- (len s) 1))))
        (assert (== (path_weight g s)
                    (+ (path_weight g r) (get_edge_weight g (idx s (- (len s) 2)) (idx s (- (len s) 1))))))
        (assert (== (path_weight g d)
                    (+ (path_weight g (take d (- (len d) 1))) (get_edge_weight g (idx d (- (len d) 2)) (idx d (- (len d) 1))))))))))
(lemma splice (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (q (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len q))) (== (idx q i) (idx q j)))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g q)
               (+ (path_weight g (concat (take q i) (drop q j))) (path_weight g (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1))))))
  (body
    (ghost-let dq (seq int) (drop q i))
    (ghost-let q2 (seq int) (concat (take q i) (drop q j)))
    (call split g q i)
    (call split g dq (- j i))
    (assert (== (drop dq (- j i)) (drop q j)))
    (assert (== (len q2) (+ i (- (len q) j))))
    (call split g q2 i)
    (assert (== (take q2 (+ i 1)) (take q (+ i 1))))
    (assert (== (drop q2 i) (drop q j)))))
(lemma slice_link (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (q (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (x int))
  (requires (is_path g q) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len q))) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (- j i))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)) x) (idx (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)) (+ x 1))))
  (body
    (call path_link g q (+ i x))
    (assert (== (idx (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)) x) (idx q (+ i x))))
    (assert (== (idx (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)) (+ x 1)) (idx q (+ (+ i x) 1))))))
(lemma join_link (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (q (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (y int))
  (requires (is_path g q) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len q))) (== (idx q i) (idx q j))
            (and (<= 0 y) (< y (- (- (len q) (- j i)) 1))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) y) (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) (+ y 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (concat (take q i) (drop q j))) (- (len q) (- j i))))
    (if (< (+ y 1) i)
      (block
        (call path_link g q y)
        (assert (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) y) (idx q y)))
        (assert (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) (+ y 1)) (idx q (+ y 1)))))
      (if (== (+ y 1) i)
        (block
          (call path_link g q y)
          (assert (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) y) (idx q y)))
          (assert (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) (+ y 1)) (idx q j)))
          (assert (== (idx q (+ y 1)) (idx q i))))
        (block
          (call path_link g q (+ (- y i) j))
          (assert (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) y) (idx q (+ (- y i) j))))
          (assert (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) (+ y 1)) (idx q (+ (+ (- y i) j) 1)))))))))
(lemma splice_path (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (q (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (is_path g q) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len q))) (== (idx q i) (idx q j)))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)))
    (> (len (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1))) 1)
    (== (idx (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)) 0)
        (idx (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)) (- (len (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1))) 1)))
    (is_path g (concat (take q i) (drop q j)))
    (== (len (concat (take q i) (drop q j))) (- (len q) (- j i)))
    (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) 0) (idx q 0))
    (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) (- (len (concat (take q i) (drop q j))) 1)) (idx q (- (len q) 1))))
  (body
    (forall ((x int)) (call slice_link g q i j x))
    (forall ((y int)) (call join_link g q i j y))
    (assert (== (len (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1))) (+ (- j i) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)) 0) (idx q i)))
    (assert (== (idx (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)) (- j i)) (idx q j)))
    (assert (== (len (concat (take q i) (drop q j))) (- (len q) (- j i))))
    (assert (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) 0) (idx q 0)))
    (assert (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) (- (- (len q) (- j i)) 1)) (idx q (- (len q) 1))))))
(lemma pigeon (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (>= n 0) (in_range s n) (distinct s))
  (ensures (<= (len s) n))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if (== n 0)
      (if (> (len s) 0) (assert (and (<= 0 (idx s 0)) (< (idx s 0) n))) (block))
      (block
        (call law_contains s (- n 1))
        (if (contains s (- n 1))
          (block
            (obtain ((k int)) (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s))) (== (idx s k) (- n 1))))
            (ghost-let t (seq int) (seq-build (- (len s) 1) (fn (m) (if (< m k) (idx s m) (idx s (+ m 1))))))
            (assert (== (len t) (- (len s) 1)))
            (assert (in_range t (- n 1)))
            (assert (distinct t))
            (call pigeon t (- n 1)))
          (block
            (assert (in_range s (- n 1)))
            (call pigeon s (- n 1))))))))
(lemma neg_witness (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)))
  (requires (is_path g c) (> (len c) 1) (== (idx c 0) (idx c (- (len c) 1))) (< (path_weight g c) 0))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body))

(lemma lower_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (k int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (lower g start d k) (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) start) (<= (len p) (+ k 1)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len d)))
           (is some (idx d (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
           (<= (field (idx d (idx p (- (len p) 1))) value) (path_weight g p)))
  (body))
(lemma lower_step_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (od (seq (option int))) (nd (seq (option int))) (k int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (wf g) (== (len od) (len g)) (== (len nd) (len g)) (>= k 0)
            (lower g start od k) (le_all nd od) (relaxed g od nd (len g) 0)
            (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) start) (<= (len p) (+ k 2)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len nd)))
           (is some (idx nd (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
           (<= (field (idx nd (idx p (- (len p) 1))) value) (path_weight g p)))
  (body
    (if (<= (len p) (+ k 1))
      (call lower_at g start od k p)
      (block
        (ghost-let r (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call path_take g p (- (len p) 1))
        (call lower_at g start od k r)
        (call last_link g p)
        (ghost-let a int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let b int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) a))
        (call conn_range g a b)
        (call relax_use g od nd a b)
        (assert (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g r) (get_edge_weight g a b))))))))
(lemma lower_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (od (seq (option int))) (nd (seq (option int))) (k int))
  (requires (wf g) (== (len od) (len g)) (== (len nd) (len g)) (>= k 0)
            (lower g start od k) (le_all nd od) (relaxed g od nd (len g) 0))
  (ensures (lower g start nd (+ k 1)))
  (body (forall ((p (seq int))) (call lower_step_one g start od nd k p))))
(lemma init_state (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (wit (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (== (len d) (len g)) (== (len wit) (len g)) (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
            (== (idx d start) (some 0))
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len d))) (!= x start)) (is none (idx d x))))
            (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len wit))) (== (idx wit y) (seq-lit start)))))
  (ensures (lower g start d 0) (valid_wit g start d wit 0) (bounded d 0))
  (body
    (assert (is_path g (seq-lit start)))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start)) 0))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit start) 0) start))
    (assert (== (len (seq-lit start)) 1))))
(lemma start_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (k int))
  (requires (lower g start d k) (>= k 0) (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g))) (== (len d) (len g)))
  (ensures (is some (idx d start)) (<= (field (idx d start) value) 0))
  (body
    (assert (is_path g (seq-lit start)))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit start) 0) start))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start)) 0))
    (call lower_at g start d k (seq-lit start))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit start) (- (len (seq-lit start)) 1)) start))))

(lemma le_refl (params (d (seq (option int))))
  (ensures (le_all d d))
  (body))
(lemma le_upd (params (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (od (seq (option int))) (v int) (c int))
  (requires (le_all d0 od) (upd_opt d0 d1 v) (== (idx d1 v) (some c))
            (or (is none (idx d0 v)) (< c (field (idx d0 v) value))))
  (ensures (le_all d1 d0) (le_all d1 od))
  (body))
(lemma bounded_at (params (d (seq (option int))) (b int) (x int))
  (requires (bounded d b) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len d))) (is some (idx d x)))
  (ensures (and (<= (* -100000 b) (field (idx d x) value)) (<= (field (idx d x) value) (* 100000 b))))
  (body))
(lemma bounded_upd (params (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (v int) (c int) (b int))
  (requires (bounded d0 b) (upd_opt d0 d1 v) (== (idx d1 v) (some c))
            (<= (* -100000 b) c) (<= c (* 100000 b)))
  (ensures (bounded d1 b))
  (body))
(lemma relaxed_next (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (od (seq (option int))) (nd (seq (option int))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (relaxed g od nd u i) (== (len od) (len g)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (or (is none (idx od u)) (>= i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (relaxed g od nd (+ u 1) 0))
  (body))
(lemma relaxed_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (od (seq (option int))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int)))
                           (u int) (i int) (v int))
  (requires (relaxed g od d0 u i) (le_all d1 d0) (== (len od) (len g)) (== (len d0) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d1)))
            (is some (idx od u))
            (is some (idx d1 v))
            (<= (field (idx d1 v) value) (+ (field (idx od u) value) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
  (ensures (relaxed g od d1 u (+ i 1)))
  (body))
(lemma wit_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (od (seq (option int))) (wit0 (seq (seq int)))
                       (d0 (seq (option int))) (w0 (seq (seq int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (w1 (seq (seq int)))

  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p x)) (< (idx p x) (len g))))
  (body
    (if (< x (- (len p) 1))
      (block (call path_link g p x) (call conn_range g (idx p x) (idx p (+ x 1))))
      (assert (== (idx p x) (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))))
(lemma path_in_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (wf g) (is_path g p) (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len g))))
  (ensures (in_range p (len g)))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call vertex_range g p x))))

(lemma drop_concat_at (params (s (seq int)) (t (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len t))))
  (ensures (== (idx (drop (concat s t) (len s)) x) (idx t x)))
  (body
    (call law_len_nonneg s)
    (call law_len_concat s t)
    (call law_idx_drop (concat s t) (len s) x)
    (call law_idx_concat s t (+ x (len s)))))
(lemma drop_concat (params (s (seq int)) (t (seq int)))
  (ensures (== (drop (concat s t) (len s)) t))
  (body
    (call law_len_nonneg s)
    (call law_len_concat s t)
    (call law_len_drop (concat s t) (len s))
    (forall ((x int)) (call drop_concat_at s t x))
    (call law_seq_ext (drop (concat s t) (len s)) t)))

(lemma split (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len s))))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g s) (+ (path_weight g (take s (+ m 1))) (path_weight g (drop s m)))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== m (- (len s) 1))
      (block
        (assert (== (take s (+ m 1)) s))
        (assert (== (len (drop s m)) 1))
        (assert (== (path_weight g (drop s m)) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let r (seq int) (take s (- (len s) 1)))
        (ghost-let d (seq int) (drop s m))
        (call split g r m)
        (assert (== (take r (+ m 1)) (take s (+ m 1))))
        (assert (== (len d) (- (len s) m)))
        (assert (== (take d (- (len d) 1)) (drop r m)))
        (assert (== (idx d (- (len d) 2)) (idx s (- (len s) 2))))
        (assert (== (idx d (- (len d) 1)) (idx s (- (len s) 1))))
        (assert (== (path_weight g s)
                    (+ (path_weight g r) (get_edge_weight g (idx s (- (len s) 2)) (idx s (- (len s) 1))))))
        (assert (== (path_weight g d)
                    (+ (path_weight g (take d (- (len d) 1))) (get_edge_weight g (idx d (- (len d) 2)) (idx d (- (len d) 1))))))))))
(lemma splice (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (q (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len q))) (== (idx q i) (idx q j)))
  (ensures (== (path_weight g q)
               (+ (path_weight g (concat (take q i) (drop q j))) (path_weight g (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1))))))
  (body
    (ghost-let dq (seq int) (drop q i))
    (ghost-let q2 (seq int) (concat (take q i) (drop q j)))
    (call split g q i)
    (call split g dq (- j i))
    (assert (== (drop dq (- j i)) (drop q j)))
    (assert (== (len q2) (+ i (- (len q) j))))
    (call split g q2 i)
    (assert (== (take q2 (+ i 1)) (take q (+ i 1))))
    (call law_len_take q i)
    (call drop_concat (take q i) (drop q j))
    (assert (== (drop q2 i) (drop q j)))))
(lemma slice_link (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (q (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (x int))
  (requires (is_path g q) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len q))) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (- j i))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)) x) (idx (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)) (+ x 1))))
  (body
    (call path_link g q (+ i x))
    (assert (== (idx (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)) x) (idx q (+ i x))))
    (assert (== (idx (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)) (+ x 1)) (idx q (+ (+ i x) 1))))))
(lemma join_link (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (q (seq int)) (i int) (j int) (y int))
  (requires (is_path g q) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len q))) (== (idx q i) (idx q j))
            (and (<= 0 y) (< y (- (- (len q) (- j i)) 1))))
  (ensures (connected g (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) y) (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) (+ y 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (concat (take q i) (drop q j))) (- (len q) (- j i))))
    (if (< (+ y 1) i)
      (block
        (call path_link g q y)
        (assert (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) y) (idx q y)))
        (assert (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) (+ y 1)) (idx q (+ y 1)))))
      (if (== (+ y 1) i)
        (block
          (call path_link g q y)
          (assert (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) y) (idx q y)))
          (assert (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) (+ y 1)) (idx q j)))
          (assert (== (idx q (+ y 1)) (idx q i))))
        (block
          (call path_link g q (+ (- y i) j))
          (assert (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) y) (idx q (+ (- y i) j))))
          (assert (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) (+ y 1)) (idx q (+ (+ (- y i) j) 1)))))))))
(lemma splice_path (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (q (seq int)) (i int) (j int))
  (requires (is_path g q) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len q))) (== (idx q i) (idx q j)))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)))
    (> (len (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1))) 1)
    (== (idx (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)) 0)
        (idx (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)) (- (len (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1))) 1)))
    (is_path g (concat (take q i) (drop q j)))
    (== (len (concat (take q i) (drop q j))) (- (len q) (- j i)))
    (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) 0) (idx q 0))
    (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) (- (len (concat (take q i) (drop q j))) 1)) (idx q (- (len q) 1))))
  (body
    (forall ((x int)) (call slice_link g q i j x))
    (forall ((y int)) (call join_link g q i j y))
    (assert (== (len (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1))) (+ (- j i) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)) 0) (idx q i)))
    (assert (== (idx (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)) (- j i)) (idx q j)))
    (assert (== (len (concat (take q i) (drop q j))) (- (len q) (- j i))))
    (assert (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) 0) (idx q 0)))
    (assert (== (idx (concat (take q i) (drop q j)) (- (- (len q) (- j i)) 1)) (idx q (- (len q) 1))))))
(lemma pigeon (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (>= n 0) (in_range s n) (distinct s))
  (ensures (<= (len s) n))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if (== n 0)
      (if (> (len s) 0) (assert (and (<= 0 (idx s 0)) (< (idx s 0) n))) (block))
      (block
        (call law_contains s (- n 1))
        (if (contains s (- n 1))
          (block
            (obtain ((k int)) (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s))) (== (idx s k) (- n 1))))
            (ghost-let t (seq int) (seq-build (- (len s) 1) (fn (m) (if (< m k) (idx s m) (idx s (+ m 1))))))
            (assert (== (len t) (- (len s) 1)))
            (assert (in_range t (- n 1)))
            (assert (distinct t))
            (call pigeon t (- n 1)))
          (block
            (assert (in_range s (- n 1)))
            (call pigeon s (- n 1))))))))
(lemma neg_witness (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)))
  (requires (is_path g c) (> (len c) 1) (== (idx c 0) (idx c (- (len c) 1))) (< (path_weight g c) 0))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body))

(lemma lower_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (k int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (lower g start d k) (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) start) (<= (len p) (+ k 1)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len d)))
           (is some (idx d (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
           (<= (field (idx d (idx p (- (len p) 1))) value) (path_weight g p)))
  (body))
(lemma lower_step_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (od (seq (option int))) (nd (seq (option int))) (k int) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (wf g) (== (len od) (len g)) (== (len nd) (len g)) (>= k 0)
            (lower g start od k) (le_all nd od) (relaxed g od nd (len g) 0)
            (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) start) (<= (len p) (+ k 2)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len nd)))
           (is some (idx nd (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
           (<= (field (idx nd (idx p (- (len p) 1))) value) (path_weight g p)))
  (body
    (if (<= (len p) (+ k 1))
      (call lower_at g start od k p)
      (block
        (ghost-let r (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call path_take g p (- (len p) 1))
        (call lower_at g start od k r)
        (call last_link g p)
        (ghost-let a int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let b int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) a))
        (call conn_range g a b)
        (call relax_use g od nd a b)
        (assert (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g r) (get_edge_weight g a b))))))))
(lemma lower_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (od (seq (option int))) (nd (seq (option int))) (k int))
  (requires (wf g) (== (len od) (len g)) (== (len nd) (len g)) (>= k 0)
            (lower g start od k) (le_all nd od) (relaxed g od nd (len g) 0))
  (ensures (lower g start nd (+ k 1)))
  (body (forall ((p (seq int))) (call lower_step_one g start od nd k p))))
(lemma init_state (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (wit (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (== (len d) (len g)) (== (len wit) (len g)) (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
            (== (idx d start) (some 0))
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len d))) (!= x start)) (is none (idx d x))))
            (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len wit))) (== (idx wit y) (seq-lit start)))))
  (ensures (lower g start d 0) (valid_wit g start d wit 0) (bounded d 0))
  (body
    (assert (is_path g (seq-lit start)))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start)) 0))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit start) 0) start))
    (assert (== (len (seq-lit start)) 1))))
(lemma start_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (k int))
  (requires (lower g start d k) (>= k 0) (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g))) (== (len d) (len g)))
  (ensures (is some (idx d start)) (<= (field (idx d start) value) 0))
  (body
    (assert (is_path g (seq-lit start)))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit start) 0) start))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (seq-lit start)) 0))
    (call lower_at g start d k (seq-lit start))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit start) (- (len (seq-lit start)) 1)) start))))

(lemma le_refl (params (d (seq (option int))))
  (ensures (le_all d d))
  (body))
(lemma le_upd (params (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (od (seq (option int))) (v int) (c int))
  (requires (le_all d0 od) (upd_opt d0 d1 v) (== (idx d1 v) (some c))
            (or (is none (idx d0 v)) (< c (field (idx d0 v) value))))
  (ensures (le_all d1 d0) (le_all d1 od))
  (body))
(lemma bounded_at (params (d (seq (option int))) (b int) (x int))
  (requires (bounded d b) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len d))) (is some (idx d x)))
  (ensures (and (<= (* -100000 b) (field (idx d x) value)) (<= (field (idx d x) value) (* 100000 b))))
  (body))
(lemma bounded_upd (params (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (v int) (c int) (b int))
  (requires (bounded d0 b) (upd_opt d0 d1 v) (== (idx d1 v) (some c))
            (<= (* -100000 b) c) (<= c (* 100000 b)))
  (ensures (bounded d1 b))
  (body))
(lemma relaxed_next (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (od (seq (option int))) (nd (seq (option int))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (relaxed g od nd u i) (== (len od) (len g)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (or (is none (idx od u)) (>= i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (relaxed g od nd (+ u 1) 0))
  (body))
(lemma relaxed_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (od (seq (option int))) (d0 (seq (option int))) (d1 (seq (option int)))
                           (u int) (i int) (v int))
  (requires (relaxed g od d0 u i) (le_all d1 d0) (== (len od) (len g)) (== (len d0) (len g))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len d1)))
            (is some (idx od u))
            (is some (idx d1 v))
            (<= (field (idx d1 v) value) (+ (field (idx od u) value) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
  (ensures (relaxed g od d1 u (+ i 1)))
  (body))
(lemma wit_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (od (seq (option int))) (wit0 (seq (seq int)))
                       (d0 (seq (option int))) (w0 (seq (seq int))) (d1 (seq (option int))) (w1 (seq (seq int)))
                       (k int) (u int) (e int) (v int) (w int) (c int))
  (requires (wf g) (== (len od) (len g)) (== (len d0) (len g))
            (valid_wit g start od wit0 k) (valid_wit g start d0 w0 (+ k 1))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g u))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) e) 1) w)
            (is some (idx od u)) (== c (+ (field (idx od u) value) w))
            (upd_opt d0 d1 v) (== (idx d1 v) (some c))
            (upd_seq w0 w1 v) (== (idx w1 v) (concat (idx wit0 u) (seq-lit v))))
  (ensures (valid_wit g start d1 w1 (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (call edge_connected g u e v w)
    (assert (is_path g (idx wit0 u)))
    (assert (== (idx (idx wit0 u) (- (len (idx wit0 u)) 1)) u))
    (assert (== (path_weight g (idx wit0 u)) (field (idx od u) value)))
    (call path_snoc g (idx wit0 u) v)))

(lemma neg_cycle (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (wit (seq (seq int)))
                         (k int) (u int) (e int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (wf g) (== k (- (len g) 1)) (>= k 0) (== (len d) (len g)) (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (lower g start d k) (valid_wit g start d wit k)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g u))))
    (== (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) e) 1) w) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
    (is some (idx d u))
    (not (and (is some (idx d v)) (<= (field (idx d v) value) (+ (field (idx d u) value) w)))))
  (ensures (has_negative_cycle g))
  (body
    (ghost-let wu (seq int) (idx wit u))
    (assert (is_path g wu))
    (assert (and (== (idx wu 0) start) (== (idx wu (- (len wu) 1)) u)))
    (assert (== (path_weight g wu) (field (idx d u) value)))
    (assert (<= (len wu) (+ k 1)))
    (call edge_connected g u e v w)
    (call path_snoc g wu v)
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat wu (seq-lit v)))
    (assert (== (path_weight g q) (+ (field (idx d u) value) w)))
    (if (<= (len q) (+ k 1))
      (call lower_at g start d k q)
      (block
        (call path_in_range g q)
        (if (distinct q) (call pigeon q (len g)) (block))
        (obtain ((i int) (j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i j)) (< j (len q))) (== (idx q i) (idx q j))))
        (call splice g q i j)
        (call splice_path g q i j)
        (call lower_at g start d k (concat (take q i) (drop q j)))
        (call neg_witness g (take (drop q i) (+ (- j i) 1)))))))

(lemma fix_lower (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (d (seq (option int))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (wf g) (== (len d) (len g)) (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
            (relaxed g d d (len g) 0) (is some (idx d start)) (<= (field (idx d start) value) 0)
            (is_path g p) (== (idx p 0) start))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len d)))
           (is some (idx d (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
           (<= (field (idx d (idx p (- (len p) 1))) value) (path_weight g p)))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (< (len p) 2)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) start))
        (assert (== (path_weight g p) 0)))
      (block
        (ghost-let r (seq int) (take p (- (len p) 1)))
        (call path_take g p (- (len p) 1))
        (call fix_lower g start d r)
        (call last_link g p)
        (ghost-let a int (idx p (- (len p) 2)))
        (ghost-let b int (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) a))
        (call conn_range g a b)
        (call relax_use g d d a b)
        (assert (== (path_weight g p) (+ (path_weight g r) (get_edge_weight g a b))))))))
(lemma final_one (params (graph weighted_graph) (start i64) (dists (vec (option i64))) (wit (seq (seq int))) (k int) (v int))
  (requires (wf (view graph)) (== (len dists) (len (view graph))) (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len (view graph))))
            (relaxed (view graph) dists dists (len (view graph)) 0)
            (valid_wit (view graph) start dists wit k)
            (is some (idx dists start)) (<= (field (idx dists start) value) 0)
            (== (size graph) (len (view graph)))
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size graph))))
  (ensures (match (idx dists v)
             (case (none) (forall ((p (seq int)))
                            (=> (and (is_path (view graph) p) (and (== (idx p 0) start) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false)))
             (case (some d) (is_shortest_dist (view graph) start v d))))
  (body
    (forall ((p0 (seq int))) (call fix_lower (view graph) start dists p0))
    (if (is some (idx dists v))
      (block
        (assert (and (and (is_path (view graph) (idx wit v))
                          (and (== (idx (idx wit v) 0) start) (== (idx (idx wit v) (- (len (idx wit v)) 1)) v)))
                     (== (path_weight (view graph) (idx wit v)) (field (idx dists v) value))))
        (assert (is_shortest_dist (view graph) start v (field (idx dists v) value))))
      (block))))
(lemma final_ok (params (graph weighted_graph) (start i64) (dists (vec (option i64))) (wit (seq (seq int))) (k int))
  (requires (wf (view graph)) (== (len dists) (len (view graph))) (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len (view graph))))
            (relaxed (view graph) dists dists (len (view graph)) 0)
            (valid_wit (view graph) start dists wit k)
            (is some (idx dists start)) (<= (field (idx dists start) value) 0))
  (ensures (and (== (len dists) (size graph))
                (forall ((v int))
                  (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size graph)))
                      (match (idx dists v)
                        (case (none) (forall ((p (seq int)))
                                       (=> (and (is_path (view graph) p) (and (== (idx p 0) start) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) false)))
                        (case (some d) (is_shortest_dist (view graph) start v d)))))))
  (body
    (assert (== (size graph) (len (view graph))))
    (forall ((v0 int)) (call final_one graph start dists wit k v0))))

(def bellman_ford
  (body
    (call init_facts graph)
    (ghost-let gv (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut dist (vec (option i64)) (seq-build n (fn (j0) (none))))
    (set-idx dist start (some 0))
    (ghost-let-mut wit (seq (seq int)) (seq-build n (fn (j1) (seq-lit start))))
    (call init_state gv start dist wit)
    (let-mut k i64 0)
    (while (< k (- n 1))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (- n 1))))
      (invariant (and (== (len dist) n) (== (len wit) n)))
      (invariant (lower gv start dist k))
      (invariant (valid_wit gv start dist wit k))
      (invariant (bounded dist k))
      (decreases (- n k))
      (let old (vec (option i64)) (seq-build n (fn (j2) (idx dist j2))))
      (assert (== (len old) n))
      (assert (== old dist))
      (ghost-let wit0 (seq (seq int)) wit)
      (assert (lower gv start old k))
      (assert (valid_wit gv start old wit0 k))
      (assert (bounded old k))
      (let-mut u i64 0)
      (while (< u n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
        (invariant (and (== (len dist) n) (== (len wit) n)))
        (invariant (le_all dist old))
        (invariant (relaxed gv old dist u 0))
        (invariant (valid_wit gv start dist wit (+ k 1)))
        (invariant (bounded dist (+ k 1)))
        (decreases (- n u))
        (let ou (option i64) (idx old u))
        (match ou
          (case (none) (call relaxed_next gv old dist u 0))
          (case (some du)
            (block
              (call bounded_at old k u)
              (let deg i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) u)))
              (let-mut i i64 0)
              (while (< i deg)
                (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i deg)))
                (invariant (and (== (len dist) n) (== (len wit) n)))
                (invariant (le_all dist old))
                (invariant (relaxed gv old dist u i))
                (invariant (valid_wit gv start dist wit (+ k 1)))
                (invariant (bounded dist (+ k 1)))
                (decreases (- deg i))
                (let ed (tuple i64 i64) (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i))
                (let v i64 (get ed 0))
                (let w i64 (get ed 1))

  (ensures
    (== (len (cc_zero_counts coins)) (len coins))
    (cc_nonnegative (cc_zero_counts coins)))
  (decreases (len coins))
  (body
    (if (> (len coins) 0)
      (block
        (call cc_zero_shape (drop coins 1))
        (assert
          (==
            (cc_zero_counts coins)
            (concat
              (seq-lit 0)
              (cc_zero_counts (drop coins 1))))))
      (block))))

(lemma cc_zero_amount
  (params (coins (seq int)))
  (ensures
    (== (total_amount (cc_zero_counts coins) coins) 0))
  (decreases (len coins))
  (body
    (call cc_zero_shape coins)
    (if (> (len coins) 0)
      (block
        (call cc_zero_amount (drop coins 1))
        (assert
          (==
            (cc_zero_counts coins)
            (concat
              (seq-lit 0)
              (cc_zero_counts (drop coins 1)))))
        (assert
          (==
            (drop (cc_zero_counts coins) 1)
            (cc_zero_counts (drop coins 1))))
        (assert (== (idx (cc_zero_counts coins) 0) 0)))
      (block))))

(lemma cc_zero_total_coins

(lemma cc_zero_facts
  (params (coins (seq int)))
  (ensures
    (== (len (cc_zero_counts coins)) (len coins))
    (cc_nonnegative (cc_zero_counts coins))
    (is_valid_change (cc_zero_counts coins) coins 0)
    (== (total_coins (cc_zero_counts coins)) 0))
  (body
    (call cc_zero_shape coins)
    (call cc_zero_amount coins)
    (call cc_zero_total_coins coins)
    (assert
      (is_valid_change
        (cc_zero_counts coins)
        coins
        0))))

(lemma cc_coin_count_nonnegative
  (params (counts (seq int)))
  (requires (cc_nonnegative counts))
  (ensures (>= (total_coins counts) 0))
  (decreases (len counts))
  (body
    (if (> (len counts) 0)
      (block
        (assert (cc_nonnegative (drop counts 1)))
        (call cc_coin_count_nonnegative (drop counts 1)))
      (block))))

(lemma cc_amount_nonnegative
  (params (counts (seq int)) (coins (seq int)))
  (requires
    (== (len counts) (len coins))
    (cc_nonnegative counts)
    (cc_positive coins))
  (ensures (>= (total_amount counts coins) 0))
  (decreases (len counts))
  (body
    (if (> (len counts) 0)
      (block
        (assert
          (== (len (drop counts 1))
              (len (drop coins 1))))
        (assert (cc_nonnegative (drop counts 1)))
        (assert (cc_positive (drop coins 1)))
        (call cc_amount_nonnegative
          (drop counts 1)

      (block))))

(lemma cc_valid_tail
  (params
    (counts (seq int))
    (coins (seq int))
    (value int))
  (requires
    (is_valid_change counts coins value)
    (> (len counts) 0))
  (ensures
    (is_valid_change
      (drop counts 1)
      (drop coins 1)
      (- value
         (* (idx counts 0) (idx coins 0)))))
  (body
    (assert
      (== (len (drop counts 1))
          (len (drop coins 1))))
    (assert (cc_nonnegative counts))
    (assert (cc_nonnegative (drop counts 1)))
    (assert
      (==
        (total_amount (drop counts 1) (drop coins 1))
        (- value
           (* (idx counts 0) (idx coins 0)))))
    (assert
      (is_valid_change
        (drop counts 1)
        (drop coins 1)
        (- value
           (* (idx counts 0) (idx coins 0)))))))

(lemma cc_count_le_amount
  (params

    (coins (seq int))
    (value int))

    (is_valid_change counts coins value)
    (cc_positive coins))
  (ensures (<= (total_coins counts) value))
  (decreases (len counts))
  (body
    (if (> (len counts) 0)
      (block
        (call cc_valid_tail counts coins value)
        (assert (cc_positive (drop coins 1)))
        (call cc_count_le_amount
          (drop counts 1)
          (drop coins 1)
          (- value
             (* (idx counts 0) (idx coins 0)))))
      (block))))

(lemma cc_increment_len

  (decreases (len counts))
  (body
    (if (> j 0)
      (block
        (call cc_increment_len
          (drop counts 1)
          (- j 1))
        (assert
          (==
            (cc_increment counts j)
            (concat
              (seq-lit (idx counts 0))
              (cc_increment (drop counts 1) (- j 1))))))
      (assert
        (==
          (cc_increment counts j)
          (concat
            (seq-lit (+ (idx counts 0) 1))
            (drop counts 1)))))))

(lemma cc_add_coin
  (params
    (counts (seq int))
    (coins (seq int))
    (value int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (is_valid_change counts coins value)
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len coins))))
  (ensures
    (== (len (cc_increment counts j)) (len coins))
    (cc_nonnegative (cc_increment counts j))
    (is_valid_change
      (cc_increment counts j)
      coins
      (+ value (idx coins j)))
    (==
      (total_coins (cc_increment counts j))
      (+ (total_coins counts) 1)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len counts) (len coins)))
    (assert (cc_nonnegative counts))
    (call cc_increment_len counts j)
    (call cc_increment_nonnegative counts j)
    (call cc_increment_amount counts coins j)
    (call cc_increment_total counts j)
    (assert
      (is_valid_change
        (cc_increment counts j)
        coins
        (+ value (idx coins j))))))

(lemma cc_has_positive_count
  (params
    (counts (seq int))
    (coins (seq int))
    (value int))
  (requires
    (is_valid_change counts coins value)
    (cc_positive coins)
    (> value 0))
  (ensures
    (exists ((j int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len counts)))
        (> (idx counts j) 0))))
  (decreases (len counts))
  (body
    (if (> (len counts) 0)
      (if (> (idx counts 0) 0)
        (block)
        (block
          (call cc_valid_tail counts coins value)
          (assert (cc_positive (drop coins 1)))
          (assert
            (==
              (- value
                 (* (idx counts 0) (idx coins 0)))
              value))
          (call cc_has_positive_count
            (drop counts 1)
            (drop coins 1)
            value)))
      (block))))

(lemma cc_uses_step
  (params (counts (seq int)) (j int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len counts))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (cc_uses_before counts (+ j 1))
      (or
        (cc_uses_before counts j)
        (> (idx counts j) 0))))
  (body
    (if (cc_uses_before counts (+ j 1))
      (block
        (obtain ((w int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 w) (< w (+ j 1)))
            (and (< w (len counts))
                 (> (idx counts w) 0))))
        (if (< w j)
          (assert (cc_uses_before counts j))
          (assert (== w j))))
      (block))))

(lemma cc_no_large_coin
  (params
    (counts (seq int))
    (coins (seq int))
    (value int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (is_valid_change counts coins value)
    (cc_positive coins)
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len coins)))
    (< value (idx coins j)))
  (ensures (not (> (idx counts j) 0)))
  (body
    (if (> (idx counts j) 0)
      (block
        (call cc_remove_coin counts coins value j)
        (call cc_amount_nonnegative
          (cc_decrement counts j)
          coins))
      (block))))

(lemma cc_base_cell
  (params (coins (seq int)) (infinity int))
  (requires (> infinity 0))
  (ensures (cc_cell coins 0 0 infinity))
  (body
    (call cc_zero_facts coins)
    (forall ((counts (seq int)))
      (call cc_coin_count_nonnegative counts))))

(lemma cc_single_prefix

    (infinity int))
  (requires
    (> (len table) 0)
    (== (idx table 0) 0)
    (cc_cell coins 0 0 infinity))
  (ensures (cc_prefix table coins 1 infinity))
  (body))

(lemma cc_empty_partial
  (params
    (coins (seq int))
    (value int)
    (infinity int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 value) (> infinity value)))
  (ensures
    (cc_partial coins value 0 infinity infinity))
  (body))

(lemma cc_relax
  (params
    (table (seq int))
    (coins (seq int))
    (value int)
    (j int)
    (old_best int)
    (new_best int)
    (infinity int))
  (requires
    (cc_positive coins)
    (cc_prefix table coins value infinity)
    (cc_partial coins value j old_best infinity)
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len coins)))
    (and (> value 0) (< value (len table)))
    (> infinity value)
    (==
      new_best
      (if (<= (idx coins j) value)
        (if (!= (idx table (- value (idx coins j))) infinity)
          (if
            (< (+ (idx table (- value (idx coins j))) 1)
               old_best)
            (+ (idx table (- value (idx coins j))) 1)
            old_best)
          old_best)
        old_best)))
  (ensures
    (cc_partial
      coins
      value
      (+ j 1)
      new_best
      infinity))
  (body
    (forall ((counts (seq int)))
      (call cc_uses_step counts j))
    (forall ((counts (seq int)))
      (call cc_remove_coin counts coins value j))
    (forall ((counts (seq int)))
      (call cc_amount_nonnegative counts coins))
    (if (<= (idx coins j) value)
      (block
        (assert
          (cc_cell
            coins
            (- value (idx coins j))
            (idx table (- value (idx coins j)))
            infinity))
        (if (!= (idx table (- value (idx coins j))) infinity)
          (block
            (obtain ((base_counts (seq int)))
              (and
                (is_valid_change
                  base_counts
                  coins
                  (- value (idx coins j)))
                (==
                  (total_coins base_counts)
                  (idx table (- value (idx coins j))))))
            (call cc_count_le_amount
              base_counts
              coins
              (- value (idx coins j)))
            (call cc_add_coin
              base_counts
              coins
              (- value (idx coins j))
              j)
            (assert
              (<
                (+ (idx table (- value (idx coins j))) 1)
                infinity))
            (if
              (< (+ (idx table (- value (idx coins j))) 1)
                 old_best)
              (block
                (assert
                  (==
                    new_best
                    (+ (idx table (- value (idx coins j))) 1))))
              (block
                (assert (== new_best old_best))
                (assert (!= old_best infinity))
                (obtain ((old_counts (seq int)))
                  (and
                    (and
                      (is_valid_change old_counts coins value)
                      (cc_uses_before old_counts j))
                    (== (total_coins old_counts) old_best))))))
          (block
            (assert (== new_best old_best))
            (if (!= old_best infinity)
              (obtain ((old_counts2 (seq int)))
                (and
                  (and
                    (is_valid_change old_counts2 coins value)
                    (cc_uses_before old_counts2 j))
                  (== (total_coins old_counts2) old_best)))
              (block))))
        (assert
          (cc_partial
            coins
            value
            (+ j 1)
            new_best
            infinity)))
      (block
        (assert (== new_best old_best))
        (forall ((counts (seq int)))
          (call cc_no_large_coin counts coins value j))
        (if (!= old_best infinity)
          (obtain ((old_counts3 (seq int)))
            (and
              (and
                (is_valid_change old_counts3 coins value)
                (cc_uses_before old_counts3 j))
              (== (total_coins old_counts3) old_best)))
          (block))
        (assert
          (cc_partial
            coins
            value
            (+ j 1)
            new_best
            infinity))))))

(lemma cc_finish_cell
  (params
    (coins (seq int))
    (value int)
    (best int)
    (infinity int))
  (requires
    (cc_positive coins)
    (> value 0)
    (cc_partial
      coins
      value
      (len coins)
      best
      infinity))
  (ensures
    (cc_cell coins value best infinity))
  (body
    (forall ((counts (seq int)))
      (call cc_has_positive_count counts coins value))))

(lemma cc_extend_prefix
  (params
    (table (seq int))
    (coins (seq int))
    (upto int)
    (infinity int))
  (requires
    (cc_prefix table coins upto infinity)
    (< upto (len table))
    (cc_cell
      coins
      upto
      (idx table upto)
      infinity))
  (ensures
    (cc_prefix table coins (+ upto 1) infinity))
  (body))

(lemma cc_negative_impossible
  (params (coins (seq int)) (amount int))
  (requires
    (cc_positive coins)
    (< amount 0))
  (ensures
    (forall ((counts (seq int)))
      (=> (is_valid_change counts coins amount) false)))
  (body
    (forall ((counts (seq int)))
      (call cc_amount_nonnegative counts coins))))

(def coin_change
  (body
    (assert (cc_positive coins))
    (if (< amount 0)
      (block
        (call cc_negative_impossible coins amount)
        (return -1))
      (block
        (let infinity i64 (+ amount 1))
        (let size i64 (+ amount 1))
        (let-mut table (vec i64)
          (seq-build size (fn (slot) infinity)))
        (set-idx table 0 0)
        (call cc_base_cell coins infinity)
        (call cc_single_prefix table coins infinity)
        (let-mut value i64 1)
        (while (< value size)
          (invariant
            (and (<= 1 value) (<= value size)))
          (invariant (== (len table) size))
          (invariant
            (cc_prefix table coins value infinity))
          (decreases (- size value))
          (let-mut best i64 infinity)
          (call cc_empty_partial coins value infinity)
          (let-mut coin_index i64 0)
          (while (< coin_index (len coins))
            (invariant
              (and
                (<= 0 coin_index)
                (<= coin_index (len coins))))
            (invariant
              (cc_prefix table coins value infinity))
            (invariant
              (cc_partial
                coins
                value
                coin_index
                best
                infinity))
            (decreases (- (len coins) coin_index))
            (let denomination i64 (idx coins coin_index))
            (let old_best i64 best)
            (if (<= denomination value)
              (block
                (let previous i64
                  (idx table (- value denomination)))
                (assert
                  (cc_cell
                    coins
                    (- value denomination)
                    previous
                    infinity))
                (if (!= previous infinity)
                  (if (< (+ previous 1) best)
                    (set best (+ previous 1))
                    (block))
                  (block)))
              (block))
            (call cc_relax
              table
              coins
              value
              coin_index
              old_best
              best
              infinity)
            (set coin_index (+ coin_index 1)))
          (call cc_finish_cell
            coins
            value
            best
            infinity)
          (set-idx table value best)
          (assert
            (cc_prefix table coins value infinity))
          (assert
            (cc_cell

            (< (+ (idx table (- value (idx coins j))) 1)

(ghost-fn cc_cell
  ((coins (seq int)) (value int) (best int) (infinity int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (<= 0 best) (<= best infinity))
      (and
        (=>
          (== best infinity)
          (forall ((counts (seq int)))
            (=> (is_valid_change counts coins value) false)))
        (=>
          (!= best infinity)
          (and
            (exists ((counts (seq int)))
              (and
                (is_valid_change counts coins value)
                (== (total_coins counts) best)))
            (forall ((counts (seq int)))
              (=>
                (is_valid_change counts coins value)
                (>= (total_coins counts) best)))))))))

(ghost-fn cc_partial
  ((coins (seq int)) (value int) (upto int) (best int) (infinity int))

      (and
        (=>
          (== best infinity)
          (forall ((counts (seq int)))
            (=>
              (and
                (is_valid_change counts coins value)
                (cc_uses_before counts upto))
              false)))
        (=>
          (!= best infinity)
          (and
            (exists ((counts (seq int)))
              (and
                (and
                  (is_valid_change counts coins value)
                  (cc_uses_before counts upto))
                (== (total_coins counts) best)))
            (forall ((counts (seq int)))
              (=>
                (and
                  (is_valid_change counts coins value)
                  (cc_uses_before counts upto))
                (>= (total_coins counts) best)))))))))

(ghost-fn cc_prefix
  ((table (seq int)) (coins (seq int)) (upto int) (infinity int))

  (body

      (forall ((value int))

          (and (<= 0 value) (< value upto))
          (cc_cell coins value (idx table value) infinity))))))

(def find_min
  (body
    (let n i64 (len dd))
    (let-mut best i64 -1)
    (let-mut bd i64 0)
    (let-mut j i64 0)
    (while (< j n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 j) (<= j n)))
      (invariant (scanned dd vw j best bd))
      (decreases (- n j))
      (if (and (== (idx vw j) 0) (>= (idx dd j) 0))
        (if (or (== best -1) (< (idx dd j) bd))
          (block
            (call scan_take dd vw j best bd)
            (set best j)
            (set bd (idx dd j)))
          (call scan_keep dd vw j best bd))
        (call scan_keep dd vw j best bd))
      (set j (+ j 1)))
    (return best bd)))

          (ghost-let vis0 (seq int) vis)
