          (and
            (and (<= 0 limit) (<= limit (len (idx (field graph adj) u))))
            (forall ((i int))
              (=>
                (and (<= 0 i) (< i limit))
                (and
                  (>= (idx dist (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 0)) 0)
                  (<=
                    (idx dist (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 0))
                    (+ du (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 1))))))))))))

(ghost-fn dijkstra_upd ((before (seq int)) (after (seq int)) (at int) (value int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (== (len after) (len before)) (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
      (and
        (== (idx after at) value)
        (forall ((v int))
          (=>
            (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len before))) (!= v at))
            (== (idx after v) (idx before v))))))))

(ghost-fn dijkstra_bupd ((before (seq bool)) (after (seq bool)) (at int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (== (len after) (len before)) (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
      (and
        (idx after at)
        (forall ((v int))
          (=>
            (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len before))) (!= v at))
            (== (idx after v) (idx before v))))))))

(ghost-fn dijkstra_updw
  ((before (seq (seq int))) (after (seq (seq int))) (at int) (value (seq int))) bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (== (len after) (len before)) (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
      (and
        (== (idx after at) value)
        (forall ((v int))
          (=>
            (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len before))) (!= v at))
            (== (idx after v) (idx before v))))))))

(ghost-fn dijkstra_answer ((dist (seq int)) (v int)) (option int)
  (requires (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist))))
  (body
    (if (== (idx dist v) -1)
      (none)
      (some (idx dist v)))))

(lemma dijkstra_bool_count_nonnegative
  (params (s (seq bool)) (x bool) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (call dijkstra_bool_count_nonnegative s x (- k 1))
      (block))))

(lemma dijkstra_bool_count_member
  (params (s (seq bool)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k (+ j 1))
      (call dijkstra_bool_count_member s j (- k 1))
      (call dijkstra_bool_count_nonnegative s (idx s j) j))))

(lemma dijkstra_no_false
  (params (s (seq bool)))
  (requires (== (occurrences s false) 0))
  (ensures
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s))) (idx s v))))
  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (call dijkstra_bool_count_member s v (len s)))))

(lemma dijkstra_weight_from_position
  (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (v int) (w int) (position int) (from int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 from) (<= from position))
    (and (<= 0 position) (< position (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row position) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx row position) 1) w)
    (forall ((j int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= from j) (< j position))
          (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len row))))
        (!= (get (idx row j) 0) v))))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v from) w))
  (decreases (- position from))
  (body
    (if (< from position)
      (call dijkstra_weight_from_position row v w position (+ from 1))
      (block))))

(lemma dijkstra_edge_weight
  (params (graph weighted_graph) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph)
    (has_edge (view graph) u v w))
  (ensures (== (get_edge_weight (view graph) u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((position int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view graph))))
          (and (<= 0 position) (< position (len (idx (view graph) u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx (view graph) u) position) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx (view graph) u) position) 1) w))))
    (call dijkstra_weight_from_position
      (idx (view graph) u) v w position 0)))

(lemma dijkstra_path_step
  (params (graph weighted_graph) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path (view graph) p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< (+ k 1) (len p))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (path_weight (view graph) (take p (+ k 2)))
      (+
        (path_weight (view graph) (take p (+ k 1)))
        (get_edge_weight (view graph) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ k 2))
    (call law_take_take p (+ k 2) (+ k 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 2) k)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 2) (+ k 1))))

(lemma dijkstra_prefix_nonnegative
  (params (graph weighted_graph) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph)
    (weights_non_negative (view graph))
    (is_path (view graph) p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (<=
      (path_weight (view graph) (take p (+ k 1)))
      (path_weight (view graph) p)))
  (decreases (- (len p) (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (if (< (+ k 1) (len p))
      (block
        (assert (connected (view graph) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
        (obtain ((edge_weight int))
          (has_edge (view graph) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)) edge_weight))
        (call dijkstra_edge_weight
          graph (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)) edge_weight)
        (call dijkstra_path_step graph p k)
        (call dijkstra_prefix_nonnegative graph p (+ k 1)))
      (call law_take_all p))))

(lemma dijkstra_extend_path
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph)
    (is_path (view graph) p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge (view graph) u v w))
  (ensures
    (is_path (view graph) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1)) v)
    (==
      (path_weight (view graph) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (+ (path_weight (view graph) p) w)))
  (body
    (call dijkstra_edge_weight graph u v w)
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) 0)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (len p))
    (call dijkstra_path_step graph (concat p (seq-lit v)) (- (len p) 1))
    (assert (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))))

(lemma dijkstra_frontier_bound
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq bool))
    (best int)
    (best_distance int)
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph)
    (weights_non_negative (view graph))
    (dijkstra_closed graph dist used)
    (dijkstra_minimum dist used best best_distance)
    (is_path (view graph) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) best)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (>= (idx dist (idx p k)) 0)
    (<=
      (idx dist (idx p k))
      (path_weight (view graph) (take p (+ k 1)))))
  (ensures (<= best_distance (path_weight (view graph) p)))
  (decreases (- (len p) (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (if (not (idx used (idx p k)))
      (call dijkstra_prefix_nonnegative graph p k)
      (if (< (+ k 1) (len p))
        (block
          (assert (connected (view graph) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
          (obtain ((edge_weight int))
            (has_edge
              (view graph)
              (idx p k)
              (idx p (+ k 1))
              edge_weight))
          (call dijkstra_edge_weight
            graph
            (idx p k)
            (idx p (+ k 1))
            edge_weight)
          (call dijkstra_path_step graph p k)
          (call dijkstra_frontier_bound
            graph
            start
            dist
            used
            best
            best_distance
            p
            (+ k 1)))
        (block)))))

(lemma dijkstra_choice
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq bool))
    (wit (seq (seq int)))
    (best int)
    (best_distance int))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph)
    (weights_non_negative (view graph))
    (dijkstra_labels graph start dist wit)
    (dijkstra_closed graph dist used)
    (dijkstra_minimum dist used best best_distance)
    (== (idx dist start) 0))
  (ensures
    (is_shortest_dist (view graph) start best best_distance))
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call dijkstra_frontier_bound
        graph start dist used best best_distance p 0))))

(lemma dijkstra_step_labels
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist0 (seq int))
    (wit0 (seq (seq int)))
    (dist (seq int))
    (wit (seq (seq int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (candidate int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_labels graph start dist0 wit0)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len dist0)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist0)))
    (>= (idx dist0 u) 0)
    (== candidate (+ (idx dist0 u) w))
    (has_edge (view graph) u v w)
    (dijkstra_upd dist0 dist v candidate)
    (dijkstra_updw wit0 wit v (concat (idx wit0 u) (seq-lit v)))
    (is_path (view graph) (concat (idx wit0 u) (seq-lit v)))
    (==
      (path_weight (view graph) (concat (idx wit0 u) (seq-lit v)))
      candidate))
  (ensures (dijkstra_labels graph start dist wit))
  (body))

(lemma dijkstra_step_nonnegative
  (params (dist0 (seq int)) (dist (seq int)) (v int) (candidate int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_nonnegative dist0)
    (dijkstra_upd dist0 dist v candidate)
    (>= candidate 0))
  (ensures (dijkstra_nonnegative dist))
  (body))

(lemma dijkstra_step_bounded
  (params (dist0 (seq int)) (dist (seq int)) (v int) (candidate int) (bound int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_bounded dist0 bound)
    (dijkstra_upd dist0 dist v candidate)
    (and (>= candidate 0) (<= candidate bound)))
  (ensures (dijkstra_bounded dist bound))
  (body))

(lemma dijkstra_closed_decrease
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (dist0 (seq int))
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq bool))
    (v int)
    (candidate int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_closed graph dist0 used)
    (dijkstra_upd dist0 dist v candidate)
    (not (idx used v))
    (>= candidate 0)
    (or
      (== (idx dist0 v) -1)
      (<= candidate (idx dist0 v))))
  (ensures (dijkstra_closed graph dist used))
  (body))

(lemma dijkstra_settled_unchanged
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist0 (seq int))
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq bool))
    (v int)
    (candidate int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_settled graph start dist0 used)
    (dijkstra_upd dist0 dist v candidate)
    (not (idx used v)))
  (ensures (dijkstra_settled graph start dist used))
  (body))

(lemma dijkstra_partial_step
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (dist (seq int))
    (u int)
    (i int)
    (du int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_partial graph dist u i du)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size graph)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx (field graph adj) u))))
    (>= (idx dist (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 0)) 0)
    (<=
      (idx dist (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 0))
      (+ du (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 1))))
  (ensures (dijkstra_partial graph dist u (+ i 1) du))
  (body))

(lemma dijkstra_partial_update
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (dist0 (seq int))
    (dist (seq int))
    (u int)
    (i int)
    (du int)
    (v int)
    (candidate int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_partial graph dist0 u i du)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size graph)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx (field graph adj) u))))
    (== v (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 0))
    (== candidate (+ du (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 1)))
    (dijkstra_upd dist0 dist v candidate)
    (>= candidate 0))
  (ensures (dijkstra_partial graph dist u (+ i 1) du))
  (body))

(lemma dijkstra_mark_closed
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used0 (seq bool))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (du int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_closed graph dist used0)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size graph)))
    (dijkstra_partial graph dist u (len (idx (field graph adj) u)) du)
    (== du (idx dist u))
    (dijkstra_bupd used0 used u))
  (ensures (dijkstra_closed graph dist used))
  (body))

(lemma dijkstra_mark_settled
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used0 (seq bool))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_settled graph start dist used0)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size graph)))
    (is_shortest_dist (view graph) start u (idx dist u))
    (dijkstra_bupd used0 used u))
  (ensures (dijkstra_settled graph start dist used))
  (body))

(lemma dijkstra_reachable_finite
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq bool))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph)
    (dijkstra_closed graph dist used)
    (dijkstra_complete dist used)
    (is_path (view graph) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (size graph)))
    (>= (idx dist (idx p k)) 0))
  (ensures
    (and
      (and
        (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (size graph)))
      (>= (idx dist (idx p (- (len p) 1))) 0)))
  (decreases (- (len p) (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (if (< (+ k 1) (len p))
      (block
        (assert (connected (view graph) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
        (obtain ((edge_weight int))
          (has_edge
            (view graph)
            (idx p k)
            (idx p (+ k 1))
            edge_weight))
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p (+ k 1)))
            (< (idx p (+ k 1)) (size graph))))
        (assert (idx used (idx p k)))
        (assert (>= (idx dist (idx p (+ k 1))) 0))
        (call dijkstra_reachable_finite
          graph start dist used p (+ k 1)))
      (block))))

(lemma dijkstra_final_vertex
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq bool))
    (v int))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph)
    (dijkstra_nonnegative dist)
    (dijkstra_closed graph dist used)
    (dijkstra_complete dist used)
    (dijkstra_settled graph start dist used)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size graph)))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size graph))))
  (ensures
    (match (dijkstra_answer dist v)
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=>
            (and
              (is_path (view graph) p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
            false)))
      (case (some final_distance)
        (is_shortest_dist (view graph) start v final_distance))))
  (body
    (if (== (idx dist v) -1)
      (forall ((p (seq int)))
        (call dijkstra_reachable_finite
          graph start dist used p 0))
      (block))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut dist (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (init_i) -1)))
    (let-mut used (vec bool) (seq-build n (fn (init_j) false)))
    (ghost-let-mut wit
      (seq (seq int))
      (seq-build n (fn (init_k) (seq-lit start))))
    (set-idx dist start 0)
    (let-mut active bool true)
    (let-mut selected i64 0)
    (let-mut outer_i i64 0)
    (assert (dijkstra_labels graph start dist wit))
    (assert (dijkstra_nonnegative dist))
    (assert (dijkstra_bounded dist 0))
    (assert (dijkstra_closed graph dist used))
    (assert (dijkstra_settled graph start dist used))
    (while (< outer_i n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 outer_i) (<= outer_i n)))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 selected) (<= selected outer_i)))
      (invariant (=> active (== selected outer_i)))
      (invariant (=> (not active) (dijkstra_no_open dist used)))
      (invariant (== (len dist) n))
      (invariant (== (len used) n))
      (invariant (== (len wit) n))
      (invariant (== (occurrences used false) (- n selected)))
      (invariant (dijkstra_labels graph start dist wit))
      (invariant (dijkstra_nonnegative dist))
      (invariant (dijkstra_bounded dist (* outer_i 100000)))
      (invariant (dijkstra_closed graph dist used))
      (invariant (dijkstra_settled graph start dist used))
      (invariant (== (idx dist start) 0))
      (decreases (- n outer_i))
      (if active
        (block
          (let-mut scan_i i64 0)
          (let-mut found bool false)
          (let-mut best_vertex i64 0)
          (let-mut best_distance i64 0)
          (while (< scan_i n)
            (invariant (and (<= 0 scan_i) (<= scan_i n)))
            (invariant
              (=>
                found
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 best_vertex) (< best_vertex scan_i))
                  (and
                    (not (idx used best_vertex))
                    (and
                      (>= best_distance 0)
                      (and
                        (== best_distance (idx dist best_vertex))
                        (<= best_distance (* outer_i 100000))))))))
            (invariant
              (forall ((candidate_i int))
                (=>
                  (and
                    (and (<= 0 candidate_i) (< candidate_i scan_i))
                    (and
                      (not (idx used candidate_i))
                      (>= (idx dist candidate_i) 0)))
                  (and
                    found
                    (<= best_distance (idx dist candidate_i))))))
            (decreases (- n scan_i))
            (let scan_distance i64 (idx dist scan_i))
            (if
              (and
                (not (idx used scan_i))
                (>= scan_distance 0))
              (if
                (or (not found) (< scan_distance best_distance))
                (block
                  (set found true)
                  (set best_vertex scan_i)
                  (set best_distance scan_distance))
                (block))
              (block))
            (set scan_i (+ scan_i 1)))
          (if found
            (block
              (assert
                (dijkstra_minimum
                  dist used best_vertex best_distance))
              (call dijkstra_choice
                graph
                start
                dist
                used
                wit
                best_vertex
                best_distance)
              (let row_length i64
                (len (idx (field graph adj) best_vertex)))
              (let-mut edge_i i64 0)
              (while (< edge_i row_length)
                (invariant (and (<= 0 edge_i) (<= edge_i row_length)))
                (invariant (== (len dist) n))
                (invariant (== (len used) n))
                (invariant (== (len wit) n))
                (invariant (dijkstra_labels graph start dist wit))
                (invariant (dijkstra_nonnegative dist))
                (invariant
                  (dijkstra_bounded dist (* (+ outer_i 1) 100000)))
                (invariant (dijkstra_closed graph dist used))
                (invariant (dijkstra_settled graph start dist used))
                (invariant
                  (dijkstra_partial
                    graph dist best_vertex edge_i best_distance))
                (invariant
                  (and
                    (and (<= 0 best_vertex) (< best_vertex n))
                    (and
                      (not (idx used best_vertex))
                      (and
                        (>= best_distance 0)
                        (and
                          (== best_distance (idx dist best_vertex))
                          (<= best_distance (* outer_i 100000)))))))
                (decreases (- row_length edge_i))
                (let edge_value (tuple i64 i64)
                  (idx
                    (idx (field graph adj) best_vertex)
                    edge_i))
                (let edge_target i64 (get edge_value 0))
                (let edge_weight i64 (get edge_value 1))
                (assert
                  (has_edge
                    (view graph)
                    best_vertex
                    edge_target
                    edge_weight))
                (assert (and (>= edge_weight 0) (<= edge_weight 100000)))
                (let candidate_distance i64
                  (+ best_distance edge_weight))
                (call dijkstra_extend_path
                  graph
                  (idx wit best_vertex)
                  best_vertex
                  edge_target
                  edge_weight)
                (if (idx used edge_target)
                  (block
                    (assert
                      (<=
                        (idx dist edge_target)
                        candidate_distance))
                    (call dijkstra_partial_step
                      graph
                      dist
                      best_vertex
                      edge_i
                      best_distance))
                  (block
                    (let old_distance i64 (idx dist edge_target))
                    (if
                      (or
                        (== old_distance -1)
                        (< candidate_distance old_distance))
                      (block
                        (ghost-let dist0 (seq int) dist)
                        (ghost-let wit0 (seq (seq int)) wit)
                        (ghost-set wit
                          (seq-build n
                            (fn (wit_i)
                              (if
                                (== wit_i edge_target)
                                (concat
                                  (idx wit0 best_vertex)
                                  (seq-lit edge_target))
                                (idx wit0 wit_i)))))
                        (set-idx dist edge_target candidate_distance)
                        (assert
                          (dijkstra_upd
                            dist0
                            dist
                            edge_target
                            candidate_distance))
                        (assert
                          (dijkstra_updw
                            wit0
                            wit
                            edge_target
                            (concat
                              (idx wit0 best_vertex)
                              (seq-lit edge_target))))
                        (call dijkstra_step_labels
                          graph
                          start
                          dist0
                          wit0
                          dist
                          wit
                          best_vertex
                          edge_target
                          edge_weight
                          candidate_distance)
                        (call dijkstra_step_nonnegative
                          dist0 dist edge_target candidate_distance)
                        (call dijkstra_step_bounded
                          dist0
                          dist
                          edge_target
                          candidate_distance
                          (* (+ outer_i 1) 100000))
                        (call dijkstra_closed_decrease
                          graph
                          dist0
                          dist
                          used
                          edge_target
                          candidate_distance)
                        (call dijkstra_settled_unchanged
                          graph
                          start
                          dist0
                          dist
                          used
                          edge_target
                          candidate_distance)
                        (call dijkstra_partial_update
                          graph
                          dist0
                          dist
                          best_vertex
                          edge_i
                          best_distance
                          edge_target
                          candidate_distance))
                      (call dijkstra_partial_step
                        graph
                        dist
                        best_vertex
                        edge_i
                        best_distance))))
                (set edge_i (+ edge_i 1)))
              (ghost-let used0 (seq bool) used)
              (set-idx used best_vertex true)
              (assert (dijkstra_bupd used0 used best_vertex))
              (call dijkstra_mark_closed
                graph
                dist
                used0
                used
                best_vertex
                best_distance)
              (call dijkstra_mark_settled
                graph
                start
                dist
                used0

                    (== (idx queue (idx pos v)) v))))
            (forall ((v int))

(ghost-fn distance_bound
  ((seen (seq bool)) (dist (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (n int)) bool

    (and (== (len seen) n) (== (len pos) n))

      (== (len dist) n)
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (idx seen v))

(ghost-fn path_witnesses

      (=> (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))

(ghost-fn pointwise_le ((a (seq int)) (b (seq int))) bool

(ghost-fn pass_rel
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (seen (seq bool))
   (base (seq int)) (dist (seq int)) (u int) (lim int)) bool
  (body (and

      (== (len seen) (len g))
      (and (== (len base) (len g)) (== (len dist) (len g))))
    (forall ((a int) (e int))
      (=> (and

              (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g a))))
              (or (< a u) (and (== a u) (< e lim)))))

                (<=
                  (idx dist (get (idx (idx g a) e) 0))

(ghost-fn triangle_labels
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (seen (seq bool))

(lemma count_nonneg_bool

  (decreases k)

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut seen (vec bool)
      (seq-build n (fn (z0) false)))
    (let-mut dist (vec i64)
      (seq-build n (fn (z1) 0)))
    (set-idx seen start true)
    (let-mut queue (vec i64) (vec-new))
    (push queue start)
    (ghost-let-mut pos (seq int)
      (seq-build n (fn (z2) 0)))
    (ghost-let-mut wit (seq (seq int))
      (seq-build n (fn (z3) (seq-lit start))))
    (assert (== queue (seq-lit start)))
    (assert
      (forall ((k0 int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 k0) (< k0 n))
            (and
              (== (idx seen k0) (== k0 start))
              (and
                (== (idx dist k0) 0)
                (and
                  (== (idx pos k0) 0)
                  (== (idx wit k0) (seq-lit start))))))))
    (call initial_state
      (view graph) start n seen dist queue pos wit)
    (let-mut head i64 0)
    (while (< head (len queue))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 head) (<= head (len queue))))
      (invariant (queue_state seen queue pos n))
      (invariant (distance_bound seen dist pos n))
      (invariant
        (path_witnesses (view graph) start seen dist wit n))
      (invariant
        (closed_prefix (view graph) seen queue head))
      (decreases (- (len queue) head))
      (let u1 i64 (idx queue head))
      (let deg1 i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) u1)))
      (let-mut e1 i64 0)
      (while (< e1 deg1)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 e1) (<= e1 deg1)))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len queue))))
        (invariant (== (idx queue head) u1))
        (invariant (queue_state seen queue pos n))
        (invariant (distance_bound seen dist pos n))
        (invariant
          (path_witnesses (view graph) start seen dist wit n))
        (invariant
          (closed_prefix (view graph) seen queue head))
        (invariant

  (body
    (and
      (== (len dist) (size graph))
      (and
        (== (len used) (size graph))
        (and
          (well_formed graph)
          (forall ((u int) (i int))
            (=>
              (and
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size graph)))
                  (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx (field graph adj) u)))))
                (idx used u))
              (and
                (>= (idx dist (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 0)) 0)
                (<=
                  (idx dist (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 0))
                  (+ (idx dist u) (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 1)))))))))))

(ghost-fn dijkstra_settled ((graph weighted_graph) (start int) (dist (seq int)) (used (seq bool))) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len dist) (size graph))
      (and
        (== (len used) (size graph))
        (forall ((v int))
          (=>
            (and
              (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size graph)))
              (idx used v))
            (and
              (>= (idx dist v) 0)
              (is_shortest_dist (view graph) start v (idx dist v)))))))))

(ghost-fn dijkstra_minimum ((dist (seq int)) (used (seq bool)) (best int) (best_distance int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len used) (len dist))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 best) (< best (len dist)))
          (not (idx used best)))
        (and
          (and (>= best_distance 0) (== best_distance (idx dist best)))
          (forall ((v int))
            (=>
              (and
                (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
                (and (not (idx used v)) (>= (idx dist v) 0)))
              (<= best_distance (idx dist v)))))))))

(ghost-fn dijkstra_scan
  ((dist (seq int)) (used (seq bool)) (limit int)
   (found bool) (best int) (best_distance int) (bound int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len used) (len dist))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 limit) (<= limit (len dist)))
        (and
          (=>
            found
            (and
              (and (<= 0 best) (< best limit))
              (and
                (not (idx used best))
                (and
                  (>= best_distance 0)
                  (and
                    (== best_distance (idx dist best))
                    (<= best_distance bound))))))
          (forall ((candidate int))
            (=>
              (and
                (and (<= 0 candidate) (< candidate limit))
                (and
                  (not (idx used candidate))
                  (>= (idx dist candidate) 0)))
              (and
                found
                (<= best_distance (idx dist candidate))))))))))

(ghost-fn dijkstra_no_open ((dist (seq int)) (used (seq bool))) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len used) (len dist))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
            (not (idx used v)))
          (== (idx dist v) -1))))))

(ghost-fn dijkstra_complete ((dist (seq int)) (used (seq bool))) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len used) (len dist))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=>
          (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist))) (>= (idx dist v) 0))
          (idx used v))))))

(ghost-fn dijkstra_partial ((graph weighted_graph) (dist (seq int)) (u int) (limit int) (du int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (well_formed graph)
      (and
        (== (len dist) (size graph))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size graph)))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 limit) (<= limit (len (idx (field graph adj) u))))
            (forall ((i int))
              (=>
                (and (<= 0 i) (< i limit))
                (and
                  (>= (idx dist (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 0)) 0)
                  (<=
                    (idx dist (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 0))
                    (+ du (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 1))))))))))))

(ghost-fn dijkstra_upd ((before (seq int)) (after (seq int)) (at int) (value int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (== (len after) (len before)) (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
      (and
        (== (idx after at) value)
        (forall ((v int))
          (=>
            (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len before))) (!= v at))
            (== (idx after v) (idx before v))))))))

(ghost-fn dijkstra_bupd ((before (seq bool)) (after (seq bool)) (at int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (== (len after) (len before)) (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
      (and
        (idx after at)
        (forall ((v int))
          (=>
            (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len before))) (!= v at))
            (== (idx after v) (idx before v))))))))

(ghost-fn dijkstra_updw
  ((before (seq (seq int))) (after (seq (seq int))) (at int) (value (seq int))) bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (== (len after) (len before)) (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len before))))
      (and
        (== (idx after at) value)
        (forall ((v int))
          (=>
            (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len before))) (!= v at))
            (== (idx after v) (idx before v))))))))

(ghost-fn dijkstra_answer ((dist (seq int)) (v int)) (option int)
  (requires (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist))))
  (body
    (if (== (idx dist v) -1)
      (none)
      (some (idx dist v)))))

(lemma dijkstra_preserve_other
  (params

(lemma dijkstra_scan_pick
  (params

    (not (idx used limit))
    (>= (idx dist limit) 0)
    (dijkstra_bounded dist bound)
    (or (not found) (< (idx dist limit) best_distance)))

      dist used (+ limit 1) true limit (idx dist limit) bound))
  (body))

(lemma dijkstra_scan_keep
  (params

(lemma dijkstra_scan_skip

(lemma dijkstra_scan_minimum
  (params
    (dist (seq int)) (used (seq bool))

(lemma dijkstra_bool_count_nonnegative
  (params (s (seq bool)) (x bool) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (call dijkstra_bool_count_nonnegative s x (- k 1))
      (block))))

(lemma dijkstra_bool_count_member
  (params (s (seq bool)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k (+ j 1))
      (call dijkstra_bool_count_member s j (- k 1))
      (call dijkstra_bool_count_nonnegative s (idx s j) j))))

(lemma dijkstra_no_false
  (params (s (seq bool)))
  (requires (== (occurrences s false) 0))
  (ensures
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s))) (idx s v))))
  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (call dijkstra_bool_count_member s v (len s)))))

(lemma dijkstra_weight_from_position
  (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (v int) (w int) (position int) (from int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 from) (<= from position))
    (and (<= 0 position) (< position (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row position) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx row position) 1) w)
    (forall ((j int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= from j) (< j position))
          (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len row))))
        (!= (get (idx row j) 0) v))))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v from) w))
  (decreases (- position from))
  (body
    (if (< from position)
      (call dijkstra_weight_from_position row v w position (+ from 1))
      (block))))

(lemma dijkstra_edge_weight
  (params (graph weighted_graph) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph)
    (has_edge (view graph) u v w))
  (ensures (== (get_edge_weight (view graph) u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((position int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view graph))))
          (and (<= 0 position) (< position (len (idx (view graph) u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx (view graph) u) position) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx (view graph) u) position) 1) w))))
    (call dijkstra_weight_from_position
      (idx (view graph) u) v w position 0)))

(lemma dijkstra_path_step
  (params (graph weighted_graph) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path (view graph) p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< (+ k 1) (len p))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (path_weight (view graph) (take p (+ k 2)))
      (+
        (path_weight (view graph) (take p (+ k 1)))
        (get_edge_weight (view graph) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ k 2))
    (call law_take_take p (+ k 2) (+ k 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 2) k)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 2) (+ k 1))))

(lemma dijkstra_prefix_nonnegative
  (params (graph weighted_graph) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph)
    (weights_non_negative (view graph))
    (is_path (view graph) p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (<=
      (path_weight (view graph) (take p (+ k 1)))
      (path_weight (view graph) p)))
  (decreases (- (len p) (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (if (< (+ k 1) (len p))
      (block
        (assert (connected (view graph) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
        (obtain ((edge_weight int))
          (has_edge (view graph) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)) edge_weight))
        (call dijkstra_edge_weight
          graph (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)) edge_weight)
        (call dijkstra_path_step graph p k)
        (call dijkstra_prefix_nonnegative graph p (+ k 1)))
      (call law_take_all p))))

(lemma dijkstra_extend_path
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph)
    (is_path (view graph) p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge (view graph) u v w))
  (ensures
    (is_path (view graph) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1)) v)
    (==
      (path_weight (view graph) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (+ (path_weight (view graph) p) w)))
  (body
    (call dijkstra_edge_weight graph u v w)
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) 0)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (len p))
    (call dijkstra_path_step graph (concat p (seq-lit v)) (- (len p) 1))
    (assert (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))))

(lemma dijkstra_frontier_bound
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq bool))
    (best int)
    (best_distance int)
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph)
    (weights_non_negative (view graph))
    (dijkstra_closed graph dist used)
    (dijkstra_minimum dist used best best_distance)
    (is_path (view graph) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) best)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (>= (idx dist (idx p k)) 0)
    (<=
      (idx dist (idx p k))
      (path_weight (view graph) (take p (+ k 1)))))
  (ensures (<= best_distance (path_weight (view graph) p)))
  (decreases (- (len p) (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (if (not (idx used (idx p k)))
      (call dijkstra_prefix_nonnegative graph p k)
      (if (< (+ k 1) (len p))
        (block
          (assert (connected (view graph) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
          (obtain ((edge_weight int))
            (has_edge
              (view graph)
              (idx p k)
              (idx p (+ k 1))
              edge_weight))
          (call dijkstra_edge_weight
            graph
            (idx p k)
            (idx p (+ k 1))
            edge_weight)
          (call dijkstra_path_step graph p k)
          (call dijkstra_frontier_bound
            graph
            start
            dist
            used
            best
            best_distance
            p
            (+ k 1)))
        (block)))))

(lemma dijkstra_choice
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (start int)

    (== (idx dist start) 0))
  (ensures
    (is_shortest_dist (view graph) start best best_distance))
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call dijkstra_frontier_bound
        graph start dist used best best_distance p 0))))

(lemma dijkstra_settled_edge_bound
  (params

(lemma dijkstra_step_labels
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist0 (seq int))
    (wit0 (seq (seq int)))

    (wit (seq (seq int)))

(lemma dijkstra_step_nonnegative

(lemma dijkstra_reachable_finite
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq bool))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph)
    (dijkstra_closed graph dist used)
    (dijkstra_complete dist used)
    (is_path (view graph) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (size graph)))
    (>= (idx dist (idx p k)) 0))
  (ensures
    (and
      (and
        (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (size graph)))
      (>= (idx dist (idx p (- (len p) 1))) 0)))
  (decreases (- (len p) (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (if (< (+ k 1) (len p))
      (block
        (assert (connected (view graph) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
        (obtain ((edge_weight int))
          (has_edge
            (view graph)
            (idx p k)
            (idx p (+ k 1))
            edge_weight))
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p (+ k 1)))
            (< (idx p (+ k 1)) (size graph))))
        (assert (idx used (idx p k)))
        (assert (>= (idx dist (idx p (+ k 1))) 0))
        (call dijkstra_reachable_finite
          graph start dist used p (+ k 1)))
      (block))))

(lemma dijkstra_final_vertex
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq bool))
    (v int))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph)
    (dijkstra_nonnegative dist)
    (dijkstra_closed graph dist used)
    (dijkstra_complete dist used)
    (dijkstra_settled graph start dist used)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size graph)))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size graph))))
  (ensures
    (match
      (if
        (== (idx dist v) -1)
        (none)
        (some (idx dist v)))
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=>
            (and
              (is_path (view graph) p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
            false)))
      (case (some final_distance)
        (is_shortest_dist (view graph) start v final_distance))))
  (body
    (if (== (idx dist v) -1)
      (forall ((p (seq int)))
        (call dijkstra_reachable_finite
          graph start dist used p 0))
      (block))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut dist (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (init_i) -1)))
    (let-mut used (vec bool) (seq-build n (fn (init_j) false)))
    (ghost-let-mut wit
      (seq (seq int))
      (seq-build n (fn (init_k) (seq-lit start))))
    (set-idx dist start 0)
    (let-mut active bool true)
    (let-mut selected i64 0)
    (let-mut outer_i i64 0)
    (assert (dijkstra_labels graph start dist wit))
    (assert (dijkstra_nonnegative dist))
    (assert (dijkstra_bounded dist 0))
    (assert (dijkstra_closed graph dist used))

          (if (== v at) value (idx before v))))
      at
      value))
  (body))

(lemma dijkstra_scan_pick
  (params
    (dist (seq int)) (used (seq bool)) (limit int)
    (found bool) (best int) (best_distance int) (bound int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_scan dist used limit found best best_distance bound)
    (< limit (len dist))
    (not (idx used limit))
    (>= (idx dist limit) 0)
    (dijkstra_bounded dist bound)
    (or (not found) (< (idx dist limit) best_distance)))
  (ensures
    (dijkstra_scan
      dist used (+ limit 1) true limit (idx dist limit) bound))
  (body))

(lemma dijkstra_scan_keep
  (params
    (dist (seq int)) (used (seq bool)) (limit int)
    (found bool) (best int) (best_distance int) (bound int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_scan dist used limit found best best_distance bound)
    (< limit (len dist))
    (not (idx used limit))
    (>= (idx dist limit) 0)
    found
    (<= best_distance (idx dist limit)))
  (ensures
    (dijkstra_scan
      dist used (+ limit 1) found best best_distance bound))
  (body))

(lemma dijkstra_scan_skip
  (params
    (dist (seq int)) (used (seq bool)) (limit int)
    (found bool) (best int) (best_distance int) (bound int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_scan dist used limit found best best_distance bound)
    (< limit (len dist))
    (or (idx used limit) (< (idx dist limit) 0)))
  (ensures
    (dijkstra_scan
      dist used (+ limit 1) found best best_distance bound))
  (body))

(lemma dijkstra_scan_minimum
  (params
    (dist (seq int)) (used (seq bool))
    (found bool) (best int) (best_distance int) (bound int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_scan
      dist used (len dist) found best best_distance bound)
    found)
  (ensures (dijkstra_minimum dist used best best_distance))
  (body))

(lemma dijkstra_bool_count_nonnegative
  (params (s (seq bool)) (x bool) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (call dijkstra_bool_count_nonnegative s x (- k 1))
      (block))))

(lemma dijkstra_bool_count_member
  (params (s (seq bool)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k (+ j 1))
      (call dijkstra_bool_count_member s j (- k 1))
      (call dijkstra_bool_count_nonnegative s (idx s j) j))))

(lemma dijkstra_no_false
  (params (s (seq bool)))
  (requires (== (occurrences s false) 0))
  (ensures
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s))) (idx s v))))
  (body
    (forall ((v int))
      (call dijkstra_bool_count_member s v (len s)))))

(lemma dijkstra_weight_from_position
  (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (v int) (w int) (position int) (from int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 from) (<= from position))
    (and (<= 0 position) (< position (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row position) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx row position) 1) w)
    (forall ((j int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= from j) (< j position))
          (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len row))))
        (!= (get (idx row j) 0) v))))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v from) w))
  (decreases (- position from))
  (body
    (if (< from position)
      (call dijkstra_weight_from_position row v w position (+ from 1))
      (block))))

(lemma dijkstra_edge_weight
  (params (graph weighted_graph) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph)
    (has_edge (view graph) u v w))
  (ensures (== (get_edge_weight (view graph) u v) w))
  (body
    (obtain ((position int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len (view graph))))
          (and (<= 0 position) (< position (len (idx (view graph) u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx (view graph) u) position) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx (view graph) u) position) 1) w))))
    (call dijkstra_weight_from_position
      (idx (view graph) u) v w position 0)))

(lemma dijkstra_path_step
  (params (graph weighted_graph) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path (view graph) p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< (+ k 1) (len p))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (path_weight (view graph) (take p (+ k 2)))
      (+
        (path_weight (view graph) (take p (+ k 1)))
        (get_edge_weight (view graph) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ k 2))
    (call law_take_take p (+ k 2) (+ k 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 2) k)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ k 2) (+ k 1))))

(lemma dijkstra_prefix_nonnegative
  (params (graph weighted_graph) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph)
    (weights_non_negative (view graph))
    (is_path (view graph) p)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (<=
      (path_weight (view graph) (take p (+ k 1)))
      (path_weight (view graph) p)))
  (decreases (- (len p) (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (if (< (+ k 1) (len p))
      (block
        (assert (connected (view graph) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
        (obtain ((edge_weight int))
          (has_edge (view graph) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)) edge_weight))
        (call dijkstra_edge_weight
          graph (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)) edge_weight)
        (call dijkstra_path_step graph p k)
        (call dijkstra_prefix_nonnegative graph p (+ k 1)))
      (call law_take_all p))))

(lemma dijkstra_extend_path
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (p (seq int))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph)
    (is_path (view graph) p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge (view graph) u v w))
  (ensures
    (is_path (view graph) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) (idx p 0))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1)) v)
    (==
      (path_weight (view graph) (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (+ (path_weight (view graph) p) w)))
  (body
    (call dijkstra_edge_weight graph u v w)
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) 0)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (- (len p) 1))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit v) (len p))
    (call dijkstra_path_step graph (concat p (seq-lit v)) (- (len p) 1))
    (assert (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))))

(lemma dijkstra_frontier_bound
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq bool))
    (best int)
    (best_distance int)
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph)
    (weights_non_negative (view graph))
    (dijkstra_closed graph dist used)
    (dijkstra_minimum dist used best best_distance)
    (is_path (view graph) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) best)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (>= (idx dist (idx p k)) 0)
    (<=
      (idx dist (idx p k))
      (path_weight (view graph) (take p (+ k 1)))))
  (ensures (<= best_distance (path_weight (view graph) p)))
  (decreases (- (len p) (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (if (not (idx used (idx p k)))
      (call dijkstra_prefix_nonnegative graph p k)
      (if (< (+ k 1) (len p))
        (block
          (assert (connected (view graph) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
          (obtain ((edge_weight int))
            (has_edge
              (view graph)
              (idx p k)
              (idx p (+ k 1))
              edge_weight))
          (call dijkstra_edge_weight
            graph
            (idx p k)
            (idx p (+ k 1))
            edge_weight)
          (call dijkstra_path_step graph p k)
          (call dijkstra_frontier_bound
            graph
            start
            dist
            used
            best
            best_distance
            p
            (+ k 1)))
        (block)))))

(lemma dijkstra_choice
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq bool))
    (wit (seq (seq int)))
    (best int)
    (best_distance int))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph)
    (weights_non_negative (view graph))
    (dijkstra_labels graph start dist wit)
    (dijkstra_closed graph dist used)
    (dijkstra_minimum dist used best best_distance)
    (== (idx dist start) 0))
  (ensures
    (is_shortest_dist (view graph) start best best_distance))
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call dijkstra_frontier_bound
        graph start dist used best best_distance p 0))))

(lemma dijkstra_settled_edge_bound
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq bool))
    (wit (seq (seq int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (candidate int))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph)
    (dijkstra_labels graph start dist wit)
    (dijkstra_settled graph start dist used)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size graph)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size graph)))
    (>= (idx dist u) 0)
    (idx used v)
    (has_edge (view graph) u v w)
    (== candidate (+ (idx dist u) w)))
  (ensures
    (>= (idx dist v) 0)
    (<= (idx dist v) candidate))
  (body
    (call dijkstra_extend_path graph (idx wit u) u v w)))

(lemma dijkstra_step_labels
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist0 (seq int))
    (wit0 (seq (seq int)))
    (dist (seq int))
    (wit (seq (seq int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (candidate int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_labels graph start dist0 wit0)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len dist0)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist0)))
    (>= (idx dist0 u) 0)
    (== candidate (+ (idx dist0 u) w))
    (has_edge (view graph) u v w)
    (dijkstra_upd dist0 dist v candidate)
    (dijkstra_updw wit0 wit v (concat (idx wit0 u) (seq-lit v)))
    (is_path (view graph) (concat (idx wit0 u) (seq-lit v)))
    (==
      (path_weight (view graph) (concat (idx wit0 u) (seq-lit v)))
      candidate))
  (ensures (dijkstra_labels graph start dist wit))
  (body))

(lemma dijkstra_step_nonnegative
  (params (dist0 (seq int)) (dist (seq int)) (v int) (candidate int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_nonnegative dist0)
    (dijkstra_upd dist0 dist v candidate)
    (>= candidate 0))
  (ensures (dijkstra_nonnegative dist))
  (body))

(lemma dijkstra_step_bounded
  (params (dist0 (seq int)) (dist (seq int)) (v int) (candidate int) (bound int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_bounded dist0 bound)
    (dijkstra_upd dist0 dist v candidate)
    (and (>= candidate 0) (<= candidate bound)))
  (ensures (dijkstra_bounded dist bound))
  (body))

(lemma dijkstra_closed_decrease
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (dist0 (seq int))
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq bool))
    (v int)
    (candidate int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_closed graph dist0 used)
    (dijkstra_upd dist0 dist v candidate)
    (not (idx used v))
    (>= candidate 0)
    (or
      (== (idx dist0 v) -1)
      (<= candidate (idx dist0 v))))
  (ensures (dijkstra_closed graph dist used))
  (body))

(lemma dijkstra_settled_unchanged
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist0 (seq int))
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq bool))
    (v int)

  (requires
    (dijkstra_settled graph start dist0 used)

(lemma dijkstra_partial_step
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (dist (seq int))
    (u int)
    (i int)
    (du int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_partial graph dist u i du)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size graph)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx (field graph adj) u))))
    (>= (idx dist (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 0)) 0)
    (<=
      (idx dist (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 0))
      (+ du (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 1))))
  (ensures (dijkstra_partial graph dist u (+ i 1) du))
  (body))

(lemma dijkstra_partial_update
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (dist0 (seq int))
    (dist (seq int))
    (u int)
    (i int)
    (du int)
    (v int)
    (candidate int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_partial graph dist0 u i du)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size graph)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx (field graph adj) u))))
    (== v (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 0))
    (== candidate (+ du (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i) 1)))
    (dijkstra_upd dist0 dist v candidate)
    (>= candidate 0))
  (ensures (dijkstra_partial graph dist u (+ i 1) du))
  (body))

(lemma dijkstra_mark_closed
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used0 (seq bool))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (du int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_closed graph dist used0)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size graph)))
    (dijkstra_partial graph dist u (len (idx (field graph adj) u)) du)
    (== du (idx dist u))
    (dijkstra_bupd used0 used u))
  (ensures (dijkstra_closed graph dist used))
  (body))

(lemma dijkstra_mark_settled
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used0 (seq bool))
    (used (seq bool))
    (u int))
  (requires
    (dijkstra_settled graph start dist used0)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size graph)))
    (>= (idx dist u) 0)
    (is_shortest_dist (view graph) start u (idx dist u))
    (dijkstra_bupd used0 used u))
  (ensures (dijkstra_settled graph start dist used))
  (body))

(lemma dijkstra_reachable_finite
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq bool))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph)
    (dijkstra_closed graph dist used)
    (dijkstra_complete dist used)
    (is_path (view graph) p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
    (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (size graph)))
    (>= (idx dist (idx p k)) 0))
  (ensures
    (and
      (and
        (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
        (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (size graph)))
      (>= (idx dist (idx p (- (len p) 1))) 0)))
  (decreases (- (len p) (+ k 1)))
  (body
    (if (< (+ k 1) (len p))
      (block
        (assert (connected (view graph) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
        (obtain ((edge_weight int))
          (has_edge
            (view graph)
            (idx p k)
            (idx p (+ k 1))
            edge_weight))
        (assert
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p (+ k 1)))
            (< (idx p (+ k 1)) (size graph))))
        (assert (idx used (idx p k)))
        (assert (>= (idx dist (idx p (+ k 1))) 0))
        (call dijkstra_reachable_finite
          graph start dist used p (+ k 1)))
      (block))))

(lemma dijkstra_final_vertex
  (params
    (graph weighted_graph)
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (used (seq bool))
    (v int))
  (requires
    (well_formed graph)
    (dijkstra_nonnegative dist)
    (dijkstra_closed graph dist used)
    (dijkstra_complete dist used)
    (dijkstra_settled graph start dist used)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (size graph)))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (size graph))))
  (ensures
    (match
      (if
        (== (idx dist v) -1)
        (none)
        (some (idx dist v)))
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=>
            (and
              (is_path (view graph) p)
              (and
                (== (idx p 0) start)
                (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
            false)))
      (case (some final_distance)
        (is_shortest_dist (view graph) start v final_distance))))
  (body
    (if (== (idx dist v) -1)
      (forall ((p (seq int)))
        (call dijkstra_reachable_finite
          graph start dist used p 0))
      (block))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut dist (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (init_i) -1)))
    (let-mut used (vec bool) (seq-build n (fn (init_j) false)))
    (ghost-let-mut wit
      (seq (seq int))
      (seq-build n (fn (init_k) (seq-lit start))))
    (set-idx dist start 0)
    (let-mut active bool true)
    (let-mut selected i64 0)
    (let-mut outer_i i64 0)
    (assert (dijkstra_labels graph start dist wit))
    (assert (dijkstra_nonnegative dist))
    (assert (dijkstra_bounded dist 0))
    (assert (dijkstra_closed graph dist used))
    (assert (dijkstra_settled graph start dist used))
    (while (< outer_i n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 outer_i) (<= outer_i n)))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 selected) (<= selected outer_i)))
      (invariant (=> active (== selected outer_i)))
      (invariant (=> (not active) (dijkstra_no_open dist used)))
      (invariant (== (len dist) n))
      (invariant (== (len used) n))
      (invariant (== (len wit) n))
      (invariant (== (occurrences used false) (- n selected)))
      (invariant (dijkstra_labels graph start dist wit))
      (invariant (dijkstra_nonnegative dist))
      (invariant (dijkstra_bounded dist (* outer_i 100000)))
      (invariant (dijkstra_closed graph dist used))
      (invariant (dijkstra_settled graph start dist used))
      (invariant (== (idx dist start) 0))
      (decreases (- n outer_i))
      (if active
        (block
          (let-mut scan_i i64 0)
          (let-mut found bool false)
          (let-mut best_vertex i64 0)
          (let-mut best_distance i64 0)
          (while (< scan_i n)
            (invariant (and (<= 0 scan_i) (<= scan_i n)))
            (invariant
              (dijkstra_scan
                dist
                used
                scan_i
                found
                best_vertex
                best_distance
                (* outer_i 100000)))
            (decreases (- n scan_i))
            (let scan_distance i64 (idx dist scan_i))
            (if
              (and
                (not (idx used scan_i))
                (>= scan_distance 0))
              (if
                (or (not found) (< scan_distance best_distance))
                (block
                  (call dijkstra_scan_pick
                    dist
                    used
                    scan_i
                    found
                    best_vertex
                    best_distance
                    (* outer_i 100000))
                  (set found true)
                  (set best_vertex scan_i)
                  (set best_distance scan_distance))
                (call dijkstra_scan_keep
                  dist
                  used
                  scan_i
                  found
                  best_vertex
                  best_distance
                  (* outer_i 100000)))
              (call dijkstra_scan_skip
                dist
                used
                scan_i
                found
                best_vertex
                best_distance
                (* outer_i 100000)))
            (set scan_i (+ scan_i 1)))
          (if found
            (block
              (call dijkstra_scan_minimum
                dist
                used
                found
                best_vertex
                best_distance
                (* outer_i 100000))
              (call dijkstra_choice
                graph
                start
                dist
                used
                wit
                best_vertex
                best_distance)
              (let row_length i64
                (len (idx (field graph adj) best_vertex)))
              (let-mut edge_i i64 0)
              (while (< edge_i row_length)
                (invariant (and (<= 0 edge_i) (<= edge_i row_length)))
                (invariant (== (len dist) n))
                (invariant (== (len used) n))
                (invariant (== (len wit) n))
                (invariant (dijkstra_labels graph start dist wit))
                (invariant (dijkstra_nonnegative dist))
                (invariant
                  (dijkstra_bounded dist (* (+ outer_i 1) 100000)))
                (invariant (dijkstra_closed graph dist used))
                (invariant (dijkstra_settled graph start dist used))
                (invariant
                  (dijkstra_partial
                    graph dist best_vertex edge_i best_distance))
                (invariant
                  (and
                    (and (<= 0 best_vertex) (< best_vertex n))
                    (and
                      (not (idx used best_vertex))
                      (and
                        (>= best_distance 0)
                        (and
                          (== best_distance (idx dist best_vertex))
                          (<= best_distance (* outer_i 100000)))))))
                (invariant (== (idx dist start) 0))
                (decreases (- row_length edge_i))
                (let edge_value (tuple i64 i64)
                  (idx
                    (idx (field graph adj) best_vertex)
                    edge_i))
                (let edge_target i64 (get edge_value 0))
                (let edge_weight i64 (get edge_value 1))
                (assert
                  (has_edge
                    (view graph)
                    best_vertex
                    edge_target
                    edge_weight))
                (assert (and (>= edge_weight 0) (<= edge_weight 100000)))
                (let candidate_distance i64
                  (+ best_distance edge_weight))
                (call dijkstra_extend_path
                  graph
                  (idx wit best_vertex)
                  best_vertex
                  edge_target
                  edge_weight)
                (if (idx used edge_target)
                  (block
                    (call dijkstra_settled_edge_bound
                      graph
                      start
                      dist
                      used
                      wit
                      best_vertex
                      edge_target
                      edge_weight
                      candidate_distance)
                    (call dijkstra_partial_step
                      graph
                      dist
                      best_vertex
                      edge_i
                      best_distance))
                  (block
                    (let old_distance i64 (idx dist edge_target))
                    (if
                      (or
                        (== old_distance -1)
                        (< candidate_distance old_distance))
                      (block
                        (assert (!= edge_target start))
                        (ghost-let dist0 (seq int) dist)
                        (ghost-let wit0 (seq (seq int)) wit)
                        (call dijkstra_build_updw
                          wit0
                          edge_target
                          (concat
                            (idx wit0 best_vertex)
                            (seq-lit edge_target)))
                        (ghost-set wit
                          (seq-build n
                            (fn (wit_i)
                              (if
                                (== wit_i edge_target)
                                (concat
                                  (idx wit0 best_vertex)
                                  (seq-lit edge_target))
                                (idx wit0 wit_i)))))
                        (set-idx dist edge_target candidate_distance)
                        (assert
                          (dijkstra_upd
                            dist0
                            dist
                            edge_target
                            candidate_distance))
                        (call dijkstra_preserve_other
                          dist0
                          dist
                          edge_target
                          candidate_distance
                          start)
                        (call dijkstra_step_labels
                          graph
                          start
                          dist0
                          wit0
                          dist
                          wit
                          best_vertex
                          edge_target
                          edge_weight
                          candidate_distance)
                        (call dijkstra_step_nonnegative
                          dist0 dist edge_target candidate_distance)

                     (get (idx (idx g a) e) 1))))))))))

(ghost-fn triangle_labels
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (seen (seq bool))
   (dist (seq int))) bool
  (body (and
    (and (== (len seen) (len g)) (== (len dist) (len g)))
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (=> (and
            (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (idx seen u))
            (connected g u v))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
            (<= (idx dist v)
                (+ (idx dist u) (get_edge_weight g u v)))))))))

(lemma count_nonneg_bool
  (params (s (seq bool)) (x bool) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (call count_nonneg_bool s x (- k 1))
      (block))))

(lemma count_member_bool
  (params (s (seq bool)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k (+ j 1))
      (call count_member_bool s j (- k 1))
      (call count_nonneg_bool s (idx s j) j))))

(lemma all_false_count
  (params (s (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (forall ((j int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len s)))
          (not (idx s j)))))
  (ensures (== (occurrences s false) (len s)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body

          (forall ((j int))
            (=> (and
                  (<= 0 j)
                  (< j (len (take s (- (len s) 1)))))
                (not (idx (take s (- (len s) 1)) j)))))
        (call all_false_count (take s (- (len s) 1)))
        (call law_take_step s (- (len s) 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          (seq-lit (idx s (- (len s) 1)))

          (idx s (- (len s) 1)) false))
      (block))))

(lemma discover_step

    (== (get (idx (idx g u) lim) 1) w)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
    (and (<= 0 w) (<= w 100000))
    (not (idx seen0 v))

    (==
      (path_weight g (concat (idx wit0 u) (seq-lit v)))
      (+ (idx dist0 u) w))
    (updb seen0 seen v true)
    (updi dist0 dist v (+ (idx dist0 u) w))
    (updi pos0 pos v (len queue0))
    (updpaths wit0 wit v (concat (idx wit0 u) (seq-lit v)))
    (appended_i queue0 queue v))
  (ensures
    (queue_state seen queue pos n)
    (distance_bound seen dist pos n)
    (path_witnesses g start seen dist wit n)
    (closed_prefix g seen queue head)

    (forall ((x int))

    (forall ((x int))

    (forall ((x int))
      (call law_occurrences_unit v x))
    (assert (idx seen0 u))
    (assert (< (idx pos0 u) (len queue0)))
    (assert (<= 0 (+ (idx dist0 u) w)))
    (assert
      (<= (+ (idx dist0 u) w)
          (* 100000 (len queue0))))
    (call count_nonneg_bool seen false (len seen))
    (assert (== (take seen (len seen)) seen))
    (assert (queue_state seen queue pos n))
    (assert (distance_bound seen dist pos n))
    (assert (path_witnesses g start seen dist wit n))
    (assert (closed_prefix g seen queue head))
    (assert (partial_closed g seen u (+ lim 1)))))

    (call law_idx_take p (+ m 1) m)

        (take p m)))
    (assert
      (==
        (idx (take p (+ m 1)) (- m 1))
        (idx p (- m 1))))
    (assert
      (==
        (idx (take p (+ m 1)) m)
        (idx p m)))
    (assert

(lemma final_vertex
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (v int) (n int)
    (seen (seq bool)) (dist (seq int)) (wit (seq (seq int))))
  (requires
    (== n (len g))

    (== (len dist) n)
    (== (len wit) n)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start n))

  (requires
    (well_formed wg)
    (weights_non_negative (view wg))
    (weights_and_size_bounded (view wg))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (size wg)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx (view wg) u)))))
  (ensures
    (has_edge
      (view wg) u
      (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) i) 0)
      (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) i) 1))
    (>= (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) i) 1) 0)
    (<= (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) i) 1) 100000)
    (==
      (get_edge_weight
        (view wg) u
        (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) i) 0))
      (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) i) 1)))
  (body
    (assert
      (forall ((a int) (b int))
        (=> (and
              (and
                (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len (idx (view wg) u))))
                (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx (view wg) u)))))
              (!= a b))
            (!=
              (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) a) 0)
              (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) b) 0)))))
    (call weight_hit
      (idx (view wg) u)
      (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) i) 0)
      (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) i) 1)
      0 i)))

(lemma extend_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int))
    (start int) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (== (get_edge_weight g u v) w))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v)) 0) start)
    (== (idx (concat p (seq-lit v))
             (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        v)
    (==
      (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (+ (path_weight g p) w)))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit v)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit v))
    (assert (== (take (concat p (seq-lit v)) (len p)) p))))

(lemma queue_room
  (params
    (seen (seq bool)) (queue (seq int))
    (pos (seq int)) (n int) (v int))
  (requires
    (queue_state seen queue pos n)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
    (not (idx seen v)))
  (ensures (< (len queue) n))
  (body
    (call count_member_bool seen v (len seen))
    (assert (== (take seen (len seen)) seen))))

(lemma initial_state
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (n int)
    (seen (seq bool)) (dist (seq int)) (queue (seq int))
    (pos (seq int)) (wit (seq (seq int))))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start n))
    (== (len seen) n)
    (== (len dist) n)
    (== (len pos) n)
    (== (len wit) n)
    (== queue (seq-lit start))
    (forall ((k int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k n))
          (and
            (== (idx seen k) (== k start))
            (and
              (== (idx dist k) 0)
              (and
                (== (idx pos k) 0)
                (== (idx wit k) (seq-lit start))))))))
  (ensures
    (queue_state seen queue pos n)
    (distance_bound seen dist pos n)
    (path_witnesses g start seen dist wit n)
    (closed_prefix g seen queue 0))
  (body
    (call false_count_single seen start)
    (call unit_queue_facts start n)
    (call singleton_path g start)
    (call count_nonneg_bool seen false (len seen))
    (assert (== (take seen (len seen)) seen))
    (assert
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (== (idx seen v) (contains queue v)))))
    (assert
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (idx seen v))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 (idx pos v))
                   (< (idx pos v) (len queue)))
              (== (idx queue (idx pos v)) v)))))
    (assert (queue_state seen queue pos n))
    (assert (distance_bound seen dist pos n))
    (assert (path_witnesses g start seen dist wit n))
    (assert (closed_prefix g seen queue 0))))

(lemma discover_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (n int)
    (seen0 (seq bool)) (dist0 (seq int)) (queue0 (seq int))
    (pos0 (seq int)) (wit0 (seq (seq int)))
    (seen (seq bool)) (dist (seq int)) (queue (seq int))
    (pos (seq int)) (wit (seq (seq int)))
    (head int) (u int) (v int) (w int) (lim int))
  (requires
    (queue_state seen0 queue0 pos0 n)
    (distance_bound seen0 dist0 pos0 n)
    (path_witnesses g start seen0 dist0 wit0 n)
    (closed_prefix g seen0 queue0 head)
    (partial_closed g seen0 u lim)
    (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len queue0)))
    (== (idx queue0 head) u)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 lim) (< lim (len (idx g u))))
    (== (get (idx (idx g u) lim) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx (idx g u) lim) 1) w)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
    (and (<= 0 w) (<= w 100000))
    (not (idx seen0 v))
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (is_path g (concat (idx wit0 u) (seq-lit v)))
    (==
      (path_weight g (concat (idx wit0 u) (seq-lit v)))
      (+ (idx dist0 u) w))
    (updb seen0 seen v true)
    (updi dist0 dist v (+ (idx dist0 u) w))
    (updi pos0 pos v (len queue0))
    (updpaths wit0 wit v (concat (idx wit0 u) (seq-lit v)))
    (appended_i queue0 queue v))
  (ensures
    (queue_state seen queue pos n)
    (distance_bound seen dist pos n)
    (path_witnesses g start seen dist wit n)
    (closed_prefix g seen queue head)
    (partial_closed g seen u (+ lim 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((x int))
      (call law_contains_concat queue0 (seq-lit v) x))
    (forall ((x int))
      (call law_contains_unit v x))
    (forall ((x int))
      (call law_occurrences_concat queue0 (seq-lit v) x))
    (forall ((x int))
      (call law_occurrences_unit v x))
    (assert (idx seen0 u))
    (assert (< (idx pos0 u) (len queue0)))
    (assert (<= 0 (+ (idx dist0 u) w)))
    (assert
      (<= (+ (idx dist0 u) w)
          (* 100000 (len queue0))))
    (call count_nonneg_bool seen false (len seen))
    (assert (== (take seen (len seen)) seen))
    (assert (queue_state seen queue pos n))
    (assert (distance_bound seen dist pos n))
    (assert (path_witnesses g start seen dist wit n))
    (assert (closed_prefix g seen queue head))
    (assert (partial_closed g seen u (+ lim 1)))))

    (== (get (idx (idx g u) lim) 0) v))

  (body))

(lemma pass_edge_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (seen (seq bool))
    (base (seq int)) (dist (seq int))
    (u int) (i int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires
    (pass_rel g seen base dist u i)
    (pointwise_le dist base)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
    (=> (idx seen u)
        (<= (idx dist v) (+ (idx dist u) w))))
  (ensures (pass_rel g seen base dist u (+ i 1)))
  (body))

(lemma weight_choice_bound
  (params
    (row (seq (tuple int int))) (dist (seq int))
    (v int) (i int) (du int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len row)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
    (exists ((j int))
      (and
        (and (<= i j) (< j (len row)))
        (== (get (idx row j) 0) v)))
    (forall ((e int))
      (=> (and
            (and (<= i e) (< e (len row)))
            (== (get (idx row e) 0) v))
          (<= (idx dist v)
              (+ du (get (idx row e) 1))))))
  (ensures
    (<= (idx dist v) (+ du (weight_from row v i))))
  (decreases (- (len row) i))
  (body
    (if (== (get (idx row i) 0) v)
      (block)
      (call weight_choice_bound row dist v (+ i 1) du))))

(lemma pass_finished_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (seen (seq bool))
    (dist (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires
    (pass_rel g seen dist dist (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (idx seen u)
    (connected g u v))
  (ensures
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
    (<= (idx dist v)
        (+ (idx dist u) (get_edge_weight g u v))))
  (body
    (obtain ((w int)) (has_edge g u v w))
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and
        (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
             (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w))))
    (assert
      (forall ((e int))
        (=> (and
              (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g u))))
              (== (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0) v))
            (<= (idx dist v)
                (+ (idx dist u)
                   (get (idx (idx g u) e) 1))))))
    (call weight_choice_bound
      (idx g u) dist v 0 (idx dist u))))
