(lemma seen_along_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (seen (seq bool))
    (start int) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires
    (edge_closed g seen)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len seen)))
    (idx seen start)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and (<= 0 (idx p m)) (< (idx p m) (len seen)))
    (idx seen (idx p m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call seen_along_path g seen start p (- m 1))
        (assert (connected g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m))))
      (block))))

(lemma path_weight_take_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 1 m) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (path_weight g (take p (+ m 1)))
      (+
        (path_weight g (take p m))
        (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take p (+ m 1))
    (call law_len_take p m)
    (call law_take_take p (+ m 1) m)
    (call law_idx_take p (+ m 1) (- m 1))
    (call law_idx_take p (+ m 1) m)
    (assert
      (==
        (take (take p (+ m 1)) m)
        (take p m)))
    (assert
      (==
        (idx (take p (+ m 1)) (- m 1))
        (idx p (- m 1))))
    (assert
      (==
        (idx (take p (+ m 1)) m)
        (idx p m)))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (take p (+ m 1)))
        (+
          (path_weight g (take p m))
          (get_edge_weight g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))))))

(lemma lower_along_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (seen (seq bool))
    (dist (seq int)) (start int) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires
    (edge_closed g seen)
    (triangle_labels g seen dist)
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len seen)))
    (idx seen start)
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and (<= 0 (idx p m)) (< (idx p m) (len seen)))
    (<=
      (idx dist (idx p m))
      (path_weight g (take p (+ m 1)))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (call seen_along_path g seen start p m)
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call lower_along_path
          g seen dist start p (- m 1))
        (assert
          (connected g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
        (call path_weight_take_step g p m))
      (block
        (call law_len_take p 1)
        (assert (== (idx p 0) start))))))

(lemma final_vertex
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (v int) (n int)
    (seen (seq bool)) (dist (seq int)) (wit (seq (seq int))))
  (requires
    (== n (len g))
    (== (len seen) n)
    (== (len dist) n)
    (== (len wit) n)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start n))
    (idx seen start)
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (edge_closed g seen)
    (triangle_labels g seen dist)
    (path_witnesses g start seen dist wit n))
  (ensures
    (match (if (idx seen v) (some (idx dist v)) (none))
      (case (none)
        (forall ((p (seq int)))
          (=> (and
                (is_path g p)
                (and
                  (== (idx p 0) start)
                  (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
              false)))
      (case (some d)
        (is_shortest_dist g start v d))))
  (body
    (if (idx seen v)
      (forall ((p (seq int)))
        (call lower_along_path
          g seen dist start p (- (len p) 1)))
      (forall ((p (seq int)))
        (call seen_along_path
          g seen start p (- (len p) 1))))))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths

      (forall ((j0 int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 j0) (< j0 (len dist)))

    (let-mut changed bool true)

        (path_witnesses (view graph) start seen dist wit n))

(lemma all_false_count
  (params (s (seq bool)))
  (requires

      (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len s)))

  (ensures (== (occurrences s false) (len s)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body

          (take s (- (len s) 1))

    (and (== (len seen) n) (== (len pos) n))
    (and
      (== (len dist) n)
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (and
              (<= 0 (idx dist v))
              (=> (idx seen v)
                  (<= (idx dist v) (* 100000 (idx pos v)))))))))))

(ghost-fn path_witnesses
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (seen (seq bool))
   (dist (seq int)) (wit (seq (seq int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (and
    (and (== (len seen) n) (== (len dist) n))
    (and
      (== (len wit) n)
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (idx seen v))
            (and
              (is_path g (idx wit v))
              (and
                (and
                  (== (idx (idx wit v) 0) start)
                  (== (idx (idx wit v) (- (len (idx wit v)) 1)) v))
                (== (path_weight g (idx wit v)) (idx dist v))))))))))

(ghost-fn closed_prefix
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (seen (seq bool))
   (queue (seq int)) (head int)) bool
  (body (and
    (== (len seen) (len g))
    (forall ((k int) (e int))
      (=> (and
            (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k head)) (< k (len queue)))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 (idx queue k)) (< (idx queue k) (len g)))
              (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g (idx queue k)))))))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g (idx queue k)) e) 0))
              (< (get (idx (idx g (idx queue k)) e) 0) (len seen)))
            (idx seen (get (idx (idx g (idx queue k)) e) 0))))))))

(ghost-fn partial_closed
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (seen (seq bool))
   (u int) (lim int)) bool
  (body (and
    (== (len seen) (len g))
    (and
      (=> (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 lim) (<= lim (len (idx g u)))))
      (forall ((e int))
        (=> (and
              (and (<= 0 e) (< e lim))
              (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
            (and
              (and
                (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0))
                (< (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0) (len seen)))
              (idx seen (get (idx (idx g u) e) 0)))))))))

(ghost-fn edge_closed
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (seen (seq bool))) bool
  (body (and
    (== (len seen) (len g))
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (=> (and
            (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (idx seen u))
            (connected g u v))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len seen)))
            (idx seen v)))))))

(ghost-fn pointwise_le ((a (seq int)) (b (seq int))) bool
  (body (and
    (== (len a) (len b))
    (forall ((k int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len a)))
          (<= (idx a k) (idx b k)))))))

(ghost-fn pass_rel
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (seen (seq bool))
   (base (seq int)) (dist (seq int)) (u int) (lim int)) bool
  (body (and
    (and
      (== (len seen) (len g))
      (and (== (len base) (len g)) (== (len dist) (len g))))
    (forall ((a int) (e int))
      (=> (and
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g a))))
              (or (< a u) (and (== a u) (< e lim)))))
          (=> (idx seen a)
              (and
                (and
                  (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g a) e) 0))
                  (< (get (idx (idx g a) e) 0) (len dist)))
                (<=
                  (idx dist (get (idx (idx g a) e) 0))
                  (+ (idx base a)
                     (get (idx (idx g a) e) 1))))))))))

(ghost-fn triangle_labels
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (seen (seq bool))
   (dist (seq int))) bool
  (body (and
    (and (== (len seen) (len g)) (== (len dist) (len g)))
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (=> (and
            (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (idx seen u))
            (connected g u v))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
            (<= (idx dist v)
                (+ (idx dist u) (get_edge_weight g u v)))))))))

(lemma count_nonneg_bool
  (params (s (seq bool)) (x bool) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (call count_nonneg_bool s x (- k 1))
      (block))))

(lemma count_member_bool
  (params (s (seq bool)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k (+ j 1))
      (call count_member_bool s j (- k 1))
      (call count_nonneg_bool s (idx s j) j))))

(lemma bool_len_take
  (params (s (seq bool)) (k int))

(lemma bool_idx_take
  (params (s (seq bool)) (k int) (i int))

(lemma bool_occurrences_concat
  (params (s (seq bool)) (t (seq bool)) (x bool))

(lemma bool_occurrences_unit
  (params (y bool) (x bool))
  (ensures

(lemma all_false_count
  (params (s (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (forall ((j int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len s)))
          (not (idx s j)))))
  (ensures (== (occurrences s false) (len s)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (call bool_len_take s (- (len s) 1))
        (forall ((j int))
          (call bool_idx_take s (- (len s) 1) j))
        (assert
          (forall ((j int))
            (=> (and
                  (<= 0 j)
                  (< j (len (take s (- (len s) 1)))))
                (not (idx (take s (- (len s) 1)) j)))))
        (call all_false_count (take s (- (len s) 1)))
        (call bool_take_step s (- (len s) 1))
        (call bool_occurrences_concat
          (take s (- (len s) 1))
          (seq-lit (idx s (- (len s) 1)))
          false)
        (call bool_occurrences_unit
          (idx s (- (len s) 1)) false))
      (block))))

(lemma false_count_single
  (params (s (seq bool)) (start int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len s)))
    (forall ((j int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len s)))
          (== (idx s j) (== j start)))))
  (ensures
    (== (occurrences s false) (- (len s) 1)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (call bool_len_take s (- (len s) 1))
    (forall ((j int))
      (call bool_idx_take s (- (len s) 1) j))
    (call bool_take_step s (- (len s) 1))
    (call bool_occurrences_concat
      (take s (- (len s) 1))
      (seq-lit (idx s (- (len s) 1)))
      false)
    (call bool_occurrences_unit
      (idx s (- (len s) 1)) false)
    (if (== start (- (len s) 1))
      (block
        (assert
          (forall ((j int))
            (=> (and
                  (<= 0 j)
                  (< j (len (take s (- (len s) 1)))))
                (not (idx (take s (- (len s) 1)) j)))))
        (call all_false_count (take s (- (len s) 1))))
      (block
        (assert
          (and (<= 0 start)
               (< start (len (take s (- (len s) 1))))))
        (assert
          (forall ((j int))
            (=> (and
                  (<= 0 j)
                  (< j (len (take s (- (len s) 1)))))
                (==
                  (idx (take s (- (len s) 1)) j)
                  (== j start)))))
        (call false_count_single
          (take s (- (len s) 1)) start)))))

(lemma unit_queue_facts
  (params (start int) (n int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 start) (< start n)))
  (ensures
    (== (len (seq-lit start)) 1)
    (forall ((k int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (seq-lit start))))
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx (seq-lit start) k))
            (< (idx (seq-lit start) k) n))))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
          (== (contains (seq-lit start) v) (== v start))))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
          (<= (occurrences (seq-lit start) v) 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit start)
    (forall ((v int))
      (call law_contains_unit start v))
    (forall ((v int))

(lemma update_tail_facts
  (params (s (seq int)) (k int) (x int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s))))

        (and
          (== (take (seq_update s k x) (- (len s) 1))

    (=> (== k (- (len s) 1))

          (== (last (seq_update s k x)) x))))

  (decreases (len s))
  (body

(lemma weight_hit
  (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (v int) (w int)
          (i int) (j int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 i) (<= i j))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len row)))
    (== (get (idx row j) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx row j) 1) w)
    (forall ((a int) (b int))
      (=> (and

          (!= (get (idx row a) 0)
              (get (idx row b) 0)))))
  (ensures (== (weight_from row v i) w))
  (decreases (- j i))
  (body

(lemma edge_at
  (params (wg weighted_graph) (u int) (i int))

      (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) i) 0)

    (>= (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) i) 1) 0)

        (view wg) u
        (get (idx (idx (view wg) u) i) 0))

    (call weight_hit

    (has_edge g u v w)

             (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
        v)
    (==

  (body

(lemma queue_state_discover
  (params
    (seen0 (seq bool)) (queue0 (seq int)) (pos0 (seq int))
    (seen (seq bool)) (queue (seq int)) (pos (seq int))
    (n int) (v int))
  (requires
    (queue_state seen0 queue0 pos0 n)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
    (not (idx seen0 v))
    (updb seen0 seen v true)
    (updi pos0 pos v (len queue0))
    (appended_i queue0 queue v))
  (ensures (queue_state seen queue pos n))
  (body
    (forall ((x int))
      (call law_contains_concat queue0 (seq-lit v) x))
    (forall ((x int))
      (call law_contains_unit v x))
    (forall ((x int))
      (call law_occurrences_concat queue0 (seq-lit v) x))
    (forall ((x int))
      (call law_occurrences_unit v x))
    (call count_nonneg_bool seen false (len seen))
    (assert (== (take seen (len seen)) seen))
    (assert (not (contains queue0 v)))
    (assert
      (== (occurrences seen false)
          (- (occurrences seen0 false) 1)))
    (assert
      (== (+ (len queue) (occurrences seen false)) n))
    (assert
      (forall ((x int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
            (== (idx seen x) (contains queue x)))))
    (assert
      (forall ((x int))
        (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (idx seen x))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 (idx pos x))
                   (< (idx pos x) (len queue)))
              (== (idx queue (idx pos x)) x)))))
    (assert
      (forall ((x int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
            (<= (occurrences queue x) 1))))))

(lemma initial_state
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (n int)
    (seen (seq bool)) (dist (seq int)) (queue (seq int))
    (pos (seq int)) (wit (seq (seq int))))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start n))
    (== (len seen) n)
    (== (len dist) n)
    (== (len pos) n)
    (== (len wit) n)
    (== queue (seq-lit start))
    (forall ((k int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k n))
          (and
            (== (idx seen k) (== k start))
            (and
              (== (idx dist k) 0)
              (and
                (== (idx pos k) 0)
                (== (idx wit k) (seq-lit start))))))))
  (ensures
    (queue_state seen queue pos n)
    (distance_bound seen dist pos n)
    (path_witnesses g start seen dist wit n)
    (closed_prefix g seen queue 0))
  (body
    (call false_count_single seen start)
    (call unit_queue_facts start n)
    (call singleton_path g start)
    (call count_nonneg_bool seen false (len seen))
    (assert (== (take seen (len seen)) seen))
    (assert
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (== (idx seen v) (contains queue v)))))
    (assert
      (forall ((v int))
        (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (idx seen v))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 (idx pos v))
                   (< (idx pos v) (len queue)))
              (== (idx queue (idx pos v)) v)))))
    (assert (queue_state seen queue pos n))
    (assert (distance_bound seen dist pos n))
    (assert (path_witnesses g start seen dist wit n))
    (assert (closed_prefix g seen queue 0))))

(lemma discover_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (n int)
    (seen0 (seq bool)) (dist0 (seq int)) (queue0 (seq int))
    (pos0 (seq int)) (wit0 (seq (seq int)))
    (seen (seq bool)) (dist (seq int)) (queue (seq int))
    (pos (seq int)) (wit (seq (seq int)))
    (head int) (u int) (v int) (w int) (lim int))
  (requires
    (queue_state seen0 queue0 pos0 n)
    (distance_bound seen0 dist0 pos0 n)
    (path_witnesses g start seen0 dist0 wit0 n)
    (closed_prefix g seen0 queue0 head)
    (partial_closed g seen0 u lim)
    (and (<= 0 head) (< head (len queue0)))
    (== (idx queue0 head) u)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 lim) (< lim (len (idx g u))))
    (== (get (idx (idx g u) lim) 0) v)
    (== (get (idx (idx g u) lim) 1) w)
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
    (and (<= 0 w) (<= w 100000))
    (not (idx seen0 v))
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (is_path g (concat (idx wit0 u) (seq-lit v)))
    (==
      (path_weight g (concat (idx wit0 u) (seq-lit v)))
      (+ (idx dist0 u) w))
    (updb seen0 seen v true)
    (updi dist0 dist v (+ (idx dist0 u) w))
    (updi pos0 pos v (len queue0))
    (updpaths wit0 wit v (concat (idx wit0 u) (seq-lit v)))
    (appended_i queue0 queue v))
  (ensures
    (queue_state seen queue pos n)
    (distance_bound seen dist pos n)
    (path_witnesses g start seen dist wit n)
    (closed_prefix g seen queue head)
    (partial_closed g seen u (+ lim 1)))
  (body
    (call queue_state_discover
      seen0 queue0 pos0 seen queue pos n v)
    (assert (idx seen0 u))
    (assert (< (idx pos0 u) (len queue0)))
    (assert (<= 0 (+ (idx dist0 u) w)))
    (assert
      (<= (+ (idx dist0 u) w)
          (* 100000 (len queue0))))
    (assert (distance_bound seen dist pos n))
    (assert (path_witnesses g start seen dist wit n))
    (assert (closed_prefix g seen queue head))
    (assert (partial_closed g seen u (+ lim 1)))))

(lemma relax_witness
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (start int) (n int)
    (seen (seq bool)) (dist0 (seq int)) (wit0 (seq (seq int)))
    (dist (seq int)) (wit (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (v int) (w int) (x int))
  (requires
    (path_witnesses g start seen dist0 wit0 n)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
    (idx seen u)
    (idx seen v)

        (and (<= 0 upto) (<= upto (len (idx g chosen)))))
      (and
        (forall ((u int) (v int) (w int))
          (=>
            (and
              (and
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len done)))
                  (idx done u))
                (!= u chosen))
              (and
                (has_edge g u v w)
                (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))))
            (and
              (>= (idx dist v) 0)
              (<=
                (idx dist v)
                (+ (idx dist u) w)))))
        (forall ((i int))
          (=>
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i upto))
            (and
              (>=
                (idx dist
                  (get (idx (idx g chosen) i) 0))
                0)
              (<=
                (idx dist
                  (get (idx (idx g chosen) i) 0))
                (+
                  (idx dist chosen)
                  (get (idx (idx g chosen) i) 1))))))))))

(ghost-fn final_dist
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (start int)
   (dist (seq int)))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len dist) (len g))
      (forall ((v int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
          (if
            (== (idx dist v) -1)
            (forall ((p (seq int)))
              (=>
                (and
                  (is_path g p)
                  (and
                    (== (idx p 0) start)
                    (==
                      (idx p (- (len p) 1))
                      v)))
                false))
            (is_shortest_dist
              g start v (idx dist v))))))))

(lemma well_formed_unique
  (params (wg weighted_graph))
  (requires (well_formed wg))
  (ensures
    (graph_range (view wg))
    (unique_targets (view wg)))
  (body))

(lemma init_dijkstra
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (done (seq bool))
    (wit (seq (seq int))))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len g)))
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (== (len done) (len g))
    (== (len wit) (len g))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
        (==
          (idx dist v)
          (if (== v start) 0 -1))))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
        (not (idx done v))))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
        (== (idx wit v) (seq-lit start)))))
  (ensures
    (dist_domain dist)
    (dist_cap dist 0)
    (dist_witnessed g start dist wit)
    (settled_sound g start dist done)
    (closed_edges g dist done))
  (body))

(lemma all_false_count
  (params (done (seq bool)))
  (requires
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len done)))
        (not (idx done v)))))
  (ensures (== (count_true done) 0))
  (body))

(lemma scan_take
  (params
    (dist (seq int))
    (done (seq bool))
    (at int)
    (chosen int)
    (best int))
  (requires
    (scan_min dist done at chosen best)
    (< at (len dist))
    (not (idx done at))
    (>= (idx dist at) 0)
    (or
      (== chosen -1)
      (< (idx dist at) best)))
  (ensures
    (scan_min
      dist done (+ at 1) at (idx dist at)))
  (body))

(lemma scan_skip
  (params
    (dist (seq int))
    (done (seq bool))
    (at int)
    (chosen int)
    (best int))
  (requires
    (scan_min dist done at chosen best)
    (< at (len dist))
    (not
      (and
        (not (idx done at))
        (and
          (>= (idx dist at) 0)
          (or
            (== chosen -1)
            (< (idx dist at) best))))))
  (ensures
    (scan_min
      dist done (+ at 1) chosen best))
  (body))

(lemma count_true_mark
  (params
    (before (seq bool))
    (after (seq bool))
    (at int))
  (requires
    (bool_update before after at true)
    (not (idx before at)))
  (ensures
    (==
      (count_true after)
      (+ (count_true before) 1)))
  (body))

(lemma false_index_count_bound
  (params
    (done (seq bool))
    (at int)
    (count int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len done)))
    (not (idx done at))
    (== (count_true done) count))
  (ensures (< count (len done)))
  (body))

(lemma widen_dist_cap
  (params
    (dist (seq int))
    (old_cap int)
    (new_cap int))
  (requires
    (dist_cap dist old_cap)
    (<= old_cap new_cap))
  (ensures (dist_cap dist new_cap))
  (body))

(lemma lookup_is_edge
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (connected g u v)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures
    (has_edge g u v (get_edge_weight g u v)))
  (body
    (obtain ((w int)) (has_edge g u v w))))

(lemma unique_edge_weight
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (first int)
    (second int))
  (requires
    (unique_targets g)
    (has_edge g u v first)
    (has_edge g u v second))
  (ensures (== first second))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) first))))
    (obtain ((j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v)
          (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1) second))))))

(lemma prefix_is_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 k) (<= k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (take p k))
    (== (idx (take p k) 0) (idx p 0))
    (==
      (idx (take p k) (- k 1))
      (idx p (- k 1))))
  (body))

(lemma path_step_facts
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (m int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (and (<= 1 m) (< m (len p)))
    (unique_targets g)
    (weights_non_negative g))
  (ensures
    (connected g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m))
    (has_edge
      g
      (idx p (- m 1))
      (idx p m)
      (get_edge_weight
        g
        (idx p (- m 1))
        (idx p m)))
    (>=
      (get_edge_weight
        g
        (idx p (- m 1))
        (idx p m))
      0)
    (==
      (path_weight g (take p (+ m 1)))
      (+
        (path_weight g (take p m))
        (get_edge_weight
          g
          (idx p (- m 1))
          (idx p m)))))
  (body
    (obtain ((w int))
      (has_edge g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m) w))
    (call lookup_is_edge
      g
      (idx p (- m 1))
      (idx p m))
    (call unique_edge_weight
      g
      (idx p (- m 1))
      (idx p m)
      w
      (get_edge_weight
        g
        (idx p (- m 1))
        (idx p m)))))

(lemma append_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) u)
    (has_edge g u v w)
    (unique_targets g))
  (ensures
    (is_path g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
    (==
      (idx
        (concat p (seq-lit v))
        (- (len (concat p (seq-lit v))) 1))
      v)
    (==
      (path_weight g (concat p (seq-lit v)))
      (+ (path_weight g p) w)))
  (body
    (call lookup_is_edge g u v)
    (call unique_edge_weight
      g u v w (get_edge_weight g u v))))

(lemma dijkstra_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (done (seq bool))
    (chosen int)
    (best int)
    (p (seq int))
    (m int))
  (requires
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (== (len done) (len dist))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (graph_range g)
    (unique_targets g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (dist_domain dist)
    (settled_sound g start dist done)
    (closed_edges g dist done)
    (scan_min dist done (len dist) chosen best)
    (and (<= 0 chosen) (< chosen (len dist)))
    (not (idx done chosen))
    (== (idx dist chosen) best)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures
    (or
      (<= best (path_weight g (take p (+ m 1))))
      (and
        (idx done (idx p m))
        (<=
          (idx dist (idx p m))
          (path_weight g (take p (+ m 1)))))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (== m 0)
      (block
        (call prefix_is_path g p 1)
        (assert
          (== (path_weight g (take p 1)) 0)))
      (block
        (call dijkstra_bound
          g start dist done chosen best p (- m 1))
        (call prefix_is_path g p m)
        (call prefix_is_path g p (+ m 1))
        (call path_step_facts g p m)
        (assert
          (or
            (<= best (path_weight g (take p m)))
            (and
              (idx done (idx p (- m 1)))
              (<=
                (idx dist (idx p (- m 1)))
                (path_weight g (take p m)))))))))))

(lemma selected_is_shortest
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (done (seq bool))
    (wit (seq (seq int)))
    (chosen int)
    (best int)
    (cap int))
  (requires
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (== (len done) (len dist))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (graph_range g)
    (unique_targets g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (dist_domain dist)
    (dist_cap dist cap)
    (dist_witnessed g start dist wit)
    (settled_sound g start dist done)
    (closed_edges g dist done)
    (scan_min dist done (len dist) chosen best)
    (and (<= 0 chosen) (< chosen (len dist)))
    (not (idx done chosen))
    (== (idx dist chosen) best))
  (ensures
    (is_shortest_dist g start chosen best))
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call dijkstra_bound
        g start dist done chosen best p (- (len p) 1)))
    (assert
      (is_path g (idx wit chosen)))
    (assert
      (==
        (path_weight g (idx wit chosen))
        best))))

(lemma mark_settled
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (before (seq bool))
    (after (seq bool))
    (chosen int))
  (requires
    (settled_sound g start dist before)
    (bool_update before after chosen true)
    (not (idx before chosen))
    (is_shortest_dist
      g start chosen (idx dist chosen)))
  (ensures
    (settled_sound g start dist after))
  (body))

(lemma begin_partial_close
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist (seq int))
    (before (seq bool))
    (after (seq bool))
    (chosen int))
  (requires
    (closed_edges g dist before)
    (bool_update before after chosen true)
    (not (idx before chosen))
    (and (<= 0 chosen) (< chosen (len g))))
  (ensures
    (partial_closed g dist after chosen 0))
  (body))

(lemma improvement_unsettled
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (done (seq bool))
    (wit (seq (seq int)))
    (chosen int)
    (target int)
    (edge_weight int)
    (alternative int))
  (requires
    (dist_witnessed g start dist wit)
    (settled_sound g start dist done)
    (unique_targets g)
    (idx done chosen)
    (is_shortest_dist
      g start chosen (idx dist chosen))
    (has_edge g chosen target edge_weight)
    (>= edge_weight 0)
    (== alternative
      (+ (idx dist chosen) edge_weight))
    (or
      (== (idx dist target) -1)
      (> (idx dist target) alternative)))
  (ensures
    (not (idx done target))
    (!= target start)
    (!= target chosen))
  (body
    (call append_path
      g
      (idx wit chosen)
      chosen
      target
      edge_weight)))

(lemma relax_edge
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (before (seq int))
    (after (seq int))
    (done (seq bool))
    (wit_before (seq (seq int)))
    (wit_after (seq (seq int)))
    (chosen int)
    (edge_index int)
    (target int)
    (edge_weight int)
    (alternative int)
    (cap int))
  (requires
    (dist_domain before)
    (dist_cap before cap)
    (dist_witnessed g start before wit_before)
    (settled_sound g start before done)
    (partial_closed g before done chosen edge_index)
    (unique_targets g)
    (and
      (<= 0 edge_index)
      (< edge_index (len (idx g chosen))))
    (== target
      (get (idx (idx g chosen) edge_index) 0))
    (== edge_weight
      (get (idx (idx g chosen) edge_index) 1))
    (has_edge g chosen target edge_weight)
    (>= edge_weight 0)
    (== alternative
      (+ (idx before chosen) edge_weight))
    (<= alternative cap)
    (not (idx done target))
    (!= target start)
    (!= target chosen)
    (int_update before after target alternative)
    (path_update
      wit_before
      wit_after
      target
      (concat
        (idx wit_before chosen)
        (seq-lit target))))
  (ensures
    (dist_domain after)
    (dist_cap after cap)
    (dist_witnessed g start after wit_after)
    (settled_sound g start after done)
    (partial_closed
      g after done chosen (+ edge_index 1))
    (== (idx after start) (idx before start))
    (== (idx after chosen) (idx before chosen)))
  (body
    (call append_path
      g
      (idx wit_before chosen)
      chosen
      target
      edge_weight)))

(lemma skip_edge
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist (seq int))
    (done (seq bool))
    (chosen int)
    (edge_index int)
    (target int)
    (edge_weight int))
  (requires
    (partial_closed g dist done chosen edge_index)
    (and
      (<= 0 edge_index)
      (< edge_index (len (idx g chosen))))
    (== target
      (get (idx (idx g chosen) edge_index) 0))
    (== edge_weight
      (get (idx (idx g chosen) edge_index) 1))
    (>= (idx dist target) 0)
    (<=
      (idx dist target)
      (+ (idx dist chosen) edge_weight)))
  (ensures
    (partial_closed
      g dist done chosen (+ edge_index 1)))
  (body))

(lemma finish_partial_close
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (dist (seq int))
    (done (seq bool))
    (chosen int))
  (requires
    (partial_closed
      g dist done chosen (len (idx g chosen))))
  (ensures
    (closed_edges g dist done))
  (body))

(lemma no_candidate_path
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (done (seq bool))
    (chosen int)
    (best int)
    (p (seq int))
    (m int))
  (requires
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (== (len done) (len dist))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (graph_range g)
    (unique_targets g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (dist_domain dist)
    (closed_edges g dist done)
    (scan_min dist done (len dist) chosen best)
    (== chosen -1)
    (is_path g p)
    (== (idx p 0) start)
    (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures
    (>= (idx dist (idx p m)) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (== m 0)
      (block)
      (block
        (call no_candidate_path
          g start dist done chosen best p (- m 1))
        (call path_step_facts g p m)))))

(lemma no_candidate_answers
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (done (seq bool))
    (wit (seq (seq int))))
  (requires
    (== (len dist) (len g))
    (== (len done) (len dist))
    (and (<= 0 start) (< start (len dist)))
    (== (idx dist start) 0)
    (graph_range g)
    (unique_targets g)
    (weights_non_negative g)
    (dist_domain dist)
    (dist_witnessed g start dist wit)
    (settled_sound g start dist done)
    (closed_edges g dist done)
    (scan_min dist done (len dist) -1 -1))
  (ensures
    (final_dist g start dist))
  (body
    (forall ((p (seq int)))
      (call no_candidate_path
        g start dist done -1 -1 p (- (len p) 1)))))

(lemma answers_to_result
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (start int)
    (dist (seq int))
    (res (vec (option i64))))
  (requires
    (final_dist g start dist)
    (== (len res) (len dist))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len dist)))
        (match (idx res v)
          (case (none)
            (== (idx dist v) -1))
          (case (some d)
            (and
              (== d (idx dist v))
              (>= d 0)))))))
  (ensures
    (== (len res) (len g))
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))
        (match (idx res v)
          (case (none)
            (forall ((p (seq int)))
              (=>
                (and
                  (is_path g p)
                  (and
                    (== (idx p 0) start)
                    (==
                      (idx p (- (len p) 1))
                      v)))
                false)))
          (case (some d)
            (is_shortest_dist g start v d))))))
  (body))

(def dijkstra_shortest_paths
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (call well_formed_unique graph)
    (let-mut dist (vec i64)
      (seq-build n
        (fn (init_index)
          (if (== init_index start) 0 -1))))
    (let-mut done (vec bool)
      (seq-build n
        (fn (done_index) false)))
    (ghost-let-mut wit (seq (seq int))
      (seq-build n
        (fn (witness_index)
          (seq-lit start))))
    (call init_dijkstra
      (view graph) start dist done wit)
    (assert
      (forall ((initial_index int))
        (=>
          (and
            (<= 0 initial_index)
            (< initial_index (len done)))
          (not (idx done initial_index)))))
    (call all_false_count done)
    (let-mut steps i64 0)
    (let-mut active bool true)
    (while active
      (invariant active)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 steps) (<= steps n)))
      (invariant (== (len dist) n))
      (invariant (== (len done) n))
      (invariant (== (len wit) n))
      (invariant (== (idx dist start) 0))
      (invariant (dist_domain dist))
      (invariant (dist_cap dist (* steps 100000)))
      (invariant
        (dist_witnessed (view graph) start dist wit))
      (invariant
        (settled_sound (view graph) start dist done))
      (invariant
        (closed_edges (view graph) dist done))
      (invariant (== (count_true done) steps))
      (decreases (- n steps))
      (let-mut chosen i64 -1)
      (let-mut best i64 -1)
      (let-mut scan_index i64 0)
      (while (< scan_index n)
        (invariant
          (and
            (<= 0 scan_index)
            (<= scan_index n)))
        (invariant
          (scan_min
            dist done scan_index chosen best))
        (decreases (- n scan_index))
        (let scan_value i64 (idx dist scan_index))
        (let old_chosen i64 chosen)
        (let old_best i64 best)
        (if
          (and
            (not (idx done scan_index))
            (and
              (>= scan_value 0)
              (or
                (== old_chosen -1)
                (< scan_value old_best))))
          (block
            (call scan_take
              dist done scan_index
              old_chosen old_best)
            (set chosen scan_index)
            (set best scan_value))
          (call scan_skip
            dist done scan_index
            old_chosen old_best))
        (set scan_index (+ scan_index 1)))
      (if (== chosen -1)
        (block
          (call no_candidate_answers
            (view graph) start dist done wit)
          (let early_out (vec (option i64))
            (seq-build n
              (fn (early_index)
                (if
                  (== (idx dist early_index) -1)
                  (none)
                  (some (idx dist early_index))))))
          (call answers_to_result
            (view graph) start dist early_out)
          (return early_out))
        (block
          (call selected_is_shortest
            (view graph)
            start
            dist
            done
            wit
            chosen
            best
            (* steps 100000))
          (call false_index_count_bound
            done chosen steps)
          (let chosen_dist i64 (idx dist chosen))
          (ghost-let done_before (seq bool) done)
          (set-idx done chosen true)
          (assert
            (bool_update
              done_before done chosen true))
          (call count_true_mark
            done_before done chosen)
          (assert
            (==
              (count_true done)
              (+ steps 1)))
          (call mark_settled
            (view graph)
            start
            dist
            done_before
            done
            chosen)
          (call begin_partial_close
            (view graph)
            dist
            done_before
            done
            chosen)
          (call widen_dist_cap
            dist
            (* steps 100000)
            (* (+ steps 1) 100000))
          (let edge_count i64
            (len (idx (field graph adj) chosen)))
          (let-mut edge_index i64 0)
          (while (< edge_index edge_count)
            (invariant
              (and
                (<= 0 edge_index)
                (<= edge_index edge_count)))
            (invariant (== (len dist) n))
            (invariant (== (len done) n))
            (invariant (== (len wit) n))
            (invariant (== (idx dist start) 0))
            (invariant
              (== (idx dist chosen) chosen_dist))
            (invariant (dist_domain dist))
            (invariant
              (dist_cap
                dist
                (* (+ steps 1) 100000)))
            (invariant
              (dist_witnessed
                (view graph) start dist wit))
            (invariant
              (settled_sound
                (view graph) start dist done))
            (invariant
              (partial_closed
                (view graph)
                dist
                done
                chosen
                edge_index))
            (decreases (- edge_count edge_index))
            (let edge_value (tuple i64 i64)
              (idx
                (idx (field graph adj) chosen)
                edge_index))
            (let target i64 (get edge_value 0))
            (let edge_weight i64 (get edge_value 1))
            (assert
              (has_edge
                (view graph)
                chosen
                target
                edge_weight))
            (assert
              (and (<= 0 target) (< target n)))
            (assert
              (and
                (>= edge_weight 0)
                (<= edge_weight 100000)))
            (assert
              (connected
                (view graph) chosen target))
            (call lookup_is_edge
              (view graph) chosen target)
            (call unique_edge_weight
              (view graph)
              chosen
              target

              (k_crosses comp x (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0))))
          (and
            found
            (<= bw (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1))))))))

(ghost-fn k_relabel
  ((old (seq int)) (new (seq int)) (from int) (to int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len new) (len old))
      (forall ((i int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len old)))
          (==
            (idx new i)
            (if (== (idx old i) from)
              to
              (idx old i))))))))

(ghost-fn k_removed
  ((old (seq int)) (new (seq int)) (at int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len old)))
      (and
        (== (len new) (- (len old) 1))
        (forall ((i int))
          (=>
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len new)))
            (==
              (idx new i)
              (idx old
                (if (< i at)
                  i
                  (+ i 1))))))))))

(ghost-fn k_appended
  ((old (seq (tuple int int int)))
   (new (seq (tuple int int int)))
   (u int)
   (v int)
   (w int))
  bool
  (body
    (== new (concat old (seq-lit (tuple u v w))))))

(ghost-fn k_rep_search
  ((comp (seq int))
   (reps (seq int))
   (target int)
   (upto int)
   (answer int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and
        (and (<= 0 upto) (<= upto (len reps)))
        (forall ((q int))
          (=>
            (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len reps)))
            (and
              (<= 0 (idx reps q))
              (< (idx reps q) (len comp))))))
      (and
        (=>
          (>= answer 0)
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 answer)
              (and (< answer (len reps)) (<= answer upto)))
            (== (idx comp (idx reps answer)) target)))
        (=>
          (< answer 0)
          (forall ((k int))
            (=>
              (and (<= 0 k) (< k upto))
              (!= (idx comp (idx reps k)) target))))))))

(lemma k_empty_components_at
  (params (comp (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (== comp (seq-build n (fn (i) i)))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures
    (==
      (== (idx comp u) (idx comp v))
      (edges_connected (seq-lit) u v)))
  (body
    (if (== u v)
      (block
        (assert
          (and
            (and
              (> (len (seq-lit u)) 0)
              (and
                (== (idx (seq-lit u) 0) u)
                (== (idx (seq-lit u) (- (len (seq-lit u)) 1)) u)))
            (path_follows_edges (seq-lit) (seq-lit u))))
        (assert (edges_connected (seq-lit) u v)))
      (block
        (if (edges_connected (seq-lit) u v)
          (block
            (obtain ((p (seq int)))
              (and
                (and
                  (> (len p) 0)
                  (and
                    (== (idx p 0) u)
                    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                (path_follows_edges (seq-lit) p)))
            (if (> (len p) 1)
              (block
                (assert (edge_in_set (seq-lit) (idx p 0) (idx p 1)))
                (assert false))
              (block))
            (assert (== (len p) 1))
            (assert (== u v))
            (assert false))
          (block))))))

(lemma k_empty_components
  (params (comp (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (== comp (seq-build n (fn (i) i))))
  (ensures (k_components (seq-lit) comp n))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (call k_empty_components_at comp n u v))))

(lemma k_path_crossing
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (comp (seq int))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (k_graph_ok g)
    (== (len comp) (len g))
    (path_follows_graph g p)
    (> (len p) 0)
    (and (> k 0) (< k (len p)))
    (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len g)))
    (!= (idx comp (idx p 0)) (idx comp (idx p k))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((u int) (i int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (k_crosses comp u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (assert (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and
        (and
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p (- k 1)))
            (< (idx p (- k 1)) (len g)))
          (and
            (<= 0 i)
            (< i (len (idx g (idx p (- k 1)))))))
        (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- k 1))) i) 0) (idx p k))))
    (if
      (!=
        (idx comp (idx p (- k 1)))
        (idx comp (idx p k)))
      (assert
        (k_crosses
          comp
          (idx p (- k 1))
          (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- k 1))) i) 0)))
      (block
        (assert (> (- k 1) 0))
        (assert
          (!=
            (idx comp (idx p 0))
            (idx comp (idx p (- k 1)))))
        (call k_path_crossing g comp p (- k 1))))))

(lemma k_removed_keeps
  (params
    (old (seq int))
    (new (seq int))
    (at int)
    (q int))
  (requires
    (k_removed old new at)
    (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len old)))
    (!= q at))
  (ensures
    (exists ((k int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len new)))
        (== (idx new k) (idx old q)))))
  (body
    (if (< q at)
      (block
        (assert (< q (len new)))
        (assert (== (idx new q) (idx old q))))
      (block
        (assert (> q at))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (- q 1)) (< (- q 1) (len new))))
        (assert (== (idx new (- q 1)) (idx old q)))))))

(lemma k_reps_after_merge_at
  (params
    (comp0 (seq int))
    (reps0 (seq int))
    (comp (seq int))
    (reps (seq int))
    (n int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (at int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (k_reps_ok comp0 reps0 n)
    (> (len reps0) 1)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
    (!= (idx comp0 u) (idx comp0 v))
    (k_relabel comp0 comp (idx comp0 v) (idx comp0 u))
    (and
      (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len reps0)))
      (== (idx comp0 (idx reps0 at)) (idx comp0 v)))
    (k_removed reps0 reps at)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((k int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len reps)))
        (== (idx comp (idx reps k)) (idx comp x)))))
  (body
    (obtain ((q int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len reps0)))
        (== (idx comp0 (idx reps0 q)) (idx comp0 x))))
    (if (!= q at)
      (block
        (call k_removed_keeps reps0 reps at q)
        (obtain ((k int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len reps)))
            (== (idx reps k) (idx reps0 q))))
        (assert (== (idx comp (idx reps k)) (idx comp x))))
      (block
        (obtain ((r int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len reps0)))
            (== (idx comp0 (idx reps0 r)) (idx comp0 u))))
        (assert (!= r at))
        (call k_removed_keeps reps0 reps at r)
        (obtain ((k2 int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 k2) (< k2 (len reps)))
            (== (idx reps k2) (idx reps0 r))))
        (assert (== (idx comp (idx reps k2)) (idx comp x)))))))

(lemma k_reps_after_merge
  (params
    (comp0 (seq int))
    (reps0 (seq int))
    (comp (seq int))
    (reps (seq int))
    (n int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (at int))
  (requires
    (k_reps_ok comp0 reps0 n)
    (> (len reps0) 1)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
    (!= (idx comp0 u) (idx comp0 v))
    (k_relabel comp0 comp (idx comp0 v) (idx comp0 u))
    (and
      (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len reps0)))
      (== (idx comp0 (idx reps0 at)) (idx comp0 v)))
    (k_removed reps0 reps at))
  (ensures (k_reps_ok comp reps n))
  (body
    (assert (== (len comp) n))
    (assert (> (len reps) 0))
    (assert
      (forall ((i int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
          (and (<= 0 (idx comp i)) (< (idx comp i) n)))))
    (assert
      (forall ((k int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len reps)))
          (and (<= 0 (idx reps k)) (< (idx reps k) n)))))
    (assert
      (forall ((a int) (b int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a b))
            (< b (len reps)))
          (!=
            (idx comp (idx reps a))
            (idx comp (idx reps b))))))
    (forall ((x int))
      (call k_reps_after_merge_at
        comp0 reps0 comp reps n u v at x))))

(lemma k_components_after_merge_at
  (params
    (edges0 (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (comp0 (seq int))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (comp (seq int))

    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (x int)
    (y int))
  (requires

    (== (len comp0) n)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
    (!= (idx comp0 u) (idx comp0 v))
    (k_appended edges0 edges u v w)
    (k_relabel comp0 comp (idx comp0 v) (idx comp0 u))
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))

    (and
      (and (< x (len comp)) (< y (len comp)))

(lemma k_components_after_merge
  (params
    (edges0 (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (comp0 (seq int))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))

(lemma k_exchange_base
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (edges0 (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (comp0 (seq int))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (base (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (k_graph_ok g)
    (k_components edges0 comp0 (len g))
    (are_valid_edges g edges0)
    (k_candidate g comp0 true u v w)
    (forall ((x int) (j int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x)))))
          (k_crosses comp0 x (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0)))
        (<= w (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1))))
    (k_appended edges0 edges u v w)
    (is_spanning_tree g base)
    (k_included edges0 base))
  (ensures
    (exists ((alt (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (and
        (and
          (is_spanning_tree g alt)
          (k_included edges alt))
        (<= (total_weight alt) (total_weight base)))))
  (body))

(lemma k_exchange_one
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (edges0 (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (comp0 (seq int))
    (reps0 (seq int))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (k_state g edges0 comp0 reps0)
    (> (len reps0) 1)
    (k_candidate g comp0 true u v w)
    (forall ((x int) (j int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x)))))
          (k_crosses comp0 x (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0)))
        (<= w (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1))))
    (k_appended edges0 edges u v w)
    (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures
    (exists ((alt (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (and
        (and
          (is_spanning_tree g alt)
          (k_included edges alt))
        (<= (total_weight alt) (total_weight other)))))
  (body
    (assert (k_dominates g edges0))
    (obtain ((base (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (and
        (and
          (is_spanning_tree g base)
          (k_included edges0 base))
        (<= (total_weight base) (total_weight other))))
    (call k_exchange_base g edges0 comp0 edges u v w base)
    (obtain ((alt (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (and
        (and
          (is_spanning_tree g alt)
          (k_included edges alt))
        (<= (total_weight alt) (total_weight base))))
    (assert (<= (total_weight alt) (total_weight other)))))

(lemma k_dominates_after_merge
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (edges0 (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (comp0 (seq int))
    (reps0 (seq int))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires

    (> (len reps0) 1)
    (k_candidate g comp0 true u v w)
    (forall ((x int) (j int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x)))))
          (k_crosses comp0 x (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0)))
        (<= w (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1))))
    (k_appended edges0 edges u v w))
  (ensures (k_dominates g edges))
  (body
    (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (call k_exchange_one
        g edges0 comp0 reps0 edges u v w other))))

(lemma k_finished_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (comp (seq int))
    (reps (seq int))
    (other (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires
    (k_state g edges comp reps)
    (== (len reps) 1)
    (is_spanning_tree g other))
  (ensures
    (<= (total_weight edges) (total_weight other)))
  (body
    (assert (k_dominates g edges))
    (obtain ((alt (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (and
        (and
          (is_spanning_tree g alt)
          (k_included edges alt))
        (<= (total_weight alt) (total_weight other))))
    (assert (== (len edges) (len alt)))
    (assert (== (total_weight edges) (total_weight alt)))))

(lemma k_initial
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (comp (seq int))
    (reps (seq int)))
  (requires
    (> (len g) 0)
    (graph_is_connected g)
    (k_graph_ok g)
    (== comp (seq-build (len g) (fn (i) i)))
    (== reps (seq-build (len g) (fn (i) i))))
  (ensures (k_state g (seq-lit) comp reps))
  (body
    (assert (k_reps_ok comp reps (len g)))
    (assert (== (+ (len (seq-lit)) (len reps)) (len g)))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g (seq-lit)))
    (call k_empty_components comp (len g))
    (assert (k_dominates g (seq-lit)))))

(lemma k_crossing_exists
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (comp (seq int))
    (reps (seq int)))
  (requires
    (graph_is_connected g)
    (k_state g edges comp reps)
    (> (len reps) 1))
  (ensures
    (exists ((u int) (i int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (k_crosses comp u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))
  (body
    (assert (k_graph_ok g))
    (assert (== (len comp) (len g)))
    (assert
      (!=
        (idx comp (idx reps 0))
        (idx comp (idx reps 1))))
    (assert
      (nodes_have_path g (idx reps 0) (idx reps 1)))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (> (len p) 0)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) (idx reps 0))
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (idx reps 1))))
        (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (assert (> (- (len p) 1) 0))
    (call k_path_crossing g comp p (- (len p) 1))))

(lemma k_greedy_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (edges0 (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (comp0 (seq int))
    (reps0 (seq int))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (comp (seq int))
    (reps (seq int))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (at int))
  (requires
    (k_state g edges0 comp0 reps0)
    (> (len reps0) 1)
    (k_candidate g comp0 true u v w)
    (forall ((x int) (j int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x)))))
          (k_crosses comp0 x (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0)))
        (<= w (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1))))
    (k_appended edges0 edges u v w)
    (k_relabel comp0 comp (idx comp0 v) (idx comp0 u))
    (and
      (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len reps0)))
      (== (idx comp0 (idx reps0 at)) (idx comp0 v)))
    (k_removed reps0 reps at))
  (ensures (k_state g edges comp reps))
  (body
    (assert (k_graph_ok g))
    (assert (== (len comp0) (len g)))
    (assert (== (len comp) (len g)))
    (assert (== (len edges) (+ (len edges0) 1)))
    (assert (== (len reps) (- (len reps0) 1)))
    (assert (== (+ (len edges) (len reps)) (len g)))
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and
          (== v (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
          (and
            (== w (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
            (k_crosses comp0 u v)))))
    (call k_reps_after_merge
      comp0 reps0 comp reps (len g) u v at)
    (assert (are_valid_edges g edges))
    (call k_components_after_merge
      edges0 comp0 edges comp (len g) u v w)
    (call k_dominates_after_merge
      g edges0 comp0 reps0 edges u v w)))

(lemma k_finished
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (comp (seq int))
    (reps (seq int)))
  (requires
    (k_state g edges comp reps)
    (== (len reps) 1))
  (ensures (is_mst g edges))
  (body
    (assert (are_valid_edges g edges))
    (assert (k_components edges comp (len g)))
    (assert (== (len edges) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (is_spanning g edges))
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g edges))
    (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (call k_finished_bound g edges comp reps other))
    (assert (is_mst g edges))))

(def kruskal_mst
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut comp (vec i64)
      (seq-build n (fn (ci) ci)))
    (let-mut reps (vec i64)
      (seq-build n (fn (ri) ri)))
    (let-mut out (vec (tuple i64 i64 i64)) (vec-new))
    (assert (k_graph_ok (view graph)))
    (call k_initial (view graph) comp reps)
    (while (> (len reps) 1)
      (invariant (k_state (view graph) out comp reps))
      (invariant (and (> (len reps) 0) (<= (len reps) n)))
      (decreases (len reps))
      (call k_crossing_exists (view graph) out comp reps)
      (let-mut found bool false)
      (let-mut bu i64 0)
      (let-mut bv i64 0)
      (let-mut bw i64 0)
      (let-mut ui i64 0)
      (while (< ui n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 ui) (<= ui n)))
        (invariant
          (k_prefix_best
            (view graph) comp ui 0 found bu bv bw))
        (decreases (- n ui))
        (let degree i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) ui)))
        (let-mut ei i64 0)
        (while (< ei degree)
          (invariant (and (<= 0 ei) (<= ei degree)))
          (invariant
            (k_prefix_best
              (view graph) comp ui ei found bu bv bw))
          (decreases (- degree ei))
          (let endpoint i64
            (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) ui) ei) 0))
          (let weight i64
            (get (idx (idx (field graph adj) ui) ei) 1))
          (if (!= (idx comp ui) (idx comp endpoint))
            (if (or (not found) (< weight bw))
              (block
                (set found true)
                (set bu ui)
                (set bv endpoint)
                (set bw weight))
              (block))
            (block))
          (set ei (+ ei 1)))
        (set ui (+ ui 1)))
      (assert found)
      (assert
        (k_candidate
          (view graph) comp true bu bv bw))
      (assert
        (forall ((x int) (j int))
          (=>
            (and
              (and
                (and
                  (<= 0 x)
                  (< x (len (view graph))))
                (and
                  (<= 0 j)
                  (< j (len (idx (view graph) x)))))
              (k_crosses
                comp
                x
                (get (idx (idx (view graph) x) j) 0)))
            (<= bw (get (idx (idx (view graph) x) j) 1)))))
      (let old_label i64 (idx comp bv))
      (let new_label i64 (idx comp bu))
      (let-mut drop_at i64 -1)
      (let-mut rk i64 0)
      (while (and (< rk (len reps)) (< drop_at 0))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 rk) (<= rk (len reps))))
        (invariant
          (k_rep_search
            comp reps old_label rk drop_at))
        (decreases (- (len reps) rk))
        (if (== (idx comp (idx reps rk)) old_label)
          (block
            (set drop_at rk)
            (set rk (+ rk 1)))
          (set rk (+ rk 1))))
      (assert
        (and
          (<= 0 drop_at)
          (< drop_at (len reps))))
      (assert
        (==
          (idx comp (idx reps drop_at))
          old_label))
      (ghost-let old_edges (seq (tuple int int int)) out)
      (ghost-let old_comp (seq int) comp)
      (ghost-let old_reps (seq int) reps)
      (push out (tuple bu bv bw))
      (set comp
        (seq-build n
          (fn (cj)
            (if (== (idx comp cj) old_label)
              new_label
              (idx comp cj)))))
      (let next_count i64 (- (len reps) 1))
      (set reps
        (seq-build next_count

          (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len g)))))))

(ghost-fn k_crosses ((comp (seq int)) (u int) (v int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (and
        (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len comp)))
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len comp))))
      (!= (idx comp u) (idx comp v)))))

(ghost-fn k_reps_ok ((comp (seq int)) (reps (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (== (len comp) n) (> (len reps) 0))
      (and
        (forall ((i int))
          (=>
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i n))
            (and (<= 0 (idx comp i)) (< (idx comp i) n))))
        (and
          (forall ((k int))
            (=>
              (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len reps)))
              (and (<= 0 (idx reps k)) (< (idx reps k) n))))
          (and
            (forall ((a int) (b int))
              (=>
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 a) (< a b))
                  (< b (len reps)))
                (!=
                  (idx comp (idx reps a))
                  (idx comp (idx reps b)))))
            (forall ((v int))
              (=>
                (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
                (exists ((k int))
                  (and
                    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len reps)))
                    (==
                      (idx comp (idx reps k))
                      (idx comp v))))))))))))

(ghost-fn k_components
  ((edges (seq (tuple int int int))) (comp (seq int)) (n int))
  bool
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
        (and
          (and (< u (len comp)) (< v (len comp)))
          (==
            (== (idx comp u) (idx comp v))
            (edges_connected edges u v)))))))

(ghost-fn k_included
  ((a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (forall ((k int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len a)))
          (contains b (idx a k))))
      (=>
        (== (len a) (len b))
        (and
          (== (multiset a) (multiset b))
          (== (total_weight a) (total_weight b)))))))

(ghost-fn k_dominates
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (chosen (seq (tuple int int int))))
  bool
  (body
    (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int))))
      (=>
        (is_spanning_tree g other)
        (exists ((alt (seq (tuple int int int))))
          (and
            (and
              (is_spanning_tree g alt)
              (k_included chosen alt))
            (<= (total_weight alt) (total_weight other))))))))

(ghost-fn k_state
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
   (comp (seq int))
   (reps (seq int)))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and
        (k_graph_ok g)
        (and
          (k_reps_ok comp reps (len g))
          (== (+ (len edges) (len reps)) (len g))))
      (and
        (and
          (are_valid_edges g edges)
          (k_components edges comp (len g)))
        (k_dominates g edges)))))

(ghost-fn k_candidate
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (comp (seq int))
   (found bool)
   (bu int)
   (bv int)
   (bw int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (k_graph_ok g) (== (len comp) (len g)))
      (=>
        found
        (exists ((i int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 bu) (< bu (len g)))
              (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g bu)))))
            (and
              (== bv (get (idx (idx g bu) i) 0))
              (and
                (== bw (get (idx (idx g bu) i) 1))
                (k_crosses comp bu bv)))))))))

(ghost-fn k_before ((x int) (j int) (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body (or (< x u) (and (== x u) (< j i)))))

(ghost-fn k_prefix_best
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (comp (seq int))
   (u int)
   (i int)
   (found bool)
   (bu int)
   (bv int)
   (bw int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (k_candidate g comp found bu bv bw)
      (forall ((x int) (j int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
              (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x)))))
            (and
              (k_before x j u i)
              (k_crosses comp x (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0))))
          (and
            found
            (<= bw (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1))))))))

(ghost-fn k_relabel
  ((old (seq int)) (new (seq int)) (from int) (to int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len new) (len old))
      (forall ((i int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len old)))
          (==
            (idx new i)
            (if (== (idx old i) from)
              to
              (idx old i))))))))

(ghost-fn k_removed
  ((old (seq int)) (new (seq int)) (at int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len old)))
      (and
        (== (len new) (- (len old) 1))
        (forall ((i int))
          (=>
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len new)))
            (==
              (idx new i)
              (idx old
                (if (< i at)
                  i
                  (+ i 1))))))))))

(ghost-fn k_appended
  ((old (seq (tuple int int int)))
   (new (seq (tuple int int int)))
   (u int)
   (v int)
   (w int))
  bool
  (body
    (== new (concat old (seq-lit (tuple u v w))))))

(ghost-fn k_rep_search
  ((comp (seq int))
   (reps (seq int))
   (target int)
   (upto int)
   (answer int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and
        (and (<= 0 upto) (<= upto (len reps)))
        (forall ((q int))
          (=>
            (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len reps)))
            (and
              (<= 0 (idx reps q))
              (< (idx reps q) (len comp))))))
      (and
        (=>
          (>= answer 0)
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 answer)
              (and (< answer (len reps)) (<= answer upto)))
            (== (idx comp (idx reps answer)) target)))
        (=>
          (< answer 0)
          (forall ((k int))
            (=>
              (and (<= 0 k) (< k upto))
              (!= (idx comp (idx reps k)) target))))))))

(lemma k_empty_components_at
  (params (comp (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (== comp (seq-build n (fn (i) i)))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures
    (==
      (== (idx comp u) (idx comp v))
      (edges_connected (seq-lit) u v)))
  (body
    (if (== u v)
      (block
        (assert
          (and
            (and
              (> (len (seq-lit u)) 0)
              (and
                (== (idx (seq-lit u) 0) u)
                (== (idx (seq-lit u) (- (len (seq-lit u)) 1)) u)))
            (path_follows_edges (seq-lit) (seq-lit u))))
        (assert (edges_connected (seq-lit) u v)))
      (block
        (if (edges_connected (seq-lit) u v)
          (block
            (obtain ((p (seq int)))
              (and
                (and
                  (> (len p) 0)
                  (and
                    (== (idx p 0) u)
                    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                (path_follows_edges (seq-lit) p)))
            (if (> (len p) 1)
              (block
                (assert (edge_in_set (seq-lit) (idx p 0) (idx p 1)))
                (assert false))
              (block))
            (assert (== (len p) 1))
            (assert (== u v))
            (assert false))
          (block))))))

(lemma k_empty_components
  (params (comp (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (== comp (seq-build n (fn (i) i))))
  (ensures (k_components (seq-lit) comp n))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (call k_empty_components_at comp n u v))))

(lemma k_path_crossing
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (comp (seq int))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (k_graph_ok g)
    (== (len comp) (len g))
    (path_follows_graph g p)
    (> (len p) 0)
    (and (> k 0) (< k (len p)))
    (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len g)))
    (!= (idx comp (idx p 0)) (idx comp (idx p k))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((u int) (i int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (k_crosses comp u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (assert (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and
        (and
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p (- k 1)))
            (< (idx p (- k 1)) (len g)))
          (and
            (<= 0 i)
            (< i (len (idx g (idx p (- k 1)))))))
        (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- k 1))) i) 0) (idx p k))))
    (if
      (!=
        (idx comp (idx p (- k 1)))
        (idx comp (idx p k)))
      (assert
        (k_crosses
          comp
          (idx p (- k 1))
          (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- k 1))) i) 0)))
      (block
        (assert (> (- k 1) 0))
        (assert
          (!=
            (idx comp (idx p 0))
            (idx comp (idx p (- k 1)))))
        (call k_path_crossing g comp p (- k 1))))))

(lemma k_removed_keeps
  (params
    (old (seq int))
    (new (seq int))
    (at int)
    (q int))
  (requires
    (k_removed old new at)
    (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len old)))
    (!= q at))
  (ensures
    (exists ((k int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len new)))
        (== (idx new k) (idx old q)))))
  (body
    (if (< q at)
      (block
        (assert (< q (len new)))
        (assert (== (idx new q) (idx old q))))
      (block
        (assert (> q at))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (- q 1)) (< (- q 1) (len new))))
        (assert (== (idx new (- q 1)) (idx old q)))))))

(lemma k_reps_after_merge_at
  (params
    (comp0 (seq int))
    (reps0 (seq int))
    (comp (seq int))
    (reps (seq int))
    (n int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (at int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (k_reps_ok comp0 reps0 n)
    (> (len reps0) 1)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
    (!= (idx comp0 u) (idx comp0 v))
    (k_relabel comp0 comp (idx comp0 v) (idx comp0 u))
    (and
      (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len reps0)))
      (== (idx comp0 (idx reps0 at)) (idx comp0 v)))
    (k_removed reps0 reps at)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((k int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len reps)))
        (== (idx comp (idx reps k)) (idx comp x)))))
  (body
    (obtain ((q int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len reps0)))
        (== (idx comp0 (idx reps0 q)) (idx comp0 x))))
    (if (!= q at)
      (block
        (call k_removed_keeps reps0 reps at q)
        (obtain ((k int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len reps)))
            (== (idx reps k) (idx reps0 q))))
        (assert (== (idx comp (idx reps k)) (idx comp x))))
      (block
        (obtain ((r int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len reps0)))
            (== (idx comp0 (idx reps0 r)) (idx comp0 u))))
        (assert (!= r at))
        (call k_removed_keeps reps0 reps at r)
        (obtain ((k2 int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 k2) (< k2 (len reps)))
            (== (idx reps k2) (idx reps0 r))))
        (assert (== (idx comp (idx reps k2)) (idx comp x)))))))

(lemma k_reps_after_merge
  (params
    (comp0 (seq int))
    (reps0 (seq int))
    (comp (seq int))
    (reps (seq int))
    (n int)
    (u int)

  (body
    (assert (== (len comp) n))

      (forall ((a int) (b int))

          (and
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a b))

          (!=
            (idx comp (idx reps a))
            (idx comp (idx reps b))))))
    (forall ((x int))

(lemma k_components_after_merge_at
  (params
    (edges0 (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (comp0 (seq int))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))

    (n int)
    (u int)

  (requires

    (!= (idx comp0 u) (idx comp0 v))

      (block))

(lemma k_valid_after_append_at
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (comp (seq int))
    (old (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (new (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (k int))
  (requires
    (are_valid_edges g old)
    (k_candidate g comp true u v w)
    (k_appended old new u v w))
  (ensures
    (=>
      (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len new)))
      (has_edge
        g
        (get (idx new k) 0)
        (get (idx new k) 1)
        (get (idx new k) 2))))
  (body
    (if (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len new)))
      (if (< k (len old))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx new k) (idx old k)))
          (assert
            (has_edge
              g
              (get (idx old k) 0)
              (get (idx old k) 1)
              (get (idx old k) 2))))
        (block
          (assert (== k (len old)))
          (assert (== (idx new k) (tuple u v w)))
          (obtain ((i int))
            (and
              (and
                (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
                (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
              (and
                (== v (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                (and
                  (== w (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))
                  (k_crosses comp u v)))))
          (assert (has_edge g u v w))))
      (block))))

  (ensures (are_valid_edges g new))
  (body
    (forall ((k int))
      (call k_valid_after_append_at g comp old new u v w k))))

(lemma k_exchange_base_present
  (params

    (u int)

  (requires

    (are_valid_edges g edges0)
    (k_candidate g comp0 true u v w)
    (forall ((x int) (j int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x)))))
          (k_crosses comp0 x (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0)))
        (<= w (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1))))
    (k_appended edges0 edges u v w)
    (is_spanning_tree g base)
    (k_included edges0 base)
    (contains base (tuple u v w)))
  (ensures
    (and
      (k_included edges base)
      (<= (total_weight base) (total_weight base))))

(lemma k_exchange_base
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (edges0 (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (comp0 (seq int))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)

      (=>
        (and
          (and

          (k_crosses comp0 x (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0)))
        (<= w (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1))))

(lemma k_exchange_one
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (edges0 (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (comp0 (seq int))
    (reps0 (seq int))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)

              (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g bu)))))
            (and
              (== bv (get (idx (idx g bu) i) 0))
              (and
                (== bw (get (idx (idx g bu) i) 1))
                (k_crosses comp bu bv)))))))))

(ghost-fn k_before ((x int) (j int) (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body (or (< x u) (and (== x u) (< j i)))))

(ghost-fn k_prefix_best
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (comp (seq int))
   (u int)
   (i int)
   (found bool)
   (bu int)
   (bv int)
   (bw int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (k_candidate g comp found bu bv bw)
      (forall ((x int) (j int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
              (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x)))))
            (and
              (k_before x j u i)
              (k_crosses comp x (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0))))
          (and
            found
            (<= bw (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1))))))))

(ghost-fn k_relabel
  ((old (seq int)) (new (seq int)) (from int) (to int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (== (len new) (len old))
      (forall ((i int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len old)))
          (==
            (idx new i)
            (if (== (idx old i) from)
              to
              (idx old i))))))))

(ghost-fn k_removed
  ((old (seq int)) (new (seq int)) (at int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len old)))
      (and
        (== (len new) (- (len old) 1))
        (forall ((i int))
          (=>
            (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len new)))
            (==
              (idx new i)
              (idx old
                (if (< i at)
                  i
                  (+ i 1))))))))))

(ghost-fn k_appended
  ((old (seq (tuple int int int)))
   (new (seq (tuple int int int)))
   (u int)
   (v int)
   (w int))
  bool
  (body
    (== new (concat old (seq-lit (tuple u v w))))))

(ghost-fn k_rep_search
  ((comp (seq int))
   (reps (seq int))
   (target int)
   (upto int)
   (answer int))
  bool
  (body
    (and
      (and
        (and (<= 0 upto) (<= upto (len reps)))
        (forall ((q int))
          (=>
            (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len reps)))
            (and
              (<= 0 (idx reps q))
              (< (idx reps q) (len comp))))))
      (and
        (=>
          (>= answer 0)
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 answer)
              (and (< answer (len reps)) (<= answer upto)))
            (== (idx comp (idx reps answer)) target)))
        (=>
          (< answer 0)
          (forall ((k int))
            (=>
              (and (<= 0 k) (< k upto))
              (!= (idx comp (idx reps k)) target))))))))

(lemma k_empty_components_at
  (params (comp (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (== comp (seq-build n (fn (i) i)))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures
    (==
      (== (idx comp u) (idx comp v))
      (edges_connected (seq-lit) u v)))
  (body
    (if (== u v)
      (block
        (assert
          (and
            (and
              (> (len (seq-lit u)) 0)
              (and
                (== (idx (seq-lit u) 0) u)
                (== (idx (seq-lit u) (- (len (seq-lit u)) 1)) u)))
            (path_follows_edges (seq-lit) (seq-lit u))))
        (assert (edges_connected (seq-lit) u v)))
      (block
        (if (edges_connected (seq-lit) u v)
          (block
            (obtain ((p (seq int)))
              (and
                (and
                  (> (len p) 0)
                  (and
                    (== (idx p 0) u)
                    (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
                (path_follows_edges (seq-lit) p)))
            (if (> (len p) 1)
              (block
                (assert (edge_in_set (seq-lit) (idx p 0) (idx p 1)))
                (assert false))
              (block))
            (assert (== (len p) 1))
            (assert (== u v))
            (assert false))
          (block))))))

(lemma k_empty_components
  (params (comp (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (== comp (seq-build n (fn (i) i))))
