    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (call k_empty_components_at comp n u v))))

(lemma k_path_crossing
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (comp (seq int))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (k_graph_ok g)
    (== (len comp) (len g))
    (path_follows_graph g p)
    (> (len p) 0)
    (and (> k 0) (< k (len p)))
    (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len g)))
    (!= (idx comp (idx p 0)) (idx comp (idx p k))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((u int) (i int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (k_crosses comp u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (assert (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and
        (and
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p (- k 1)))
            (< (idx p (- k 1)) (len g)))
          (and
            (<= 0 i)
            (< i (len (idx g (idx p (- k 1)))))))
        (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- k 1))) i) 0) (idx p k))))
    (if
      (!=
        (idx comp (idx p (- k 1)))
        (idx comp (idx p k)))
      (assert
        (k_crosses
          comp
          (idx p (- k 1))
          (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- k 1))) i) 0)))
      (block
        (assert (> (- k 1) 0))
        (assert
          (!=
            (idx comp (idx p 0))
            (idx comp (idx p (- k 1)))))
        (call k_path_crossing g comp p (- k 1))))))

(lemma k_removed_keeps
  (params
    (old (seq int))
    (new (seq int))
    (at int)
    (q int))
  (requires
    (k_removed old new at)
    (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len old)))
    (!= q at))
  (ensures
    (exists ((k int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len new)))
        (== (idx new k) (idx old q)))))
  (body
    (if (< q at)
      (block
        (assert (< q (len new)))
        (assert (== (idx new q) (idx old q))))
      (block
        (assert (> q at))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (- q 1)) (< (- q 1) (len new))))
        (assert (== (idx new (- q 1)) (idx old q)))))))

(lemma k_reps_after_merge_at
  (params
    (comp0 (seq int))
    (reps0 (seq int))
    (comp (seq int))
    (reps (seq int))
    (n int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (at int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (k_reps_ok comp0 reps0 n)
    (> (len reps0) 1)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
    (!= (idx comp0 u) (idx comp0 v))
    (k_relabel comp0 comp (idx comp0 v) (idx comp0 u))
    (and
      (and (<= 0 at) (< at (len reps0)))
      (== (idx comp0 (idx reps0 at)) (idx comp0 v)))
    (k_removed reps0 reps at)
    (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((k int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len reps)))
        (== (idx comp (idx reps k)) (idx comp x)))))
  (body
    (obtain ((q int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len reps0)))
        (== (idx comp0 (idx reps0 q)) (idx comp0 x))))
    (if (!= q at)
      (block
        (call k_removed_keeps reps0 reps at q)
        (obtain ((k int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len reps)))
            (== (idx reps k) (idx reps0 q))))
        (assert (== (idx comp (idx reps k)) (idx comp x))))
      (block
        (obtain ((r int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len reps0)))
            (== (idx comp0 (idx reps0 r)) (idx comp0 u))))
        (assert (!= r at))
        (call k_removed_keeps reps0 reps at r)
        (obtain ((k2 int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 k2) (< k2 (len reps)))
            (== (idx reps k2) (idx reps0 r))))
        (assert (== (idx comp (idx reps k2)) (idx comp x)))))))

(lemma k_reps_after_merge
  (params

  (requires

  (body
    (if (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len new)))

        (block

            (has_edge
              g

  (ensures
    (exists ((alt (seq (tuple int int int))))

          (is_spanning_tree g alt)

  (body
    (assert (k_dominates g edges0))

(lemma k_initial
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

  (requires
    (> (len g) 0)
    (graph_is_connected g)

    (== selected (seq-lit))

  (ensures (kruskal_state g selected labels))

    (call kruskal_empty_components labels)
    (call kruskal_empty_extension g)

    (best_v int)
    (best_w int))
  (requires
    (weights_bounded g)
    (graph_is_connected g)
    (kruskal_state g selected_before labels_before)
    (< (len selected_before) (- (len g) 1))
    (kruskal_scan_state
      g labels_before true best_u best_v best_w (len g) 0)
    (==
      selected_after
      (concat selected_before (seq-lit (tuple best_u best_v best_w))))
    (kruskal_relabelled
      labels_before
      labels_after
      (idx labels_before best_v)
      (idx labels_before best_u)))
  (ensures (kruskal_state g selected_after labels_after))
  (body

      selected_before
      selected_after
      labels_before
      labels_after
      best_u
      best_v
      best_w)
    (call kruskal_extend_greedy
      g
      selected_before
      selected_after
      labels_before
      best_u
      best_v
      best_w)
    (assert
      (== (len selected_after) (+ (len selected_before) 1)))
    (assert (== (len labels_after) (len g)))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g selected_after))
    (assert (<= (len selected_after) (- (len g) 1)))

      (invariant (== (len edges) edge_count))
      (invariant (kruskal_state (view graph) edges labels))
      (decreases (- (- n 1) edge_count))

      (let-mut best_v i64 0)
      (let-mut best_w i64 0)

(lemma ends_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int))

  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx s j) 0)) (< (get (idx s j) 0) (len g)))
                (and (<= 0 (get (idx s j) 1)) (< (get (idx s j) 1) (len g)))))
  (body
    (ghost-let u0 int (get (idx s j) 0))
    (assert (has_edge g u0 (get (idx s j) 1) (get (idx s j) 2)))
    (obtain ((q int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u0) (< u0 (len g))) (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len (idx g u0)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u0) q) 0) (get (idx s j) 1)) (== (get (idx (idx g u0) q) 1) (get (idx s j) 2)))))
    (assert (< (get (idx (idx g u0) q) 0) (len g)))))

(lemma edge_int_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (lab (seq int)) (t int) (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g s) (internal_lt g lab (+ t 1)) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len s))) (<= (get (idx s j) 2) t))
  (ensures (== (lb lab (get (idx s j) 0)) (lb lab (get (idx s j) 1))))
  (body
    (ghost-let u0 int (get (idx s j) 0))
    (assert (has_edge g u0 (get (idx s j) 1) (get (idx s j) 2)))
    (obtain ((q int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u0) (< u0 (len g))) (and (<= 0 q) (< q (len (idx g u0)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u0) q) 0) (get (idx s j) 1)) (== (get (idx (idx g u0) q) 1) (get (idx s j) 2)))))
    (assert (< (get (idx (idx g u0) q) 1) (+ t 1)))))
(lemma connect (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (lab (seq int)) (s (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (lab_wf lab) (== (len lab) (len g)) (> (len g) 0) (ends_ok s (len g)) (is_spanning g s))
  (ensures (>= (cross lab s) (- (nroots lab (len lab)) 1)))
  (decreases (nroots lab (len lab)))
  (body
    (call nroots_nonneg lab (len lab))
    (call cross_nonneg lab s)
    (if (>= (nroots lab (len lab)) 2)
      (block
        (call find_split lab)
        (obtain ((x int)) (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len lab))) (!= (idx lab x) (idx lab 0))))
        (assert (edges_connected s 0 x))
        (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x))) (path_follows_edges s p)))
        (assert (== (lb lab (idx p 0)) (idx lab 0)))
        (assert (== (lb lab (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (idx lab x)))
        (call find_step lab p (- (len p) 1))
        (obtain ((kk int)) (and (and (<= 0 kk) (< kk (- (len p) 1))) (!= (lb lab (idx p kk)) (lb lab (idx p (+ kk 1))))))
        (assert (edge_in_set s (idx p kk) (idx p (+ kk 1))))
        (obtain ((ej int)) (and (and (<= 0 ej) (< ej (len s)))
          (or (and (== (get (idx s ej) 0) (idx p kk)) (== (get (idx s ej) 1) (idx p (+ kk 1))))
              (and (== (get (idx s ej) 0) (idx p (+ kk 1))) (== (get (idx s ej) 1) (idx p kk))))))
        (ghost-let a int (get (idx s ej) 0))
        (ghost-let b int (get (idx s ej) 1))
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len lab))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len lab)))))
        (assert (!= (lb lab a) (lb lab b)))
        (ghost-let ca int (idx lab a))
        (ghost-let cb int (idx lab b))
        (ghost-let lab2 (seq int) (seq-build (len lab) (fn (z) (if (== (idx lab z) cb) ca (idx lab z)))))
        (assert (merged lab lab2 ca cb))
        (call merge_wf lab lab2 ca cb)
        (call nroots_merge lab lab2 ca cb (len lab))
        (call merge_refines lab lab2 ca cb)
        (assert (== (lb lab2 a) (lb lab2 b)))
        (call cross_strict lab lab2 s ej)
        (call connect g lab2 s))
      (block))))

(def kruskal_mst

        (assert (== (idx c (- k 1)) (if (== (idx p (- k 1)) cv) cu (idx p (- k 1)))))
        (assert (== (nroots c k) (+ (nroots c (- k 1)) (if (== (idx c (- k 1)) (- k 1)) 1 0))))
        (assert (== (nroots p k) (+ (nroots p (- k 1)) (if (== (idx p (- k 1)) (- k 1)) 1 0)))))
      (block (assert (== (nroots c 0) 0)) (assert (== (nroots p 0) 0))))))
(lemma merge_wf (params (p (seq int)) (c (seq int)) (cu int) (cv int))
  (requires (lab_wf p) (merged p c cu cv)
            (and (<= 0 cu) (< cu (len p))) (== (idx p cu) cu) (!= cu cv))
  (ensures (lab_wf c))
  (body))
(lemma merge_refines (params (p (seq int)) (c (seq int)) (cu int) (cv int))
  (requires (merged p c cu cv))
  (ensures (refines p c))
  (body))
(lemma refines_trans (params (p (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (c (seq int)))
  (requires (refines p q) (refines q c))
  (ensures (refines p c))
  (body))
(lemma closed_init (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)))
  (requires (wbound g))
  (ensures (closed_lt g c -100000))
  (body))
(lemma closed_mono (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (c (seq int)) (t int))
  (requires (closed_lt g p t) (refines p c))
  (ensures (closed_lt g c t))
  (body))
(lemma done_mono (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (c (seq int)) (t int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (done_upto g p t u i) (refines p c))
  (ensures (done_upto g c t u i))
  (body))
(lemma close_round (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (t int))
  (requires (closed_lt g c t) (done_upto g c t (len g) 0))
  (ensures (closed_lt g c (+ t 1)))
  (body))
(lemma add_entry (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (t int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (done_upto g c t u i) (== (len c) (len g)) (targets_ok g)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (or (!= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) t) (== (idx c u) (idx c (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))
  (ensures (done_upto g c t u (+ i 1)))
  (body))
(lemma next_vertex (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (done_upto g c t u (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (done_upto g c t (+ u 1) 0))
  (body))

(lemma conn_refl (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int))
  (ensures (edges_connected r a a))
  (body
    (ghost-let pa (seq int) (seq-lit a))
    (assert (and (== (len pa) 1) (== (idx pa 0) a)))
    (assert (== (idx pa (- (len pa) 1)) a))
    (assert (path_follows_edges r pa))))
(lemma conn_init (params (c (seq int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len c))) (== (idx c x) x))))
  (ensures (conn_inv c r))
  (body (forall ((a int)) (call conn_refl r a))))
(lemma edge_ext (params (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (snoc r0 r1 e) (edge_in_set r0 x y))
  (ensures (edge_in_set r1 x y))
  (body
    (obtain ((k int)) (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len r0)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx r0 k) 0) x) (== (get (idx r0 k) 1) y))
          (and (== (get (idx r0 k) 0) y) (== (get (idx r0 k) 1) x)))))
    (assert (== (idx r1 k) (idx r0 k)))))
(lemma path_ext_k (params (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (snoc r0 r1 e) (path_follows_edges r0 p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set r1 (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (edge_in_set r0 (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
    (call edge_ext r0 r1 e (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
(lemma path_ext (params (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (snoc r0 r1 e) (path_follows_edges r0 p))
  (ensures (path_follows_edges r1 p))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call path_ext_k r0 r1 e p k))))
(lemma conn_ext (params (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (snoc r0 r1 e) (edges_connected r0 a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected r1 a b))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges r0 p)))
    (call path_ext r0 r1 e p)))
(lemma conn_edge (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len r))) (== (get (idx r k) 0) a) (== (get (idx r k) 1) b))
  (ensures (edges_connected r a b) (edges_connected r b a))
  (body
    (assert (edge_in_set r a b))
    (assert (edge_in_set r b a))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (seq-lit a b))
    (assert (and (== (len q) 2) (and (== (idx q 0) a) (== (idx q 1) b))))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) b))
    (assert (path_follows_edges r q))
    (ghost-let q2 (seq int) (seq-lit b a))
    (assert (and (== (len q2) 2) (and (== (idx q2 0) b) (== (idx q2 1) a))))
    (assert (== (idx q2 (- (len q2) 1)) a))
    (assert (path_follows_edges r q2))))
(lemma trans_k (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (pq (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (joined p q pq) (path_follows_edges r p) (path_follows_edges r q)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (idx q 0))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len pq) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set r (idx pq k) (idx pq (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (if (< k (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx pq k) (idx p k)))
        (assert (== (idx pq (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1))))
        (assert (edge_in_set r (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
      (if (== k (- (len p) 1))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx pq k) (idx q 0)))
          (assert (== (idx pq (+ k 1)) (idx q 1)))
          (assert (edge_in_set r (idx q 0) (idx q 1))))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx pq k) (idx q (+ (- k (len p)) 1))))
          (assert (== (idx pq (+ k 1)) (idx q (+ (- k (len p)) 2))))
          (assert (edge_in_set r (idx q (+ (- k (len p)) 1)) (idx q (+ (- k (len p)) 2)))))))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (edges_connected r a b) (edges_connected r b d))
  (ensures (edges_connected r a d))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges r p)))
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) b) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) d))) (path_follows_edges r q)))
    (ghost-let pq (seq int) (seq-build (- (+ (len p) (len q)) 1) (fn (i) (if (< i (len p)) (idx p i) (idx q (+ (- i (len p)) 1))))))
    (assert (joined p q pq))
    (forall ((k int)) (call trans_k r p q pq k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges r pq))
    (assert (> (len pq) 0))
    (assert (== (idx pq 0) a))
    (assert (== (idx pq (- (len pq) 1)) d))))
(lemma merge_conn_ab (params (p (seq int)) (c (seq int)) (cu int) (cv int)
                             (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int)))
                             (u int) (v int) (w int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (conn_inv p r0) (merged p c cu cv) (snoc r0 r1 (tuple u v w))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len p))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len p)))
            (== (idx p u) cu) (== (idx p v) cv)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len p))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len p)))
            (== (idx c a) (idx c b)))
  (ensures (edges_connected r1 a b))
  (body
    (call conn_edge r1 (len r0) u v)
    (if (== (idx p a) (idx p b))
      (block
        (assert (edges_connected r0 a b))
        (call conn_ext r0 r1 (tuple u v w) a b))
      (if (== (idx p a) cv)
        (block
          (assert (edges_connected r0 a v))
          (assert (edges_connected r0 u b))
          (call conn_ext r0 r1 (tuple u v w) a v)
          (call conn_ext r0 r1 (tuple u v w) u b)
          (call conn_trans r1 a v u)
          (call conn_trans r1 a u b))
        (block
          (assert (edges_connected r0 a u))
          (assert (edges_connected r0 v b))
          (call conn_ext r0 r1 (tuple u v w) a u)
          (call conn_ext r0 r1 (tuple u v w) v b)
          (call conn_trans r1 a u v)
          (call conn_trans r1 a v b))))))
(lemma merge_conn (params (p (seq int)) (c (seq int)) (cu int) (cv int)
                          (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int)))
                          (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (conn_inv p r0) (merged p c cu cv) (snoc r0 r1 (tuple u v w))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len p))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len p)))
            (== (idx p u) cu) (== (idx p v) cv))
  (ensures (conn_inv c r1))
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call merge_conn_ab p c cu cv r0 r1 u v w a b))))
(lemma wlt_push (params (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (t int))
  (requires (w_lt r0 t) (snoc r0 r1 e) (< (get e 2) t))
  (ensures (w_lt r1 t))
  (body))
(lemma valid_push (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g r0) (snoc r0 r1 e) (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g r1))
  (body))

(lemma le_snoc (params (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (s int))
  (requires (snoc r0 r1 e))
  (ensures (== (le_cnt r1 s) (+ (le_cnt r0 s) (if (<= (get e 2) s) 1 0))))
  (decreases (len r0))
  (body
    (if (> (len r0) 0)
      (block
        (assert (snoc (drop r0 1) (drop r1 1) e))
        (call le_snoc (drop r0 1) (drop r1 1) e s)
        (assert (== (idx r1 0) (idx r0 0)))
        (assert (== (le_cnt r1 s) (+ (if (<= (get (idx r1 0) 2) s) 1 0) (le_cnt (drop r1 1) s))))
        (assert (== (le_cnt r0 s) (+ (if (<= (get (idx r0 0) 2) s) 1 0) (le_cnt (drop r0 1) s)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx r1 0) e))
        (assert (== (len (drop r1 1)) 0))
        (assert (== (le_cnt (drop r1 1) s) 0))
        (assert (== (le_cnt r1 s) (+ (if (<= (get (idx r1 0) 2) s) 1 0) (le_cnt (drop r1 1) s))))
        (assert (== (le_cnt r0 s) 0))))))
(lemma opt_keep (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (t int))
  (requires (opt_below g r0 t) (snoc r0 r1 e) (>= (get e 2) t))
  (ensures (opt_below g r1 t))
  (body (forall ((s int)) (call le_snoc r0 r1 e s))))
(lemma le_all (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int))
  (requires (w_lt r (+ t 1)))
  (ensures (== (le_cnt r t) (len r)))
  (decreases (len r))
  (body
    (if (> (len r) 0)
      (block
        (assert (w_lt (drop r 1) (+ t 1)))
        (call le_all (drop r 1) t)
        (assert (< (get (idx r 0) 2) (+ t 1)))
        (assert (== (le_cnt r t) (+ (if (<= (get (idx r 0) 2) t) 1 0) (le_cnt (drop r 1) t)))))
      (assert (== (le_cnt r t) 0)))))
(lemma clip_step (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int))
  (ensures (== (clip r s) (- (clip r (+ s 1)) (le_cnt r s))))
  (decreases (len r))
  (body
    (if (> (len r) 0)
      (block
        (call clip_step (drop r 1) s)
        (assert (== (clip r s) (+ (if (< (get (idx r 0) 2) s) s (get (idx r 0) 2)) (clip (drop r 1) s))))
        (assert (== (clip r (+ s 1)) (+ (if (< (get (idx r 0) 2) (+ s 1)) (+ s 1) (get (idx r 0) 2)) (clip (drop r 1) (+ s 1)))))
        (assert (== (le_cnt r s) (+ (if (<= (get (idx r 0) 2) s) 1 0) (le_cnt (drop r 1) s)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (clip r s) 0))
        (assert (== (clip r (+ s 1)) 0))
        (assert (== (le_cnt r s) 0))))))
(lemma wb_drop (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (wb r) (> (len r) 0))
  (ensures (wb (drop r 1)))
  (body))
(lemma clip_low (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (wb r))
  (ensures (== (clip r -100000) (total_weight r)))
  (decreases (len r))
  (body
    (if (> (len r) 0)
      (block
        (call wb_drop r)
        (call clip_low (drop r 1))
        (assert (<= -100000 (get (idx r 0) 2)))
        (assert (== (clip r -100000) (+ (if (< (get (idx r 0) 2) -100000) -100000 (get (idx r 0) 2)) (clip (drop r 1) -100000))))
        (assert (== (total_weight r) (+ (get (idx r 0) 2) (total_weight (drop r 1))))))
      (block (assert (== (clip r -100000) 0)) (assert (== (total_weight r) 0))))))
(lemma clip_high (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (wb r))
  (ensures (== (clip r 100000) (* (len r) 100000)))
  (decreases (len r))
  (body
    (if (> (len r) 0)
      (block
        (call wb_drop r)
        (call clip_high (drop r 1))
        (assert (<= (get (idx r 0) 2) 100000))
        (assert (== (clip r 100000) (+ (if (< (get (idx r 0) 2) 100000) 100000 (get (idx r 0) 2)) (clip (drop r 1) 100000))))
        (assert (== (len (drop r 1)) (- (len r) 1))))
      (assert (== (clip r 100000) 0)))))
(lemma clip_cmp (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int))
  (requires (wb r) (wb o) (== (len r) (len o)) (le_dom r o t) (and (<= -100000 t) (<= t 100000)))
  (ensures (<= (clip r t) (clip o t)))
  (decreases (- 100000 t))
  (body
    (if (< t 100000)
      (block
        (call clip_cmp r o (+ t 1))
        (call clip_step r t)
        (call clip_step o t)
        (assert (<= (le_cnt o t) (le_cnt r t))))
      (block (call clip_high r) (call clip_high o)))))
(lemma valid_wb_k (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (weights_bounded g) (are_valid_edges g r) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len r))))
  (ensures (and (<= -100000 (get (idx r k) 2)) (<= (get (idx r k) 2) 100000)))
  (body (assert (has_edge g (get (idx r k) 0) (get (idx r k) 1) (get (idx r k) 2)))))
(lemma valid_wb (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (weights_bounded g) (are_valid_edges g r))
  (ensures (wb r))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call valid_wb_k g r k))))
(lemma mst_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (weights_bounded g) (is_spanning_tree g r) (is_spanning_tree g o) (opt_below g r 100001))
  (ensures (<= (total_weight r) (total_weight o)))
  (body
    (assert (are_valid_edges g r))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g o))
    (call valid_wb g r)
    (call valid_wb g o)
    (call clip_low r)
    (call clip_low o)
    (assert (le_dom r o -100000))
    (call clip_cmp r o -100000)))
(lemma mst_final (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (weights_bounded g) (is_spanning_tree g r) (opt_below g r 100001))
  (ensures (is_mst g r))
  (body (forall ((o (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call mst_one g r o))))

(lemma edge_info (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int) (k int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (are_valid_edges g r) (== (len c) (len g)) (closed_lt g c (+ t 1))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len r))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get (idx r k) 0)) (< (get (idx r k) 0) (len g)))
           (and (<= 0 (get (idx r k) 1)) (< (get (idx r k) 1) (len g)))
           (=> (<= (get (idx r k) 2) t) (== (idx c (get (idx r k) 0)) (idx c (get (idx r k) 1)))))
  (body
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx r k) 0) (get (idx r k) 1) (get (idx r k) 2)))
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx r k) 0)) (< (get (idx r k) 0) (len g)))
                (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g (get (idx r k) 0))))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g (get (idx r k) 0)) i) 0) (get (idx r k) 1))
                (== (get (idx (idx g (get (idx r k) 0)) i) 1) (get (idx r k) 2)))))))
(lemma lpath (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (ends_in o (len l)) (edges_eq_upto o l (len o)) (path_follows_edges o p)
            (> (len p) 0) (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) (len l)))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len l))) (== (idx l (idx p k)) (idx l (idx p 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call lpath o l p (- k 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set o (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))
        (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len o)))
          (or (and (== (get (idx o e) 0) (idx p (- k 1))) (== (get (idx o e) 1) (idx p k)))
              (and (== (get (idx o e) 0) (idx p k)) (== (get (idx o e) 1) (idx p (- k 1)))))))
        (assert (== (idx l (get (idx o e) 0)) (idx l (get (idx o e) 1)))))
      (block))))
(lemma lab_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (is_spanning g o) (== (len l) (len g)) (ends_in o (len l)) (edges_eq_upto o l (len o))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))))
  (ensures (== (idx l x) (idx l 0)))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected o 0 x))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x))) (path_follows_edges o p)))
    (call lpath o l p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma lab_const (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)))
  (requires (is_spanning g o) (== (len l) (len g)) (ends_in o (len l)) (edges_eq_upto o l (len o)))
  (ensures (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l))) (== (idx l x) (idx l 0)))))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call lab_one g o l x))))
(lemma cut_bound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int))
  (requires (lab_wf c) (== (len c) (len g)) (> (len g) 0) (targets_ok g) (closed_lt g c (+ t 1))
            (is_spanning_tree g o))
  (ensures (<= (le_cnt o t) (- (len g) (nroots c (len g)))))
  (body
    (assert (are_valid_edges g o))
    (assert (is_spanning g o))
    (assert (== (len o) (- (len g) 1)))
    (forall ((k0 int)) (call edge_info g c o t k0))
    (assert (ends_in o (len g)))
    (assert (== (len (take o 0)) 0))
    (assert (== (le_cnt (take o 0) t) 0))
    (ghost-let-mut lab (seq int) c)
    (ghost-let-mut k int 0)
    (while (< k (len o))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len o))))
      (invariant (== (len lab) (len g)))
      (invariant (lab_wf lab))
      (invariant (refines c lab))
      (invariant (edges_eq_upto o lab k))
      (invariant (<= (+ (- (nroots c (len g)) (nroots lab (len g))) (le_cnt (take o k) t)) k))
      (decreases (- (len o) k))
      (call edge_info g c o t k)
      (ghost-let ea int (get (idx o k) 0))
      (ghost-let eb int (get (idx o k) 1))
      (ghost-let lab0 (seq int) lab)
      (ghost-let la int (idx lab0 ea))
      (ghost-let lb int (idx lab0 eb))
      (assert (snoc (take o k) (take o (+ k 1)) (idx o k)))
      (call le_snoc (take o k) (take o (+ k 1)) (idx o k) t)
      (if (== la lb)
        (block)
        (block
          (assert (> (get (idx o k) 2) t))
          (ghost-set lab (seq-build (len g) (fn (z) (if (== (idx lab0 z) lb) la (idx lab0 z)))))
          (assert (merged lab0 lab la lb))
          (call merge_wf lab0 lab la lb)
          (call nroots_merge lab0 lab la lb (len g))
          (call merge_refines lab0 lab la lb)
          (call refines_trans c lab0 lab)
          (assert (== (idx lab ea) la))
          (assert (== (idx lab eb) la))))
      (ghost-set k (+ k 1)))
    (assert (== (take o (len o)) o))
    (call lab_const g o lab)
    (call nroots_one lab (idx lab 0) (len g))))
(lemma opt_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int))
  (requires (lab_wf c) (== (len c) (len g)) (> (len g) 0) (targets_ok g) (closed_lt g c (+ t 1))
            (w_lt r (+ t 1)) (== (+ (len r) (nroots c (len g))) (len g)) (opt_below g r t))
  (ensures (opt_below g r (+ t 1)))

(lemma merge_refines (params (p (seq int)) (c (seq int)) (cu int) (cv int))
  (requires (merged p c cu cv))
  (ensures (refines p c))
  (body))
(lemma refines_trans (params (p (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (c (seq int)))
  (requires (refines p q) (refines q c))
  (ensures (refines p c))
  (body))
(lemma closed_init (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)))
  (requires (wbound g))
  (ensures (closed_lt g c -100000))
  (body))
(lemma closed_mono (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (c (seq int)) (t int))
  (requires (closed_lt g p t) (refines p c))
  (ensures (closed_lt g c t))
  (body))
(lemma done_mono (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (p (seq int)) (c (seq int)) (t int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (done_upto g p t u i) (refines p c))
  (ensures (done_upto g c t u i))
  (body))
(lemma close_round (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (t int))
  (requires (closed_lt g c t) (done_upto g c t (len g) 0))
  (ensures (closed_lt g c (+ t 1)))
  (body))
(lemma add_entry (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (t int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (done_upto g c t u i) (== (len c) (len g)) (targets_ok g)
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (or (!= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) t) (== (idx c u) (idx c (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))

(lemma next_vertex (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (t int) (u int))

  (ensures (done_upto g c t (+ u 1) 0))
  (body))

(lemma conn_refl (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int))
  (ensures (edges_connected r a a))
  (body
    (ghost-let pa (seq int) (seq-lit a))
    (assert (and (== (len pa) 1) (== (idx pa 0) a)))
    (assert (== (idx pa (- (len pa) 1)) a))
    (assert (path_follows_edges r pa))))
(lemma conn_init (params (c (seq int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len c))) (== (idx c x) x))))
  (ensures (conn_inv c r))
  (body (forall ((a int)) (call conn_refl r a))))
(lemma edge_ext (params (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (snoc r0 r1 e) (edge_in_set r0 x y))
  (ensures (edge_in_set r1 x y))
  (body
    (obtain ((k int)) (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len r0)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx r0 k) 0) x) (== (get (idx r0 k) 1) y))
          (and (== (get (idx r0 k) 0) y) (== (get (idx r0 k) 1) x)))))
    (assert (== (idx r1 k) (idx r0 k)))))
(lemma path_ext_k (params (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (snoc r0 r1 e) (path_follows_edges r0 p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set r1 (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (edge_in_set r0 (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
    (call edge_ext r0 r1 e (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
(lemma path_ext (params (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (snoc r0 r1 e) (path_follows_edges r0 p))
  (ensures (path_follows_edges r1 p))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call path_ext_k r0 r1 e p k))))
(lemma conn_ext (params (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (snoc r0 r1 e) (edges_connected r0 a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected r1 a b))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges r0 p)))
    (call path_ext r0 r1 e p)))
(lemma conn_edge (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len r))) (== (get (idx r k) 0) a) (== (get (idx r k) 1) b))
  (ensures (edges_connected r a b) (edges_connected r b a))
  (body
    (assert (edge_in_set r a b))
    (assert (edge_in_set r b a))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (seq-lit a b))
    (assert (and (== (len q) 2) (and (== (idx q 0) a) (== (idx q 1) b))))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) b))
    (assert (path_follows_edges r q))
    (ghost-let q2 (seq int) (seq-lit b a))
    (assert (and (== (len q2) 2) (and (== (idx q2 0) b) (== (idx q2 1) a))))
    (assert (== (idx q2 (- (len q2) 1)) a))
    (assert (path_follows_edges r q2))))
(lemma trans_k (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (pq (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (joined p q pq) (path_follows_edges r p) (path_follows_edges r q)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (idx q 0))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len pq) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set r (idx pq k) (idx pq (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (if (< k (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx pq k) (idx p k)))
        (assert (== (idx pq (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1))))
        (assert (edge_in_set r (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
      (if (== k (- (len p) 1))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx pq k) (idx q 0)))
          (assert (== (idx pq (+ k 1)) (idx q 1)))
          (assert (edge_in_set r (idx q 0) (idx q 1))))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx pq k) (idx q (+ (- k (len p)) 1))))
          (assert (== (idx pq (+ k 1)) (idx q (+ (- k (len p)) 2))))
          (assert (edge_in_set r (idx q (+ (- k (len p)) 1)) (idx q (+ (- k (len p)) 2)))))))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (edges_connected r a b) (edges_connected r b d))
  (ensures (edges_connected r a d))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges r p)))
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) b) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) d))) (path_follows_edges r q)))
    (ghost-let pq (seq int) (seq-build (- (+ (len p) (len q)) 1) (fn (i) (if (< i (len p)) (idx p i) (idx q (+ (- i (len p)) 1))))))
    (assert (joined p q pq))
    (forall ((k int)) (call trans_k r p q pq k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges r pq))
    (assert (> (len pq) 0))
    (assert (== (idx pq 0) a))
    (assert (== (idx pq (- (len pq) 1)) d))))
(lemma merge_conn_ab (params (p (seq int)) (c (seq int)) (cu int) (cv int)
                             (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int)))
                             (u int) (v int) (w int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (conn_inv p r0) (merged p c cu cv) (snoc r0 r1 (tuple u v w))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len p))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len p)))
            (== (idx p u) cu) (== (idx p v) cv)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len p))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len p)))
            (== (idx c a) (idx c b)))
  (ensures (edges_connected r1 a b))
  (body
    (call conn_edge r1 (len r0) u v)
    (if (== (idx p a) (idx p b))
      (block
        (assert (edges_connected r0 a b))
        (call conn_ext r0 r1 (tuple u v w) a b))
      (if (== (idx p a) cv)
        (block
          (assert (edges_connected r0 a v))
          (assert (edges_connected r0 u b))
          (call conn_ext r0 r1 (tuple u v w) a v)
          (call conn_ext r0 r1 (tuple u v w) u b)
          (call conn_trans r1 a v u)
          (call conn_trans r1 a u b))
        (block
          (assert (edges_connected r0 a u))
          (assert (edges_connected r0 v b))
          (call conn_ext r0 r1 (tuple u v w) a u)
          (call conn_ext r0 r1 (tuple u v w) v b)
          (call conn_trans r1 a u v)
          (call conn_trans r1 a v b))))))
(lemma merge_conn (params (p (seq int)) (c (seq int)) (cu int) (cv int)
                          (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int)))
                          (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (conn_inv p r0) (merged p c cu cv) (snoc r0 r1 (tuple u v w))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len p))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len p)))
            (== (idx p u) cu) (== (idx p v) cv))
  (ensures (conn_inv c r1))
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call merge_conn_ab p c cu cv r0 r1 u v w a b))))
(lemma wlt_push (params (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (t int))
  (requires (w_lt r0 t) (snoc r0 r1 e) (< (get e 2) t))
  (ensures (w_lt r1 t))
  (body))
(lemma valid_push (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g r0) (snoc r0 r1 e) (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g r1))
  (body))

(lemma le_snoc (params (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (s int))
  (requires (snoc r0 r1 e))
  (ensures (== (le_cnt r1 s) (+ (le_cnt r0 s) (if (<= (get e 2) s) 1 0))))
  (decreases (len r0))
  (body
    (if (> (len r0) 0)
      (block
        (assert (snoc (drop r0 1) (drop r1 1) e))
        (call le_snoc (drop r0 1) (drop r1 1) e s)
        (assert (== (idx r1 0) (idx r0 0)))
        (assert (== (le_cnt r1 s) (+ (if (<= (get (idx r1 0) 2) s) 1 0) (le_cnt (drop r1 1) s))))
        (assert (== (le_cnt r0 s) (+ (if (<= (get (idx r0 0) 2) s) 1 0) (le_cnt (drop r0 1) s)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx r1 0) e))
        (assert (== (len (drop r1 1)) 0))
        (assert (== (le_cnt (drop r1 1) s) 0))
        (assert (== (le_cnt r1 s) (+ (if (<= (get (idx r1 0) 2) s) 1 0) (le_cnt (drop r1 1) s))))
        (assert (== (le_cnt r0 s) 0))))))
(lemma opt_keep (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (t int))
  (requires (opt_below g r0 t) (snoc r0 r1 e) (>= (get e 2) t))
  (ensures (opt_below g r1 t))
  (body (forall ((s int)) (call le_snoc r0 r1 e s))))
(lemma le_all (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int))
  (requires (w_lt r (+ t 1)))
  (ensures (== (le_cnt r t) (len r)))
  (decreases (len r))
  (body
    (if (> (len r) 0)
      (block
        (assert (w_lt (drop r 1) (+ t 1)))
        (call le_all (drop r 1) t)
        (assert (< (get (idx r 0) 2) (+ t 1)))
        (assert (== (le_cnt r t) (+ (if (<= (get (idx r 0) 2) t) 1 0) (le_cnt (drop r 1) t)))))
      (assert (== (le_cnt r t) 0)))))
(lemma clip_step (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int))
  (ensures (== (clip r s) (- (clip r (+ s 1)) (le_cnt r s))))
  (decreases (len r))
  (body
    (if (> (len r) 0)
      (block
        (call clip_step (drop r 1) s)
        (assert (== (clip r s) (+ (if (< (get (idx r 0) 2) s) s (get (idx r 0) 2)) (clip (drop r 1) s))))
        (assert (== (clip r (+ s 1)) (+ (if (< (get (idx r 0) 2) (+ s 1)) (+ s 1) (get (idx r 0) 2)) (clip (drop r 1) (+ s 1)))))
        (assert (== (le_cnt r s) (+ (if (<= (get (idx r 0) 2) s) 1 0) (le_cnt (drop r 1) s)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (clip r s) 0))
        (assert (== (clip r (+ s 1)) 0))
        (assert (== (le_cnt r s) 0))))))
(lemma wb_drop (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (wb r) (> (len r) 0))
  (ensures (wb (drop r 1)))
  (body))
(lemma clip_low (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (wb r))
  (ensures (== (clip r -100000) (total_weight r)))
  (decreases (len r))
  (body
    (if (> (len r) 0)
      (block
        (call wb_drop r)
        (call clip_low (drop r 1))
        (assert (<= -100000 (get (idx r 0) 2)))
        (assert (== (clip r -100000) (+ (if (< (get (idx r 0) 2) -100000) -100000 (get (idx r 0) 2)) (clip (drop r 1) -100000))))
        (assert (== (total_weight r) (+ (get (idx r 0) 2) (total_weight (drop r 1))))))
      (block (assert (== (clip r -100000) 0)) (assert (== (total_weight r) 0))))))
(lemma clip_high (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (wb r))
  (ensures (== (clip r 100000) (* (len r) 100000)))
  (decreases (len r))
  (body
    (if (> (len r) 0)
      (block
        (call wb_drop r)
        (call clip_high (drop r 1))
        (assert (<= (get (idx r 0) 2) 100000))
        (assert (== (clip r 100000) (+ (if (< (get (idx r 0) 2) 100000) 100000 (get (idx r 0) 2)) (clip (drop r 1) 100000))))
        (assert (== (len (drop r 1)) (- (len r) 1))))
      (assert (== (clip r 100000) 0)))))
(lemma clip_cmp (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int))
  (requires (wb r) (wb o) (== (len r) (len o)) (le_dom r o t) (and (<= -100000 t) (<= t 100000)))
  (ensures (<= (clip r t) (clip o t)))
  (decreases (- 100000 t))
  (body
    (if (< t 100000)
      (block
        (call clip_cmp r o (+ t 1))
        (call clip_step r t)
        (call clip_step o t)
        (assert (<= (le_cnt o t) (le_cnt r t))))
      (block (call clip_high r) (call clip_high o)))))
(lemma valid_wb_k (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (weights_bounded g) (are_valid_edges g r) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len r))))
  (ensures (and (<= -100000 (get (idx r k) 2)) (<= (get (idx r k) 2) 100000)))
  (body (assert (has_edge g (get (idx r k) 0) (get (idx r k) 1) (get (idx r k) 2)))))
(lemma valid_wb (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (weights_bounded g) (are_valid_edges g r))
  (ensures (wb r))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call valid_wb_k g r k))))
(lemma mst_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (weights_bounded g) (is_spanning_tree g r) (is_spanning_tree g o) (opt_below g r 100001))
  (ensures (<= (total_weight r) (total_weight o)))
  (body
    (assert (are_valid_edges g r))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g o))
    (call valid_wb g r)
    (call valid_wb g o)
    (call clip_low r)
    (call clip_low o)
    (assert (le_dom r o -100000))
    (call clip_cmp r o -100000)))
(lemma mst_final (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (weights_bounded g) (is_spanning_tree g r) (opt_below g r 100001))
  (ensures (is_mst g r))
  (body (forall ((o (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call mst_one g r o))))

(lemma edge_info (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int) (k int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (are_valid_edges g r) (== (len c) (len g)) (closed_lt g c (+ t 1))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len r))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get (idx r k) 0)) (< (get (idx r k) 0) (len g)))
           (and (<= 0 (get (idx r k) 1)) (< (get (idx r k) 1) (len g)))
           (=> (<= (get (idx r k) 2) t) (== (idx c (get (idx r k) 0)) (idx c (get (idx r k) 1)))))
  (body
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx r k) 0) (get (idx r k) 1) (get (idx r k) 2)))
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx r k) 0)) (< (get (idx r k) 0) (len g)))
                (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g (get (idx r k) 0))))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g (get (idx r k) 0)) i) 0) (get (idx r k) 1))
                (== (get (idx (idx g (get (idx r k) 0)) i) 1) (get (idx r k) 2)))))))
(lemma lpath (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (ends_in o (len l)) (edges_eq_upto o l (len o)) (path_follows_edges o p)
            (> (len p) 0) (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) (len l)))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len l))) (== (idx l (idx p k)) (idx l (idx p 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call lpath o l p (- k 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set o (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))
        (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len o)))
          (or (and (== (get (idx o e) 0) (idx p (- k 1))) (== (get (idx o e) 1) (idx p k)))
              (and (== (get (idx o e) 0) (idx p k)) (== (get (idx o e) 1) (idx p (- k 1)))))))
        (assert (== (idx l (get (idx o e) 0)) (idx l (get (idx o e) 1)))))
      (block))))
(lemma lab_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (is_spanning g o) (== (len l) (len g)) (ends_in o (len l)) (edges_eq_upto o l (len o))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))))
  (ensures (== (idx l x) (idx l 0)))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected o 0 x))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x))) (path_follows_edges o p)))
    (call lpath o l p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma lab_const (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)))
  (requires (is_spanning g o) (== (len l) (len g)) (ends_in o (len l)) (edges_eq_upto o l (len o)))
  (ensures (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l))) (== (idx l x) (idx l 0)))))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call lab_one g o l x))))
(lemma cut_bound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int))
  (requires (lab_wf c) (== (len c) (len g)) (> (len g) 0) (targets_ok g) (closed_lt g c (+ t 1))
            (is_spanning_tree g o))
  (ensures (<= (le_cnt o t) (- (len g) (nroots c (len g)))))
  (body
    (assert (are_valid_edges g o))
    (assert (is_spanning g o))
    (assert (== (len o) (- (len g) 1)))
    (forall ((k0 int)) (call edge_info g c o t k0))
    (assert (ends_in o (len g)))
    (assert (== (len (take o 0)) 0))
    (assert (== (le_cnt (take o 0) t) 0))
    (ghost-let-mut lab (seq int) c)
    (ghost-let-mut k int 0)
    (while (< k (len o))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len o))))
      (invariant (== (len lab) (len g)))
      (invariant (lab_wf lab))
      (invariant (refines c lab))
      (invariant (edges_eq_upto o lab k))
      (invariant (<= (+ (- (nroots c (len g)) (nroots lab (len g))) (le_cnt (take o k) t)) k))
      (decreases (- (len o) k))
      (call edge_info g c o t k)
      (ghost-let ea int (get (idx o k) 0))
      (ghost-let eb int (get (idx o k) 1))
      (ghost-let lab0 (seq int) lab)
      (ghost-let la int (idx lab0 ea))
      (ghost-let lb int (idx lab0 eb))
      (assert (snoc (take o k) (take o (+ k 1)) (idx o k)))
      (call le_snoc (take o k) (take o (+ k 1)) (idx o k) t)
      (if (== la lb)
        (block)
        (block
          (assert (> (get (idx o k) 2) t))
          (ghost-set lab (seq-build (len g) (fn (z) (if (== (idx lab0 z) lb) la (idx lab0 z)))))
          (assert (merged lab0 lab la lb))
          (call merge_wf lab0 lab la lb)
          (call nroots_merge lab0 lab la lb (len g))
          (call merge_refines lab0 lab la lb)
          (call refines_trans c lab0 lab)
          (assert (== (idx lab ea) la))
          (assert (== (idx lab eb) la))))
      (ghost-set k (+ k 1)))
    (assert (== (take o (len o)) o))
    (call lab_const g o lab)
    (call nroots_one lab (idx lab 0) (len g))))
(lemma opt_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int))
  (requires (lab_wf c) (== (len c) (len g)) (> (len g) 0) (targets_ok g) (closed_lt g c (+ t 1))
            (w_lt r (+ t 1)) (== (+ (len r) (nroots c (len g))) (len g)) (opt_below g r t))
  (ensures (opt_below g r (+ t 1)))
  (body
    (call le_all r t)
    (forall ((o (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call cut_bound g c o t))))
(lemma span_final (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len c) (len g)) (> (len g) 0) (conn_inv c r)
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len c))) (== (idx c x) (idx c 0)))))
  (ensures (is_spanning g r))
  (body))

        (assert (edge_in_set r (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
      (if (== k (- (len p) 1))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx pq k) (idx q 0)))
          (assert (== (idx pq (+ k 1)) (idx q 1)))
          (assert (edge_in_set r (idx q 0) (idx q 1))))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx pq k) (idx q (+ (- k (len p)) 1))))
          (assert (== (idx pq (+ k 1)) (idx q (+ (- k (len p)) 2))))
          (assert (edge_in_set r (idx q (+ (- k (len p)) 1)) (idx q (+ (- k (len p)) 2)))))))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (edges_connected r a b) (edges_connected r b d))
  (ensures (edges_connected r a d))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges r p)))
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) b) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) d))) (path_follows_edges r q)))
    (ghost-let pq (seq int) (seq-build (- (+ (len p) (len q)) 1) (fn (i) (if (< i (len p)) (idx p i) (idx q (+ (- i (len p)) 1))))))
    (assert (joined p q pq))
    (forall ((k int)) (call trans_k r p q pq k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges r pq))
    (assert (> (len pq) 0))
    (assert (== (idx pq 0) a))
    (assert (== (idx pq (- (len pq) 1)) d))))
(lemma merge_conn_ab (params (p (seq int)) (c (seq int)) (cu int) (cv int)
                             (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int)))
                             (u int) (v int) (w int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (conn_inv p r0) (merged p c cu cv) (snoc r0 r1 (tuple u v w))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len p))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len p)))
            (== (idx p u) cu) (== (idx p v) cv)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len p))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len p)))
            (== (idx c a) (idx c b)))
  (ensures (edges_connected r1 a b))
  (body
    (call conn_edge r1 (len r0) u v)
    (if (== (idx p a) (idx p b))
      (block
        (assert (edges_connected r0 a b))
        (call conn_ext r0 r1 (tuple u v w) a b))
      (if (== (idx p a) cv)
        (block
          (assert (edges_connected r0 a v))
          (assert (edges_connected r0 u b))
          (call conn_ext r0 r1 (tuple u v w) a v)
          (call conn_ext r0 r1 (tuple u v w) u b)
          (call conn_trans r1 a v u)
          (call conn_trans r1 a u b))
        (block
          (assert (edges_connected r0 a u))
          (assert (edges_connected r0 v b))
          (call conn_ext r0 r1 (tuple u v w) a u)
          (call conn_ext r0 r1 (tuple u v w) v b)
          (call conn_trans r1 a u v)
          (call conn_trans r1 a v b))))))
(lemma merge_conn (params (p (seq int)) (c (seq int)) (cu int) (cv int)
                          (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int)))
                          (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (conn_inv p r0) (merged p c cu cv) (snoc r0 r1 (tuple u v w))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len p))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len p)))
            (== (idx p u) cu) (== (idx p v) cv))
  (ensures (conn_inv c r1))
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int)) (call merge_conn_ab p c cu cv r0 r1 u v w a b))))
(lemma wlt_push (params (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (t int))
  (requires (w_lt r0 t) (snoc r0 r1 e) (< (get e 2) t))

(lemma valid_push (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g r0) (snoc r0 r1 e) (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)))

(lemma le_snoc (params (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (s int))
  (requires (snoc r0 r1 e))
  (ensures (== (le_cnt r1 s) (+ (le_cnt r0 s) (if (<= (get e 2) s) 1 0))))
  (decreases (len r0))
  (body
    (if (> (len r0) 0)
      (block
        (assert (snoc (drop r0 1) (drop r1 1) e))
        (call le_snoc (drop r0 1) (drop r1 1) e s)
        (assert (== (idx r1 0) (idx r0 0)))
        (assert (== (le_cnt r1 s) (+ (if (<= (get (idx r1 0) 2) s) 1 0) (le_cnt (drop r1 1) s))))
        (assert (== (le_cnt r0 s) (+ (if (<= (get (idx r0 0) 2) s) 1 0) (le_cnt (drop r0 1) s)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx r1 0) e))
        (assert (== (len (drop r1 1)) 0))
        (assert (== (le_cnt (drop r1 1) s) 0))
        (assert (== (le_cnt r1 s) (+ (if (<= (get (idx r1 0) 2) s) 1 0) (le_cnt (drop r1 1) s))))
        (assert (== (le_cnt r0 s) 0))))))
(lemma opt_keep (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (r1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (t int))
  (requires (opt_below g r0 t) (snoc r0 r1 e) (>= (get e 2) t))
  (ensures (opt_below g r1 t))
  (body (forall ((s int)) (call le_snoc r0 r1 e s))))
(lemma le_all (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int))
  (requires (w_lt r (+ t 1)))
  (ensures (== (le_cnt r t) (len r)))
  (decreases (len r))
  (body
    (if (> (len r) 0)
      (block
        (assert (w_lt (drop r 1) (+ t 1)))
        (call le_all (drop r 1) t)
        (assert (< (get (idx r 0) 2) (+ t 1)))
        (assert (== (le_cnt r t) (+ (if (<= (get (idx r 0) 2) t) 1 0) (le_cnt (drop r 1) t)))))
      (assert (== (le_cnt r t) 0)))))
(lemma clip_step (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (s int))
  (ensures (== (clip r s) (- (clip r (+ s 1)) (le_cnt r s))))
  (decreases (len r))
  (body
    (if (> (len r) 0)
      (block
        (call clip_step (drop r 1) s)
        (assert (== (clip r s) (+ (if (< (get (idx r 0) 2) s) s (get (idx r 0) 2)) (clip (drop r 1) s))))
        (assert (== (clip r (+ s 1)) (+ (if (< (get (idx r 0) 2) (+ s 1)) (+ s 1) (get (idx r 0) 2)) (clip (drop r 1) (+ s 1)))))
        (assert (== (le_cnt r s) (+ (if (<= (get (idx r 0) 2) s) 1 0) (le_cnt (drop r 1) s)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (clip r s) 0))
        (assert (== (clip r (+ s 1)) 0))
        (assert (== (le_cnt r s) 0))))))
(lemma wb_drop (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (wb r) (> (len r) 0))
  (ensures (wb (drop r 1)))
  (body))
(lemma clip_low (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (wb r))
  (ensures (== (clip r -100000) (total_weight r)))
  (decreases (len r))
  (body
    (if (> (len r) 0)
      (block
        (call wb_drop r)
        (call clip_low (drop r 1))
        (assert (<= -100000 (get (idx r 0) 2)))
        (assert (== (clip r -100000) (+ (if (< (get (idx r 0) 2) -100000) -100000 (get (idx r 0) 2)) (clip (drop r 1) -100000))))
        (assert (== (total_weight r) (+ (get (idx r 0) 2) (total_weight (drop r 1))))))
      (block (assert (== (clip r -100000) 0)) (assert (== (total_weight r) 0))))))
(lemma clip_high (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (wb r))
  (ensures (== (clip r 100000) (* (len r) 100000)))
  (decreases (len r))
  (body
    (if (> (len r) 0)
      (block
        (call wb_drop r)
        (call clip_high (drop r 1))
        (assert (<= (get (idx r 0) 2) 100000))
        (assert (== (clip r 100000) (+ (if (< (get (idx r 0) 2) 100000) 100000 (get (idx r 0) 2)) (clip (drop r 1) 100000))))
        (assert (== (len (drop r 1)) (- (len r) 1))))
      (assert (== (clip r 100000) 0)))))
(lemma clip_cmp (params (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int))
  (requires (wb r) (wb o) (== (len r) (len o)) (le_dom r o t) (and (<= -100000 t) (<= t 100000)))
  (ensures (<= (clip r t) (clip o t)))
  (decreases (- 100000 t))
  (body
    (if (< t 100000)
      (block
        (call clip_cmp r o (+ t 1))
        (call clip_step r t)
        (call clip_step o t)
        (assert (<= (le_cnt o t) (le_cnt r t))))
      (block (call clip_high r) (call clip_high o)))))
(lemma valid_wb_k (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (weights_bounded g) (are_valid_edges g r) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len r))))
  (ensures (and (<= -100000 (get (idx r k) 2)) (<= (get (idx r k) 2) 100000)))
  (body (assert (has_edge g (get (idx r k) 0) (get (idx r k) 1) (get (idx r k) 2)))))
(lemma valid_wb (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (weights_bounded g) (are_valid_edges g r))
  (ensures (wb r))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call valid_wb_k g r k))))
(lemma mst_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (weights_bounded g) (is_spanning_tree g r) (is_spanning_tree g o) (opt_below g r 100001))
  (ensures (<= (total_weight r) (total_weight o)))
  (body
    (assert (are_valid_edges g r))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g o))
    (call valid_wb g r)
    (call valid_wb g o)
    (call clip_low r)
    (call clip_low o)
    (assert (le_dom r o -100000))
    (call clip_cmp r o -100000)))
(lemma mst_final (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (weights_bounded g) (is_spanning_tree g r) (opt_below g r 100001))
  (ensures (is_mst g r))

(lemma edge_info (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int) (k int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (are_valid_edges g r) (== (len c) (len g)) (closed_lt g c (+ t 1))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len r))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (get (idx r k) 0)) (< (get (idx r k) 0) (len g)))
           (and (<= 0 (get (idx r k) 1)) (< (get (idx r k) 1) (len g)))
           (=> (<= (get (idx r k) 2) t) (== (idx c (get (idx r k) 0)) (idx c (get (idx r k) 1)))))
  (body
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx r k) 0) (get (idx r k) 1) (get (idx r k) 2)))
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx r k) 0)) (< (get (idx r k) 0) (len g)))
                (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g (get (idx r k) 0))))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g (get (idx r k) 0)) i) 0) (get (idx r k) 1))
                (== (get (idx (idx g (get (idx r k) 0)) i) 1) (get (idx r k) 2)))))))
(lemma lpath (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (ends_in o (len l)) (edges_eq_upto o l (len o)) (path_follows_edges o p)
            (> (len p) 0) (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) (len l)))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len l))) (== (idx l (idx p k)) (idx l (idx p 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call lpath o l p (- k 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set o (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))
        (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len o)))
          (or (and (== (get (idx o e) 0) (idx p (- k 1))) (== (get (idx o e) 1) (idx p k)))
              (and (== (get (idx o e) 0) (idx p k)) (== (get (idx o e) 1) (idx p (- k 1)))))))
        (assert (== (idx l (get (idx o e) 0)) (idx l (get (idx o e) 1)))))
      (block))))
(lemma lab_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (is_spanning g o) (== (len l) (len g)) (ends_in o (len l)) (edges_eq_upto o l (len o))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))))
  (ensures (== (idx l x) (idx l 0)))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected o 0 x))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x))) (path_follows_edges o p)))
    (call lpath o l p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma lab_const (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)))
  (requires (is_spanning g o) (== (len l) (len g)) (ends_in o (len l)) (edges_eq_upto o l (len o)))
  (ensures (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l))) (== (idx l x) (idx l 0)))))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call lab_one g o l x))))
(lemma cut_bound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int))
  (requires (lab_wf c) (== (len c) (len g)) (> (len g) 0) (targets_ok g) (closed_lt g c (+ t 1))
            (is_spanning_tree g o))
  (ensures (<= (le_cnt o t) (- (len g) (nroots c (len g)))))
  (body
    (assert (are_valid_edges g o))
    (assert (is_spanning g o))
    (assert (== (len o) (- (len g) 1)))
    (forall ((k0 int)) (call edge_info g c o t k0))
    (assert (ends_in o (len g)))
    (assert (== (len (take o 0)) 0))
    (assert (== (le_cnt (take o 0) t) 0))
    (ghost-let-mut lab (seq int) c)
    (ghost-let-mut k int 0)
    (while (< k (len o))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len o))))
      (invariant (== (len lab) (len g)))
      (invariant (lab_wf lab))
      (invariant (refines c lab))
      (invariant (edges_eq_upto o lab k))
      (invariant (<= (+ (- (nroots c (len g)) (nroots lab (len g))) (le_cnt (take o k) t)) k))
      (decreases (- (len o) k))
      (call edge_info g c o t k)
      (ghost-let ea int (get (idx o k) 0))
      (ghost-let eb int (get (idx o k) 1))
      (ghost-let lab0 (seq int) lab)
      (assert (lab_wf lab0))
      (assert (== (len lab0) (len g)))
      (assert (and (<= 0 ea) (< ea (len lab0))))
      (assert (and (<= 0 eb) (< eb (len lab0))))
      (call lab_at lab0 ea)
      (call lab_at lab0 eb)
      (ghost-let la int (idx lab0 ea))
      (ghost-let lb int (idx lab0 eb))
      (assert (and (<= 0 la) (< la (len lab0))))
      (assert (and (<= 0 lb) (< lb (len lab0))))
      (assert (== (idx lab0 la) la))
      (assert (== (idx lab0 lb) lb))
      (assert (snoc (take o k) (take o (+ k 1)) (idx o k)))
      (call le_snoc (take o k) (take o (+ k 1)) (idx o k) t)
      (if (== la lb)
        (block)
        (block
          (assert (> (get (idx o k) 2) t))
          (ghost-set lab (seq-build (len g) (fn (z) (if (== (idx lab0 z) lb) la (idx lab0 z)))))
          (assert (merged lab0 lab la lb))
          (call merge_wf lab0 lab la lb)
          (call nroots_merge lab0 lab la lb (len g))
          (call merge_refines lab0 lab la lb)
          (call refines_trans c lab0 lab)
          (assert (== (idx lab ea) la))
          (assert (== (idx lab eb) la))))
      (ghost-set k (+ k 1)))
    (assert (== (take o (len o)) o))
    (call lab_const g o lab)
    (call lab_at lab 0)
    (call nroots_one lab (idx lab 0) (len g))))
(lemma opt_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int))
  (requires (lab_wf c) (== (len c) (len g)) (> (len g) 0) (targets_ok g) (closed_lt g c (+ t 1))
            (w_lt r (+ t 1)) (== (+ (len r) (nroots c (len g))) (len g)) (opt_below g r t))
  (ensures (opt_below g r (+ t 1)))
  (body
    (call le_all r t)
    (forall ((o (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call cut_bound g c o t))))
(lemma span_final (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (r (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len c) (len g)) (> (len g) 0) (conn_inv c r)
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len c))) (== (idx c x) (idx c 0)))))
  (ensures (is_spanning g r))

(lemma gpath (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (== (len c) (len g)) (targets_ok g) (wbound g) (closed_lt g c 100001)
            (path_follows_graph g p) (> (len p) 0) (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len g))) (== (idx c (idx p k)) (idx c (idx p 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call gpath g c p (- k 1))
        (assert (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p (- k 1)) (idx p k)))
        (obtain ((i int))
          (and (and (and (<= 0 (idx p (- k 1))) (< (idx p (- k 1)) (len g)))
                    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g (idx p (- k 1)))))))
               (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- k 1))) i) 0) (idx p k))))
        (assert (<= (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- k 1))) i) 1) 100000))
        (assert (== (idx c (idx p (- k 1))) (idx c (idx p k)))))
      (block))))
(lemma same_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (== (len c) (len g)) (targets_ok g) (wbound g) (closed_lt g c 100001) (graph_is_connected g)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))))
  (ensures (== (idx c x) (idx c 0)))
  (body
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 x))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x))) (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (call gpath g c p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma all_same (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)))
  (requires (== (len c) (len g)) (targets_ok g) (wbound g) (closed_lt g c 100001) (graph_is_connected g))
  (ensures (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len c))) (== (idx c x) (idx c 0)))))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call same_one g c x))))

(def kruskal_mst
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (ghost-let gg (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (assert (== gg (field graph adj)))
    (assert (== (len gg) n))
    (assert (> n 0))
    (assert (weights_bounded gg))
    (assert (<= n 100000))
    (assert (targets_ok gg))
    (call get_wbound gg)
    (let-mut comp (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (x0) x0)))
    (let-mut res (vec (tuple i64 i64 i64)) (vec-new))
    (call nroots_id comp n)
    (call conn_init comp res)
    (call closed_init gg comp)
    (let-mut t i64 -100000)
    (while (<= t 100000)
      (invariant (and (<= -100000 t) (<= t 100001)))
      (invariant (== (len comp) n))
      (invariant (lab_wf comp))
      (invariant (== (+ (len res) (nroots comp n)) n))
      (invariant (are_valid_edges gg res))
      (invariant (w_lt res t))
      (invariant (conn_inv comp res))
      (invariant (closed_lt gg comp t))
      (invariant (opt_below gg res t))
      (decreases (- 100001 t))
      (let-mut u i64 0)
      (while (< u n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
        (invariant (and (<= -100000 t) (<= t 100000)))
        (invariant (== (len comp) n))
        (invariant (lab_wf comp))
        (invariant (== (+ (len res) (nroots comp n)) n))
        (invariant (are_valid_edges gg res))
        (invariant (w_lt res (+ t 1)))
        (invariant (conn_inv comp res))
        (invariant (closed_lt gg comp t))
        (invariant (done_upto gg comp t u 0))
        (invariant (opt_below gg res t))
        (decreases (- n u))
        (let deg i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) u)))
        (assert (== deg (len (idx gg u))))
        (let-mut i i64 0)
        (while (< i deg)
          (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i deg)))
          (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
          (invariant (and (<= -100000 t) (<= t 100000)))
          (invariant (== (len comp) n))
          (invariant (lab_wf comp))
          (invariant (== (+ (len res) (nroots comp n)) n))
          (invariant (are_valid_edges gg res))
          (invariant (w_lt res (+ t 1)))
          (invariant (conn_inv comp res))
          (invariant (closed_lt gg comp t))
          (invariant (done_upto gg comp t u i))
          (invariant (opt_below gg res t))
          (decreases (- deg i))
          (let ed (tuple i64 i64) (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i))
          (let v i64 (get ed 0))
          (let w i64 (get ed 1))
          (assert (== (idx (idx gg u) i) ed))
          (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
          (if (== w t)
            (block
              (let cu i64 (idx comp u))
              (let cv i64 (idx comp v))
              (if (== cu cv)
                (call add_entry gg comp t u i)
                (block
                  (ghost-let pre_comp (seq int) comp)
                  (ghost-let pre_res (seq (tuple int int int)) res)
                  (assert (== (len pre_comp) n))
                  (assert (lab_wf pre_comp))
                  (assert (== (+ (len pre_res) (nroots pre_comp n)) n))
                  (assert (are_valid_edges gg pre_res))
                  (assert (w_lt pre_res (+ t 1)))
                  (assert (conn_inv pre_comp pre_res))
                  (assert (closed_lt gg pre_comp t))
                  (assert (done_upto gg pre_comp t u i))
                  (assert (opt_below gg pre_res t))
                  (assert (and (== (idx pre_comp u) cu) (== (idx pre_comp v) cv)))
                  (call lab_at pre_comp u)
