(ghost-fn all_good ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((o (seq (tuple int int int)))) (=> (is_spanning_tree g o) (good g t o)))))
(ghost-fn state_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (c int)) bool
  (body (and (and (and (== (len s) (len g)) (== (len t) (- c 1))) (and (== (cnt s) c) (in_s s 0)))
             (and (and (tree_in s t) (are_valid_edges g t)) (and (conn_s t s) (all_good g t))))))
(ghost-fn has_cross ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool))) bool
  (body (exists ((u int) (i int))
    (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
         (!= (in_s s u) (in_s s (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))))
(ghost-fn scanned_rows ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (ub int) (found bool) (bw int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (i int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u ub)) (< u (len g)))
             (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (!= (in_s s u) (in_s s (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))
        (and found (<= bw (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn scanned_part ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (u int) (ib int) (found bool) (bw int)) bool
  (body (=> (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (forall ((i int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i ib)) (and (< i (len (idx g u))) (!= (in_s s u) (in_s s (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))
          (and found (<= bw (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))))))
(ghost-fn best_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (bu int) (bv int) (bw int) (bi int)) bool
  (body (and (and (and (<= 0 bu) (< bu (len g))) (and (<= 0 bi) (< bi (len (idx g bu)))))
             (and (and (== (get (idx (idx g bu) bi) 0) bv) (== (get (idx (idx g bu) bi) 1) bw))
                  (!= (in_s s bu) (in_s s bv))))))

(lemma wf_view (params (wg weighted_graph))
  (requires (well_formed wg))
  (ensures (wfg (view wg)))
  (body (assert (== (view wg) (field wg adj)))))
(lemma edge_intro (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (h int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (edge_of s h u v))
  (ensures (edge_in_set s u v))
  (body (assert (and (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len s)))
    (or (and (== (get (idx s h) 0) u) (== (get (idx s h) 1) v))
        (and (== (get (idx s h) 0) v) (== (get (idx s h) 1) u)))))))
(lemma edge_sym (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (edge_in_set s u v))
  (ensures (edge_in_set s v u))
  (body
    (obtain ((h int)) (and (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len s)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx s h) 0) u) (== (get (idx s h) 1) v))
          (and (== (get (idx s h) 0) v) (== (get (idx s h) 1) u)))))
    (call edge_intro s h v u)))
(lemma conn_refl (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int))
  (ensures (edges_connected s a a))
  (body
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (seq-lit a))
    (call law_len_unit a)
    (assert (== (idx q 0) a))
    (assert (path_follows_edges s q))
    (assert (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) a) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) a))) (path_follows_edges s q)))))
(lemma ext_pt (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (c int) (k int))
  (requires (> (len p) 0) (path_follows_edges s p) (edge_in_set s (idx p (- (len p) 1)) c) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set s (idx (concat p (seq-lit c)) k) (idx (concat p (seq-lit c)) (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_unit c)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit c) k)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit c) (+ k 1))
    (if (< k (- (len p) 1))
      (assert (edge_in_set s (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
      (assert (== (idx (seq-lit c) 0) c)))))
(lemma extend (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (c int))
  (requires (edges_connected s a b) (edge_in_set s b c))
  (ensures (edges_connected s a c))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges s p)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call ext_pt s p c k))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (concat p (seq-lit c)))
    (call law_len_unit c)
    (call law_len_concat p (seq-lit c))
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit c) 0)
    (call law_idx_concat p (seq-lit c) (len p))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) c))
    (assert (path_follows_edges s q))
    (assert (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) a) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) c))) (path_follows_edges s q)))))
(lemma fwd_walk (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (q (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges s q) (> (len q) 0) (edges_connected s a (idx q 0)) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len q))))
  (ensures (edges_connected s a (idx q m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call fwd_walk s a q (- m 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set s (idx q (- m 1)) (idx q m)))
        (call extend s a (idx q (- m 1)) (idx q m)))
      (block))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (c int))
  (requires (edges_connected s a b) (edges_connected s b c))
  (ensures (edges_connected s a c))
  (body
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) b) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) c))) (path_follows_edges s q)))
    (call fwd_walk s a q (- (len q) 1))))
(lemma rev_walk (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (b int) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges s p) (> (len p) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures (edges_connected s b (idx p m)))
  (decreases (- (len p) m))
  (body
    (if (< m (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (call rev_walk s b p (+ m 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set s (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1))))
        (call edge_sym s (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1)))
        (call extend s b (idx p (+ m 1)) (idx p m)))
      (call conn_refl s b))))
(lemma conn_sym (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (edges_connected s a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected s b a))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges s p)))
    (call rev_walk s b p 0)))
(lemma conn_pair (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (edges_connected s 0 u) (edges_connected s 0 v))
  (ensures (edges_connected s u v))
  (body (call conn_sym s 0 u) (call conn_trans s u 0 v)))
(lemma span_root (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (forall ((z int)) (=> (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len g))) (edges_connected s 0 z))))
  (ensures (is_spanning g s))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call conn_pair s u v))))
(lemma lift_k (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (prefix_of t o) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))) (edge_in_set t (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set o (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (obtain ((h int)) (and (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len t)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx t h) 0) (idx p k)) (== (get (idx t h) 1) (idx p (+ k 1))))
          (and (== (get (idx t h) 0) (idx p (+ k 1))) (== (get (idx t h) 1) (idx p k))))))
    (assert (== (idx o h) (idx t h)))
    (call edge_intro o h (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
(lemma lift (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (prefix_of t o) (edges_connected t a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected o a b))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges t p)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call lift_k t o p k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges o p))
    (assert (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges o p)))))
(lemma move_edge (params (o2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (o3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (fi int) (k int) (h int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (keeps o2 o3 fi k) (edge_of o2 h a b) (!= h fi))
  (ensures (edge_in_set o3 a b))
  (body
    (ghost-let h2 int (if (== h k) fi h))
    (assert (and (<= 0 h2) (< h2 (len o3))))
    (assert (== (idx o3 h2) (idx o2 h)))
    (call edge_intro o3 h2 a b)))
(lemma step_c (params (o2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (o3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (fi int) (k int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (keeps o2 o3 fi k) (and (<= 0 fi) (< fi (len o2)))
            (edges_connected o3 0 a) (edge_in_set o2 a b)
            (edges_connected o3 0 (get (idx o2 fi) 0)) (edges_connected o3 0 (get (idx o2 fi) 1)))
  (ensures (edges_connected o3 0 b))
  (body
    (obtain ((h int)) (and (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len o2)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx o2 h) 0) a) (== (get (idx o2 h) 1) b))
          (and (== (get (idx o2 h) 0) b) (== (get (idx o2 h) 1) a)))))
    (if (== h fi)
      (assert (or (== b (get (idx o2 fi) 0)) (== b (get (idx o2 fi) 1))))
      (block (call move_edge o2 o3 fi k h a b) (call extend o3 0 a b)))))
(lemma walk_fwd (params (o2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (o3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (fi int) (k int) (q (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (keeps o2 o3 fi k) (and (<= 0 fi) (< fi (len o2)))
            (path_follows_edges o2 q) (> (len q) 0) (== (idx q 0) 0)
            (edges_connected o3 0 (get (idx o2 fi) 0)) (edges_connected o3 0 (get (idx o2 fi) 1))
            (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len q))))
  (ensures (edges_connected o3 0 (idx q m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call walk_fwd o2 o3 fi k q (- m 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set o2 (idx q (- m 1)) (idx q m)))
        (call step_c o2 o3 fi k (idx q (- m 1)) (idx q m)))
      (call conn_refl o3 0))))
(lemma all_c (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (o3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (fi int) (k int) (z int))
  (requires (keeps o2 o3 fi k) (and (<= 0 fi) (< fi (len o2))) (is_spanning g o2) (> (len g) 0)
            (edges_connected o3 0 (get (idx o2 fi) 0)) (edges_connected o3 0 (get (idx o2 fi) 1))
            (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len g))))
  (ensures (edges_connected o3 0 z))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected o2 0 z))
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) 0) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) z))) (path_follows_edges o2 q)))
    (call walk_fwd o2 o3 fi k q (- (len q) 1))))
(lemma walk_back
  (params (o2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (o3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq bool)) (fi int) (k int) (p (seq int)) (j int) (m int))
  (requires (keeps o2 o3 fi k) (and (<= 0 fi) (< fi (len o2))) (path_follows_edges o2 p)
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1))) (in_s s (idx p j))
            (forall ((mm int)) (=> (and (< j mm) (< mm (len p))) (not (in_s s (idx p mm)))))
            (edge_of o2 fi (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1)))
            (edges_connected o3 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
            (and (< j m) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures (edges_connected o3 0 (idx p m)))
  (decreases (- (len p) m))
  (body
    (if (< m (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (call walk_back o2 o3 s fi k p j (+ m 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set o2 (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1))))
        (obtain ((h int)) (and (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len o2)))
          (or (and (== (get (idx o2 h) 0) (idx p m)) (== (get (idx o2 h) 1) (idx p (+ m 1))))
              (and (== (get (idx o2 h) 0) (idx p (+ m 1))) (== (get (idx o2 h) 1) (idx p m))))))
        (assert (not (in_s s (idx p m))))
        (assert (not (in_s s (idx p (+ m 1)))))
        (assert (!= h fi))
        (call move_edge o2 o3 fi k h (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1)))
        (call edge_sym o3 (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1)))
        (call extend o3 0 (idx p (+ m 1)) (idx p m)))
      (block))))
(lemma last_in (params (s (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (j0 int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 j0) (< j0 (len p))) (in_s s (idx p j0)) (not (in_s s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures (exists ((j int)) (and (and (and (<= j0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1))) (in_s s (idx p j)))
    (forall ((mm int)) (=> (and (< j mm) (< mm (len p))) (not (in_s s (idx p mm))))))))
  (decreases (- (len p) j0))
  (body
    (if (exists ((mm int)) (and (and (< j0 mm) (< mm (len p))) (in_s s (idx p mm))))
      (block
        (obtain ((m1 int)) (and (and (< j0 m1) (< m1 (len p))) (in_s s (idx p m1))))
        (call last_in s p m1))
      (block
        (assert (< j0 (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (and (and (and (<= j0 j0) (< j0 (- (len p) 1))) (in_s s (idx p j0)))
          (forall ((mm int)) (=> (and (< j0 mm) (< mm (len p))) (not (in_s s (idx p mm)))))))))))
(lemma upd3_facts (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (x (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))))
  (ensures (== (len (upd3 s i x)) (len s))
           (== (idx (upd3 s i x) i) x)
           (forall ((z int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len s))) (!= z i)) (== (idx (upd3 s i x) z) (idx s z)))))
  (body))
(lemma total_upd (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (x (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (upd3 s i x)) (+ (- (total_weight s) (get (idx s i) 2)) (get x 2))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (call upd3_facts s i x)
    (assert (== (total_weight (upd3 s i x)) (+ (get (idx (upd3 s i x) 0) 2) (total_weight (drop (upd3 s i x) 1)))))
    (assert (== (total_weight s) (+ (get (idx s 0) 2) (total_weight (drop s 1)))))
    (if (== i 0)
      (assert (== (drop (upd3 s i x) 1) (drop s 1)))
      (block
        (call upd3_facts (drop s 1) (- i 1) x)
        (assert (== (idx (drop s 1) (- i 1)) (idx s i)))
        (assert (== (drop (upd3 s i x) 1) (upd3 (drop s 1) (- i 1) x)))
        (call total_upd (drop s 1) (- i 1) x)))))
(lemma exch
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (o2 (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (wfg g) (== (len s) (len g)) (in_s s 0) (tree_in s t) (conn_s t s)
            (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)) (!= (in_s s (get e 0)) (in_s s (get e 1)))
            (scanned_rows g s (len g) true (get e 2)) (< (len t) (- (len g) 1))
            (is_spanning_tree g o2) (prefix_of t o2))
  (ensures (exists ((ox (seq (tuple int int int))))
    (and (and (is_spanning_tree g ox) (<= (total_weight ox) (total_weight o2))) (prefix_of (concat t (seq-lit e)) ox))))
  (body
    (assert (and (and (are_valid_edges g o2) (is_spanning g o2)) (== (len o2) (- (len g) 1))))
    (ghost-let k int (len t))
    (ghost-let sa int (if (in_s s (get e 0)) (get e 0) (get e 1)))
    (ghost-let nv int (if (in_s s (get e 0)) (get e 1) (get e 0)))
    (obtain ((ei int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (get e 0)) (< (get e 0) (len g))) (and (<= 0 ei) (< ei (len (idx g (get e 0))))))
      (and (== (get (idx (idx g (get e 0)) ei) 0) (get e 1)) (== (get (idx (idx g (get e 0)) ei) 1) (get e 2)))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get e 1)) (< (get e 1) (len g))))
    (assert (in_s s sa))
    (assert (not (in_s s nv)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 sa) (< sa (len g))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 nv) (< nv (len g))))
    (assert (edges_connected o2 sa nv))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) sa) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) nv))) (path_follows_edges o2 p)))
    (call last_in s p 0)
    (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1))) (in_s s (idx p j)))
      (forall ((mm int)) (=> (and (< j mm) (< mm (len p))) (not (in_s s (idx p mm)))))))
    (assert (not (in_s s (idx p (+ j 1)))))
    (assert (edge_in_set o2 (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))
    (obtain ((fi int)) (and (and (<= 0 fi) (< fi (len o2)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx o2 fi) 0) (idx p j)) (== (get (idx o2 fi) 1) (idx p (+ j 1))))
          (and (== (get (idx o2 fi) 0) (idx p (+ j 1))) (== (get (idx o2 fi) 1) (idx p j))))))
    (assert (edge_of o2 fi (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))
    (assert (=> (< fi k) (== (idx o2 fi) (idx t fi))))
    (assert (>= fi k))
    (ghost-let f (tuple int int int) (idx o2 fi))
    (assert (!= (in_s s (get f 0)) (in_s s (get f 1))))
    (assert (has_edge g (get f 0) (get f 1) (get f 2)))
    (obtain ((fj int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (get f 0)) (< (get f 0) (len g))) (and (<= 0 fj) (< fj (len (idx g (get f 0))))))
      (and (== (get (idx (idx g (get f 0)) fj) 0) (get f 1)) (== (get (idx (idx g (get f 0)) fj) 1) (get f 2)))))
    (assert (<= (get e 2) (get f 2)))
    (ghost-let mid (seq (tuple int int int)) (upd3 o2 fi (idx o2 k)))
    (call upd3_facts o2 fi (idx o2 k))
    (ghost-let o3 (seq (tuple int int int)) (upd3 mid k e))
    (call upd3_facts mid k e)
    (call total_upd o2 fi (idx o2 k))
    (call total_upd mid k e)
    (assert (== (idx mid k) (idx o2 k)))
    (assert (<= (total_weight o3) (total_weight o2)))
    (assert (== (len o3) (len o2)))
    (assert (== (idx o3 k) e))
    (assert (prefix_of t o3))
    (assert (prefix_of (concat t (seq-lit e)) o3))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g o3))
    (assert (keeps o2 o3 fi k))
    (assert (edges_connected t 0 sa))
    (call lift t o3 0 sa)
    (call edge_intro o3 k sa nv)
    (call extend o3 0 sa nv)
    (assert (edges_connected t 0 (idx p j)))
    (call lift t o3 0 (idx p j))
    (call walk_back o2 o3 s fi k p j (+ j 1))
    (assert (edges_connected o3 0 (get f 0)))
    (assert (edges_connected o3 0 (get f 1)))
    (forall ((z int)) (call all_c g o2 o3 fi k z))
    (call span_root g o3)
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g o3))
    (assert (and (and (is_spanning_tree g o3) (<= (total_weight o3) (total_weight o2))) (prefix_of (concat t (seq-lit e)) o3)))))
(lemma keep_good
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (wfg g) (== (len s) (len g)) (in_s s 0) (tree_in s t) (conn_s t s)
            (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)) (!= (in_s s (get e 0)) (in_s s (get e 1)))
            (scanned_rows g s (len g) true (get e 2)) (< (len t) (- (len g) 1))
            (=> (is_spanning_tree g o) (good g t o)))
  (ensures (=> (is_spanning_tree g o) (good g (concat t (seq-lit e)) o)))
  (body
    (if (is_spanning_tree g o)
      (block
        (assert (good g t o))
        (obtain ((o2 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (and (and (is_spanning_tree g o2) (<= (total_weight o2) (total_weight o))) (prefix_of t o2)))
        (call exch g s t e o2)
        (obtain ((o3 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (and (and (is_spanning_tree g o3) (<= (total_weight o3) (total_weight o2))) (prefix_of (concat t (seq-lit e)) o3)))
        (assert (and (and (is_spanning_tree g o3) (<= (total_weight o3) (total_weight o))) (prefix_of (concat t (seq-lit e)) o3))))
      (block))))
(lemma keep_all
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (wfg g) (== (len s) (len g)) (in_s s 0) (tree_in s t) (conn_s t s)
            (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)) (!= (in_s s (get e 0)) (in_s s (get e 1)))
            (scanned_rows g s (len g) true (get e 2)) (< (len t) (- (len g) 1))
            (all_good g t))
  (ensures (all_good g (concat t (seq-lit e))))
  (body (forall ((o (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call keep_good g s t e o))))
(lemma good_init (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len t) 0))
  (ensures (=> (is_spanning_tree g o) (good g t o)))

  (body
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) b) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) c))) (path_follows_edges s q)))
    (call fwd_walk s a q (- (len q) 1))))
(lemma rev_walk (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (b int) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges s p) (> (len p) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures (edges_connected s b (idx p m)))
  (decreases (- (len p) m))
  (body
    (if (< m (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (call rev_walk s b p (+ m 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set s (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1))))
        (call edge_sym s (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1)))
        (call extend s b (idx p (+ m 1)) (idx p m)))
      (call conn_refl s b))))
(lemma conn_sym (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (edges_connected s a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected s b a))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges s p)))
    (call rev_walk s b p 0)))
(lemma conn_pair (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (edges_connected s 0 u) (edges_connected s 0 v))
  (ensures (edges_connected s u v))
  (body (call conn_sym s 0 u) (call conn_trans s u 0 v)))
(lemma span_root (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (forall ((z int)) (=> (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len g))) (edges_connected s 0 z))))
  (ensures (is_spanning g s))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call conn_pair s u v))))
(lemma lift_k (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (prefix_of t o) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))) (edge_in_set t (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set o (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (obtain ((h int)) (and (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len t)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx t h) 0) (idx p k)) (== (get (idx t h) 1) (idx p (+ k 1))))
          (and (== (get (idx t h) 0) (idx p (+ k 1))) (== (get (idx t h) 1) (idx p k))))))
    (assert (== (idx o h) (idx t h)))
    (call edge_intro o h (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
(lemma lift (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (prefix_of t o) (edges_connected t a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected o a b))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges t p)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call lift_k t o p k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges o p))
    (assert (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges o p)))))
(lemma move_edge (params (o2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (o3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (fi int) (k int) (h int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (keeps o2 o3 fi k) (edge_of o2 h a b) (!= h fi))
  (ensures (edge_in_set o3 a b))
  (body
    (ghost-let h2 int (if (== h k) fi h))
    (assert (and (<= 0 h2) (< h2 (len o3))))
    (assert (== (idx o3 h2) (idx o2 h)))
    (call edge_intro o3 h2 a b)))
(lemma step_c (params (o2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (o3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (fi int) (k int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (keeps o2 o3 fi k) (and (<= 0 fi) (< fi (len o2)))
            (edges_connected o3 0 a) (edge_in_set o2 a b)
            (edges_connected o3 0 (get (idx o2 fi) 0)) (edges_connected o3 0 (get (idx o2 fi) 1)))
  (ensures (edges_connected o3 0 b))
  (body
    (obtain ((h int)) (and (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len o2)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx o2 h) 0) a) (== (get (idx o2 h) 1) b))
          (and (== (get (idx o2 h) 0) b) (== (get (idx o2 h) 1) a)))))
    (if (== h fi)
      (assert (or (== b (get (idx o2 fi) 0)) (== b (get (idx o2 fi) 1))))
      (block (call move_edge o2 o3 fi k h a b) (call extend o3 0 a b)))))
(lemma walk_fwd (params (o2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (o3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (fi int) (k int) (q (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (keeps o2 o3 fi k) (and (<= 0 fi) (< fi (len o2)))
            (path_follows_edges o2 q) (> (len q) 0) (== (idx q 0) 0)
            (edges_connected o3 0 (get (idx o2 fi) 0)) (edges_connected o3 0 (get (idx o2 fi) 1))
            (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len q))))
  (ensures (edges_connected o3 0 (idx q m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call walk_fwd o2 o3 fi k q (- m 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set o2 (idx q (- m 1)) (idx q m)))
        (call step_c o2 o3 fi k (idx q (- m 1)) (idx q m)))
      (call conn_refl o3 0))))
(lemma all_c (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (o3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (fi int) (k int) (z int))
  (requires (keeps o2 o3 fi k) (and (<= 0 fi) (< fi (len o2))) (is_spanning g o2) (> (len g) 0)
            (edges_connected o3 0 (get (idx o2 fi) 0)) (edges_connected o3 0 (get (idx o2 fi) 1))
            (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len g))))
  (ensures (edges_connected o3 0 z))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected o2 0 z))
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) 0) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) z))) (path_follows_edges o2 q)))
    (call walk_fwd o2 o3 fi k q (- (len q) 1))))
(lemma walk_back
  (params (o2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (o3 (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq bool)) (fi int) (k int) (p (seq int)) (j int) (m int))
  (requires (keeps o2 o3 fi k) (and (<= 0 fi) (< fi (len o2))) (path_follows_edges o2 p)
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1))) (in_s s (idx p j))
            (forall ((mm int)) (=> (and (< j mm) (< mm (len p))) (not (in_s s (idx p mm)))))
            (edge_of o2 fi (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1)))
            (edges_connected o3 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1)))
            (and (< j m) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures (edges_connected o3 0 (idx p m)))
  (decreases (- (len p) m))
  (body
    (if (< m (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (call walk_back o2 o3 s fi k p j (+ m 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set o2 (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1))))
        (obtain ((h int)) (and (and (<= 0 h) (< h (len o2)))
          (or (and (== (get (idx o2 h) 0) (idx p m)) (== (get (idx o2 h) 1) (idx p (+ m 1))))
              (and (== (get (idx o2 h) 0) (idx p (+ m 1))) (== (get (idx o2 h) 1) (idx p m))))))
        (assert (not (in_s s (idx p m))))
        (assert (not (in_s s (idx p (+ m 1)))))
        (assert (!= h fi))
        (call move_edge o2 o3 fi k h (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1)))
        (call edge_sym o3 (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1)))
        (call extend o3 0 (idx p (+ m 1)) (idx p m)))
      (block))))
(lemma last_in (params (s (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (j0 int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 j0) (< j0 (len p))) (in_s s (idx p j0)) (not (in_s s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures (exists ((j int)) (and (and (and (<= j0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1))) (in_s s (idx p j)))
    (forall ((mm int)) (=> (and (< j mm) (< mm (len p))) (not (in_s s (idx p mm))))))))
  (decreases (- (len p) j0))
  (body
    (if (exists ((mm int)) (and (and (< j0 mm) (< mm (len p))) (in_s s (idx p mm))))
      (block
        (obtain ((m1 int)) (and (and (< j0 m1) (< m1 (len p))) (in_s s (idx p m1))))
        (call last_in s p m1))
      (block
        (assert (< j0 (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (and (and (and (<= j0 j0) (< j0 (- (len p) 1))) (in_s s (idx p j0)))
          (forall ((mm int)) (=> (and (< j0 mm) (< mm (len p))) (not (in_s s (idx p mm)))))))))))
(lemma upd3_facts (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (x (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))))
  (ensures (== (len (upd3 s i x)) (len s))
           (== (idx (upd3 s i x) i) x)
           (forall ((z int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len s))) (!= z i)) (== (idx (upd3 s i x) z) (idx s z)))))
  (body))
(lemma total_upd (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (x (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (upd3 s i x)) (+ (- (total_weight s) (get (idx s i) 2)) (get x 2))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (call upd3_facts s i x)
    (assert (== (total_weight (upd3 s i x)) (+ (get (idx (upd3 s i x) 0) 2) (total_weight (drop (upd3 s i x) 1)))))
    (assert (== (total_weight s) (+ (get (idx s 0) 2) (total_weight (drop s 1)))))
    (if (== i 0)
      (assert (== (drop (upd3 s i x) 1) (drop s 1)))
      (block
        (call upd3_facts (drop s 1) (- i 1) x)
        (assert (== (idx (drop s 1) (- i 1)) (idx s i)))
        (assert (== (drop (upd3 s i x) 1) (upd3 (drop s 1) (- i 1) x)))
        (call total_upd (drop s 1) (- i 1) x)))))
(lemma exch
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (o2 (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (wfg g) (== (len s) (len g)) (in_s s 0) (tree_in s t) (conn_s t s)
            (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)) (!= (in_s s (get e 0)) (in_s s (get e 1)))
            (scanned_rows g s (len g) true (get e 2)) (< (len t) (- (len g) 1))
            (is_spanning_tree g o2) (prefix_of t o2))
  (ensures (exists ((ox (seq (tuple int int int))))
    (and (and (is_spanning_tree g ox) (<= (total_weight ox) (total_weight o2))) (prefix_of (concat t (seq-lit e)) ox))))
  (body
    (assert (and (and (are_valid_edges g o2) (is_spanning g o2)) (== (len o2) (- (len g) 1))))
    (ghost-let k int (len t))
    (ghost-let sa int (if (in_s s (get e 0)) (get e 0) (get e 1)))
    (ghost-let nv int (if (in_s s (get e 0)) (get e 1) (get e 0)))
    (obtain ((ei int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (get e 0)) (< (get e 0) (len g))) (and (<= 0 ei) (< ei (len (idx g (get e 0))))))
      (and (== (get (idx (idx g (get e 0)) ei) 0) (get e 1)) (== (get (idx (idx g (get e 0)) ei) 1) (get e 2)))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get e 1)) (< (get e 1) (len g))))
    (assert (in_s s sa))
    (assert (not (in_s s nv)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 sa) (< sa (len g))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 nv) (< nv (len g))))
    (assert (edges_connected o2 sa nv))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) sa) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) nv))) (path_follows_edges o2 p)))
    (call last_in s p 0)
    (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1))) (in_s s (idx p j)))
      (forall ((mm int)) (=> (and (< j mm) (< mm (len p))) (not (in_s s (idx p mm)))))))
    (assert (not (in_s s (idx p (+ j 1)))))
    (assert (edge_in_set o2 (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))
    (obtain ((fi int)) (and (and (<= 0 fi) (< fi (len o2)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx o2 fi) 0) (idx p j)) (== (get (idx o2 fi) 1) (idx p (+ j 1))))
          (and (== (get (idx o2 fi) 0) (idx p (+ j 1))) (== (get (idx o2 fi) 1) (idx p j))))))
    (assert (edge_of o2 fi (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))
    (assert (=> (< fi k) (== (idx o2 fi) (idx t fi))))
    (assert (>= fi k))
    (ghost-let f (tuple int int int) (idx o2 fi))
    (assert (!= (in_s s (get f 0)) (in_s s (get f 1))))
    (assert (has_edge g (get f 0) (get f 1) (get f 2)))
    (obtain ((fj int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (get f 0)) (< (get f 0) (len g))) (and (<= 0 fj) (< fj (len (idx g (get f 0))))))
      (and (== (get (idx (idx g (get f 0)) fj) 0) (get f 1)) (== (get (idx (idx g (get f 0)) fj) 1) (get f 2)))))
    (assert (<= (get e 2) (get f 2)))
    (ghost-let mid (seq (tuple int int int)) (upd3 o2 fi (idx o2 k)))
    (call upd3_facts o2 fi (idx o2 k))
    (ghost-let o3 (seq (tuple int int int)) (upd3 mid k e))
    (call upd3_facts mid k e)
    (call total_upd o2 fi (idx o2 k))
    (call total_upd mid k e)
    (assert (== (idx mid k) (idx o2 k)))
    (assert (<= (total_weight o3) (total_weight o2)))
    (assert (== (len o3) (len o2)))
    (assert (== (idx o3 k) e))
    (assert (prefix_of t o3))
    (assert (prefix_of (concat t (seq-lit e)) o3))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g o3))
    (assert (keeps o2 o3 fi k))
    (assert (edges_connected t 0 sa))
    (call lift t o3 0 sa)
    (call edge_intro o3 k sa nv)
    (call extend o3 0 sa nv)
    (assert (edges_connected t 0 (idx p j)))
    (call lift t o3 0 (idx p j))
    (call walk_back o2 o3 s fi k p j (+ j 1))
    (assert (edges_connected o3 0 (get f 0)))
    (assert (edges_connected o3 0 (get f 1)))
    (forall ((z int)) (call all_c g o2 o3 fi k z))
    (call span_root g o3)
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g o3))
    (assert (and (and (is_spanning_tree g o3) (<= (total_weight o3) (total_weight o2))) (prefix_of (concat t (seq-lit e)) o3)))))
(lemma keep_good
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (wfg g) (== (len s) (len g)) (in_s s 0) (tree_in s t) (conn_s t s)
            (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)) (!= (in_s s (get e 0)) (in_s s (get e 1)))
            (scanned_rows g s (len g) true (get e 2)) (< (len t) (- (len g) 1))
            (=> (is_spanning_tree g o) (good g t o)))
  (ensures (=> (is_spanning_tree g o) (good g (concat t (seq-lit e)) o)))
  (body
    (if (is_spanning_tree g o)
      (block
        (assert (good g t o))
        (obtain ((o2 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (and (and (is_spanning_tree g o2) (<= (total_weight o2) (total_weight o))) (prefix_of t o2)))
        (call exch g s t e o2)
        (obtain ((o3 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (and (and (is_spanning_tree g o3) (<= (total_weight o3) (total_weight o2))) (prefix_of (concat t (seq-lit e)) o3)))
        (assert (and (and (is_spanning_tree g o3) (<= (total_weight o3) (total_weight o))) (prefix_of (concat t (seq-lit e)) o3))))
      (block))))
(lemma keep_all
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (wfg g) (== (len s) (len g)) (in_s s 0) (tree_in s t) (conn_s t s)
            (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)) (!= (in_s s (get e 0)) (in_s s (get e 1)))
            (scanned_rows g s (len g) true (get e 2)) (< (len t) (- (len g) 1))
            (all_good g t))
  (ensures (all_good g (concat t (seq-lit e))))
  (body (forall ((o (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call keep_good g s t e o))))
(lemma good_init (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len t) 0))
  (ensures (=> (is_spanning_tree g o) (good g t o)))
  (body
    (if (is_spanning_tree g o)
      (block
        (assert (prefix_of t o))
        (assert (and (and (is_spanning_tree g o) (<= (total_weight o) (total_weight o))) (prefix_of t o))))
      (block))))
(lemma final_min (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (all_good g t) (== (len t) (- (len g) 1)))
  (ensures (=> (is_spanning_tree g o) (<= (total_weight t) (total_weight o))))
  (body
    (if (is_spanning_tree g o)
      (block
        (assert (good g t o))
        (obtain ((o2 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (and (and (is_spanning_tree g o2) (<= (total_weight o2) (total_weight o))) (prefix_of t o2)))
        (assert (== (len o2) (len t)))
        (assert (== o2 t)))
      (block))))
(lemma cnt_bounds (params (s (seq bool)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (cnt s)) (<= (cnt s) (len s))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (call cnt_bounds (drop s 1))
        (assert (== (cnt s) (+ (if (idx s 0) 1 0) (cnt (drop s 1))))))
      (assert (== (cnt s) 0)))))
(lemma cnt_zero (params (s (seq bool)))
  (requires (forall ((z int)) (=> (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len s))) (not (idx s z)))))
  (ensures (== (cnt s) 0))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (assert (not (idx s 0)))
        (call cnt_zero (drop s 1))
        (assert (== (cnt s) (+ (if (idx s 0) 1 0) (cnt (drop s 1))))))
      (assert (== (cnt s) 0)))))
(lemma cnt_all (params (s (seq bool)))
  (requires (forall ((z int)) (=> (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len s))) (idx s z))))
  (ensures (== (cnt s) (len s)))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (> (len s) 0)
      (block
        (assert (idx s 0))
        (call cnt_all (drop s 1))
        (assert (== (cnt s) (+ (if (idx s 0) 1 0) (cnt (drop s 1))))))
      (assert (== (cnt s) 0)))))
(lemma has_false (params (s (seq bool)))
  (requires (< (cnt s) (len s)))
  (ensures (exists ((z int)) (and (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len s))) (not (idx s z)))))
  (body
    (if (forall ((z int)) (=> (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len s))) (idx s z)))
      (call cnt_all s)
      (block))))
(lemma cnt_full (params (s (seq bool)) (z int))
  (requires (== (cnt s) (len s)) (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len s))))
  (ensures (idx s z))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (call cnt_bounds (drop s 1))
    (assert (== (cnt s) (+ (if (idx s 0) 1 0) (cnt (drop s 1)))))
    (assert (idx s 0))
    (if (> z 0)
      (block
        (call cnt_full (drop s 1) (- z 1))
        (assert (== (idx (drop s 1) (- z 1)) (idx s z))))
      (block))))
(lemma cnt_upd (params (s0 (seq bool)) (s1 (seq bool)) (i int))
  (requires (agree s0 s1 i) (not (idx s0 i)))
  (ensures (== (cnt s1) (+ (cnt s0) 1)))
  (decreases (len s0))
  (body
    (assert (== (cnt s0) (+ (if (idx s0 0) 1 0) (cnt (drop s0 1)))))
    (assert (== (cnt s1) (+ (if (idx s1 0) 1 0) (cnt (drop s1 1)))))
    (if (== i 0)
      (assert (== (drop s1 1) (drop s0 1)))
      (block
        (assert (agree (drop s0 1) (drop s1 1) (- i 1)))
        (call cnt_upd (drop s0 1) (drop s1 1) (- i 1))))))
(lemma mono (params (s0 (seq bool)) (s1 (seq bool)) (nv int) (y int))
  (requires (agree s0 s1 nv) (in_s s0 y))
  (ensures (in_s s1 y))
  (body))
(lemma tree_step (params (s0 (seq bool)) (s1 (seq bool)) (t0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (nv int))
  (requires (tree_in s0 t0) (prefix_of t0 t1) (== (len t1) (+ (len t0) 1)) (agree s0 s1 nv)
            (in_s s1 (get (idx t1 (len t0)) 0)) (in_s s1 (get (idx t1 (len t0)) 1)))
  (ensures (tree_in s1 t1))
  (body (forall ((y int)) (call mono s0 s1 nv y))))
(lemma valid_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g t0) (prefix_of t0 t1) (== (len t1) (+ (len t0) 1)) (== (idx t1 (len t0)) e)
            (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g t1))
  (body))
(lemma prefix_push (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (== (len (concat t (seq-lit e))) (+ (len t) 1))
           (== (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) (len t)) e)
           (prefix_of t (concat t (seq-lit e))))
  (body))
(lemma conn_step
  (params (s0 (seq bool)) (s1 (seq bool)) (t0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (sa int) (nv int) (x int))
  (requires (conn_s t0 s0) (prefix_of t0 t1) (edge_of t1 (len t0) sa nv) (in_s s0 sa) (agree s0 s1 nv) (in_s s1 x))
  (ensures (edges_connected t1 0 x))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected t0 0 sa))
    (call lift t0 t1 0 sa)
    (if (== x nv)
      (block (call edge_intro t1 (len t0) sa nv) (call extend t1 0 sa nv))
      (block (assert (in_s s0 x)) (assert (edges_connected t0 0 x)) (call lift t0 t1 0 x)))))
(lemma walk_cross (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (path_follows_graph g p) (> (len p) 0) (in_s s (idx p 0)) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures (or (has_cross g s) (in_s s (idx p m))))
  (decreases m)

        (assert (not (in_s s (idx p (+ m 1)))))

        (call move_edge o2 o3 fi k h (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1)))

(lemma last_in (params (s (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (j0 int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 j0) (< j0 (len p))) (in_s s (idx p j0)) (not (in_s s (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures (exists ((j int)) (and (and (and (<= j0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1))) (in_s s (idx p j)))
    (forall ((mm int)) (=> (and (< j mm) (< mm (len p))) (not (in_s s (idx p mm))))))))
  (decreases (- (len p) j0))

    (if (exists ((mm int)) (and (and (< j0 mm) (< mm (len p))) (in_s s (idx p mm))))
      (block
        (obtain ((m1 int)) (and (and (< j0 m1) (< m1 (len p))) (in_s s (idx p m1))))
        (call last_in s p m1))
      (block
        (assert (< j0 (- (len p) 1)))
        (assert (and (and (and (<= j0 j0) (< j0 (- (len p) 1))) (in_s s (idx p j0)))
          (forall ((mm int)) (=> (and (< j0 mm) (< mm (len p))) (not (in_s s (idx p mm)))))))))))
(lemma upd3_facts (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (x (tuple int int int)))

           (== (idx (upd3 s i x) i) x)

(lemma total_upd (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int) (x (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))))

  (decreases (len s))

    (assert (== (total_weight s) (+ (get (idx s 0) 2) (total_weight (drop s 1)))))

        (call upd3_facts (drop s 1) (- i 1) x)
        (assert (== (idx (drop s 1) (- i 1)) (idx s i)))

(lemma prefix_ext_pt (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (m int))
  (requires (prefix_of t o) (< (len t) (len o)) (== (idx o (len t)) e) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len t))))

(lemma prefix_ext (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (prefix_of t o) (< (len t) (len o)) (== (idx o (len t)) e))

(lemma exch
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (o2 (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (wfg g) (== (len s) (len g)) (in_s s 0) (tree_in s t) (conn_s t s)
            (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)) (!= (in_s s (get e 0)) (in_s s (get e 1)))
            (scanned_rows g s (len g) true (get e 2)) (< (len t) (- (len g) 1))
            (is_spanning_tree g o2) (prefix_of t o2))

    (and (and (is_spanning_tree g ox) (<= (total_weight ox) (total_weight o2))) (prefix_of (concat t (seq-lit e)) ox))))

    (assert (and (and (are_valid_edges g o2) (is_spanning g o2)) (== (len o2) (- (len g) 1))))
    (ghost-let k int (len t))
    (ghost-let sa int (if (in_s s (get e 0)) (get e 0) (get e 1)))
    (ghost-let nv int (if (in_s s (get e 0)) (get e 1) (get e 0)))

      (and (== (get (idx (idx g (get e 0)) ei) 0) (get e 1)) (== (get (idx (idx g (get e 0)) ei) 1) (get e 2)))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get e 1)) (< (get e 1) (len g))))
    (assert (in_s s sa))
    (assert (not (in_s s nv)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 sa) (< sa (len g))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 nv) (< nv (len g))))
    (assert (edges_connected o2 sa nv))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) sa) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) nv))) (path_follows_edges o2 p)))
    (call last_in s p 0)
    (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1))) (in_s s (idx p j)))
      (forall ((mm int)) (=> (and (< j mm) (< mm (len p))) (not (in_s s (idx p mm)))))))
    (assert (not (in_s s (idx p (+ j 1)))))
    (assert (edge_in_set o2 (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))
    (obtain ((fi int)) (and (and (<= 0 fi) (< fi (len o2)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx o2 fi) 0) (idx p j)) (== (get (idx o2 fi) 1) (idx p (+ j 1))))
          (and (== (get (idx o2 fi) 0) (idx p (+ j 1))) (== (get (idx o2 fi) 1) (idx p j))))))
    (assert (edge_of o2 fi (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))
    (assert (=> (< fi k) (== (idx o2 fi) (idx t fi))))
    (assert (>= fi k))
    (ghost-let f (tuple int int int) (idx o2 fi))
    (assert (!= (in_s s (get f 0)) (in_s s (get f 1))))
    (assert (has_edge g (get f 0) (get f 1) (get f 2)))
    (obtain ((fj int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (get f 0)) (< (get f 0) (len g))) (and (<= 0 fj) (< fj (len (idx g (get f 0))))))
      (and (== (get (idx (idx g (get f 0)) fj) 0) (get f 1)) (== (get (idx (idx g (get f 0)) fj) 1) (get f 2)))))
    (assert (<= (get e 2) (get f 2)))
    (ghost-let mid (seq (tuple int int int)) (upd3 o2 fi (idx o2 k)))
    (call upd3_facts o2 fi (idx o2 k))
    (ghost-let o3 (seq (tuple int int int)) (upd3 mid k e))
    (call upd3_facts mid k e)
    (call total_upd o2 fi (idx o2 k))
    (call total_upd mid k e)
    (assert (== (idx mid k) (idx o2 k)))
    (assert (<= (total_weight o3) (total_weight o2)))
    (assert (== (len o3) (len o2)))
    (assert (== (idx o3 k) e))
    (assert (prefix_of t o3))
    (call prefix_ext t e o3)
    (assert (are_valid_edges g o3))
    (assert (keeps o2 o3 fi k))
    (assert (edges_connected t 0 sa))
    (call lift t o3 0 sa)
    (call edge_intro o3 k sa nv)
    (call extend o3 0 sa nv)
    (assert (edges_connected t 0 (idx p j)))
    (call lift t o3 0 (idx p j))
    (call walk_back o2 o3 s fi k p j (+ j 1))
    (assert (edges_connected o3 0 (get f 0)))
    (assert (edges_connected o3 0 (get f 1)))
    (forall ((z int)) (call all_c g o2 o3 fi k z))
    (call span_root g o3)
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g o3))
    (assert (and (and (is_spanning_tree g o3) (<= (total_weight o3) (total_weight o2))) (prefix_of (concat t (seq-lit e)) o3)))))
(lemma keep_good
  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (wfg g) (== (len s) (len g)) (in_s s 0) (tree_in s t) (conn_s t s)
            (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)) (!= (in_s s (get e 0)) (in_s s (get e 1)))
            (scanned_rows g s (len g) true (get e 2)) (< (len t) (- (len g) 1))
            (=> (is_spanning_tree g o) (good g t o)))
  (ensures (=> (is_spanning_tree g o) (good g (concat t (seq-lit e)) o)))
  (body
    (if (is_spanning_tree g o)
      (block
        (assert (good g t o))
        (obtain ((o2 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (and (and (is_spanning_tree g o2) (<= (total_weight o2) (total_weight o))) (prefix_of t o2)))
        (call exch g s t e o2)
        (obtain ((o3 (seq (tuple int int int)))) (and (and (is_spanning_tree g o3) (<= (total_weight o3) (total_weight o2))) (prefix_of (concat t (seq-lit e)) o3)))
        (assert (and (and (is_spanning_tree g o3) (<= (total_weight o3) (total_weight o))) (prefix_of (concat t (seq-lit e)) o3))))
      (block))))

  (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))

            (scanned_rows g s (len g) true (get e 2)) (< (len t) (- (len g) 1))

(lemma has_false (params (s (seq bool)))

           (prefix_of t (concat t (seq-lit e))))
  (body))
(lemma conn_step
  (params (s0 (seq bool)) (s1 (seq bool)) (t0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (t1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (sa int) (nv int) (x int))
  (requires (conn_s t0 s0) (prefix_of t0 t1) (edge_of t1 (len t0) sa nv) (in_s s0 sa) (agree s0 s1 nv) (in_s s1 x))
  (ensures (edges_connected t1 0 x))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected t0 0 sa))
    (call lift t0 t1 0 sa)
    (if (== x nv)
      (block (call edge_intro t1 (len t0) sa nv) (call extend t1 0 sa nv))
      (block (assert (in_s s0 x)) (assert (edges_connected t0 0 x)) (call lift t0 t1 0 x)))))
(lemma walk_cross (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (path_follows_graph g p) (> (len p) 0) (in_s s (idx p 0)) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures (or (has_cross g s) (in_s s (idx p m))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call walk_cross g s p (- m 1))
        (assert (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (idx p (- m 1))) (< (idx p (- m 1)) (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g (idx p (- m 1)))))))
          (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- m 1))) i) 0) (idx p m))))
        (if (and (in_s s (idx p (- m 1))) (not (in_s s (idx p m))))
          (block
            (assert (and (and (and (<= 0 (idx p (- m 1))) (< (idx p (- m 1)) (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g (idx p (- m 1)))))))
              (!= (in_s s (idx p (- m 1))) (in_s s (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- m 1))) i) 0)))))
            (assert (has_cross g s)))
          (block)))
      (block))))
(lemma cross_exists (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (z int))
  (requires (graph_is_connected g) (> (len g) 0) (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len g))) (in_s s 0) (not (in_s s z)))
  (ensures (has_cross g s))
  (body

    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) z))) (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (call walk_cross g s p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma must_find (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (found bool) (bw int))
  (requires (graph_is_connected g) (> (len g) 0) (== (len s) (len g)) (in_s s 0) (< (cnt s) (len s))
            (scanned_rows g s (len g) found bw))
  (ensures found)
  (body
    (call has_false s)
    (obtain ((z int)) (and (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len s))) (not (idx s z))))
    (call cross_exists g s z)
    (obtain ((cu int) (ci int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 cu) (< cu (len g))) (and (<= 0 ci) (< ci (len (idx g cu)))))
      (!= (in_s s cu) (in_s s (get (idx (idx g cu) ci) 0)))))
    (assert (and found (<= bw (get (idx (idx g cu) ci) 1))))))
(lemma best_edge (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (s (seq bool)) (bu int) (bv int) (bw int) (bi int))
  (requires (wfg g) (best_ok g s bu bv bw bi))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 bu) (< bu (len g))) (and (<= 0 bv) (< bv (len g)))
           (has_edge g bu bv bw) (!= (in_s s bu) (in_s s bv)))
  (body
    (assert (and (and (and (<= 0 bu) (< bu (len g))) (and (<= 0 bi) (< bi (len (idx g bu)))))
      (and (== (get (idx (idx g bu) bi) 0) bv) (== (get (idx (idx g bu) bi) 1) bw))))))

(def prim_mst
  (body
    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (assert (== g (field graph adj)))
    (call wf_view graph)
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (assert (> n 0))
    (let-mut in_tree (vec bool) (seq-build n (fn (j) false)))
    (ghost-let s_init (seq bool) in_tree)
    (call cnt_zero s_init)
    (set-idx in_tree 0 true)
    (assert (agree s_init in_tree 0))
    (call cnt_upd s_init in_tree 0)
    (let-mut edges (vec (tuple i64 i64 i64)) (vec-new))
    (call conn_refl edges 0)
    (assert (conn_s edges in_tree))
    (forall ((o (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call good_init g edges o))
    (let-mut count i64 1)
    (assert (state_ok g in_tree edges count))
    (while (< count n)
      (invariant (and (<= 1 count) (<= count n)))
      (invariant (== n (len g)))
      (invariant (== g (field graph adj)))
      (invariant (wfg g))
      (invariant (graph_is_connected g))
      (invariant (state_ok g in_tree edges count))
      (decreases (- n count))
      (let-mut found bool false)
      (let-mut bu i64 0)
      (let-mut bv i64 0)
      (let-mut bw i64 0)
      (ghost-let-mut bi int 0)
      (let-mut u i64 0)
      (while (< u n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
        (invariant (and (<= 1 count) (< count n)))
        (invariant (== n (len g)))
        (invariant (== g (field graph adj)))
        (invariant (wfg g))
        (invariant (graph_is_connected g))
        (invariant (state_ok g in_tree edges count))
        (invariant (=> found (best_ok g in_tree bu bv bw bi)))
        (invariant (scanned_rows g in_tree u found bw))
        (decreases (- n u))
        (let deg i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) u)))
        (let-mut i i64 0)
        (while (< i deg)
          (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i deg)))
          (invariant (== n (len g)))
          (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
          (invariant (== g (field graph adj)))
          (invariant (== deg (len (idx g u))))
          (invariant (and (<= 1 count) (< count n)))
          (invariant (wfg g))
          (invariant (graph_is_connected g))
          (invariant (state_ok g in_tree edges count))
          (invariant (=> found (best_ok g in_tree bu bv bw bi)))
          (invariant (scanned_rows g in_tree u found bw))
          (invariant (scanned_part g in_tree u i found bw))
          (decreases (- deg i))
          (let t (tuple i64 i64) (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i))
          (let v i64 (get t 0))
          (let w i64 (get t 1))
          (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
          (if (!= (idx in_tree u) (idx in_tree v))
            (if (or (not found) (< w bw))
              (block (set found true) (set bu u) (set bv v) (set bw w) (ghost-set bi i))
              (block))
            (block))
          (set i (+ i 1)))
        (set u (+ u 1)))
      (call must_find g in_tree found bw)
      (call best_edge g in_tree bu bv bw bi)
      (ghost-let s0 (seq bool) in_tree)
      (ghost-let t0 (seq (tuple int int int)) edges)
      (ghost-let e (tuple int int int) (tuple bu bv bw))
      (call keep_all g s0 t0 e)
      (ghost-let sa int (if (idx in_tree bu) bu bv))

      (not (crossing seen u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
      (and
        found
        (>= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) best_w))))
  (ensures
    (scan_ok g seen u (+ i 1) found best_u best_v best_w))
  (body))

(lemma scan_next_row
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (seen (seq bool))
    (u int)
    (found bool)
    (best_u int)
    (best_v int)
    (best_w int))
  (requires

  (ensures
    (scan_ok
      g seen (+ u 1) 0
      found best_u best_v best_w))
  (body))

(lemma path_vertex_range
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (well_formed (weighted_graph (seq-build (len g) (fn (z) (seq-build (len (idx g z)) (fn (q) (tuple (get (idx (idx g z) q) 0) (get (idx (idx g z) q) 1))))))))
    (path_follows_graph g p)
    (> (len p) 0)
    (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p))))
  (ensures
    (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len g))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call path_vertex_range g p (- k 1))
        (assert
          (graph_has_any_edge
            g
            (idx p (- k 1))
            (idx p k)))
        (obtain ((j int))
          (and
            (and
              (and
                (<= 0 (idx p (- k 1)))
                (< (idx p (- k 1)) (len g)))
              (and
                (<= 0 j)
                (< j (len (idx g (idx p (- k 1)))))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- k 1))) j) 0)
                (idx p k)))))
      (block))))

(lemma path_has_change
  (params
    (seen (seq bool))
    (p (seq int)))
  (requires
    (> (len p) 0)
    (forall ((j int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len p)))
        (and
          (<= 0 (idx p j))
          (< (idx p j) (len seen)))))
    (idx seen (idx p 0))
    (not (idx seen (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((k int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1)))
        (!=
          (idx seen (idx p k))
          (idx seen (idx p (+ k 1)))))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (> (len p) 1)
      (if
        (!=
          (idx seen (idx p 0))
          (idx seen (idx p 1)))
        (assert
          (exists ((k int))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1)))
              (!=
                (idx seen (idx p k))
                (idx seen (idx p (+ k 1)))))))
        (block
          (assert (> (len (drop p 1)) 0))
          (assert
            (idx seen (idx (drop p 1) 0)))
          (assert
            (not
              (idx seen
                (idx (drop p 1)
                  (- (len (drop p 1)) 1)))))
          (call path_has_change seen (drop p 1))
          (obtain ((j int))
            (and
              (and
                (<= 0 j)
                (< j (- (len (drop p 1)) 1)))
              (!=
                (idx seen (idx (drop p 1) j))
                (idx seen (idx (drop p 1) (+ j 1))))))
          (assert
            (exists ((k int))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1)))
                (!=
                  (idx seen (idx p k))
                  (idx seen (idx p (+ k 1)))))))))
      (assert false))))

(lemma connected_cut_found
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (seen (seq bool))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (found bool)
    (best_u int)
    (best_v int)
    (best_w int))
  (requires
    (graph_is_connected g)
    (prim_partial g seen edges)
    (not (all_visited seen))
    (scan_ok g seen (len g) 0 found best_u best_v best_w))
  (ensures found)
  (body
    (assert
      (exists ((v int))
        (and
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len seen)))
          (not (idx seen v)))))
    (obtain ((v int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len seen)))
        (not (idx seen v))))
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 v))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (> (len p) 0)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) 0)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
        (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (assert
      (forall ((j int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len p)))
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p j))
            (< (idx p j) (len seen))))))
    (call path_has_change seen p)
    (obtain ((k int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1)))
        (!=
          (idx seen (idx p k))
          (idx seen (idx p (+ k 1))))))
    (assert
      (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
    (obtain ((j int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len g)))
          (and
            (<= 0 j)
            (< j (len (idx g (idx p k))))))
        (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p k)) j) 0)
            (idx p (+ k 1)))))
    (assert
      (processed g (len g) 0 (idx p k) j))
    (assert
      (crossing
        seen
        (idx p k)
        (get (idx (idx g (idx p k)) j) 0)))
    (assert found)))

(lemma scan_gives_minimum
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

(lemma empty_completion
  (params

(lemma prim_begin
  (params

(lemma bool_update_tail
  (params
    (before (seq bool))
    (after (seq bool))

    (value bool))
  (requires
    (bool_update before after at value)

      (drop after 1)
      (- at 1)
      value))
  (body))

(lemma bool_equal_tail
  (params
    (before (seq bool))
    (after (seq bool))
    (at int)
    (value bool))
  (requires
    (bool_update before after at value)
    (== at 0))
  (ensures
    (== (drop before 1) (drop after 1)))
  (body
    (assert
      (==
        (len (drop before 1))
        (len (drop after 1))))
    (assert
      (forall ((k int))
        (=>
          (and
            (<= 0 k)
            (< k (len (drop before 1))))
          (==
            (idx (drop before 1) k)
            (idx (drop after 1) k)))))
    (assert
      (== (drop before 1) (drop after 1)))))

(lemma count_update_true
  (params
    (before (seq bool))
    (after (seq bool))
    (at int))
  (requires
    (bool_update before after at true)
    (not (idx before at)))
  (ensures
    (== (visited_count after)
        (+ (visited_count before) 1)))
  (decreases (len before))
  (body
    (if (== at 0)
      (block
        (call bool_equal_tail before after at true)
        (assert
          (==
            (visited_count before)
            (+ 0 (visited_count (drop before 1)))))
        (assert
          (==
            (visited_count after)
            (+ 1 (visited_count (drop after 1))))))
      (block
        (assert (> at 0))
        (assert (== (idx before 0) (idx after 0)))
        (call bool_update_tail before after at true)
        (call count_update_true
          (drop before 1)
          (drop after 1)
          (- at 1))
        (assert
          (==
            (visited_count before)
            (+
              (if (idx before 0) 1 0)
              (visited_count (drop before 1)))))
        (assert
          (==
            (visited_count after)
            (+
              (if (idx after 0) 1 0)
              (visited_count (drop after 1)))))))))

(lemma count_implies_all
  (params (seen (seq bool)))

    (== (visited_count seen) (len seen)))

  (body
    (if (> (len seen) 0)
      (block
        (assert
          (==
            (visited_count seen)
            (+
              (if (idx seen 0) 1 0)
              (visited_count (drop seen 1)))))
        (assert
          (<=
            (visited_count (drop seen 1))
            (len (drop seen 1))))
        (assert (idx seen 0))
        (assert
          (==
            (visited_count (drop seen 1))
            (len (drop seen 1))))
        (call count_implies_all (drop seen 1))
        (assert
          (forall ((i int))
            (=>
              (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len seen)))
              (idx seen i)))))
      (block))))

(lemma edges_connected_symmetric
  (params
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (u int)
    (v int))
  (requires (edges_connected edges u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected edges v u))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (> (len p) 0)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) u)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
        (path_follows_edges edges p)))
    (ghost-let q (seq int)
      (seq-build
        (len p)
        (fn (i) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) i)))))
    (assert (> (len q) 0))
    (assert (== (idx q 0) v))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) u))
    (assert (path_follows_edges edges q))
    (assert
      (exists ((r (seq int)))
        (and
          (and
            (> (len r) 0)
            (and
              (== (idx r 0) v)
              (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) u)))
          (path_follows_edges edges r))))))

(lemma edges_connected_transitive
  (params
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (edges_connected edges u v)
    (edges_connected edges v w))
  (ensures (edges_connected edges u w))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (> (len p) 0)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) u)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v)))
        (path_follows_edges edges p)))
    (obtain ((q (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (> (len q) 0)
          (and
            (== (idx q 0) v)
            (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) w)))
        (path_follows_edges edges q)))
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (concat p (drop q 1)))
    (assert (> (len r) 0))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) u))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) w))
    (assert (path_follows_edges edges r))
    (assert
      (exists ((s (seq int)))
        (and
          (and
            (> (len s) 0)
            (and
              (== (idx s 0) u)
              (== (idx s (- (len s) 1)) w)))
          (path_follows_edges edges s))))))

(lemma reached_update_at
  (params
    (seen0 (seq bool))
    (edges0 (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (seen (seq bool))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (new_vertex int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (reached_seen seen0 edges0)
    (selected_endpoints_seen seen0 edges0)
    (crossing seen0 u v)
    (== new_vertex (if (idx seen0 u) v u))
    (bool_update seen0 seen new_vertex true)
    (== edges
      (concat edges0 (seq-lit (tuple u v w))))
    (and
      (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len seen)))
      (idx seen x)))
  (ensures (edges_connected edges 0 x))
  (body
    (if (== x new_vertex)
      (if (idx seen0 u)
        (block
          (assert (edges_connected edges0 0 u))
          (assert (edge_in_set edges u v))
          (assert (edges_connected edges u v))
          (assert (edges_connected edges 0 u))
          (call edges_connected_transitive edges 0 u v))
        (block
          (assert (edges_connected edges0 0 v))
          (assert (edge_in_set edges v u))
          (assert (edges_connected edges v u))
          (assert (edges_connected edges 0 v))
          (call edges_connected_transitive edges 0 v u)))
      (block
        (assert (idx seen0 x))
        (assert (edges_connected edges0 0 x))
        (assert (edges_connected edges 0 x))))))

  (params

(lemma prim_complete
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
