  (body (=> (is_spanning_tree g o) (better g t o))))
(ghost-fn optimal ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((o (seq (tuple int int int)))) (keeps g t o))))
(ghost-fn rev ((p (seq int))) (seq int)
  (body (seq-build (len p) (fn (ri) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) ri))))))
(ghost-fn exch_seq ((q (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (lt int) (fi int)) (seq (tuple int int int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 lt) (<= lt fi)) (< fi (len q))))
  (body (seq-build (len q) (fn (k1) (if (== k1 lt) e (if (== k1 fi) (idx q lt) (idx q k1)))))))

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))
(lemma zero_at (params (s (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))) (>= (occurrences (take s k) 0) 1))
  (ensures (exists ((j int)) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (== (idx s j) 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call law_take_step s (- k 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat (take s (- k 1)) (seq-lit (idx s (- k 1))) 0)
        (call law_occurrences_unit (idx s (- k 1)) 0)
        (if (== (idx s (- k 1)) 0)
          (assert (and (and (<= 0 (- k 1)) (< (- k 1) k)) (== (idx s (- k 1)) 0)))
          (call zero_at s (- k 1))))
      (call law_occurrences_none s 0))))
(lemma all_in (params (mark (seq int)) (v int))
  (requires (binary mark) (== (occurrences mark 0) 0) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len mark))))
  (ensures (ins mark v))
  (body
    (call count_member mark v (len mark))
    (assert (== (take mark (len mark)) mark))))
(lemma path_in (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (mark (seq int)) (bw int) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (scan_ok g mark false bw (len g) 0) (path_follows_graph g p) (> (len p) 0) (ins mark (idx p 0))
            (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures (ins mark (idx p m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call path_in g mark bw p (- m 1))
        (assert (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
        (obtain ((gi int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (idx p (- m 1))) (< (idx p (- m 1)) (len g)))
                                     (and (<= 0 gi) (< gi (len (idx g (idx p (- m 1)))))))
                                (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- m 1))) gi) 0) (idx p m))))
        (assert (not (crosses mark (idx p (- m 1)) (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- m 1))) gi) 0)))))
      (block))))
(lemma stuck (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (mark (seq int)) (bw int))
  (requires (scan_ok g mark false bw (len g) 0) (graph_is_connected g) (ins mark 0) (== (len mark) (len g))
            (>= (occurrences mark 0) 1))
  (ensures false)
  (body
    (call law_take_all mark)
    (call zero_at mark (len mark))
    (obtain ((z int)) (and (and (<= 0 z) (< z (len mark))) (== (idx mark z) 0)))
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 z))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) z))) (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (call path_in g mark bw p (- (len p) 1))
    (assert (ins mark z))))

(lemma conn_refl (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int))
  (ensures (edges_connected t u u))
  (body
    (assert (path_follows_edges t (seq-lit u)))
    (assert (and (and (> (len (seq-lit u)) 0) (and (== (idx (seq-lit u) 0) u) (== (idx (seq-lit u) (- (len (seq-lit u)) 1)) u)))
                 (path_follows_edges t (seq-lit u))))))
(lemma conn_edge (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (edge_in_set t u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected t u v))
  (body
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit u v) 0) u))
    (assert (== (idx (seq-lit u v) 1) v))
    (assert (path_follows_edges t (seq-lit u v)))
    (assert (and (and (> (len (seq-lit u v)) 0) (and (== (idx (seq-lit u v) 0) u) (== (idx (seq-lit u v) (- (len (seq-lit u v)) 1)) v)))
                 (path_follows_edges t (seq-lit u v))))))
(lemma edge_sym (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (edge_in_set t u v))
  (ensures (edge_in_set t v u))
  (body
    (obtain ((ei int)) (and (and (<= 0 ei) (< ei (len t)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx t ei) 0) u) (== (get (idx t ei) 1) v)) (and (== (get (idx t ei) 0) v) (== (get (idx t ei) 1) u)))))
    (assert (and (and (<= 0 ei) (< ei (len t)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx t ei) 0) v) (== (get (idx t ei) 1) u)) (and (== (get (idx t ei) 0) u) (== (get (idx t ei) 1) v)))))))
(lemma sym_step (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges t p))
  (ensures (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))) (edge_in_set t (idx (rev p) k) (idx (rev p) (+ k 1)))))
  (body
    (if (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1)))
      (block
        (ghost-let j int (- (- (len p) 2) k))
        (assert (edge_in_set t (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))
        (call edge_sym t (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1)))
        (assert (== (idx (rev p) k) (idx p (+ j 1))))
        (assert (== (idx (rev p) (+ k 1)) (idx p j))))
      (block))))
(lemma conn_sym (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (edges_connected t u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected t v u))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges t p)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call sym_step t p k))
    (assert (== (len (rev p)) (len p)))
    (assert (== (idx (rev p) 0) v))
    (assert (== (idx (rev p) (- (len (rev p)) 1)) u))
    (assert (path_follows_edges t (rev p)))
    (assert (and (and (> (len (rev p)) 0) (and (== (idx (rev p) 0) v) (== (idx (rev p) (- (len (rev p)) 1)) u)))
                 (path_follows_edges t (rev p))))))
(lemma trans_step (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges t p) (path_follows_edges t q) (> (len p) 0) (> (len q) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (idx q 0)))
  (ensures (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (+ (len p) (len q)) 2)))
               (edge_in_set t (idx (concat p (drop q 1)) k) (idx (concat p (drop q 1)) (+ k 1)))))
  (body
    (if (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (+ (len p) (len q)) 2)))
      (if (< k (- (len p) 1))
        (block
          (assert (edge_in_set t (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
          (assert (== (idx (concat p (drop q 1)) k) (idx p k)))
          (assert (== (idx (concat p (drop q 1)) (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
        (block
          (ghost-let j int (+ (- k (len p)) 1))
          (assert (edge_in_set t (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1))))
          (assert (== (idx (concat p (drop q 1)) k) (idx q j)))
          (assert (== (idx (concat p (drop q 1)) (+ k 1)) (idx q (+ j 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (edges_connected t u v) (edges_connected t v w))
  (ensures (edges_connected t u w))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges t p)))
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) v) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) w))) (path_follows_edges t q)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call trans_step t p q k))
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (concat p (drop q 1)))
    (assert (== (len r) (- (+ (len p) (len q)) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) u))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) w))
    (assert (path_follows_edges t r))
    (assert (and (and (> (len r) 0) (and (== (idx r 0) u) (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) w))) (path_follows_edges t r)))))
(lemma chain_seg (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (lo int) (m int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 lo) (<= lo m)) (< m (len p)))
            (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= lo k) (< k m)) (edges_connected t (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))))
  (ensures (edges_connected t (idx p lo) (idx p m)))
  (decreases (- m lo))
  (body
    (if (> m lo)
      (block
        (call chain_seg t p lo (- m 1))
        (assert (edges_connected t (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
        (call conn_trans t (idx p lo) (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
      (call conn_refl t (idx p lo)))))
(lemma lift_step (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (lifts t s) (path_follows_edges t p))
  (ensures (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))) (edges_connected s (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
  (body (if (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))) (assert (edge_in_set t (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))) (block))))
(lemma conn_lift (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (lifts t s) (edges_connected t u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected s u v))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges t p)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call lift_step t s p k))
    (call chain_seg s p 0 (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma push_edge (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (u int) (v int))
  (ensures (=> (edge_in_set t u v) (edges_connected (concat t (seq-lit e)) u v)))
  (body
    (if (edge_in_set t u v)
      (block
        (obtain ((ei int)) (and (and (<= 0 ei) (< ei (len t)))
          (or (and (== (get (idx t ei) 0) u) (== (get (idx t ei) 1) v)) (and (== (get (idx t ei) 0) v) (== (get (idx t ei) 1) u)))))
        (assert (== (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) ei) (idx t ei)))
        (assert (edge_in_set (concat t (seq-lit e)) u v))
        (call conn_edge (concat t (seq-lit e)) u v))
      (block))))
(lemma lifts_push (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (lifts t (concat t (seq-lit e))))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call push_edge t e u v))))
(lemma new_edge (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (concat t (seq-lit e)) (get e 0) (get e 1)) (edge_in_set (concat t (seq-lit e)) (get e 1) (get e 0)))
  (body (assert (== (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) (len t)) e))))
(lemma conn_step (params (mark (seq int)) (mark2 (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t2 (seq (tuple int int int)))
                         (x int) (y int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (conn_all mark t) (lifts t t2) (edge_in_set t2 x y) (ins mark x) (ext_by mark mark2 y))
  (ensures (=> (and (ins mark2 u) (ins mark2 v)) (edges_connected t2 u v)))
  (body
    (if (and (ins mark2 u) (ins mark2 v))
      (if (== u y)
        (if (== v y)
          (call conn_refl t2 y)
          (block
            (assert (ins mark v))
            (assert (edges_connected t x v))
            (call conn_lift t t2 x v)
            (call conn_edge t2 x y)
            (call conn_sym t2 x y)
            (call conn_trans t2 y x v)))
        (if (== v y)
          (block
            (assert (ins mark u))
            (assert (edges_connected t u x))
            (call conn_lift t t2 u x)
            (call conn_edge t2 x y)
            (call conn_trans t2 u x y))
          (block
            (assert (ins mark u))
            (assert (ins mark v))
            (assert (edges_connected t u v))
            (call conn_lift t t2 u v))))
      (block))))
(lemma inside_k (params (mark0 (seq int)) (mark (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (y int) (k int))
  (requires (inside mark0 t) (ext_by mark0 mark y) (ins mark (get e 0)) (ins mark (get e 1)))
  (ensures (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (+ (len t) 1)))
    (and (ins mark (get (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) k) 0)) (ins mark (get (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) k) 1)))))
  (body
    (if (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len t)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) k) (idx t k)))
        (assert (and (ins mark0 (get (idx t k) 0)) (ins mark0 (get (idx t k) 1))))
        (assert (!= (get (idx t k) 0) y))
        (assert (!= (get (idx t k) 1) y))
        (assert (ins mark (get (idx t k) 0)))
        (assert (ins mark (get (idx t k) 1))))
      (if (== k (len t)) (assert (== (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) k) e)) (block)))))
(lemma inside_push (params (mark0 (seq int)) (mark (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (y int))
  (requires (inside mark0 t) (ext_by mark0 mark y) (ins mark (get e 0)) (ins mark (get e 1)))
  (ensures (inside mark (concat t (seq-lit e))))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call inside_k mark0 mark t e y k))))
(lemma valid_k (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (k int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g t) (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)))
  (ensures (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (+ (len t) 1)))
    (has_edge g (get (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) k) 0) (get (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) k) 1) (get (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) k) 2))))
  (body
    (if (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len t)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) k) (idx t k)))
        (assert (has_edge g (get (idx t k) 0) (get (idx t k) 1) (get (idx t k) 2))))
      (if (== k (len t)) (assert (== (idx (concat t (seq-lit e)) k) e)) (block)))))
(lemma valid_push (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g t) (has_edge g (get e 0) (get e 1) (get e 2)))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (concat t (seq-lit e))))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call valid_k g t e k))))
(lemma has_edge_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (has_edge g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (body))
(lemma init_conn (params (mark (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len mark))) (!= w 0)) (== (idx mark w) 0))))
  (ensures (=> (and (ins mark u) (ins mark v)) (edges_connected t u v)))
  (body (if (and (ins mark u) (ins mark v)) (block (assert (== u 0)) (assert (== v 0)) (call conn_refl t u)) (block))))
(lemma init_o (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (== (len t) 0))
  (ensures (keeps g t o))
  (body
    (if (is_spanning_tree g o)
      (block
        (assert (== (take o 0) t))
        (assert (better g t o)))
      (block))))
(lemma span_final (params (mark (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (binary mark) (== (occurrences mark 0) 0) (conn_all mark t))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len mark))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len mark)))) (edges_connected t u v)))
  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len mark))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len mark))))
      (block (call all_in mark u) (call all_in mark v))
      (block))))
(lemma final_k (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (optimal g t) (== (len t) (- (len g) 1)))
  (ensures (=> (is_spanning_tree g o) (<= (total_weight t) (total_weight o))))
  (body
    (assert (keeps g t o))
    (if (is_spanning_tree g o)
      (block
        (assert (better g t o))
        (obtain ((q (seq (tuple int int int)))) (and (and (<= (len t) (len q)) (== (take q (len t)) t))
                                                    (and (is_spanning_tree g q) (<= (total_weight q) (total_weight o)))))
        (assert (== (len q) (len t)))
        (assert (== (take q (len q)) q))
        (assert (== t q)))
      (block))))
(lemma tw_upd (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (i int))
  (requires (== (len s) (len t)) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
            (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len s))) (!= k i)) (== (idx s k) (idx t k)))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight t) (+ (- (total_weight s) (get (idx s i) 2)) (get (idx t i) 2))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (assert (== (total_weight s) (+ (get (idx s 0) 2) (total_weight (drop s 1)))))
    (assert (== (total_weight t) (+ (get (idx t 0) 2) (total_weight (drop t 1)))))
    (if (== i 0)
      (assert (== (drop s 1) (drop t 1)))
      (call tw_upd (drop s 1) (drop t 1) (- i 1)))))
(lemma last_in (params (mark (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (> (len p) 0) (ins mark (idx p 0)) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p)))
            (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (< m k) (< k (len p))) (not (ins mark (idx p k))))))
  (ensures (exists ((j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 j) (<= j m)) (ins mark (idx p j)))
                                  (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (< j k) (< k (len p))) (not (ins mark (idx p k))))))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (ins mark (idx p m))
      (assert (and (and (and (<= 0 m) (<= m m)) (ins mark (idx p m)))
                   (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (< m k) (< k (len p))) (not (ins mark (idx p k)))))))
      (call last_in mark p (- m 1)))))
(lemma qmap (params (q (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (lt int) (fi int) (qi int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 lt) (<= lt fi)) (< fi (len q))) (and (<= 0 qi) (< qi (len q))) (!= qi fi))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (exch_seq q e lt fi) (get (idx q qi) 0) (get (idx q qi) 1)))
  (body
    (if (== qi lt)
      (assert (== (idx (exch_seq q e lt fi) fi) (idx q qi)))
      (assert (== (idx (exch_seq q e lt fi) qi) (idx q qi))))))
(lemma qlift (params (q (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (lt int) (fi int) (a int) (b int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 lt) (<= lt fi)) (< fi (len q)))
            (or (and (== (get (idx q fi) 0) a) (== (get (idx q fi) 1) b)) (and (== (get (idx q fi) 0) b) (== (get (idx q fi) 1) a)))
            (edges_connected (exch_seq q e lt fi) a b) (edges_connected (exch_seq q e lt fi) b a))
  (ensures (=> (edge_in_set q u v) (edges_connected (exch_seq q e lt fi) u v)))
  (body
    (if (edge_in_set q u v)
      (block
        (obtain ((qi int)) (and (and (<= 0 qi) (< qi (len q)))
          (or (and (== (get (idx q qi) 0) u) (== (get (idx q qi) 1) v)) (and (== (get (idx q qi) 0) v) (== (get (idx q qi) 1) u)))))
        (if (== qi fi)
          (block)
          (block
            (call qmap q e lt fi qi)
            (if (== (get (idx q qi) 0) u)
              (call conn_edge (exch_seq q e lt fi) u v)
              (block (call edge_sym (exch_seq q e lt fi) v u) (call conn_edge (exch_seq q e lt fi) u v))))))
      (block))))
(lemma qlift_out (params (mark (seq int)) (q (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (lt int) (fi int) (a int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 lt) (<= lt fi)) (< fi (len q))) (ins mark a)
            (or (== (get (idx q fi) 0) a) (== (get (idx q fi) 1) a))
            (edge_in_set q u v) (not (ins mark u)) (not (ins mark v)))
  (ensures (edges_connected (exch_seq q e lt fi) u v))
  (body
    (obtain ((qi int)) (and (and (<= 0 qi) (< qi (len q)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx q qi) 0) u) (== (get (idx q qi) 1) v)) (and (== (get (idx q qi) 0) v) (== (get (idx q qi) 1) u)))))
    (assert (!= qi fi))
    (call qmap q e lt fi qi)
    (if (== (get (idx q qi) 0) u)
      (call conn_edge (exch_seq q e lt fi) u v)
      (block (call edge_sym (exch_seq q e lt fi) v u) (call conn_edge (exch_seq q e lt fi) u v)))))
(lemma out_step (params (mark (seq int)) (q (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (lt int) (fi int) (a int)
                        (p (seq int)) (j int) (kk int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 lt) (<= lt fi)) (< fi (len q))) (ins mark a)
            (or (== (get (idx q fi) 0) a) (== (get (idx q fi) 1) a))
            (path_follows_edges q p) (<= 0 j)
            (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (< j k) (< k (len p))) (not (ins mark (idx p k))))))
  (ensures (=> (and (<= (+ j 1) kk) (< kk (- (len p) 1)))

(lemma conn_sym (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (edges_connected t u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected t v u))

    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges t p)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call sym_step t p k))
    (assert (== (len (rev p)) (len p)))
    (assert (== (idx (rev p) 0) v))
    (assert (== (idx (rev p) (- (len (rev p)) 1)) u))
    (assert (path_follows_edges t (rev p)))
    (assert (and (and (> (len (rev p)) 0) (and (== (idx (rev p) 0) v) (== (idx (rev p) (- (len (rev p)) 1)) u)))

(lemma trans_step (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (k int))

  (ensures (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (+ (len p) (len q)) 2)))

    (if (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (+ (len p) (len q)) 2)))
      (if (< k (- (len p) 1))

          (assert (edge_in_set t (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
          (assert (== (idx (concat p (drop q 1)) k) (idx p k)))
          (assert (== (idx (concat p (drop q 1)) (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
        (block
          (ghost-let j int (+ (- k (len p)) 1))
          (assert (edge_in_set t (idx q j) (idx q (+ j 1))))
          (assert (== (idx (concat p (drop q 1)) k) (idx q j)))
          (assert (== (idx (concat p (drop q 1)) (+ k 1)) (idx q (+ j 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int) (w int))

  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges t p)))
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) v) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) w))) (path_follows_edges t q)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call trans_step t p q k))
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (concat p (drop q 1)))
    (assert (== (len r) (- (+ (len p) (len q)) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) u))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) w))
    (assert (path_follows_edges t r))
    (assert (and (and (> (len r) 0) (and (== (idx r 0) u) (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) w))) (path_follows_edges t r)))))
(lemma chain_seg (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (lo int) (m int))

            (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= lo k) (< k m)) (edges_connected t (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))))
  (ensures (edges_connected t (idx p lo) (idx p m)))
  (decreases (- m lo))
  (body
    (if (> m lo)
      (block
        (call chain_seg t p lo (- m 1))
        (assert (edges_connected t (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
        (call conn_trans t (idx p lo) (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))

(lemma conn_lift (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))

(lemma push_edge (params (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (u int) (v int))

(lemma conn_step (params (mark (seq int)) (mark2 (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (t2 (seq (tuple int int int)))
                         (x int) (y int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (conn_all mark t) (lifts t t2) (edge_in_set t2 x y) (ins mark x) (ext_by mark mark2 y))
  (ensures (=> (and (ins mark2 u) (ins mark2 v)) (edges_connected t2 u v)))
  (body
    (if (and (ins mark2 u) (ins mark2 v))
      (if (== u y)
        (if (== v y)
          (call conn_refl t2 y)
          (block
            (assert (ins mark v))
            (assert (edges_connected t x v))
            (call conn_lift t t2 x v)
            (call conn_edge t2 x y)
            (call conn_sym t2 x y)
            (call conn_trans t2 y x v)))

            (assert (ins mark u))
            (assert (edges_connected t u x))
            (call conn_lift t t2 u x)
            (call conn_edge t2 x y)
            (call conn_trans t2 u x y))
          (block
            (assert (ins mark u))
            (assert (ins mark v))
            (assert (edges_connected t u v))
            (call conn_lift t t2 u v))))
      (block))))

(lemma exch_q (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (mark (seq int)) (t (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int))

  (requires
    (== (len mark) (len g)) (inside mark t) (conn_all mark t) (ins mark x) (not (ins mark y)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g)))
    (or (and (== (get e 0) x) (== (get e 1) y)) (and (== (get e 0) y) (== (get e 1) x)))

    (<= (len t) (len q)) (== (take q (len t)) t) (is_spanning_tree g q))

    (assert (is_spanning g q))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g q))
    (assert (== (len q) (- (len g) 1)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))))
    (assert (edges_connected q x y))

    (call last_in mark p (- (len p) 1))
    (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 j) (<= j (- (len p) 1))) (ins mark (idx p j)))
                           (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (< j k) (< k (len p))) (not (ins mark (idx p k)))))))
    (assert (< j (- (len p) 1)))

    (ghost-let b int (idx p (+ j 1)))

    (assert (not (ins mark b)))

    (obtain ((fi int)) (and (and (<= 0 fi) (< fi (len q)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx q fi) 0) a) (== (get (idx q fi) 1) b)) (and (== (get (idx q fi) 0) b) (== (get (idx q fi) 1) a)))))
    (ghost-let lt int (len t))

    (assert (=> (< fi lt) (and (ins mark (get (idx t fi) 0)) (ins mark (get (idx t fi) 1)))))
    (assert (>= fi lt))
    (ghost-let f (tuple int int int) (idx q fi))
    (assert (has_edge g (get f 0) (get f 1) (get f 2)))
    (obtain ((gi int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (get f 0)) (< (get f 0) (len g))) (and (<= 0 gi) (< gi (len (idx g (get f 0))))))
                            (and (== (get (idx (idx g (get f 0)) gi) 0) (get f 1)) (== (get (idx (idx g (get f 0)) gi) 1) (get f 2)))))
    (assert (crosses mark (get f 0) (get (idx (idx g (get f 0)) gi) 0)))
    (assert (<= (get e 2) (get f 2)))

    (assert (== (len nn) (len q)))
    (if (== fi lt)
      (block
        (call tw_upd q nn fi)

        (ghost-let v1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (seq-build (len q) (fn (k2) (if (== k2 fi) e (idx q k2)))))
        (ghost-let v2 (seq (tuple int int int)) (seq-build (len q) (fn (k3) (if (== k3 lt) e (idx v1 k3)))))
        (call tw_upd q v1 fi)
        (call tw_upd v1 v2 lt)
        (call tw_upd v2 nn fi)

  (body (exists ((rest (seq (tuple int int int))))
    (and (is_spanning_tree g (concat es rest)) (<= (total_weight (concat es rest)) (total_weight other))))))
(ghost-fn good ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int)))) (=> (is_spanning_tree g other) (extends g es other)))))
(ghost-fn simple ((p (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((i int) (k int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (< k (len p))) (!= (idx p i) (idx p k))))))
(ghost-fn swp ((es0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (r int)) (seq (tuple int int int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len rest))))
  (body (concat (concat es0 (seq-lit e)) (concat (take rest r) (drop rest (+ r 1))))))
(ghost-fn npos ((l0 int) (r int) (t1 int)) int
  (body (if (< t1 l0) t1 (if (< t1 (+ l0 r)) (+ t1 1) t1))))
(ghost-fn opos ((l0 int) (r int) (k int)) int
  (body (if (< k l0) k (if (<= k (+ l0 r)) (- k 1) k))))
(lemma occ_pos (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))) (> (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (ensures (exists ((j int)) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (== (idx s j) x))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (call law_occurrences_none s x)
      (block
        (call law_take_step s (- k 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat (take s (- k 1)) (seq-lit (idx s (- k 1))) x)
        (call law_occurrences_unit (idx s (- k 1)) x)
        (if (== (idx s (- k 1)) x)
          (assert (== (idx s (- k 1)) x))
          (call occ_pos s x (- k 1)))))))
(lemma cross_on_path (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (== (len a) (len g)) (bin01 a) (path_follows_graph g p)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
            (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len g)))
            (== (idx a (idx p k)) 1)
            (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len g)))
            (== (idx a (idx p (- (len p) 1))) 0))
  (ensures (exists ((j int))
    (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1)))
         (and (and (<= 0 (idx p j)) (< (idx p j) (len g)))
              (and (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1)))
                   (and (and (<= 0 (idx p (+ j 1))) (< (idx p (+ j 1)) (len g)))
                        (and (== (idx a (idx p j)) 1) (== (idx a (idx p (+ j 1))) 0))))))))
  (decreases (- (len p) k))
  (body
    (assert (< k (- (len p) 1)))
    (assert (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
    (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g (idx p k)))))
                           (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p k)) e) 0) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (idx p (+ k 1))) (< (idx p (+ k 1)) (len g))))
    (if (== (idx a (idx p (+ k 1))) 1)
      (call cross_on_path g a p (+ k 1))
      (assert (== (idx a (idx p (+ k 1))) 0)))))
(lemma some_cross (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq int)))
  (requires (graph_is_connected g) (targets_ok g) (== (len a) (len g)) (> (len g) 0)
            (bin01 a) (== (idx a 0) 1) (> (occurrences a 0) 0))
  (ensures (not (no_cross_upto g a (len g) 0)))
  (body
    (call law_take_all a)
    (call occ_pos a 0 (len a))
    (obtain ((x int)) (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len a))) (== (idx a x) 0)))
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 x))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x)))
                                 (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (call cross_on_path g a p 0)
    (obtain ((j int))
      (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1)))
           (and (and (<= 0 (idx p j)) (< (idx p j) (len g)))
                (and (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1)))
                     (and (and (<= 0 (idx p (+ j 1))) (< (idx p (+ j 1)) (len g)))
                          (and (== (idx a (idx p j)) 1) (== (idx a (idx p (+ j 1))) 0)))))))
    (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g (idx p j)))))
                           (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p j)) e) 0) (idx p (+ j 1)))))
    (assert (is_cross g a (idx p j) e))))
(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))
(lemma one_pt (params (a (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (bin01 a) (== (occurrences a 0) 0) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len a))))
  (ensures (== (idx a x) 1))
  (body
    (call law_take_all a)
    (call count_member a x (len a))
    (assert (or (== (idx a x) 0) (== (idx a x) 1)))))
(lemma all_one (params (a (seq int)))
  (requires (bin01 a) (== (occurrences a 0) 0))
  (ensures (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len a))) (== (idx a x) 1))))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call one_pt a x))))
(lemma conn_intro (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (> (len p) 0) (path_follows_edges es p))
  (ensures (edges_connected es (idx p 0) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
  (body))
(lemma es_from (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (m int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges es p) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (- (len p) 1))) (== (idx p m) x) (== (idx p (+ m 1)) y))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es x y))
  (body (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1))))))
(lemma es_sym (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (edge_in_set es u v))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es v u))
  (body
    (obtain ((t1 int)) (and (and (<= 0 t1) (< t1 (len es)))
                            (or (and (== (get (idx es t1) 0) u) (== (get (idx es t1) 1) v))
                                (and (== (get (idx es t1) 0) v) (== (get (idx es t1) 1) u)))))
    (assert (and (and (<= 0 t1) (< t1 (len es)))
                 (or (and (== (get (idx es t1) 0) v) (== (get (idx es t1) 1) u))
                     (and (== (get (idx es t1) 0) u) (== (get (idx es t1) 1) v)))))))
(lemma es_pre (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (edge_in_set es u v))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (concat es s2) u v))
  (body
    (obtain ((t1 int)) (and (and (<= 0 t1) (< t1 (len es)))
                            (or (and (== (get (idx es t1) 0) u) (== (get (idx es t1) 1) v))
                                (and (== (get (idx es t1) 0) v) (== (get (idx es t1) 1) u)))))
    (assert (== (len (concat es s2)) (+ (len es) (len s2))))
    (assert (== (idx (concat es s2) t1) (idx es t1)))))
(lemma es_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (are_valid_edges g es) (edge_in_set es u v))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (body
    (obtain ((t1 int)) (and (and (<= 0 t1) (< t1 (len es)))
                            (or (and (== (get (idx es t1) 0) u) (== (get (idx es t1) 1) v))
                                (and (== (get (idx es t1) 0) v) (== (get (idx es t1) 1) u)))))
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx es t1) 0) (get (idx es t1) 1) (get (idx es t1) 2)))
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx es t1) 0)) (< (get (idx es t1) 0) (len g)))
                                (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g (get (idx es t1) 0))))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g (get (idx es t1) 0)) i) 0) (get (idx es t1) 1))
                                (== (get (idx (idx g (get (idx es t1) 0)) i) 1) (get (idx es t1) 2)))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g (get (idx es t1) 0)) i) 0))
                 (< (get (idx (idx g (get (idx es t1) 0)) i) 0) (len g))))))
(lemma edge_conn1 (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (edge_in_set es u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected es u v))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-build 2 (fn (z) (if (== z 0) u v))))
    (assert (== (len p) 2))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) u))
    (assert (== (idx p 1) v))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es p))
    (call conn_intro es p)))
(lemma conn_refl (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int))
  (ensures (edges_connected es x x))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-build 1 (fn (z) x)))
    (assert (== (len p) 1))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) x))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es p))
    (call conn_intro es p)))
(lemma rev_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges es p) (== (len q) (len p)) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len q) 1)))
            (== (idx q k) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) k)))
            (== (idx q (+ k 1)) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) (+ k 1)))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (+ (- (- (len p) 1) (+ k 1)) 1) (- (- (len p) 1) k)))
    (call es_from es p (- (- (len p) 1) (+ k 1)) (idx q (+ k 1)) (idx q k))
    (call es_sym es (idx q (+ k 1)) (idx q k))))
(lemma conn_sym (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (edges_connected es x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected es y x))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (seq-build (len p) (fn (z) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) z)))))
    (forall ((k int)) (call rev_step es p q k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es q))
    (call conn_intro es q)
    (assert (== (idx q 0) y))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) x))))
(lemma cat_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p1 (seq int)) (p2 (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges es p1) (path_follows_edges es p2) (> (len p1) 0) (> (len p2) 0)
            (== (idx p1 (- (len p1) 1)) (idx p2 0))
            (== (len q) (- (+ (len p1) (len p2)) 1))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len q) 1)))
            (== (idx q k) (if (< k (len p1)) (idx p1 k) (idx p2 (+ (- k (len p1)) 1))))
            (== (idx q (+ k 1)) (if (< (+ k 1) (len p1)) (idx p1 (+ k 1)) (idx p2 (+ (- (+ k 1) (len p1)) 1)))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (if (< (+ k 1) (len p1))
      (call es_from es p1 k (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1)))
      (if (== (+ k 1) (len p1))
        (call es_from es p2 0 (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1)))
        (call es_from es p2 (+ (- k (len p1)) 1) (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1)))))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int) (z int))
  (requires (edges_connected es x y) (edges_connected es y z))
  (ensures (edges_connected es x z))
  (body
    (obtain ((p1 (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p1) 0) (and (== (idx p1 0) x) (== (idx p1 (- (len p1) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges es p1)))
    (obtain ((p2 (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p2) 0) (and (== (idx p2 0) y) (== (idx p2 (- (len p2) 1)) z))) (path_follows_edges es p2)))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (seq-build (- (+ (len p1) (len p2)) 1)
      (fn (w) (if (< w (len p1)) (idx p1 w) (idx p2 (+ (- w (len p1)) 1))))))
    (forall ((k int)) (call cat_step es p1 p2 q k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es q))
    (call conn_intro es q)
    (assert (== (idx q 0) x))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) z))))
(lemma mono_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges es p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (concat es s2) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (call es_from es p k (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))
    (call es_pre es s2 (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
(lemma conn_mono (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (edges_connected es x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected (concat es s2) x y))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call mono_step es s2 p k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges (concat es s2) p))
    (call conn_intro (concat es s2) p)))
(lemma edge_link (params (es0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (or (and (== (get e 0) u) (== (get e 1) v)) (and (== (get e 0) v) (== (get e 1) u))))
  (ensures (edges_connected (concat es0 (seq-lit e)) u v))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (concat es0 (seq-lit e))) (+ (len es0) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx (concat es0 (seq-lit e)) (len es0)) e))
    (assert (edge_in_set (concat es0 (seq-lit e)) u v))
    (call edge_conn1 (concat es0 (seq-lit e)) u v)))
(lemma tconn_pt (params (es0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a0 (seq int)) (a1 (seq int)) (ov int) (nv int) (e (tuple int int int)) (x int))
  (requires (tconn es0 a0) (and (<= 0 ov) (< ov (len a0))) (== (idx a0 ov) 1)
            (edges_connected (concat es0 (seq-lit e)) ov nv)
            (== (len a1) (len a0))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len a1))) (== (idx a1 x) 1)
            (or (== x nv) (== (idx a1 x) (idx a0 x))))
  (ensures (edges_connected (concat es0 (seq-lit e)) 0 x))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected es0 0 ov))
    (call conn_mono es0 (seq-lit e) 0 ov)
    (if (== x nv)
      (call conn_trans (concat es0 (seq-lit e)) 0 ov nv)
      (block
        (assert (edges_connected es0 0 x))
        (call conn_mono es0 (seq-lit e) 0 x)))))
(lemma tconn_step (params (es0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a0 (seq int)) (a1 (seq int)) (ov int) (nv int) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (tconn es0 a0) (== (len a1) (len a0))
                        (and (<= 0 ov) (< ov (len a0))) (== (idx a0 ov) 1)
            (and (<= 0 nv) (< nv (len a0))) (== (idx a1 nv) 1)
            (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len a0))) (!= y nv)) (== (idx a1 y) (idx a0 y))))
            (or (and (== (get e 0) ov) (== (get e 1) nv)) (and (== (get e 0) nv) (== (get e 1) ov))))
  (ensures (tconn (concat es0 (seq-lit e)) a1))
  (body
    (call edge_link es0 e ov nv)
    (forall ((x int)) (call tconn_pt es0 a0 a1 ov nv e x))))
(lemma span_pt (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (a (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (tconn es a) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len a))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len a))) (== (idx a u) 1) (== (idx a v) 1))
  (ensures (edges_connected es u v))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected es 0 u))
    (assert (edges_connected es 0 v))
    (call conn_sym es 0 u)
    (call conn_trans es u 0 v)))
(lemma span_final (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (a (seq int)))
  (requires (tconn es a) (== (len a) (len g))
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len a))) (== (idx a x) 1))))
  (ensures (is_spanning g es))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call span_pt es a u v))))
(lemma chain (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (q (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len q)))
            (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k m)) (edges_connected es (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))))
  (ensures (edges_connected es (idx q 0) (idx q m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (== m 0)
      (call conn_refl es (idx q 0))
      (block
        (call chain es q (- m 1))
        (assert (edges_connected es (idx q (- m 1)) (idx q m)))
        (call conn_trans es (idx q 0) (idx q (- m 1)) (idx q m))))))
(lemma short_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (i1 int) (i2 int) (k int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges es p) (and (and (<= 0 i1) (< i1 i2)) (< i2 (len p))) (== (idx p i1) (idx p i2))
            (== (len q) (- (len p) (- i2 i1)))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len q) 1)))
            (== (idx q k) (if (<= k i1) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k (- i2 i1)))))
            (== (idx q (+ k 1)) (if (<= (+ k 1) i1) (idx p (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ (+ k 1) (- i2 i1))))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (if (< k i1)
      (call es_from es p k (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1)))
      (if (== k i1)
        (call es_from es p i2 (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1)))
        (call es_from es p (+ k (- i2 i1)) (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1)))))))
(lemma simple_path (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (> (len p) 0) (path_follows_edges es p))
  (ensures (exists ((sq (seq int)))
    (and (and (and (> (len sq) 0) (== (idx sq 0) (idx p 0))) (== (idx sq (- (len sq) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
         (and (path_follows_edges es sq) (simple sq)))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (simple p)
      (block)
      (block
        (obtain ((i1 int)) (exists ((i3 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i1) (< i1 i3)) (< i3 (len p))) (== (idx p i1) (idx p i3)))))
        (obtain ((i2 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i1) (< i1 i2)) (< i2 (len p))) (== (idx p i1) (idx p i2))))
        (ghost-let q (seq int) (seq-build (- (len p) (- i2 i1)) (fn (z) (if (<= z i1) (idx p z) (idx p (+ z (- i2 i1)))))))
        (forall ((k int)) (call short_step es p q i1 i2 k))
        (assert (path_follows_edges es q))
        (assert (== (idx q 0) (idx p 0)))
        (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
        (call simple_path es q)))))
(lemma cross_es (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq int)) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (are_valid_edges g es) (== (len a) (len g)) (bin01 a) (path_follows_edges es p)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
            (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len g)))
            (== (idx a (idx p k)) 1)
            (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len g)))
            (== (idx a (idx p (- (len p) 1))) 0))
  (ensures (exists ((j int))
    (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1)))
         (and (and (and (<= 0 (idx p j)) (< (idx p j) (len g))) (and (<= 0 (idx p (+ j 1))) (< (idx p (+ j 1)) (len g))))
              (and (== (idx a (idx p j)) 1) (== (idx a (idx p (+ j 1))) 0))))))
  (decreases (- (len p) k))
  (body
    (assert (< k (- (len p) 1)))
    (call es_from es p k (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))
    (call es_range g es (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))
    (if (== (idx a (idx p (+ k 1))) 1)
      (call cross_es g a es p (+ k 1))
      (assert (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1)))
                   (and (and (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len g))) (and (<= 0 (idx p (+ k 1))) (< (idx p (+ k 1)) (len g))))
                        (and (== (idx a (idx p k)) 1) (== (idx a (idx p (+ k 1))) 0))))))))
(lemma pair_ne (params (sp (seq int)) (j int) (m int))
  (requires (simple sp) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len sp) 1))) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (- (len sp) 1))) (!= m j))
  (ensures (not (or (and (== (idx sp m) (idx sp j)) (== (idx sp (+ m 1)) (idx sp (+ j 1))))
                    (and (== (idx sp m) (idx sp (+ j 1))) (== (idx sp (+ m 1)) (idx sp j))))))
  (body))
(lemma tw_concat (params (s (seq (tuple int int int))) (s2 (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (ensures (== (total_weight (concat s s2)) (+ (total_weight s) (total_weight s2))))
  (decreases (len s))
  (body
    (if (== (len s) 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (concat s s2) s2))
        (assert (== (total_weight s) 0)))
      (block
        (call tw_concat (drop s 1) s2)
        (assert (== (len (concat s s2)) (+ (len s) (len s2))))
        (assert (== (idx (concat s s2) 0) (idx s 0)))
        (assert (== (drop (concat s s2) 1) (concat (drop s 1) s2)))
        (assert (== (total_weight (concat s s2)) (+ (get (idx (concat s s2) 0) 2) (total_weight (drop (concat s s2) 1)))))

      (forall ((a int) (i int))
        (==
          (processed_before
            a i (+ outer 1) 0)
          (or
            (processed_before
              a i outer
              (len (idx g outer)))
            (and
              (== a outer)
              (and
                (<= 0 i)
                (< i (len (idx g outer)))))))))
    (assert
      (scan_ok
        g selected (+ outer 1) 0
        found u v w))))

(lemma scan_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (selected (seq bool))
    (found bool)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (a int)
    (b int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (scan_ok
      g selected (len g) 0
      found u v w)
    (has_edge g a b x)
    (!=
      (idx selected a)
      (idx selected b)))
  (ensures
    (and found (<= w x)))
  (body
    (obtain ((i int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
          (and
            (<= 0 i)
            (< i (len (idx g a)))))
        (and
          (==
            (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0)
            b)
          (==
            (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1)
            x))))
    (assert
      (processed_before a i (len g) 0))
    (assert (and found (<= w x)))))

(lemma scan_to_cut
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (selected (seq bool))
    (found bool)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (scan_ok
      g selected (len g) 0
      found u v w)
    found)
  (ensures
    (cut_minimum
      g
      (iset-of ((x int))
        (and
          (and
            (<= 0 x)
            (< x (len selected)))
          (idx selected x)))
      u v w))
  (body
    (assert
      (forall ((x int))
        (==
          (contains
            (iset-of ((y int))
              (and
                (and
                  (<= 0 y)
                  (< y (len selected)))
                (idx selected y)))
            x)
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 x)
              (< x (len selected)))
            (idx selected x)))))
    (forall ((a int) (b int) (x int))
      (call scan_bound
        g selected found u v w a b x))
    (assert
      (cut_minimum
        g
        (iset-of ((x int))
          (and
            (and
              (<= 0 x)
              (< x (len selected)))
            (idx selected x)))
        u v w))))

(lemma chosen_has_zero
  (params
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (ensures
    (contains
      (chosen_vertices edges)
      0))
  (decreases (len edges))
  (body
    (if (> (len edges) 0)
      (block
        (call chosen_has_zero
          (take edges (- (len edges) 1)))
        (assert
          (contains
            (chosen_vertices edges)
            0)))
      (assert
        (contains
          (chosen_vertices edges)
          0)))))

(lemma false_occurrence_witness
  (params
    (selected (seq bool))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (and
      (<= 0 k)
      (<= k (len selected)))
    (> (occurrences (take selected k) false) 0))
  (ensures
    (exists ((v int))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v k))
        (not (idx selected v)))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call law_take_step selected (- k 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat
          (take selected (- k 1))
          (seq-lit (idx selected (- k 1)))
          false)
        (call law_occurrences_unit
          (idx selected (- k 1))
          false)
        (if
          (not (idx selected (- k 1)))
          (obtain ((v int))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 v) (< v k))
              (not (idx selected v))))
          (block
            (assert
              (>
                (occurrences
                  (take selected (- k 1))
                  false)
                0))
            (call false_occurrence_witness
              selected (- k 1)))))
      (assert false))))

(lemma path_crossing
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (selected (seq bool))
    (p (seq int))
    (k int)
    (last_index int))
  (requires
    (vertices_bounded g)
    (== (len selected) (len g))
    (path_follows_graph g p)
    (and
      (<= 0 k)
      (< k last_index))
    (< last_index (len p))
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx p k))
      (< (idx p k) (len g)))
    (idx selected (idx p k))
    (not (idx selected (idx p last_index))))
  (ensures
    (exists ((u int) (v int) (w int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
        (and
          (idx selected u)
          (and
            (not (idx selected v))
            (has_edge g u v w))))))
  (decreases (- last_index k))
  (body
    (assert
      (graph_has_any_edge
        g
        (idx p k)
        (idx p (+ k 1))))
    (obtain ((edge_index int))
      (and
        (and
          (and
            (<= 0 (idx p k))
            (< (idx p k) (len g)))
          (and
            (<= 0 edge_index)
            (< edge_index
              (len (idx g (idx p k))))))
        (==
          (get
            (idx
              (idx g (idx p k))
              edge_index)
            0)
          (idx p (+ k 1)))))
    (assert
      (and
        (<= 0 (idx p (+ k 1)))
        (< (idx p (+ k 1)) (len g))))
    (obtain ((edge_weight int))
      (has_edge
        g
        (idx p k)
        (idx p (+ k 1))
        edge_weight))
    (if
      (not (idx selected (idx p (+ k 1))))
      (obtain ((u int) (v int) (w int))
        (and
          (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
          (and
            (idx selected u)
            (and
              (not (idx selected v))
              (has_edge g u v w)))))
      (call path_crossing
        g selected p (+ k 1) last_index))))

(lemma connected_crossing
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (selected (seq bool))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (count int))
  (requires
    (vertices_bounded g)
    (graph_is_connected g)
    (> (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 1 count) (< count (len g)))
    (selected_matches selected edges (len g))
    (prim_trace g edges)
    (== (len edges) (- count 1))
    (==
      (occurrences selected false)
      (- (len g) count)))
  (ensures
    (exists ((u int) (v int) (w int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
        (and
          (idx selected u)
          (and
            (not (idx selected v))
            (has_edge g u v w))))))
  (body
    (assert (> (occurrences selected false) 0))
    (call law_take_all selected)
    (call false_occurrence_witness
      selected (len selected))
    (obtain ((target int))
      (and
        (and
          (<= 0 target)
          (< target (len selected)))
        (not (idx selected target))))
    (call chosen_has_zero edges)
    (assert (idx selected 0))
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 target))
    (obtain ((p (seq int)))
      (and
        (and
          (> (len p) 0)
          (and
            (== (idx p 0) 0)
            (==
              (idx p (- (len p) 1))
              target)))
        (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (assert (> (len p) 1))
    (call path_crossing
      g selected p 0 (- (len p) 1))))

(lemma scan_finds_crossing
  (params

  (requires

        (and
          (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))))
        (and
          (!=
            (idx selected a)
            (idx selected b))
          (has_edge g a b x)))))
  (ensures found)
  (body
    (obtain ((a int) (b int) (x int))
      (and
        (and
          (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))))
        (and
          (!=
            (idx selected a)
            (idx selected b))

    (call scan_bound

(lemma trace_append
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (before (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (after (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (prim_trace g before)
    (edge_appended before after u v w)
    (cut_minimum
      g
      (chosen_vertices before)
      u v w))
  (ensures
    (prim_trace g after))
  (body
    (call law_len_concat
      before
      (seq-lit (tuple u v w)))
    (call law_len_unit (tuple u v w))
    (assert
      (== (len after)
          (+ (len before) 1)))
    (call law_take_step after (len before))
    (assert
      (==
        (take after (len before))
        before))
    (call law_last after)
    (assert
      (==
        (last after)
        (tuple u v w)))
    (assert
      (prim_trace g after))))

(lemma chosen_append
  (params
    (before (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (after (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int))
  (requires
    (edge_appended before after u v w))
  (ensures
    (==
      (chosen_vertices after)
      (union
        (chosen_vertices before)
        (iset-lit u v))))
  (body
    (call law_len_concat
      before
      (seq-lit (tuple u v w)))
    (call law_len_unit (tuple u v w))
    (assert
      (== (len after)
          (+ (len before) 1)))
    (call law_take_step after (len before))
    (assert
      (==
        (take after (len before))
        before))
    (call law_last after)
    (assert
      (==
        (last after)
        (tuple u v w)))
    (assert
      (==
        (chosen_vertices after)
        (union
          (chosen_vertices before)
          (iset-lit u v))))))

(lemma selected_append
  (params
    (before_selected (seq bool))
    (after_selected (seq bool))
    (before_edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (after_edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (n int)
    (u int)
    (v int)
    (w int)
    (new_vertex int))
  (requires
    (selected_matches
      before_selected before_edges n)
    (bool_update
      before_selected after_selected new_vertex)
    (edge_appended
      before_edges after_edges u v w)
    (and
      (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
      (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
    (crosses
      (chosen_vertices before_edges)
      u v)
    (or
      (and
        (contains
          (chosen_vertices before_edges)
          u)
        (and
          (not
            (contains
              (chosen_vertices before_edges)
              v))
          (== new_vertex v)))
      (and
        (contains
          (chosen_vertices before_edges)
          v)
        (and
          (not
            (contains
              (chosen_vertices before_edges)
              u))
          (== new_vertex u)))))
  (ensures
    (selected_matches
      after_selected after_edges n))
  (body
    (call chosen_append
      before_edges after_edges u v w)
    (assert
      (forall ((k int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 k) (< k n))
          (==
            (idx after_selected k)
            (contains
              (chosen_vertices after_edges)
              k)))))
    (assert
      (==
        (iset-of ((k int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k n))
            (idx after_selected k)))
        (chosen_vertices after_edges)))
    (assert
      (selected_matches
        after_selected after_edges n))))

(lemma initial_selected
  (params

          (and

(lemma trace_edge_valid
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (k int))
  (requires
    (prim_trace g edges)
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len edges))))
  (ensures
    (has_edge
      g
      (get (idx edges k) 0)
      (get (idx edges k) 1)
      (get (idx edges k) 2)))
  (decreases (len edges))
  (body
    (if
      (< k (- (len edges) 1))
      (block
        (call law_idx_take
          edges
          (- (len edges) 1)
          k)
        (call trace_edge_valid
          g
          (take edges (- (len edges) 1))
          k))
      (block
        (assert
          (== k (- (len edges) 1)))
        (call law_last edges)
        (assert
          (has_edge
            g
            (get (idx edges k) 0)

  (params

    (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int))))

(lemma prim_trace_is_mst
  (params

(lemma all_vertices_chosen
  (params
    (selected (seq bool))
    (edges (seq (tuple int int int)))
    (n int))
  (requires
    (selected_matches selected edges n)
    (forall ((v int))
      (=>
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
        (idx selected v))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (chosen_vertices edges)
      (iset-of ((v int))
        (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))))
  (body
    (assert
      (==
        (iset-of ((v int))
          (and
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (idx selected v)))
        (chosen_vertices edges)))
    (assert
      (forall ((v int))
        (==
          (contains
            (iset-of ((x int))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
                (idx selected x)))
            v)
          (contains
            (iset-of ((x int))
              (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)))
            v))))
    (assert
      (==
        (chosen_vertices edges)
        (iset-of ((v int))
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))))))

(def prim_mst
  (body
    (let n i64
      (len (field graph adj)))
    (let-mut selected (vec bool)
      (seq-build n
        (fn (initial_index) false)))
    (set-idx selected 0 true)
    (let-mut edges
      (vec (tuple i64 i64 i64))
      (vec-new))
    (let-mut count i64 1)
    (call initial_selected selected n)
    (assert (vertices_bounded (view graph)))

    (while (< count n)
      (invariant
        (and (<= 1 count) (<= count n)))
      (invariant
        (== (len selected) n))
      (invariant
        (== (len edges) (- count 1)))
      (invariant
        (==
          (occurrences selected false)
          (- n count)))
      (invariant
        (selected_matches selected edges n))
      (invariant
        (prim_trace (view graph) edges))
      (decreases (- n count))

      (let-mut found bool false)
      (let-mut best_u i64 0)
      (let-mut best_v i64 0)
      (let-mut best_w i64 0)
      (let-mut outer i64 0)

      (while (< outer n)
        (invariant
          (and (<= 0 outer) (<= outer n)))
        (invariant
          (== (len selected) n))
        (invariant
          (scan_ok
            (view graph)
            selected outer 0
            found best_u best_v best_w))
        (decreases (- n outer))

        (let degree i64
          (len
            (idx
              (field graph adj)
              outer)))
        (let-mut inner i64 0)

        (while (< inner degree)
          (invariant
            (and
              (<= 0 inner)
              (<= inner degree)))
          (invariant
            (and (<= 0 outer) (< outer n)))
          (invariant
            (==
              degree
              (len
                (idx
                  (field graph adj)
                  outer))))
          (invariant
            (== (len selected) n))
          (invariant
            (scan_ok
              (view graph)
              selected outer inner
              found best_u best_v best_w))
          (decreases (- degree inner))

          (let neighbor i64
            (get
              (idx
                (idx
                  (field graph adj)
                  outer)
                inner)
              0))
          (let edge_weight i64
            (get
              (idx
                (idx
                  (field graph adj)
                  outer)
                inner)
              1))
          (assert
            (and
              (<= 0 neighbor)
              (< neighbor n)))

          (ghost-let old_found bool found)
          (ghost-let old_best_u i64 best_u)
          (ghost-let old_best_v i64 best_v)
          (ghost-let old_best_w i64 best_w)

          (if
            (!=
              (idx selected outer)
              (idx selected neighbor))
            (if
              (or
                (not found)
                (< edge_weight best_w))
              (block
                (set found true)
                (set best_u outer)
                (set best_v neighbor)
                (set best_w edge_weight))
              (block))
            (block))

          (assert
            (scan_transition
              old_found
              old_best_u
              old_best_v
              old_best_w
              (!=
                (idx selected outer)
                (idx selected neighbor))
              outer
              neighbor
              edge_weight
              found
              best_u
              best_v
              best_w))
          (call scan_step
            (view graph)
            selected
            outer
            inner
            old_found
            old_best_u
            old_best_v
            old_best_w
            found
            best_u
            best_v
            best_w)

          (set inner (+ inner 1)))

        (call scan_row
          (view graph)
          selected
          outer
          found
          best_u
          best_v
          best_w)
        (set outer (+ outer 1)))

      (call connected_crossing
        (view graph)
        selected
        edges
        count)
      (call scan_finds_crossing
        (view graph)
        selected
        found
        best_u
        best_v
        best_w)
      (call selected_set
        selected edges n)
      (call scan_to_cut
        (view graph)
        selected
        found
        best_u
        best_v
        best_w)

      (assert
        (and
          (and
            (<= 0 best_u)
            (< best_u n))
          (and
            (<= 0 best_v)
            (< best_v n))))
      (assert
        (!=
          (idx selected best_u)
          (idx selected best_v)))
      (assert
        (crosses
          (chosen_vertices edges)
          best_u
          best_v))

      (let new_vertex i64
        (if
          (idx selected best_u)
          best_v
          best_u))
      (assert
        (and
          (<= 0 new_vertex)
          (< new_vertex n)))
      (assert
        (not (idx selected new_vertex)))
      (assert
        (or
          (and
            (contains
              (chosen_vertices edges)
              best_u)
            (and
              (not
                (contains
                  (chosen_vertices edges)
                  best_v))
              (== new_vertex best_v)))
          (and
            (contains
              (chosen_vertices edges)
              best_v)
            (and
              (not
                (contains
                  (chosen_vertices edges)
                  best_u))
              (== new_vertex best_u)))))

      (ghost-let old_selected
        (seq bool)
        selected)
      (ghost-let old_edges
        (seq (tuple int int int))
        edges)

      (push edges
        (tuple best_u best_v best_w))
      (set-idx selected new_vertex true)

      (assert
        (bool_update
          old_selected
          selected
          new_vertex))
      (assert
        (edge_appended
          old_edges
          edges
          best_u
          best_v
          best_w))

      (call trace_append
        (view graph)
        old_edges
        edges
        best_u
        best_v
        best_w)
      (call selected_append
        old_selected
        selected
        old_edges
        edges
        n
        best_u
        best_v
        best_w
        new_vertex)

      (set count (+ count 1)))

    (assert
      (== (occurrences selected false) 0))
    (assert
      (forall ((vertex int))
        (=>
          (and
