    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
        (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len g)))))))
(ghost-fn bin01 ((a (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len a))) (or (== (idx a k) 0) (== (idx a k) 1))))))
(ghost-fn is_cross ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq int)) (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
             (and (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len a))) (< u (len a)))
                  (or (and (== (idx a u) 1) (== (idx a (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) 0))
                      (and (== (idx a u) 0) (== (idx a (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn no_cross_upto ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq int)) (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (j int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x)))))
             (or (< x u) (and (== x u) (< j i))))
        (not (is_cross g a x j))))))
(ghost-fn min_upto ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (w int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (j int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x)))))
             (and (or (< x u) (and (== x u) (< j i))) (is_cross g a x j)))
        (<= w (get (idx (idx g x) j) 1))))))
(ghost-fn chosen ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq int)) (u int) (i int) (v int) (w int)) bool
  (body (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
             (and (is_cross g a u i)
                  (and (== v (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (== w (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn inside ((edges (seq (tuple int int int))) (a (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((k int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len edges)))
        (and (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx edges k) 0)) (< (get (idx edges k) 0) (len a)))
                  (and (<= 0 (get (idx edges k) 1)) (< (get (idx edges k) 1) (len a))))
             (and (== (idx a (get (idx edges k) 0)) 1) (== (idx a (get (idx edges k) 1)) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn state_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq int)) (edges (seq (tuple int int int))) (count int)) bool
  (body (and (and (and (<= 1 count) (<= count (len g))) (== (len a) (len g)))
             (and (and (bin01 a) (== (idx a 0) 1))
                  (and (and (== (occurrences a 0) (- (len g) count)) (== (len edges) (- count 1)))
                       (and (are_valid_edges g edges) (inside edges a)))))))
(ghost-fn tconn ((es (seq (tuple int int int))) (a (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len a))) (== (idx a x) 1)) (edges_connected es 0 x)))))
(ghost-fn extends ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (other (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (exists ((rest (seq (tuple int int int))))
    (and (is_spanning_tree g (concat es rest)) (<= (total_weight (concat es rest)) (total_weight other))))))
(ghost-fn good ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int)))) (=> (is_spanning_tree g other) (extends g es other)))))
(ghost-fn simple ((p (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((i int) (k int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (< k (len p))) (!= (idx p i) (idx p k))))))
(ghost-fn swp ((es0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (rest (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (r int)) (seq (tuple int int int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len rest))))
  (body (concat (concat es0 (seq-lit e)) (concat (take rest r) (drop rest (+ r 1))))))
(ghost-fn npos ((l0 int) (r int) (t1 int)) int
  (body (if (< t1 l0) t1 (if (< t1 (+ l0 r)) (+ t1 1) t1))))
(ghost-fn opos ((l0 int) (r int) (k int)) int
  (body (if (< k l0) k (if (<= k (+ l0 r)) (- k 1) k))))
(lemma occ_pos (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))) (> (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (ensures (exists ((j int)) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (== (idx s j) x))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (== k 0)
      (call law_occurrences_none s x)
      (block
        (call law_take_step s (- k 1))
        (call law_occurrences_concat (take s (- k 1)) (seq-lit (idx s (- k 1))) x)
        (call law_occurrences_unit (idx s (- k 1)) x)
        (if (== (idx s (- k 1)) x)
          (assert (== (idx s (- k 1)) x))
          (call occ_pos s x (- k 1)))))))
(lemma cross_on_path (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (== (len a) (len g)) (bin01 a) (path_follows_graph g p)
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len p)))
            (and (<= 0 (idx p k)) (< (idx p k) (len g)))
            (== (idx a (idx p k)) 1)
            (and (<= 0 (idx p (- (len p) 1))) (< (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (len g)))
            (== (idx a (idx p (- (len p) 1))) 0))
  (ensures (exists ((j int))
    (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1)))
         (and (and (<= 0 (idx p j)) (< (idx p j) (len g)))
              (and (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1)))
                   (and (and (<= 0 (idx p (+ j 1))) (< (idx p (+ j 1)) (len g)))
                        (and (== (idx a (idx p j)) 1) (== (idx a (idx p (+ j 1))) 0))))))))
  (decreases (- (len p) k))
  (body
    (assert (< k (- (len p) 1)))
    (assert (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
    (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g (idx p k)))))
                           (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p k)) e) 0) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (idx p (+ k 1))) (< (idx p (+ k 1)) (len g))))
    (if (== (idx a (idx p (+ k 1))) 1)
      (call cross_on_path g a p (+ k 1))
      (assert (== (idx a (idx p (+ k 1))) 0)))))
(lemma some_cross (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (a (seq int)))
  (requires (graph_is_connected g) (targets_ok g) (== (len a) (len g)) (> (len g) 0)
            (bin01 a) (== (idx a 0) 1) (> (occurrences a 0) 0))
  (ensures (not (no_cross_upto g a (len g) 0)))
  (body
    (call law_take_all a)
    (call occ_pos a 0 (len a))
    (obtain ((x int)) (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len a))) (== (idx a x) 0)))
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 x))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x)))
                                 (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (call cross_on_path g a p 0)
    (obtain ((j int))
      (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1)))
           (and (and (<= 0 (idx p j)) (< (idx p j) (len g)))
                (and (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1)))
                     (and (and (<= 0 (idx p (+ j 1))) (< (idx p (+ j 1)) (len g)))
                          (and (== (idx a (idx p j)) 1) (== (idx a (idx p (+ j 1))) 0)))))))
    (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len (idx g (idx p j)))))
                           (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p j)) e) 0) (idx p (+ j 1)))))
    (assert (is_cross g a (idx p j) e))))
(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))
(lemma one_pt (params (a (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (bin01 a) (== (occurrences a 0) 0) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len a))))
  (ensures (== (idx a x) 1))
  (body
    (call law_take_all a)
    (call count_member a x (len a))
    (assert (or (== (idx a x) 0) (== (idx a x) 1)))))
(lemma all_one (params (a (seq int)))
  (requires (bin01 a) (== (occurrences a 0) 0))
  (ensures (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len a))) (== (idx a x) 1))))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call one_pt a x))))
(lemma conn_intro (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (> (len p) 0) (path_follows_edges es p))
  (ensures (edges_connected es (idx p 0) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
  (body))
(lemma es_from (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (m int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges es p) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (- (len p) 1))) (== (idx p m) x) (== (idx p (+ m 1)) y))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es x y))
  (body (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p m) (idx p (+ m 1))))))
(lemma es_sym (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (edge_in_set es u v))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es v u))
  (body
    (obtain ((t1 int)) (and (and (<= 0 t1) (< t1 (len es)))
                            (or (and (== (get (idx es t1) 0) u) (== (get (idx es t1) 1) v))
                                (and (== (get (idx es t1) 0) v) (== (get (idx es t1) 1) u)))))
    (assert (and (and (<= 0 t1) (< t1 (len es)))
                 (or (and (== (get (idx es t1) 0) v) (== (get (idx es t1) 1) u))
                     (and (== (get (idx es t1) 0) u) (== (get (idx es t1) 1) v)))))))
(lemma es_pre (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (edge_in_set es u v))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (concat es s2) u v))
  (body
    (obtain ((t1 int)) (and (and (<= 0 t1) (< t1 (len es)))
                            (or (and (== (get (idx es t1) 0) u) (== (get (idx es t1) 1) v))
                                (and (== (get (idx es t1) 0) v) (== (get (idx es t1) 1) u)))))
    (assert (== (len (concat es s2)) (+ (len es) (len s2))))
    (assert (== (idx (concat es s2) t1) (idx es t1)))))
(lemma es_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (targets_ok g) (are_valid_edges g es) (edge_in_set es u v))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (body
    (obtain ((t1 int)) (and (and (<= 0 t1) (< t1 (len es)))
                            (or (and (== (get (idx es t1) 0) u) (== (get (idx es t1) 1) v))
                                (and (== (get (idx es t1) 0) v) (== (get (idx es t1) 1) u)))))
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx es t1) 0) (get (idx es t1) 1) (get (idx es t1) 2)))
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx es t1) 0)) (< (get (idx es t1) 0) (len g)))
                                (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g (get (idx es t1) 0))))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g (get (idx es t1) 0)) i) 0) (get (idx es t1) 1))
                                (== (get (idx (idx g (get (idx es t1) 0)) i) 1) (get (idx es t1) 2)))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g (get (idx es t1) 0)) i) 0))
                 (< (get (idx (idx g (get (idx es t1) 0)) i) 0) (len g))))))
(lemma edge_conn1 (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (edge_in_set es u v))
  (ensures (edges_connected es u v))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-build 2 (fn (z) (if (== z 0) u v))))
    (assert (== (len p) 2))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) u))
    (assert (== (idx p 1) v))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es p))
    (call conn_intro es p)))
(lemma conn_refl (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int))
  (ensures (edges_connected es x x))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-build 1 (fn (z) x)))
    (assert (== (len p) 1))
    (assert (== (idx p 0) x))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es p))
    (call conn_intro es p)))
(lemma rev_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges es p) (== (len q) (len p)) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len q) 1)))
            (== (idx q k) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) k)))
            (== (idx q (+ k 1)) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) (+ k 1)))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (assert (== (+ (- (- (len p) 1) (+ k 1)) 1) (- (- (len p) 1) k)))
    (call es_from es p (- (- (len p) 1) (+ k 1)) (idx q (+ k 1)) (idx q k))
    (call es_sym es (idx q (+ k 1)) (idx q k))))
(lemma conn_sym (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (edges_connected es x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected es y x))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (seq-build (len p) (fn (z) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) z)))))
    (forall ((k int)) (call rev_step es p q k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es q))
    (call conn_intro es q)
    (assert (== (idx q 0) y))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) x))))
(lemma cat_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p1 (seq int)) (p2 (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges es p1) (path_follows_edges es p2) (> (len p1) 0) (> (len p2) 0)
            (== (idx p1 (- (len p1) 1)) (idx p2 0))
            (== (len q) (- (+ (len p1) (len p2)) 1))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len q) 1)))
            (== (idx q k) (if (< k (len p1)) (idx p1 k) (idx p2 (+ (- k (len p1)) 1))))
            (== (idx q (+ k 1)) (if (< (+ k 1) (len p1)) (idx p1 (+ k 1)) (idx p2 (+ (- (+ k 1) (len p1)) 1)))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (if (< (+ k 1) (len p1))
      (call es_from es p1 k (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1)))
      (if (== (+ k 1) (len p1))
        (call es_from es p2 0 (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1)))
        (call es_from es p2 (+ (- k (len p1)) 1) (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1)))))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int) (z int))
  (requires (edges_connected es x y) (edges_connected es y z))
  (ensures (edges_connected es x z))
  (body
    (obtain ((p1 (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p1) 0) (and (== (idx p1 0) x) (== (idx p1 (- (len p1) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges es p1)))
    (obtain ((p2 (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p2) 0) (and (== (idx p2 0) y) (== (idx p2 (- (len p2) 1)) z))) (path_follows_edges es p2)))
    (ghost-let q (seq int) (seq-build (- (+ (len p1) (len p2)) 1)
      (fn (w) (if (< w (len p1)) (idx p1 w) (idx p2 (+ (- w (len p1)) 1))))))
    (forall ((k int)) (call cat_step es p1 p2 q k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es q))
    (call conn_intro es q)
    (assert (== (idx q 0) x))
    (assert (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) z))))
(lemma mono_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges es p) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (concat es s2) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (call es_from es p k (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))
    (call es_pre es s2 (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
(lemma conn_mono (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (s2 (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (edges_connected es x y))
  (ensures (edges_connected (concat es s2) x y))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call mono_step es s2 p k))
    (assert (path_follows_edges (concat es s2) p))
    (call conn_intro (concat es s2) p)))
(lemma edge_link (params (es0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (e (tuple int int int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (or (and (== (get e 0) u) (== (get e 1) v)) (and (== (get e 0) v) (== (get e 1) u))))
  (ensures (edges_connected (concat es0 (seq-lit e)) u v))
  (body
    (assert (== (len (concat es0 (seq-lit e))) (+ (len es0) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx (concat es0 (seq-lit e)) (len es0)) e))
    (assert (edge_in_set (concat es0 (seq-lit e)) u v))
    (call edge_conn1 (concat es0 (seq-lit e)) u v)))
(lemma tconn_pt (params (es0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a0 (seq int)) (a1 (seq int)) (ov int) (nv int) (e (tuple int int int)) (x int))
  (requires (tconn es0 a0) (and (<= 0 ov) (< ov (len a0))) (== (idx a0 ov) 1)
            (edges_connected (concat es0 (seq-lit e)) ov nv)
            (== (len a1) (len a0))
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len a1))) (== (idx a1 x) 1)
            (or (== x nv) (== (idx a1 x) (idx a0 x))))
  (ensures (edges_connected (concat es0 (seq-lit e)) 0 x))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected es0 0 ov))
    (call conn_mono es0 (seq-lit e) 0 ov)
    (if (== x nv)
      (call conn_trans (concat es0 (seq-lit e)) 0 ov nv)
      (block
        (assert (edges_connected es0 0 x))
        (call conn_mono es0 (seq-lit e) 0 x)))))
(lemma tconn_step (params (es0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a0 (seq int)) (a1 (seq int)) (ov int) (nv int) (e (tuple int int int)))
  (requires (tconn es0 a0) (== (len a1) (len a0))
                        (and (<= 0 ov) (< ov (len a0))) (== (idx a0 ov) 1)
            (and (<= 0 nv) (< nv (len a0))) (== (idx a1 nv) 1)
            (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len a0))) (!= y nv)) (== (idx a1 y) (idx a0 y))))
            (or (and (== (get e 0) ov) (== (get e 1) nv)) (and (== (get e 0) nv) (== (get e 1) ov))))
  (ensures (tconn (concat es0 (seq-lit e)) a1))
  (body
    (call edge_link es0 e ov nv)
    (forall ((x int)) (call tconn_pt es0 a0 a1 ov nv e x))))
(lemma span_pt (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (a (seq int)) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (tconn es a) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len a))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len a))) (== (idx a u) 1) (== (idx a v) 1))
  (ensures (edges_connected es u v))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected es 0 u))
    (assert (edges_connected es 0 v))
    (call conn_sym es 0 u)
    (call conn_trans es u 0 v)))
(lemma span_final (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (a (seq int)))
  (requires (tconn es a) (== (len a) (len g))
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len a))) (== (idx a x) 1))))
  (ensures (is_spanning g es))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call span_pt es a u v))))
(lemma chain (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (q (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len q)))
            (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k m)) (edges_connected es (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))))
  (ensures (edges_connected es (idx q 0) (idx q m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (== m 0)
      (call conn_refl es (idx q 0))
      (block
        (call chain es q (- m 1))
        (assert (edges_connected es (idx q (- m 1)) (idx q m)))
        (call conn_trans es (idx q 0) (idx q (- m 1)) (idx q m))))))
(lemma short_step (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (i1 int) (i2 int) (k int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges es p) (and (and (<= 0 i1) (< i1 i2)) (< i2 (len p))) (== (idx p i1) (idx p i2))
            (== (len q) (- (len p) (- i2 i1)))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len q) 1)))
            (== (idx q k) (if (<= k i1) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k (- i2 i1)))))
            (== (idx q (+ k 1)) (if (<= (+ k 1) i1) (idx p (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ (+ k 1) (- i2 i1))))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (if (< k i1)
      (call es_from es p k (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1)))
      (if (== k i1)
        (call es_from es p i2 (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1)))
        (call es_from es p (+ k (- i2 i1)) (idx q k) (idx q (+ k 1)))))))
(lemma simple_path (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (> (len p) 0) (path_follows_edges es p))
  (ensures (exists ((sq (seq int)))
    (and (and (and (> (len sq) 0) (== (idx sq 0) (idx p 0))) (== (idx sq (- (len sq) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1))))
         (and (path_follows_edges es sq) (simple sq)))))
  (decreases (len p))
  (body
    (if (simple p)
      (block)
      (block
        (obtain ((i1 int)) (exists ((i3 int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 i1) (< i1 i3)) (< i3 (len p))) (== (idx p i1) (idx p i3)))))

      (=> (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (== (len (idx f u)) n))))))

(ghost-fn flow_domain
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (and
    (== n (len g))
    (and
      (flow_shape f n)
      (and
        (forall ((u int) (v int))
          (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
              (and
                (and (<= 0 (idx (idx f u) v)) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) 100000))
                (=> (not (exists ((c int)) (has_capacity g u v c)))
                    (== (idx (idx f u) v) 0)))))
        (forall ((u int) (i int))
          (=> (and
                (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (< u n))
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
                  (and
                    (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                    (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) n))))
              (and
                (<= 0 (idx (idx f u) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
                (<= (idx (idx f u) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                    (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))))))))

(ghost-fn edge_before ((a int) (j int) (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body (or (< a u) (and (== a u) (< j i)))))

(ghost-fn prefix_same
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (a (seq (seq int)))
   (b (seq (seq int)))
   (u int)
   (i int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (j int))
    (=> (and
          (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
               (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x)))))
          (edge_before x j u i))
        (== (get_flow a x (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0))
            (get_flow b x (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0)))))))

(ghost-fn search_result
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (base (seq (seq int)))
   (u int)
   (i int)
   (s int)
   (t int)
   (found bool)
   (best int)) bool
  (body (and
    (forall ((candidate (seq (seq int))))
      (=> (and
            (and
              (flow_domain g candidate (len g))
              (prefix_same g candidate base u i))
            (is_conserved g candidate s t))
          (and found (>= best (flow_val g candidate s)))))
    (=> found
        (exists ((candidate (seq (seq int))))
          (and
            (and
              (and
                (flow_domain g candidate (len g))
                (prefix_same g candidate base u i))
              (is_conserved g candidate s t))
            (== (flow_val g candidate s) best)))))))

(ghost-fn scan_result
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (base (seq (seq int)))
   (u int)
   (i int)
   (limit int)
   (s int)
   (t int)
   (found bool)
   (best int)) bool
  (body (and
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and
      (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
      (and
        (forall ((candidate (seq (seq int))))
          (=> (and
                (and
                  (and
                    (flow_domain g candidate (len g))
                    (prefix_same g candidate base u i))
                  (< (get_flow candidate u
                        (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                     limit))
                (is_conserved g candidate s t))
              (and found (>= best (flow_val g candidate s)))))
        (=> found
            (exists ((candidate (seq (seq int))))
              (and
                (and
                  (and
                    (and
                      (flow_domain g candidate (len g))
                      (prefix_same g candidate base u i))
                    (< (get_flow candidate u
                          (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                       limit))
                  (is_conserved g candidate s t))
                (== (flow_val g candidate s) best)))))))))

(ghost-fn matrix_change
  ((old (seq (seq int)))
   (new (seq (seq int)))
   (n int)
   (u int)
   (v int)
   (x int)) bool
  (body (and
    (and (flow_shape old n) (flow_shape new n))
    (forall ((a int) (b int))
      (=> (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
          (== (idx (idx new a) b)
              (if (and (== a u) (== b v))
                  x
                  (idx (idx old a) b))))))))

(ghost-fn choose_found ((a bool) (b bool)) bool
  (body (or a b)))

(ghost-fn choose_best
  ((af bool) (av int) (bf bool) (bv int)) int
  (body (if (and bf (or (not af) (> bv av))) bv av)))

(ghost-fn conserved_prefix
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (f (seq (seq int)))
   (s int)
   (t int)
   (k int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int))
    (=> (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u k))
          (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
        (== (total_flow_in g f u) (total_flow_out g f u))))))

(ghost-fn edge_tail
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int)) int
  (decreases (- (len g) u))
  (body
    (if (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
        (+ (len (idx g u)) (+ 1 (edge_tail g (+ u 1))))
        0)))

(ghost-fn work_left
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int)) int
  (body
    (if (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
          (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len (idx g u)))))
        (+ (- (len (idx g u)) i)
           (+ 1 (edge_tail g (+ u 1))))
        0)))

(ghost-fn normalized
  ((f (seq (seq int))) (n int)) (seq (seq int))
  (requires (>= n 0))
  (body
    (seq-build n
      (fn (u)
        (seq-build n
          (fn (v) (get_flow f u v)))))))

(lemma domain_change
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (old (seq (seq int)))
    (new (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (u int)
    (i int)
    (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (capacities_bounded g)
    (== n (len g))
    (flow_domain g old n)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
    (matrix_change old new n u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) x))
  (ensures
    (flow_domain g new n)
    (prefix_same g new old u i)
    (== (get_flow new u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) x))
  (body
    (assert (flow_shape new n))
    (assert (flow_domain g new n))
    (assert (prefix_same g new old u i))))

(lemma prefix_chain
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq (seq int)))
    (b (seq (seq int)))
    (c (seq (seq int)))
    (u int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (prefix_same g a b u i)
    (prefix_same g b c u i))
  (ensures (prefix_same g a c u i))
  (body))

(lemma scan_empty
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (u int)
    (i int)
    (s int)
    (t int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (scan_result g base u i 0 s t false 0))
  (body))

(lemma scan_add
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (branch (seq (seq int)))
    (u int)
    (i int)
    (x int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (old_found bool)
    (old_best int)
    (branch_found bool)
    (branch_best int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (prefix_same g branch base u i)
    (== (get_flow branch u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) x)
    (scan_result g base u i x s t old_found old_best)
    (search_result g branch u (+ i 1) s t branch_found branch_best))
  (ensures
    (scan_result
      g base u i (+ x 1) s t
      (choose_found old_found branch_found)
      (choose_best old_found old_best branch_found branch_best)))
  (body))

(lemma scan_complete
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (u int)
    (i int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (found bool)
    (best int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (scan_result
      g base u i
      (+ (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 1)
      s t found best))
  (ensures (search_result g base u i s t found best))
  (body))

(lemma row_complete
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (out (seq (seq int)))
    (u int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (found bool)
    (best int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (prefix_same g out base (+ u 1) 0)
    (search_result g base (+ u 1) 0 s t found best))
  (ensures
    (prefix_same g out base u (len (idx g u)))
    (search_result g base u (len (idx g u)) s t found best))
  (body))

(lemma leaf_complete
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (ok bool)
    (amount int))
  (requires
    (flow_domain g base (len g))
    (== ok (is_conserved g base s t))
    (== amount (flow_val g base s)))
  (ensures
    (search_result g base (len g) 0 s t ok amount))
  (body
    (assert (prefix_same g base base (len g) 0))
    (if ok
      (assert
        (exists ((candidate (seq (seq int))))
          (and
            (and
              (and
                (flow_domain g candidate (len g))
                (prefix_same g candidate base (len g) 0))
              (is_conserved g candidate s t))
            (== (flow_val g candidate s) amount))))
      (block))
    (assert (search_result g base (len g) 0 s t ok amount))))

(lemma domain_respects
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (flow_domain g f (len g)))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f))
  (body))

(lemma domain_nonnegative
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (flow_domain g f (len g)))
  (ensures
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (=> (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f)))
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
          (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0))))
  (body))

(lemma domain_is_valid
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (s int)
    (t int))
  (requires
    (flow_domain g f (len g))
    (is_conserved g f s t))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (body
    (call domain_respects g f)
    (call domain_nonnegative g f)
    (assert (is_valid_flow g f s t))))

(lemma normalized_get
  (params
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (u int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures
    (== (get_flow (normalized f n) u v)
        (get_flow f u v)))
  (body))

(lemma normalized_out
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (u int)
    (k int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g (normalized f n) u k)
        (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call normalized_out g f n u (- k 1))
        (call normalized_get
          f n u
          (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)))
      (block))))

(lemma normalized_in
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (u int)
    (k int))
  (requires
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures
    (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g (normalized f n) u k)
        (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call normalized_in g f n u (- k 1))
        (call normalized_get f n (- k 1) u))
      (block))))

(lemma normalized_out_full
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (u int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
  (ensures
    (== (total_flow_out g (normalized f n) u)
        (total_flow_out g f u)))
  (body
    (call normalized_out g f n u (len (idx g u)))))

(lemma normalized_in_full
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (u int))
  (requires
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)))
  (ensures
    (== (total_flow_in g (normalized f n) u)
        (total_flow_in g f u)))
  (body
    (call normalized_in g f n u n)))

(lemma normalized_properties
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (capacities_bounded g)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
    (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (ensures
    (flow_domain g (normalized f n) n)
    (is_conserved g (normalized f n) s t)
    (== (flow_val g (normalized f n) s)
        (flow_val g f s)))
  (body
    (forall ((u int))
      (call normalized_out_full g f n u))
    (forall ((u int))
      (call normalized_in_full g f n u))
    (assert (flow_domain g (normalized f n) n))
    (assert (is_conserved g (normalized f n) s t))
    (assert
      (== (flow_val g (normalized f n) s)
          (flow_val g f s)))))

(lemma conclude_maximum
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (best int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (capacities_bounded g)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
    (search_result g base 0 0 s t true best))
  (ensures
    (exists ((f (seq (seq int))))
      (and
        (is_max_flow g f s t)
        (== (flow_val g f s) best))))
  (body
    (obtain ((winner (seq (seq int))))
      (and
        (and
          (and
            (flow_domain g winner n)
            (prefix_same g winner base 0 0))
          (is_conserved g winner s t))
        (== (flow_val g winner s) best)))
    (call domain_is_valid g winner s t)
    (forall ((other (seq (seq int))))
      (call normalized_properties g other n s t))
    (assert (is_max_flow g winner s t))))

(lemma task_graph_facts
  (params (cg capacity_graph))
  (requires
    (well_formed cg)
    (capacities_bounded (view cg)))
  (ensures
    (graph_ok (view cg))
    (capacities_bounded (view cg)))
  (body))

(lemma outgoing_step_fits
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (u int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (capacities_bounded g)
    (== n (len g))
    (flow_domain g f n)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (in_i64
      (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u j)
         (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)))))
  (body))

(lemma incoming_step_fits
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (u int)
    (k int))
  (requires
    (capacities_bounded g)
    (== n (len g))
    (flow_domain g f n)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 k) (< k n)))
  (ensures
    (in_i64
      (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u k)
         (get_flow f k u))))
  (body))

(lemma flow_difference_fits
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (capacities_bounded g)
    (== n (len g))
    (flow_domain g f n)
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures
    (in_i64
      (- (total_flow_out g f s)
         (total_flow_in g f s))))
  (body))

(lemma conserved_prefix_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (u int)
    (old bool)
    (incoming int)
    (outgoing int))
  (requires
    (== old (conserved_prefix g f s t u))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (== incoming (total_flow_in g f u))
    (== outgoing (total_flow_out g f u)))
  (ensures
    (==
      (and old
        (or (or (== u s) (== u t)) (== incoming outgoing)))
      (conserved_prefix g f s t (+ u 1))))
  (body))

(spec inspect_candidate
  (params
    (graph_edges (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (flows (ref (slice (vec i64))))
    (n i64)
    (s i64)
    (t i64))
  (returns (ok bool) (amount i64))
  (requires
    (graph_ok graph_edges)
    (capacities_bounded graph_edges)
    (== n (len graph_edges))
    (flow_domain graph_edges flows n)
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)))
  (ensures
    (== ok (is_conserved graph_edges flows s t))
    (== amount (flow_val graph_edges flows s)))
  (effects))

(def inspect_candidate
  (body
    (let-mut ok bool true)
    (let-mut amount i64 0)
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (== ok (conserved_prefix graph_edges flows s t u)))
      (invariant
        (if (< s u)
          (== amount (flow_val graph_edges flows s))
          (== amount 0)))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let-mut outgoing i64 0)
      (let-mut j i64 0)
      (while (< j (len (idx graph_edges u)))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 j) (<= j (len (idx graph_edges u)))))
        (invariant
          (== outgoing
              (sum_flow_out_recursive graph_edges flows u j)))
        (decreases (- (len (idx graph_edges u)) j))
        (let v i64 (get (idx (idx graph_edges u) j) 0))
        (call outgoing_step_fits graph_edges flows n u j)
        (set outgoing (+ outgoing (idx (idx flows u) v)))
        (set j (+ j 1)))
      (let-mut incoming i64 0)
      (let-mut k i64 0)
      (while (< k n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
        (invariant
          (== incoming
              (sum_flow_in_recursive graph_edges flows u k)))
        (decreases (- n k))
        (call incoming_step_fits graph_edges flows n u k)
        (set incoming (+ incoming (idx (idx flows k) u)))
        (set k (+ k 1)))
      (ghost-let old_ok bool ok)
      (set ok
        (and ok
          (or (or (== u s) (== u t)) (== incoming outgoing))))
      (call conserved_prefix_step
        graph_edges flows s t u old_ok incoming outgoing)
      (if (== u s)
        (block
          (call flow_difference_fits graph_edges flows n s)
          (set amount (- outgoing incoming)))
        (block))
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (return ok amount)))

(spec flow_search
  (params
    (graph_edges (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (flow (vec (vec i64)))
    (u i64)
    (i i64)
    (n i64)
    (s i64)
    (t i64))
  (returns
    (out_flow (vec (vec i64)))
    (found bool)
    (best i64))
  (requires
    (graph_ok graph_edges)
    (capacities_bounded graph_edges)
    (== n (len graph_edges))
    (flow_domain graph_edges flow n)
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
    (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n))
    (=> (< u n)
        (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len (idx graph_edges u))))))
  (ensures
    (flow_domain graph_edges out_flow n)
    (prefix_same graph_edges out_flow flow u i)
    (search_result graph_edges flow u i s t found best))
  (effects))

(def flow_search
  (decreases (work_left graph_edges u i))
  (body
    (let-mut work (vec (vec i64)) flow)
    (if (== u n)
      (block
        (let ((valid bool) (value i64))
          (call inspect_candidate graph_edges (borrow work) n s t))
        (call leaf_complete graph_edges flow s t valid value)
        (return work valid value))
      (if (== i (len (idx graph_edges u)))
        (block
          (let
            ((next (vec (vec i64))) (next_found bool) (next_best i64))
            (call flow_search graph_edges work (+ u 1) 0 n s t))
          (call row_complete
            graph_edges flow next u s t next_found next_best)
          (return next next_found next_best))
        (block
          (let target i64 (get (idx (idx graph_edges u) i) 0))
          (let capacity i64 (get (idx (idx graph_edges u) i) 1))
          (let-mut any bool false)
          (let-mut best_value i64 0)
          (let-mut x i64 0)
          (call scan_empty graph_edges flow u i s t)
          (while (<= x capacity)
            (invariant (and (<= 0 x) (<= x (+ capacity 1))))
            (invariant (flow_domain graph_edges work n))
            (invariant (prefix_same graph_edges work flow u i))
            (invariant
              (scan_result
                graph_edges flow u i x s t any best_value))
            (decreases (+ (- capacity x) 1))
            (ghost-let prior (seq (seq int)) work)
            (set-idx (idx work u) target x)
            (assert (matrix_change prior work n u target x))
            (call domain_change graph_edges prior work n u i x)
            (call prefix_chain graph_edges work prior flow u i)
            (ghost-let branch (seq (seq int)) work)
            (let
              ((next_work (vec (vec i64)))
               (branch_found bool)
               (branch_best i64))
              (call flow_search
                graph_edges work u (+ i 1) n s t))
            (set work next_work)
            (call prefix_chain graph_edges work branch flow u i)
            (ghost-let old_found bool any)
            (ghost-let old_best int best_value)
            (if
              (and branch_found
                (or (not any) (> branch_best best_value)))
              (set best_value branch_best)
              (block))
            (if branch_found (set any true) (block))
            (call scan_add
              graph_edges flow branch u i x s t
              old_found old_best branch_found branch_best)
            (set x (+ x 1)))
          (call scan_complete

    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq (seq int)))
    (b (seq (seq int)))
    (s int)
    (t int))
  (requires
    (flow_domain g a (len g))
    (flow_domain g b (len g))
    (prefix_same g a b (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))))
  (ensures
    (== (is_conserved g a s t) (is_conserved g b s t))
    (== (flow_val g a s) (flow_val g b s)))
  (body
    (forall ((u int))
      (call full_prefix_out g a b u (len (idx g u))))
    (forall ((u int))
      (call full_prefix_in g a b u (len g)))))

(lemma leaf_complete
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (ok bool)
    (amount int))
  (requires
    (flow_domain g base (len g))
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g)))
    (== ok (is_conserved g base s t))
    (== amount (flow_val g base s)))
  (ensures
    (search_result g base (len g) 0 s t ok amount))
  (body
    (assert (prefix_same g base base (len g) 0))
    (forall ((candidate (seq (seq int))))
      (call full_prefix_properties g candidate base s t))
    (if ok
      (assert
        (exists ((candidate (seq (seq int))))
          (and
            (and
              (and
                (flow_domain g candidate (len g))
                (prefix_same g candidate base (len g) 0))
              (is_conserved g candidate s t))
            (== (flow_val g candidate s) amount))))
      (block))))

(lemma domain_respects
  (params

  (body))

(lemma domain_nonnegative
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (flow_domain g f (len g)))
  (ensures
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (=> (and
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f)))
            (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
          (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0))))
  (body))

(lemma domain_is_valid
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (s int)
    (t int))
  (requires
    (flow_domain g f (len g))
    (is_conserved g f s t))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (body
    (call domain_respects g f)
    (call domain_nonnegative g f)
    (assert (is_valid_flow g f s t))))

(lemma normalized_cell
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (u int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (capacities_bounded g)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
    (is_valid_flow g f s t)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (domain_cell g (normalized f n) n u v))
  (body
    (call normalized_get f n u v)
    (if (> (get_flow f u v) 0)
      (block
        (assert (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (get_flow f u v) c))))
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (get_flow f u v) c))))
      (block))))

(lemma normalized_edge
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (u int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (capacities_bounded g)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
    (is_valid_flow g f s t)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (domain_edge g (normalized f n) u i))
  (body
    (call normalized_get f n u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (if (> (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) 0)
      (block
        (assert
          (exists ((c int))
            (and
              (has_capacity g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) c)
              (<= (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) c))))
        (obtain ((c int))
          (and
            (has_capacity g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) c)
            (<= (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) c)))
        (obtain ((j int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
              (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)
                  (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
              (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1) c)))))
      (block))))

(lemma normalized_out
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (u int)
    (k int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g (normalized f n) u k)
        (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call normalized_out g f n u (- k 1))
        (call normalized_get
          f n u
          (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)))
      (block))))

  (decreases k)

        (call normalized_in g f n u (- k 1))

  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

  (requires

(lemma normalized_properties
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (capacities_bounded g)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
    (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (ensures
    (flow_domain g (normalized f n) n)
    (is_conserved g (normalized f n) s t)
    (== (flow_val g (normalized f n) s)
        (flow_val g f s)))
  (body
    (call normalized_shape f n)
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (call normalized_cell g f n s t u v))
    (forall ((u int) (i int))
      (call normalized_edge g f n s t u i))
    (assert (flow_domain g (normalized f n) n))
    (forall ((u int))
      (call normalized_out_full g f n u))
    (forall ((u int))
      (call normalized_in_full g f n u))
    (assert (is_conserved g (normalized f n) s t))
    (assert
      (== (flow_val g (normalized f n) s)
          (flow_val g f s)))))

(lemma conclude_maximum
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (best int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (capacities_bounded g)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
    (search_result g base 0 0 s t true best))
  (ensures
    (exists ((f (seq (seq int))))
      (and
        (is_max_flow g f s t)
        (== (flow_val g f s) best))))
  (body
    (obtain ((winner (seq (seq int))))
      (and
        (and
          (and
            (flow_domain g winner n)
            (prefix_same g winner base 0 0))
          (is_conserved g winner s t))
        (== (flow_val g winner s) best)))
    (call domain_is_valid g winner s t)
    (forall ((other (seq (seq int))))
      (call normalized_properties g other n s t))
    (assert (is_max_flow g winner s t))))

(lemma outgoing_prefix_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (u int)
    (k int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)

    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))

    (and
      (<= 0 (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k))
      (<= (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k) (* 100000 k))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (call outgoing_prefix_bound g f n u (- k 1))

(lemma outgoing_step_fits
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (u int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)

    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (in_i64
      (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u j)
         (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)))))
  (body
    (call outgoing_prefix_bound g f n u (+ j 1))

(lemma flow_difference_fits
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int)
    (s int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (capacities_bounded g)
    (== n (len g))
    (flow_domain g f n)
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures
    (in_i64
      (- (total_flow_out g f s)
         (total_flow_in g f s))))
  (body
    (call row_length_bound g s)
    (call outgoing_prefix_bound g f n s (len (idx g s)))
    (call incoming_prefix_bound g f n s n)))

(lemma conserved_prefix_step
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (s int)
    (t int)
    (u int)
    (old bool)
    (incoming int)
    (outgoing int))
  (requires
    (== old (conserved_prefix g f s t u))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (== incoming (total_flow_in g f u))
    (== outgoing (total_flow_out g f u)))
  (ensures
    (==
      (and old
        (or (or (== u s) (== u t)) (== incoming outgoing)))
      (conserved_prefix g f s t (+ u 1))))
  (body))

(lemma work_edge_decreases
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (work_left g u (+ i 1)))
      (< (work_left g u (+ i 1)) (work_left g u i))))
  (body
    (assert
      (==
        (work_left g u i)
        (+ (- (len (idx g u)) i)
           (+ 1 (edge_tail g (+ u 1))))))
    (assert
      (==
        (work_left g u (+ i 1))
        (+ (- (len (idx g u)) (+ i 1))
           (+ 1 (edge_tail g (+ u 1))))))))

(lemma work_row_decreases
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (work_left g (+ u 1) 0))
      (< (work_left g (+ u 1) 0)
         (work_left g u (len (idx g u))))))
  (body
    (if (< (+ u 1) (len g))
      (block
        (assert
          (==
            (edge_tail g (+ u 1))
            (+ (len (idx g (+ u 1)))
               (+ 1 (edge_tail g (+ u 2))))))
        (assert
          (==
            (work_left g (+ u 1) 0)
            (edge_tail g (+ u 1)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (work_left g (+ u 1) 0) 0))
        (assert (== (edge_tail g (+ u 1)) 0))))))

(spec inspect_candidate
  (params
    (graph_edges (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (flows (ref (slice (vec i64))))
    (n i64)
    (s i64)
    (t i64))
  (returns (ok bool) (amount i64))
  (requires
    (graph_ok graph_edges)
    (capacities_bounded graph_edges)
    (== n (len graph_edges))
    (flow_domain graph_edges flows n)
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)))
  (ensures
    (== ok (is_conserved graph_edges flows s t))
    (== amount (flow_val graph_edges flows s)))
  (effects))

(def inspect_candidate
  (body
    (let-mut ok bool true)
    (let-mut amount i64 0)
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (== ok (conserved_prefix graph_edges flows s t u)))
      (invariant
        (if (< s u)
          (== amount (flow_val graph_edges flows s))
          (== amount 0)))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let-mut outgoing i64 0)
      (let-mut j i64 0)
      (while (< j (len (idx graph_edges u)))
        (invariant (and (<= 0 j) (<= j (len (idx graph_edges u)))))
        (invariant
          (== outgoing
              (sum_flow_out_recursive graph_edges flows u j)))
        (decreases (- (len (idx graph_edges u)) j))
        (let v i64 (get (idx (idx graph_edges u) j) 0))
        (call outgoing_step_fits graph_edges flows n u j)
        (set outgoing (+ outgoing (idx (idx flows u) v)))
        (set j (+ j 1)))
      (let-mut incoming i64 0)
      (let-mut k i64 0)
      (while (< k n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
        (invariant
          (== incoming
              (sum_flow_in_recursive graph_edges flows u k)))
        (decreases (- n k))
        (call incoming_step_fits graph_edges flows n u k)
        (set incoming (+ incoming (idx (idx flows k) u)))
        (set k (+ k 1)))
      (ghost-let old_ok bool ok)
      (set ok
        (and ok
          (or (or (== u s) (== u t)) (== incoming outgoing))))
      (call conserved_prefix_step
        graph_edges flows s t u old_ok incoming outgoing)
      (if (== u s)
        (block
          (call flow_difference_fits graph_edges flows n s)
          (set amount (- outgoing incoming)))
        (block))
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (return ok amount)))

(spec flow_search
  (params
    (graph_edges (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (flow (vec (vec i64)))
    (u i64)
    (i i64)
    (n i64)
    (s i64)
    (t i64))
  (returns
    (out_flow (vec (vec i64)))
    (found bool)
    (best i64))
  (requires
    (graph_ok graph_edges)
    (capacities_bounded graph_edges)
    (== n (len graph_edges))
    (flow_domain graph_edges flow n)
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
    (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n))
    (=> (< u n)
        (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len (idx graph_edges u))))))
  (ensures
    (flow_domain graph_edges out_flow n)
    (prefix_same graph_edges out_flow flow u i)
    (search_result graph_edges flow u i s t found best))
  (effects))

(def flow_search
  (decreases (work_left graph_edges u i))
  (body
    (let-mut work (vec (vec i64)) flow)
    (if (== u n)
      (block
        (let ((valid bool) (value i64))
          (call inspect_candidate graph_edges (borrow work) n s t))
        (call leaf_complete graph_edges flow s t valid value)
        (return work valid value))
      (if (== i (len (idx graph_edges u)))
        (block
          (call work_row_decreases graph_edges u)
          (let
            ((next (vec (vec i64))) (next_found bool) (next_best i64))
            (call flow_search graph_edges work (+ u 1) 0 n s t))
          (call row_complete
            graph_edges flow next u s t next_found next_best)
          (return next next_found next_best))
        (block
          (let target i64 (get (idx (idx graph_edges u) i) 0))
          (let capacity i64 (get (idx (idx graph_edges u) i) 1))
          (let-mut any bool false)
          (let-mut best_value i64 0)
          (let-mut x i64 0)
          (call scan_empty graph_edges flow u i s t)
          (while (<= x capacity)
            (invariant (and (<= 0 x) (<= x (+ capacity 1))))
            (invariant (flow_domain graph_edges work n))
            (invariant (prefix_same graph_edges work flow u i))
            (invariant
              (scan_result
                graph_edges flow u i x s t any best_value))
            (decreases (+ (- capacity x) 1))
            (ghost-let prior (seq (seq int)) work)
            (set-idx (idx work u) target x)
            (assert (matrix_change prior work n u target x))
            (call domain_change graph_edges prior work n u i x)
            (call prefix_chain graph_edges work prior flow u i)
            (ghost-let branch (seq (seq int)) work)
            (call work_edge_decreases graph_edges u i)
            (let
              ((next_work (vec (vec i64)))
               (branch_found bool)
               (branch_best i64))
              (call flow_search

  (params

    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (domain_edge g (normalized f n) u i))
  (body
    (call normalized_get
      f n u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (if
      (> (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) 0)
      (block
        (assert
          (exists ((c int))
            (and
              (has_capacity
                g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) c)
              (<=
                (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                c))))
        (obtain ((c int))
          (and
            (has_capacity
              g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) c)
            (<=
              (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
              c)))
        (obtain ((j int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
              (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
            (and
              (==
                (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)
                (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
              (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1) c))))
        (assert (== j i))
        (assert
          (==
            c
            (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
      (block
        (assert
          (>= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 0))))
    (assert (domain_edge g (normalized f n) u i))))

(lemma normalized_out
  (params

  (ensures
    (exists ((f (seq (seq int))))
      (and
        (is_max_flow g f s t)
        (== (flow_val g f s) best))))
  (body
    (obtain ((winner (seq (seq int))))
      (and
        (and
          (and
            (flow_domain g winner n)
            (prefix_same g winner base 0 0))
          (is_conserved g winner s t))

(spec inspect_candidate
  (params
    (graph_edges (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (flows (ref (slice (vec i64))))
    (n i64)
    (s i64)
    (t i64))
  (returns (ok bool) (amount i64))
  (requires
    (graph_ok graph_edges)
    (capacities_bounded graph_edges)
    (== n (len graph_edges))
    (flow_domain graph_edges flows n)
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)))
  (ensures
    (== ok (is_conserved graph_edges flows s t))
    (== amount (flow_val graph_edges flows s)))
  (effects))

(def inspect_candidate
  (body
    (let-mut ok bool true)
    (let-mut amount i64 0)
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (== ok (conserved_prefix graph_edges flows s t u)))
      (invariant
        (if
          (< s u)
          (== amount (flow_val graph_edges flows s))
          (== amount 0)))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let-mut outgoing i64 0)
      (let-mut j i64 0)
      (while (< j (len (idx graph_edges u)))
        (invariant
          (and
            (<= 0 j)
            (<= j (len (idx graph_edges u)))))
        (invariant
          (==
            outgoing
            (sum_flow_out_recursive graph_edges flows u j)))
        (decreases (- (len (idx graph_edges u)) j))
        (let v i64 (get (idx (idx graph_edges u) j) 0))
        (call outgoing_step_fits graph_edges flows n u j)
        (set outgoing (+ outgoing (idx (idx flows u) v)))
        (set j (+ j 1)))
      (let-mut incoming i64 0)
      (let-mut k i64 0)
      (while (< k n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
        (invariant
          (==
            incoming
            (sum_flow_in_recursive graph_edges flows u k)))
        (decreases (- n k))
        (call incoming_step_fits graph_edges flows n u k)
        (set incoming (+ incoming (idx (idx flows k) u)))
        (set k (+ k 1)))
      (ghost-let old_ok bool ok)
      (set ok
        (and
          ok
          (or
            (or (== u s) (== u t))
            (== incoming outgoing))))
      (call conserved_prefix_step
        graph_edges flows s t u old_ok incoming outgoing)
      (if
        (== u s)
        (block
          (call flow_difference_fits graph_edges flows n s)
          (set amount (- outgoing incoming)))
        (block))
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (return ok amount)))

(spec flow_search
  (params
    (graph_edges (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (flow (vec (vec i64)))

    (flow_domain graph_edges flow n)
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))

    (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n))

  (ensures

  (effects))

(def flow_search
  (decreases (work_left graph_edges u i))
  (body
    (let-mut work (vec (vec i64)) flow)
    (if
      (== u n)
      (block
        (let ((valid bool) (value i64))
          (call inspect_candidate
            graph_edges (borrow work) n s t))
        (call leaf_complete graph_edges flow s t valid value)

          (call work_row_decreases graph_edges u)

            ((next (vec (vec i64)))
             (next_found bool)
             (next_best i64))
            (call flow_search
              graph_edges work (+ u 1) 0 n s t))
          (call row_complete
            graph_edges flow next u s t
            next_found next_best)
          (return next next_found next_best))
        (block
          (let target i64
            (get (idx (idx graph_edges u) i) 0))
          (let capacity i64
            (get (idx (idx graph_edges u) i) 1))
          (let-mut any bool false)
          (let-mut best_value i64 0)
          (let-mut x i64 0)
          (call scan_empty graph_edges flow u i s t)
          (while (<= x capacity)
            (invariant
              (and (<= 0 x) (<= x (+ capacity 1))))
            (invariant (flow_domain graph_edges work n))
            (invariant (prefix_same graph_edges work flow u i))
            (invariant
              (scan_result
                graph_edges flow u i x s t any best_value))
            (decreases (+ (- capacity x) 1))
            (ghost-let prior (seq (seq int)) work)
            (set-idx (idx work u) target x)
            (assert (matrix_change prior work n u target x))
            (call domain_change
              graph_edges prior work n u i x)
            (call prefix_chain
              graph_edges work prior flow u i)
            (ghost-let branch (seq (seq int)) work)
            (call work_edge_decreases graph_edges u i)
            (let
              ((next_work (vec (vec i64)))
               (branch_found bool)
               (branch_best i64))
              (call flow_search
                graph_edges work u (+ i 1) n s t))
            (set work next_work)
            (call prefix_chain
              graph_edges work branch flow u i)
            (ghost-let old_found bool any)
            (ghost-let old_best int best_value)
            (if
              (and
                branch_found
                (or (not any) (> branch_best best_value)))
              (set best_value branch_best)
              (block))
            (if branch_found (set any true) (block))
            (call scan_add
              graph_edges flow branch u i x s t
              old_found old_best branch_found branch_best)
            (set x (+ x 1)))
          (call scan_complete
            graph_edges flow u i s t any best_value)
          (return work any best_value))))))

    (if

              (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v)

        (assert (edge_before u j (len g) 0))
        (assert
          (==
            (get_flow a u v)
            (get_flow b u v))))
      (block
        (assert (domain_cell g a (len g) u v))
        (assert (domain_cell g b (len g) u v))

  (body

    (s (seq int)) (n int) (p int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (injective_bounded s n)
    (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len s)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (remove_at s p))))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (remove_at s p))))
    (!= i j))
  (ensures
    (!= (idx (remove_at s p) i)
        (idx (remove_at s p) j)))
  (body
    (call remove_at_len s p)
    (if
      (< i p)
      (call remove_at_before s p i)
      (call remove_at_after s p i))
    (if
      (< j p)
      (call remove_at_before s p j)
      (call remove_at_after s p j))))

(lemma removed_injective
  (params (s (seq int)) (n int) (p int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (injective_bounded s n)
    (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len s)))
    (== (idx s p) (- n 1)))
  (ensures (injective_bounded (remove_at s p) (- n 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((i int))
      (call removed_range_point s n p i))
    (forall ((i int) (j int))
      (call removed_unique_point s n p i j))))

(lemma shrink_range_point
  (params (s (seq int)) (n int) (i int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (injective_bounded s n)
    (not (contains s (- n 1)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))))
  (ensures
    (and (<= 0 (idx s i)) (< (idx s i) (- n 1))))
  (body
    (call law_contains s (- n 1))))

(lemma shrink_injective
  (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (injective_bounded s n)
    (not (contains s (- n 1))))
  (ensures (injective_bounded s (- n 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((i int))
      (call shrink_range_point s n i))))

(lemma injective_bound
  (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (injective_bounded s n))
  (ensures (<= (len s) n))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if
      (== n 0)
      (block
        (if
          (> (len s) 0)
          (assert
            (and
              (<= 0 (idx s 0))
              (< (idx s 0) 0)))
          (block)))
      (if
        (contains s (- n 1))
        (block
          (call law_contains s (- n 1))
          (obtain ((p int))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len s)))
              (== (idx s p) (- n 1))))
          (call removed_injective s n p)
          (call injective_bound (remove_at s p) (- n 1))
          (call remove_at_len s p))
        (block
          (call shrink_injective s n)
          (call injective_bound s (- n 1)))))))

(lemma destinations_len
  (params (row (seq (tuple int int))))
  (ensures (== (len (destinations row)) (len row)))
  (body))

(lemma destinations_at
  (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len row))))
  (ensures
    (== (idx (destinations row) i)
        (get (idx row i) 0)))
  (body))

(lemma graph_row_range
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx (destinations (idx g u)) i))
      (< (idx (destinations (idx g u)) i) (len g))))
  (body
    (call destinations_at (idx g u) i)))

(lemma graph_row_unique
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (i int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u))))
    (!= i j))
  (ensures
    (!= (idx (destinations (idx g u)) i)
        (idx (destinations (idx g u)) j)))
  (body
    (call destinations_at (idx g u) i)
    (call destinations_at (idx g u) j)))

(lemma row_length_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (<= (len (idx g u)) (len g)))
  (body
    (call destinations_len (idx g u))
    (forall ((i int))
      (call graph_row_range g u i))
    (forall ((i int) (j int))
      (call graph_row_unique g u i j))
    (assert
      (injective_bounded
        (destinations (idx g u))
        (len g)))
    (call injective_bound
      (destinations (idx g u))
      (len g))))

(lemma change_cell
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (old (seq (seq int))) (new (seq (seq int)))
    (n int) (u int) (i int) (x int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (capacities_bounded g)
    (== n (len g))
    (flow_domain g old n)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
    (matrix_change old new n u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) x)
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (domain_cell g new n a b))
  (body
    (if
      (and (== a u) (== b (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
      (block
        (assert
          (has_capacity g u
            (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
            (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
        (assert (== (get_flow new a b) x))
        (assert (domain_cell g new n a b)))
      (block
        (assert
          (== (get_flow new a b) (get_flow old a b)))
        (assert (domain_cell g old n a b))
        (assert (domain_cell g new n a b))))))

(lemma change_edge
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (old (seq (seq int))) (new (seq (seq int)))
    (n int) (u int) (i int) (x int) (a int) (j int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (capacities_bounded g)
    (== n (len g))
    (flow_domain g old n)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
    (matrix_change old new n u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) x)
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
  (ensures (domain_edge g new a j))
  (body
    (if
      (and
        (== a u)
        (==
          (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0)
          (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
      (block
        (assert (== j i))
        (assert
          (==
            (get_flow new a (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
            x))
        (assert (domain_edge g new a j)))
      (block
        (assert
          (==
            (get_flow new a (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
            (get_flow old a (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))))
        (assert (domain_edge g old a j))
        (assert (domain_edge g new a j))))))

(lemma change_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (old (seq (seq int))) (new (seq (seq int)))
    (n int) (u int) (i int) (x int) (a int) (j int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (matrix_change old new n u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) x)
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a))))
    (edge_before a j u i))
  (ensures
    (==
      (get_flow new a (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
      (get_flow old a (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))))
  (body
    (if
      (== a u)
      (assert
        (!=
          (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0)
          (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
      (block))))

(lemma domain_change
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (old (seq (seq int))) (new (seq (seq int)))
    (n int) (u int) (i int) (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (capacities_bounded g)
    (== n (len g))
    (flow_domain g old n)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
    (matrix_change old new n u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) x))
  (ensures
    (flow_domain g new n)
    (prefix_same g new old u i)
    (==
      (get_flow new u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
      x))
  (body
    (forall ((a int) (b int))
      (call change_cell g old new n u i x a b))
    (forall ((a int) (j int))
      (call change_edge g old new n u i x a j))
    (forall ((a int) (j int))
      (call change_prefix g old new n u i x a j))
    (assert (flow_domain g new n))
    (assert (prefix_same g new old u i))
    (assert
      (==
        (get_flow new u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
        x))))

(lemma prefix_chain
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq (seq int))) (b (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (i int))
  (requires
    (prefix_same g a b u i)
    (prefix_same g b c u i))
  (ensures (prefix_same g a c u i))
  (body))

(lemma domain_nonnegative_point
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

  (requires
    (flow_domain g f (len g))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
  (ensures (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
  (body
    (assert (domain_cell g f (len g) u v))))

(lemma edge_limit
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (u int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (flow_domain g f (len g))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (<
      (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
      (+ (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 1)))
  (body
    (assert (domain_edge g f u i))))

(lemma scan_empty
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (i int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (scan_result g base u i 0 s t false 0))
  (body
    (assert
      (and
        (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
        (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len g))))
    (forall ((candidate (seq (seq int))))
      (call domain_nonnegative_point
        g candidate u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
    (assert (scan_result g base u i 0 s t false 0))))

(lemma scan_add
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (branch (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (i int) (x int) (s int) (t int)
    (old_found bool) (old_best int)
    (branch_found bool) (branch_best int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (prefix_same g branch base u i)
    (==
      (get_flow branch u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
      x)
    (scan_result g base u i x s t old_found old_best)
    (search_result g branch u (+ i 1) s t branch_found branch_best))
  (ensures
    (scan_result
      g base u i (+ x 1) s t
      (choose_found old_found branch_found)
      (choose_best old_found old_best branch_found branch_best)))
  (body))

(lemma scan_complete
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (i int) (s int) (t int)
    (found bool) (best int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (scan_result
      g base u i
      (+ (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 1)
      s t found best))
  (ensures (search_result g base u i s t found best))
  (body
    (forall ((candidate (seq (seq int))))
      (call edge_limit g candidate u i))
    (assert (search_result g base u i s t found best))))

(lemma row_complete
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))

    (search_result g base (+ u 1) 0 s t found best))
  (ensures
    (prefix_same g out base u (len (idx g u)))
    (search_result g base u (len (idx g u)) s t found best))
  (body))

(lemma full_prefix_get
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq (seq int))) (b (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (v int))
  (requires
    (flow_domain g a (len g))
    (flow_domain g b (len g))
    (prefix_same g a b (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (== (get_flow a u v) (get_flow b u v)))
  (body
    (if
      (exists ((c int)) (has_capacity g u v c))
      (block
        (obtain ((c int)) (has_capacity g u v c))
        (obtain ((j int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
              (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v)
              (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1) c))))
        (assert (edge_before u j (len g) 0))
        (assert (== (get_flow a u v) (get_flow b u v))))
      (block
        (assert (domain_cell g a (len g) u v))
        (assert (domain_cell g b (len g) u v))
        (assert (== (get_flow a u v) 0))
        (assert (== (get_flow b u v) 0))))))

(lemma full_prefix_out
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq (seq int))) (b (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (k int))
  (requires
    (flow_domain g a (len g))
    (flow_domain g b (len g))
    (prefix_same g a b (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (sum_flow_out_recursive g a u k)
      (sum_flow_out_recursive g b u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if
      (> k 0)
      (block
        (call full_prefix_out g a b u (- k 1))
        (call full_prefix_get
          g a b u (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)))
      (block))))

(lemma full_prefix_in
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq (seq int))) (b (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (k int))
  (requires

  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if
      (> k 0)
      (block
        (call full_prefix_in g a b u (- k 1))
        (call full_prefix_get g a b (- k 1) u))
      (block))))

(lemma full_prefix_out_guarded
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq (seq int))) (b (seq (seq int)))

  (requires

(lemma full_prefix_in_guarded
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq (seq int))) (b (seq (seq int)))
    (u int))
  (requires

(lemma full_prefix_properties
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq (seq int))) (b (seq (seq int)))
    (s int) (t int))
  (requires
    (flow_domain g a (len g))
    (flow_domain g b (len g))
    (prefix_same g a b (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))))
  (ensures
    (== (is_conserved g a s t) (is_conserved g b s t))
    (== (flow_val g a s) (flow_val g b s)))
  (body
    (forall ((u int))
      (call full_prefix_out_guarded g a b u))
    (forall ((u int))
      (call full_prefix_in_guarded g a b u))))

(lemma leaf_complete
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (s int) (t int) (ok bool) (amount int))
  (requires
    (flow_domain g base (len g))
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g)))
    (== ok (is_conserved g base s t))
    (== amount (flow_val g base s)))
  (ensures
    (search_result g base (len g) 0 s t ok amount))
  (body
    (assert (prefix_same g base base (len g) 0))
    (forall ((candidate (seq (seq int))))
      (call full_prefix_properties g candidate base s t))
    (if
      ok
      (assert
        (exists ((candidate (seq (seq int))))
          (and
            (and
              (and
                (flow_domain g candidate (len g))
                (prefix_same g candidate base (len g) 0))
              (is_conserved g candidate s t))
            (== (flow_val g candidate s) amount))))
      (block))))

  (params

(lemma normalized_cell
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (capacities_bounded g)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
    (is_valid_flow g f s t)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (domain_cell g (normalized f n) n u v))
  (body
    (call normalized_get f n u v)
    (if
      (> (get_flow f u v) 0)
      (block
        (assert
          (exists ((c int))

              (has_capacity g u v c)

        (obtain ((c int))

            (has_capacity g u v c)
            (<= (get_flow f u v) c)))

    (assert (domain_cell g (normalized f n) n u v))))

(lemma normalized_edge
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int) (s int) (t int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (capacities_bounded g)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
    (is_valid_flow g f s t)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (domain_edge g (normalized f n) u i))
  (body
    (assert
      (has_capacity
        g u
        (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
        (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
    (assert
      (and
        (>= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 0)
        (<= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 100000)))
    (call normalized_get
      f n u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (if
      (> (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) 0)
      (block
        (assert
          (exists ((c int))
            (and
              (has_capacity
                g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) c)
              (<=
                (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                c))))
        (obtain ((c int))
          (and
            (has_capacity
              g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) c)
            (<=
              (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
              c)))
        (obtain ((j int))

                (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))

        (assert (== j i))
        (assert (== c (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
      (block))
    (assert (domain_edge g (normalized f n) u i))))
