(spec inspect_candidate
  (params
    (graph_edges (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (flows (ref (slice (vec i64))))
    (n i64) (s i64) (t i64))
  (returns (ok bool) (amount i64))
  (requires
    (graph_ok graph_edges)
    (capacities_bounded graph_edges)
    (== n (len graph_edges))
    (flow_domain graph_edges flows n)
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)))
  (ensures
    (== ok (is_conserved graph_edges flows s t))
    (== amount (flow_val graph_edges flows s)))
  (effects))

(def inspect_candidate
  (body
    (let-mut ok bool true)
    (let-mut amount i64 0)
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (== ok (conserved_prefix graph_edges flows s t u)))
      (invariant
        (if
          (< s u)
          (== amount (flow_val graph_edges flows s))
          (== amount 0)))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let-mut outgoing i64 0)
      (let-mut j i64 0)
      (while (< j (len (idx graph_edges u)))
        (invariant
          (and (<= 0 j) (<= j (len (idx graph_edges u)))))
        (invariant
          (== outgoing
              (sum_flow_out_recursive graph_edges flows u j)))
        (decreases (- (len (idx graph_edges u)) j))
        (let v i64 (get (idx (idx graph_edges u) j) 0))
        (call outgoing_step_fits graph_edges flows n u j)
        (set outgoing (+ outgoing (idx (idx flows u) v)))
        (set j (+ j 1)))
      (let-mut incoming i64 0)
      (let-mut k i64 0)
      (while (< k n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
        (invariant
          (== incoming
              (sum_flow_in_recursive graph_edges flows u k)))
        (decreases (- n k))
        (call incoming_step_fits graph_edges flows n u k)
        (set incoming (+ incoming (idx (idx flows k) u)))
        (set k (+ k 1)))
      (ghost-let old_ok bool ok)
      (set ok
        (and
          ok
          (or
            (or (== u s) (== u t))
            (== incoming outgoing))))
      (call conserved_prefix_step
        graph_edges flows s t u old_ok incoming outgoing)
      (if
        (== u s)
        (block
          (call flow_difference_fits graph_edges flows n s)
          (set amount (- outgoing incoming)))
        (block))
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (return ok amount)))

(spec flow_search
  (params
    (graph_edges (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (flow (vec (vec i64)))
    (u i64) (i i64) (n i64) (s i64) (t i64))
  (returns
    (out_flow (vec (vec i64)))
    (found bool)
    (best i64))
  (requires
    (graph_ok graph_edges)
    (capacities_bounded graph_edges)
    (== n (len graph_edges))
    (flow_domain graph_edges flow n)
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
    (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n))
    (=>
      (< u n)
      (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len (idx graph_edges u))))))
  (ensures
    (flow_domain graph_edges out_flow n)
    (prefix_same graph_edges out_flow flow u i)
    (search_result graph_edges flow u i s t found best))
  (effects))

(def flow_search
  (decreases (work_left graph_edges u i))
  (body
    (let-mut work (vec (vec i64)) flow)
    (if
      (== u n)
      (block
        (let ((valid bool) (value i64))
          (call inspect_candidate graph_edges (borrow work) n s t))
        (call leaf_complete graph_edges flow s t valid value)
        (return work valid value))
      (if
        (== i (len (idx graph_edges u)))
        (block
          (call work_row_decreases graph_edges u)
          (let
            ((next (vec (vec i64)))
             (next_found bool)
             (next_best i64))
            (call flow_search
              graph_edges work (+ u 1) 0 n s t))
          (call row_complete
            graph_edges flow next u s t
            next_found next_best)
          (return next next_found next_best))
        (block
          (let target i64
            (get (idx (idx graph_edges u) i) 0))
          (let capacity i64
            (get (idx (idx graph_edges u) i) 1))
          (assert
            (has_capacity graph_edges u target capacity))
          (assert
            (and (>= capacity 0) (<= capacity 100000)))
          (let-mut any bool false)
          (let-mut best_value i64 0)
          (let-mut x i64 0)
          (call scan_empty graph_edges flow u i s t)
          (while (<= x capacity)
            (invariant
              (and (<= 0 x) (<= x (+ capacity 1))))
            (invariant (flow_domain graph_edges work n))
            (invariant (prefix_same graph_edges work flow u i))
            (invariant
              (scan_result
                graph_edges flow u i x s t any best_value))
            (decreases (+ (- capacity x) 1))
            (ghost-let prior (seq (seq int)) work)
            (set-idx (idx work u) target x)
            (assert (matrix_change prior work n u target x))
            (call domain_change
              graph_edges prior work n u i x)
            (call prefix_chain
              graph_edges work prior flow u i)
            (ghost-let branch (seq (seq int)) work)
            (call work_edge_decreases graph_edges u i)
            (let
              ((next_work (vec (vec i64)))
               (branch_found bool)
               (branch_best i64))
              (call flow_search
                graph_edges work u (+ i 1) n s t))
            (set work next_work)
            (call prefix_chain
              graph_edges work branch flow u i)
            (ghost-let old_found bool any)
            (ghost-let old_best int best_value)
            (if
              (and
                branch_found
                (or (not any) (> branch_best best_value)))
              (set best_value branch_best)
              (block))
            (if branch_found (set any true) (block))
            (call scan_add
              graph_edges flow branch u i x s t
              old_found old_best branch_found branch_best)
            (set x (+ x 1)))
          (call scan_complete
            graph_edges flow u i s t any best_value)
          (return work any best_value))))))

(def max_flow_value
  (body
    (call task_graph_facts graph)
    (match graph
      (case (capacity_graph rows)
        (block
          (let n i64 (len rows))
          (let initial (vec (vec i64))
            (seq-build n
              (fn (row_index)
                (seq-build n
                  (fn (column_index) 0)))))
          (assert (== initial (zero_matrix n)))
          (call zero_domain rows n)
          (call zero_conserved rows n s t)
          (let

    (s (seq int)) (n int) (p int) (i int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (injective_bounded s n)
    (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len s)))
    (== (idx s p) (- n 1))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (remove_at s p)))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx (remove_at s p) i))
      (< (idx (remove_at s p) i) (- n 1))))
  (body
    (call remove_at_len s p)
    (if
      (< i p)
      (block
        (call remove_at_before s p i)
        (assert (!= i p)))
      (block
        (call remove_at_after s p i)
        (assert (!= (+ i 1) p))))))

(lemma removed_unique_point
  (params
    (s (seq int)) (n int) (p int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (injective_bounded s n)
    (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len s)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (remove_at s p))))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (remove_at s p))))
    (!= i j))
  (ensures
    (!= (idx (remove_at s p) i)
        (idx (remove_at s p) j)))
  (body
    (call remove_at_len s p)
    (if
      (< i p)
      (call remove_at_before s p i)
      (call remove_at_after s p i))
    (if
      (< j p)
      (call remove_at_before s p j)
      (call remove_at_after s p j))))

(lemma removed_injective
  (params (s (seq int)) (n int) (p int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (injective_bounded s n)
    (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len s)))
    (== (idx s p) (- n 1)))
  (ensures (injective_bounded (remove_at s p) (- n 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((i int))
      (call removed_range_point s n p i))
    (forall ((i int) (j int))
      (call removed_unique_point s n p i j))))

(lemma shrink_range_point
  (params (s (seq int)) (n int) (i int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (injective_bounded s n)
    (not (contains s (- n 1)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))))
  (ensures
    (and (<= 0 (idx s i)) (< (idx s i) (- n 1))))
  (body
    (call law_contains s (- n 1))))

(lemma shrink_injective
  (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (injective_bounded s n)
    (not (contains s (- n 1))))
  (ensures (injective_bounded s (- n 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((i int))
      (call shrink_range_point s n i))))

(lemma injective_bound
  (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (injective_bounded s n))
  (ensures (<= (len s) n))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if
      (== n 0)
      (block
        (if
          (> (len s) 0)
          (assert
            (and
              (<= 0 (idx s 0))
              (< (idx s 0) 0)))
          (block)))
      (if
        (contains s (- n 1))
        (block
          (call law_contains s (- n 1))
          (obtain ((p int))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len s)))
              (== (idx s p) (- n 1))))
          (call removed_injective s n p)
          (call injective_bound (remove_at s p) (- n 1))
          (call remove_at_len s p))
        (block
          (call shrink_injective s n)
          (call injective_bound s (- n 1)))))))

(lemma destinations_len
  (params (row (seq (tuple int int))))
  (ensures (== (len (destinations row)) (len row)))
  (body))

(lemma destinations_at
  (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len row))))
  (ensures
    (== (idx (destinations row) i)
        (get (idx row i) 0)))
  (body))

(lemma graph_row_range
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx (destinations (idx g u)) i))
      (< (idx (destinations (idx g u)) i) (len g))))
  (body
    (call destinations_at (idx g u) i)))

(lemma graph_row_unique
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (i int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u))))
    (!= i j))
  (ensures
    (!= (idx (destinations (idx g u)) i)
        (idx (destinations (idx g u)) j)))
  (body
    (call destinations_at (idx g u) i)
    (call destinations_at (idx g u) j)))

(lemma row_length_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (<= (len (idx g u)) (len g)))
  (body
    (call destinations_len (idx g u))
    (forall ((i int))
      (call graph_row_range g u i))
    (forall ((i int) (j int))
      (call graph_row_unique g u i j))
    (assert
      (injective_bounded
        (destinations (idx g u))
        (len g)))
    (call injective_bound
      (destinations (idx g u))
      (len g))))

(lemma change_cell
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (old (seq (seq int))) (new (seq (seq int)))
    (n int) (u int) (i int) (x int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (capacities_bounded g)
    (== n (len g))
    (flow_domain g old n)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
    (matrix_change old new n u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) x)
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (domain_cell g new n a b))
  (body
    (if
      (and (== a u) (== b (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
      (block
        (assert
          (has_capacity g u
            (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
            (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
        (assert (== (get_flow new a b) x))
        (assert (domain_cell g new n a b)))
      (block
        (assert
          (== (get_flow new a b) (get_flow old a b)))
        (assert (domain_cell g old n a b))
        (assert (domain_cell g new n a b))))))

(lemma change_edge
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (old (seq (seq int))) (new (seq (seq int)))
    (n int) (u int) (i int) (x int) (a int) (j int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (capacities_bounded g)
    (== n (len g))
    (flow_domain g old n)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
    (matrix_change old new n u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) x)
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
  (ensures (domain_edge g new a j))
  (body
    (if
      (and
        (== a u)
        (==
          (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0)
          (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
      (block
        (assert (== j i))
        (assert
          (==
            (get_flow new a (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
            x))
        (assert (domain_edge g new a j)))
      (block
        (assert
          (==
            (get_flow new a (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
            (get_flow old a (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))))
        (assert (domain_edge g old a j))
        (assert (domain_edge g new a j))))))

(lemma change_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (old (seq (seq int))) (new (seq (seq int)))
    (n int) (u int) (i int) (x int) (a int) (j int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (matrix_change old new n u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) x)
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a))))
    (edge_before a j u i))
  (ensures
    (==
      (get_flow new a (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
      (get_flow old a (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))))
  (body
    (if
      (== a u)
      (assert
        (!=
          (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0)
          (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
      (block))))

(lemma domain_change
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (old (seq (seq int))) (new (seq (seq int)))
    (n int) (u int) (i int) (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (capacities_bounded g)
    (== n (len g))
    (flow_domain g old n)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
    (matrix_change old new n u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) x))
  (ensures
    (flow_domain g new n)
    (prefix_same g new old u i)
    (==
      (get_flow new u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
      x))
  (body
    (forall ((a int) (b int))
      (call change_cell g old new n u i x a b))
    (forall ((a int) (j int))
      (call change_edge g old new n u i x a j))
    (forall ((a int) (j int))
      (call change_prefix g old new n u i x a j))
    (assert (flow_domain g new n))
    (assert (prefix_same g new old u i))
    (assert
      (==
        (get_flow new u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
        x))))

(lemma prefix_chain
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq (seq int))) (b (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (i int))
  (requires
    (prefix_same g a b u i)
    (prefix_same g b c u i))
  (ensures (prefix_same g a c u i))
  (body))

(lemma domain_nonnegative_point
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (u int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (flow_domain g f (len g))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
  (ensures (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
  (body
    (assert (domain_cell g f (len g) u v))))

(lemma edge_limit
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (u int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (flow_domain g f (len g))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (<
      (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
      (+ (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 1)))
  (body
    (assert (domain_edge g f u i))))

(lemma scan_empty
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (i int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (scan_result g base u i 0 s t false 0))
  (body
    (assert
      (and
        (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
        (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len g))))
    (forall ((candidate (seq (seq int))))
      (call domain_nonnegative_point
        g candidate u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
    (assert (scan_result g base u i 0 s t false 0))))

(lemma scan_add
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (branch (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (i int) (x int) (s int) (t int)
    (old_found bool) (old_best int)
    (branch_found bool) (branch_best int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (prefix_same g branch base u i)
    (==
      (get_flow branch u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
      x)
    (scan_result g base u i x s t old_found old_best)
    (search_result g branch u (+ i 1) s t branch_found branch_best))
  (ensures
    (scan_result
      g base u i (+ x 1) s t
      (choose_found old_found branch_found)
      (choose_best old_found old_best branch_found branch_best)))
  (body))

(lemma scan_complete
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (i int) (s int) (t int)
    (found bool) (best int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (scan_result
      g base u i
      (+ (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 1)
      s t found best))
  (ensures (search_result g base u i s t found best))
  (body
    (forall ((candidate (seq (seq int))))
      (call edge_limit g candidate u i))
    (assert (search_result g base u i s t found best))))

(lemma row_complete
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (out (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (s int) (t int)
    (found bool) (best int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (prefix_same g out base (+ u 1) 0)
    (search_result g base (+ u 1) 0 s t found best))
  (ensures
    (prefix_same g out base u (len (idx g u)))
    (search_result g base u (len (idx g u)) s t found best))
  (body))

(lemma full_prefix_get
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq (seq int))) (b (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (v int))
  (requires
    (flow_domain g a (len g))
    (flow_domain g b (len g))
    (prefix_same g a b (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (== (get_flow a u v) (get_flow b u v)))
  (body
    (if
      (exists ((c int)) (has_capacity g u v c))
      (block
        (obtain ((c int)) (has_capacity g u v c))
        (obtain ((j int))
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
              (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
            (and
              (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) v)
              (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1) c))))
        (assert (edge_before u j (len g) 0))
        (assert (== (get_flow a u v) (get_flow b u v))))
      (block
        (assert (domain_cell g a (len g) u v))
        (assert (domain_cell g b (len g) u v))
        (assert (== (get_flow a u v) 0))
        (assert (== (get_flow b u v) 0))))))

(lemma full_prefix_out
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq (seq int))) (b (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (k int))
  (requires
    (flow_domain g a (len g))
    (flow_domain g b (len g))
    (prefix_same g a b (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (sum_flow_out_recursive g a u k)
      (sum_flow_out_recursive g b u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if
      (> k 0)
      (block
        (call full_prefix_out g a b u (- k 1))
        (call full_prefix_get
          g a b u (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)))
      (block))))

(lemma full_prefix_in
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq (seq int))) (b (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (k int))
  (requires
    (flow_domain g a (len g))
    (flow_domain g b (len g))
    (prefix_same g a b (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len g))))
  (ensures
    (==
      (sum_flow_in_recursive g a u k)
      (sum_flow_in_recursive g b u k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if
      (> k 0)
      (block
        (call full_prefix_in g a b u (- k 1))
        (call full_prefix_get g a b (- k 1) u))
      (block))))

(lemma full_prefix_out_guarded
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq (seq int))) (b (seq (seq int)))
    (u int))
  (requires
    (flow_domain g a (len g))
    (flow_domain g b (len g))
    (prefix_same g a b (len g) 0))
  (ensures
    (=>
      (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
      (== (total_flow_out g a u) (total_flow_out g b u))))
  (body
    (if
      (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
      (call full_prefix_out g a b u (len (idx g u)))
      (block))))

(lemma full_prefix_in_guarded
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq (seq int))) (b (seq (seq int)))
    (u int))
  (requires
    (flow_domain g a (len g))
    (flow_domain g b (len g))
    (prefix_same g a b (len g) 0))
  (ensures
    (=>
      (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
      (== (total_flow_in g a u) (total_flow_in g b u))))
  (body
    (if
      (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
      (call full_prefix_in g a b u (len g))
      (block))))

(lemma full_prefix_properties
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq (seq int))) (b (seq (seq int)))
    (s int) (t int))
  (requires
    (flow_domain g a (len g))
    (flow_domain g b (len g))
    (prefix_same g a b (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))))
  (ensures
    (== (is_conserved g a s t) (is_conserved g b s t))
    (== (flow_val g a s) (flow_val g b s)))
  (body
    (forall ((u int))
      (call full_prefix_out_guarded g a b u))
    (forall ((u int))
      (call full_prefix_in_guarded g a b u))))

(lemma leaf_complete
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (s int) (t int) (ok bool) (amount int))
  (requires
    (flow_domain g base (len g))
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g)))
    (== ok (is_conserved g base s t))
    (== amount (flow_val g base s)))
  (ensures
    (search_result g base (len g) 0 s t ok amount))
  (body
    (assert (prefix_same g base base (len g) 0))
    (forall ((candidate (seq (seq int))))
      (call full_prefix_properties g candidate base s t))
    (if
      ok
      (assert
        (exists ((candidate (seq (seq int))))
          (and
            (and
              (and
                (flow_domain g candidate (len g))
                (prefix_same g candidate base (len g) 0))
              (is_conserved g candidate s t))
            (== (flow_val g candidate s) amount))))
      (block))))

(lemma domain_respects_point
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (v int))
  (requires
    (flow_domain g f (len g))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
  (ensures
    (=>
      (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
      (exists ((c int))
        (and
          (has_capacity g u v c)
          (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c)))))
  (body
    (assert (domain_cell g f (len g) u v))))

(lemma domain_respects
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (flow_domain g f (len g)))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (call domain_respects_point g f u v))))

(lemma domain_nonnegative
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (flow_domain g f (len g)))
  (ensures
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f)))
          (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
        (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0))))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (call domain_nonnegative_point g f u v))))

(lemma domain_is_valid
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (s int) (t int))
  (requires
    (flow_domain g f (len g))
    (is_conserved g f s t))
  (ensures (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (body
    (call domain_respects g f)
    (call domain_nonnegative g f)
    (assert (is_valid_flow g f s t))))

(lemma normalized_get
  (params
    (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures
    (== (get_flow (normalized f n) u v) (get_flow f u v)))
  (body))

(lemma normalized_shape
  (params (f (seq (seq int))) (n int))
  (requires (>= n 0))
  (ensures (flow_shape (normalized f n) n))
  (body))

(lemma normalized_cell
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (capacities_bounded g)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
    (is_valid_flow g f s t)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (domain_cell g (normalized f n) n u v))
  (body
    (call normalized_get f n u v)
    (if
      (> (get_flow f u v) 0)
      (block
        (assert
          (exists ((c int))
            (and
              (has_capacity g u v c)
              (<= (get_flow f u v) c))))
        (obtain ((c int))
          (and
            (has_capacity g u v c)
            (<= (get_flow f u v) c)))
        (assert (and (>= c 0) (<= c 100000))))
      (block))
    (assert (domain_cell g (normalized f n) n u v))))

(lemma normalized_edge
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (n int) (s int) (t int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (capacities_bounded g)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
    (is_valid_flow g f s t)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (domain_edge g (normalized f n) u i))
  (body
    (assert
      (has_capacity
        g u
        (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
        (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
    (assert
      (and
        (>= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 0)
        (<= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 100000)))
    (call normalized_get
      f n u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
    (if
      (> (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) 0)
      (block
        (assert
          (exists ((c int))
            (and
              (has_capacity
                g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) c)
              (<=
                (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))

            (<=

        (obtain ((j int))

            (and
              (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
              (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
            (and
              (==
                (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)
                (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
              (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 1) c))))
        (assert (== j i))
        (assert (== c (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
      (block))
    (assert (domain_edge g (normalized f n) u i))))

(spec inspect_candidate
  (params
    (graph_edges (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (flows (ref (slice (vec i64))))
    (n i64) (s i64) (t i64))
  (returns (ok bool) (amount i64))
  (requires
    (graph_ok graph_edges)
    (capacities_bounded graph_edges)
    (== n (len graph_edges))
    (flow_domain graph_edges flows n)
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)))
  (ensures
    (== ok (is_conserved graph_edges flows s t))
    (== amount (flow_val graph_edges flows s)))
  (effects))

(def inspect_candidate
  (body
    (let-mut ok bool true)
    (let-mut amount i64 0)
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (== ok (conserved_prefix graph_edges flows s t u)))
      (invariant
        (if
          (< s u)
          (== amount (flow_val graph_edges flows s))
          (== amount 0)))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let-mut outgoing i64 0)
      (let-mut j i64 0)
      (while (< j (len (idx graph_edges u)))
        (invariant
          (and (<= 0 j) (<= j (len (idx graph_edges u)))))
        (invariant
          (== outgoing
              (sum_flow_out_recursive graph_edges flows u j)))
        (decreases (- (len (idx graph_edges u)) j))
        (let v i64 (get (idx (idx graph_edges u) j) 0))
        (call outgoing_step_fits graph_edges flows n u j)
        (set outgoing (+ outgoing (idx (idx flows u) v)))
        (set j (+ j 1)))
      (let-mut incoming i64 0)
      (let-mut k i64 0)
      (while (< k n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
        (invariant
          (== incoming
              (sum_flow_in_recursive graph_edges flows u k)))
        (decreases (- n k))
        (call incoming_step_fits graph_edges flows n u k)
        (set incoming (+ incoming (idx (idx flows k) u)))
        (set k (+ k 1)))
      (ghost-let old_ok bool ok)
      (set ok
        (and
          ok
          (or
            (or (== u s) (== u t))
            (== incoming outgoing))))
      (call conserved_prefix_step
        graph_edges flows s t u old_ok incoming outgoing)
      (if
        (== u s)
        (block
          (call flow_difference_fits graph_edges flows n s)
          (set amount (- outgoing incoming)))
        (block))
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (return ok amount)))

(spec flow_search
  (params
    (graph_edges (ref (slice (vec (tuple i64 i64)))))
    (flow (vec (vec i64)))
    (u i64) (i i64) (n i64) (s i64) (t i64))
  (returns
    (out_flow (vec (vec i64)))
    (found bool)
    (best i64))
  (requires
    (graph_ok graph_edges)
    (capacities_bounded graph_edges)
    (== n (len graph_edges))
    (flow_domain graph_edges flow n)
    (and (<= 0 s) (< s n))
    (and (<= 0 t) (< t n))
    (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n))
    (=>
      (< u n)
      (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len (idx graph_edges u))))))
  (ensures
    (flow_domain graph_edges out_flow n)
    (prefix_same graph_edges out_flow flow u i)
    (search_result graph_edges flow u i s t found best))
  (effects))

(def flow_search
  (decreases (work_left graph_edges u i))
  (body
    (let-mut work (vec (vec i64)) flow)
    (if
      (== u n)
      (block
        (let ((valid bool) (value i64))
          (call inspect_candidate graph_edges (borrow work) n s t))
        (call leaf_complete graph_edges flow s t valid value)
        (return work valid value))
      (if
        (== i (len (idx graph_edges u)))
        (block
          (call work_row_decreases graph_edges u)
          (let
            ((next (vec (vec i64)))
             (next_found bool)
             (next_best i64))
            (call flow_search
              graph_edges work (+ u 1) 0 n s t))
          (call row_complete
            graph_edges flow next u s t
            next_found next_best)
          (return next next_found next_best))
        (block
          (let target i64
            (get (idx (idx graph_edges u) i) 0))
          (let capacity i64
            (get (idx (idx graph_edges u) i) 1))
          (assert
            (has_capacity graph_edges u target capacity))
          (assert
            (and (>= capacity 0) (<= capacity 100000)))
          (let-mut any bool false)
          (let-mut best_value i64 0)
          (let-mut x i64 0)
          (call scan_empty graph_edges flow u i s t)
          (while (<= x capacity)
            (invariant
              (and (<= 0 x) (<= x (+ capacity 1))))
            (invariant (flow_domain graph_edges work n))
            (invariant (prefix_same graph_edges work flow u i))
            (invariant
              (scan_result
                graph_edges flow u i x s t any best_value))
            (decreases (+ (- capacity x) 1))
            (ghost-let prior (seq (seq int)) work)
            (set-idx (idx work u) target x)
            (assert (matrix_change prior work n u target x))
            (call domain_change
              graph_edges prior work n u i x)
            (call prefix_chain
              graph_edges work prior flow u i)
            (ghost-let branch (seq (seq int)) work)
            (call work_edge_decreases graph_edges u i)
            (let
              ((next_work (vec (vec i64)))
               (branch_found bool)
               (branch_best i64))
              (call flow_search
                graph_edges work u (+ i 1) n s t))
            (set work next_work)
            (call prefix_chain
              graph_edges work branch flow u i)
            (ghost-let old_found bool any)
            (ghost-let old_best int best_value)
            (if
              (and
                branch_found
                (or (not any) (> branch_best best_value)))
              (set best_value branch_best)
              (block))

          (!= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
              (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0)))))))

(ghost-fn flow_shape ((f (seq (seq int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (and
    (== (len f) n)
    (forall ((u int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (== (len (idx f u)) n))))))

(ghost-fn domain_cell
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int)))
   (n int) (u int) (v int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (<= 0 (get_flow f u v)) (<= (get_flow f u v) 100000))
      (=>
        (> (get_flow f u v) 0)
        (exists ((c int))
          (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (get_flow f u v) c)))))))

(ghost-fn domain_edge
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int)))
   (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body
    (if
      (and
        (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
      (and
        (<= 0 (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
        (<= (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
            (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
      true)))

(ghost-fn flow_domain
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (== n (len g))
      (and
        (graph_ok g)
        (and
          (flow_shape f n)
          (and
            (forall ((u int) (v int))
              (=>
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
                  (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
                (domain_cell g f n u v)))
            (forall ((u int) (i int))
              (=>
                (and
                  (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
                  (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                (domain_edge g f u i)))))))))

(ghost-fn edge_before ((a int) (j int) (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body (or (< a u) (and (== a u) (< j i)))))

(ghost-fn prefix_same
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (a (seq (seq int))) (b (seq (seq int)))
   (u int) (i int)) bool
  (body
    (forall ((x int) (j int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g)))
            (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g x)))))
          (edge_before x j u i))
        (==
          (get_flow a x (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0))
          (get_flow b x (get (idx (idx g x) j) 0)))))))

(ghost-fn search_result
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (base (seq (seq int)))
   (u int) (i int) (s int) (t int)
   (found bool) (best int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (forall ((candidate (seq (seq int))))
        (=>
          (and
            (and
              (flow_domain g candidate (len g))
              (prefix_same g candidate base u i))
            (is_conserved g candidate s t))
          (and found (>= best (flow_val g candidate s)))))
      (=>
        found
        (exists ((candidate (seq (seq int))))
          (and
            (and
              (and
                (flow_domain g candidate (len g))
                (prefix_same g candidate base u i))
              (is_conserved g candidate s t))
            (== (flow_val g candidate s) best)))))))

(ghost-fn scan_result
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
   (base (seq (seq int)))
   (u int) (i int) (limit int) (s int) (t int)
   (found bool) (best int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
      (and
        (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
        (and
          (forall ((candidate (seq (seq int))))
            (=>
              (and
                (and
                  (and
                    (flow_domain g candidate (len g))
                    (prefix_same g candidate base u i))
                  (<
                    (get_flow candidate u
                      (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                    limit))
                (is_conserved g candidate s t))
              (and found (>= best (flow_val g candidate s)))))
          (=>
            found
            (exists ((candidate (seq (seq int))))
              (and
                (and
                  (and
                    (and
                      (flow_domain g candidate (len g))
                      (prefix_same g candidate base u i))
                    (<
                      (get_flow candidate u
                        (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
                      limit))
                  (is_conserved g candidate s t))
                (== (flow_val g candidate s) best)))))))))

(ghost-fn matrix_change
  ((old (seq (seq int))) (new (seq (seq int)))
   (n int) (u int) (v int) (x int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (and (flow_shape old n) (flow_shape new n))
      (forall ((a int) (b int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
            (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
          (==
            (idx (idx new a) b)
            (if (and (== a u) (== b v))
                x
                (idx (idx old a) b))))))))

(ghost-fn choose_found ((a bool) (b bool)) bool
  (body (or a b)))

(ghost-fn choose_best
  ((af bool) (av int) (bf bool) (bv int)) int
  (body (if (and bf (or (not af) (> bv av))) bv av)))

(ghost-fn conserved_prefix
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int)))
   (s int) (t int) (k int)) bool
  (body
    (forall ((u int))
      (=>
        (and
          (and (<= 0 u) (< u k))
          (and (!= u s) (!= u t)))
        (== (total_flow_in g f u) (total_flow_out g f u))))))

(ghost-fn edge_tail
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int)) int
  (decreases (- (len g) u))
  (body
    (if
      (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
      (+ (len (idx g u)) (+ 1 (edge_tail g (+ u 1))))
      0)))

(ghost-fn work_left
  ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int)) int
  (body
    (if
      (and
        (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
        (and (<= 0 i) (<= i (len (idx g u)))))
      (+ (- (len (idx g u)) i) (+ 1 (edge_tail g (+ u 1))))
      0)))

(ghost-fn normalized
  ((f (seq (seq int))) (n int)) (seq (seq int))
  (requires (>= n 0))
  (body
    (seq-build n
      (fn (u)
        (seq-build n
          (fn (v) (get_flow f u v)))))))

(ghost-fn zero_matrix ((n int)) (seq (seq int))
  (requires (>= n 0))
  (body
    (seq-build n
      (fn (u)
        (seq-build n
          (fn (v) 0))))))

(ghost-fn destinations
  ((row (seq (tuple int int)))) (seq int)
  (body
    (seq-build (len row)
      (fn (i) (get (idx row i) 0)))))

(ghost-fn injective_bounded
  ((s (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body
    (and
      (forall ((i int))
        (=>
          (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
          (and (<= 0 (idx s i)) (< (idx s i) n))))
      (forall ((i int) (j int))
        (=>
          (and
            (and
              (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s)))
              (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len s))))
            (!= i j))
          (!= (idx s i) (idx s j)))))))

(ghost-fn remove_at
  ((s (seq int)) (p int)) (seq int)
  (requires (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len s))))
  (body (concat (take s p) (drop s (+ p 1)))))

(lemma remove_at_len
  (params (s (seq int)) (p int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len s))))
  (ensures (== (len (remove_at s p)) (- (len s) 1)))
  (body
    (call law_len_take s p)
    (call law_len_drop s (+ p 1))
    (call law_len_concat (take s p) (drop s (+ p 1)))))

(lemma remove_at_before
  (params (s (seq int)) (p int) (i int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len s)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i p)))
  (ensures (== (idx (remove_at s p) i) (idx s i)))
  (body
    (call law_idx_concat (take s p) (drop s (+ p 1)) i)
    (call law_idx_take s p i)))

(lemma remove_at_after
  (params (s (seq int)) (p int) (i int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len s)))
    (and (<= p i) (< i (- (len s) 1))))
  (ensures (== (idx (remove_at s p) i) (idx s (+ i 1))))
  (body
    (call law_len_take s p)
    (call law_len_drop s (+ p 1))
    (call law_idx_concat (take s p) (drop s (+ p 1)) i)
    (call law_idx_drop s (+ p 1) (- i p))))

(lemma removed_range_point
  (params
    (s (seq int)) (n int) (p int) (i int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (injective_bounded s n)
    (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len s)))
    (== (idx s p) (- n 1))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (remove_at s p)))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx (remove_at s p) i))
      (< (idx (remove_at s p) i) (- n 1))))
  (body
    (call remove_at_len s p)
    (if
      (< i p)
      (block
        (call remove_at_before s p i)
        (assert (!= i p)))
      (block
        (call remove_at_after s p i)
        (assert (!= (+ i 1) p))))))

(lemma removed_unique_point
  (params
    (s (seq int)) (n int) (p int) (i int) (j int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (injective_bounded s n)
    (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len s)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (remove_at s p))))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (remove_at s p))))
    (!= i j))
  (ensures
    (!= (idx (remove_at s p) i)
        (idx (remove_at s p) j)))
  (body
    (call remove_at_len s p)
    (if
      (< i p)
      (call remove_at_before s p i)
      (call remove_at_after s p i))
    (if
      (< j p)
      (call remove_at_before s p j)
      (call remove_at_after s p j))))

(lemma removed_injective
  (params (s (seq int)) (n int) (p int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (injective_bounded s n)
    (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len s)))
    (== (idx s p) (- n 1)))
  (ensures (injective_bounded (remove_at s p) (- n 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((i int))
      (call removed_range_point s n p i))
    (forall ((i int) (j int))
      (call removed_unique_point s n p i j))))

(lemma shrink_range_point
  (params (s (seq int)) (n int) (i int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (injective_bounded s n)
    (not (contains s (- n 1)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len s))))
  (ensures
    (and (<= 0 (idx s i)) (< (idx s i) (- n 1))))
  (body
    (call law_contains s (- n 1))))

(lemma shrink_injective
  (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires
    (> n 0)
    (injective_bounded s n)
    (not (contains s (- n 1))))
  (ensures (injective_bounded s (- n 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((i int))
      (call shrink_range_point s n i))))

(lemma injective_bound
  (params (s (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires
    (>= n 0)
    (injective_bounded s n))
  (ensures (<= (len s) n))
  (decreases n)
  (body
    (if
      (== n 0)
      (block
        (if
          (> (len s) 0)
          (assert
            (and
              (<= 0 (idx s 0))
              (< (idx s 0) 0)))
          (block)))
      (if
        (contains s (- n 1))
        (block
          (call law_contains s (- n 1))
          (obtain ((p int))
            (and
              (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len s)))
              (== (idx s p) (- n 1))))
          (call removed_injective s n p)
          (call injective_bound (remove_at s p) (- n 1))
          (call remove_at_len s p))
        (block
          (call shrink_injective s n)
          (call injective_bound s (- n 1)))))))

(lemma destinations_len
  (params (row (seq (tuple int int))))
  (ensures (== (len (destinations row)) (len row)))
  (body))

(lemma destinations_at
  (params (row (seq (tuple int int))) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len row))))
  (ensures
    (== (idx (destinations row) i)
        (get (idx row i) 0)))
  (body))

(lemma graph_row_range
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (and
      (<= 0 (idx (destinations (idx g u)) i))
      (< (idx (destinations (idx g u)) i) (len g))))
  (body
    (call destinations_at (idx g u) i)))

(lemma graph_row_unique
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int)
    (i int)
    (j int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u))))
    (!= i j))
  (ensures
    (!= (idx (destinations (idx g u)) i)
        (idx (destinations (idx g u)) j)))
  (body
    (call destinations_at (idx g u) i)
    (call destinations_at (idx g u) j)))

(lemma row_length_bound
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (u int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (<= (len (idx g u)) (len g)))
  (body
    (call destinations_len (idx g u))
    (forall ((i int))
      (call graph_row_range g u i))
    (forall ((i int) (j int))
      (call graph_row_unique g u i j))
    (assert
      (injective_bounded
        (destinations (idx g u))
        (len g)))
    (call injective_bound
      (destinations (idx g u))
      (len g))))

(lemma change_cell
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (old (seq (seq int))) (new (seq (seq int)))
    (n int) (u int) (i int) (x int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (capacities_bounded g)
    (== n (len g))
    (flow_domain g old n)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
    (matrix_change old new n u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) x)
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
    (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (domain_cell g new n a b))
  (body
    (if
      (and (== a u) (== b (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
      (block
        (assert
          (has_capacity g u
            (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)
            (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
        (assert (== (get_flow new a b) x))
        (assert (domain_cell g new n a b)))
      (block
        (assert
          (== (get_flow new a b) (get_flow old a b)))
        (assert (domain_cell g old n a b))
        (assert (domain_cell g new n a b))))))

(lemma change_edge
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (old (seq (seq int))) (new (seq (seq int)))
    (n int) (u int) (i int) (x int) (a int) (j int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (capacities_bounded g)
    (== n (len g))
    (flow_domain g old n)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
    (matrix_change old new n u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) x)
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a)))))
  (ensures (domain_edge g new a j))
  (body
    (if
      (and
        (== a u)
        (==
          (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0)
          (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
      (block
        (assert (== j i))
        (assert
          (==
            (get_flow new a (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
            x))
        (assert (domain_edge g new a j)))
      (block
        (assert
          (==
            (get_flow new a (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
            (get_flow old a (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))))
        (assert (domain_edge g old a j))
        (assert (domain_edge g new a j))))))

(lemma change_prefix
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (old (seq (seq int))) (new (seq (seq int)))
    (n int) (u int) (i int) (x int) (a int) (j int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (== n (len g))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (matrix_change old new n u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) x)
    (and (<= 0 a) (< a n))
    (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g a))))
    (edge_before a j u i))
  (ensures
    (==
      (get_flow new a (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))
      (get_flow old a (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0))))
  (body
    (if
      (== a u)
      (assert
        (!=
          (get (idx (idx g a) j) 0)
          (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
      (block))))

(lemma domain_change
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (old (seq (seq int))) (new (seq (seq int)))
    (n int) (u int) (i int) (x int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (capacities_bounded g)
    (== n (len g))
    (flow_domain g old n)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (and (<= 0 x) (<= x (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
    (matrix_change old new n u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) x))
  (ensures
    (flow_domain g new n)
    (prefix_same g new old u i)
    (==
      (get_flow new u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
      x))
  (body
    (forall ((a int) (b int))
      (call change_cell g old new n u i x a b))
    (forall ((a int) (j int))
      (call change_edge g old new n u i x a j))
    (forall ((a int) (j int))
      (call change_prefix g old new n u i x a j))
    (assert (flow_domain g new n))
    (assert (prefix_same g new old u i))
    (assert
      (==
        (get_flow new u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
        x))))

(lemma prefix_chain
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq (seq int))) (b (seq (seq int))) (c (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (i int))
  (requires
    (prefix_same g a b u i)
    (prefix_same g b c u i))
  (ensures (prefix_same g a c u i))
  (body))

(lemma domain_nonnegative_point
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (u int)
    (v int))
  (requires
    (flow_domain g f (len g))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
  (ensures (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
  (body
    (assert (domain_cell g f (len g) u v))))

(lemma edge_limit
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (f (seq (seq int)))
    (u int)
    (i int))
  (requires
    (flow_domain g f (len g))
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures
    (<
      (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
      (+ (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 1)))
  (body
    (assert (domain_edge g f u i))))

(lemma scan_empty
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (i int) (s int) (t int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (scan_result g base u i 0 s t false 0))
  (body
    (assert
      (and
        (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
        (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len g))))
    (forall ((candidate (seq (seq int))))
      (call domain_nonnegative_point
        g candidate u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))
    (assert (scan_result g base u i 0 s t false 0))))

(lemma scan_add
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (branch (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (i int) (x int) (s int) (t int)
    (old_found bool) (old_best int)
    (branch_found bool) (branch_best int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (prefix_same g branch base u i)
    (==
      (get_flow branch u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
      x)
    (scan_result g base u i x s t old_found old_best)
    (search_result g branch u (+ i 1) s t branch_found branch_best))
  (ensures
    (scan_result
      g base u i (+ x 1) s t
      (choose_found old_found branch_found)
      (choose_best old_found old_best branch_found branch_best)))
  (body))

(lemma scan_complete
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (i int) (s int) (t int)
    (found bool) (best int))
  (requires
    (graph_ok g)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
    (scan_result
      g base u i
      (+ (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 1)
      s t found best))
  (ensures (search_result g base u i s t found best))
  (body
    (forall ((candidate (seq (seq int))))
      (call edge_limit g candidate u i))
    (assert (search_result g base u i s t found best))))

(lemma row_complete
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (base (seq (seq int)))
    (out (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (s int) (t int)
    (found bool) (best int))
  (requires
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (prefix_same g out base (+ u 1) 0)
    (search_result g base (+ u 1) 0 s t found best))
  (ensures
    (prefix_same g out base u (len (idx g u)))
    (search_result g base u (len (idx g u)) s t found best))
  (body))

(lemma full_prefix_get
  (params
    (g (seq (seq (tuple int int))))
    (a (seq (seq int))) (b (seq (seq int)))
    (u int) (v int))
  (requires
    (flow_domain g a (len g))
    (flow_domain g b (len g))
    (prefix_same g a b (len g) 0)
    (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
    (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
  (ensures (== (get_flow a u v) (get_flow b u v)))
  (body
    (if
      (exists ((c int)) (has_capacity g u v c))
      (block
        (obtain ((c int)) (has_capacity g u v c))

  (ensures

  (params

  (requires

How it works:

- **Algorithm.** Each round runs a breadth-first search over the residual graph, then pushes one unit of flow along the parent chain from `t` back to `s`. The loop stops when `t` can't be reached.
- **Termination.** Every round raises the flow value by 1. The value is bounded by 100000 × n ≤ 10^8, so the loop must end.
- **Walking back from `t`.** Each vertex records the order in which the search reached it. That order strictly decreases along the parent chain, so no flow entry is changed twice in one augmentation. Each step adds 1 to the net flow at one end of an edge and subtracts 1 at the other, so conservation still holds at every vertex except `s` and `t`.
- **Optimality.** When `t` can't be reached, let S be the reached vertices. For any valid flow h, the flow value equals Σ_{u,v} h(u,v)·([u∈S] − [v∈S]). This takes a double-sum swap and converting the adjacency-list out-sums into row sums. Our flow saturates every edge leaving S and carries nothing into S, so this sum is never larger for h than for ours.

  (body (if (== (len es) 0) 0
    (+ (if (< (get (idx es 0) 2) t) (get (idx es 0) 2) t) (wmin (drop es 1) t)))))
(ghost-fn wbound ((es (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len es)))
    (and (<= -100000 (get (idx es k) 2)) (<= (get (idx es k) 2) 100000))))))
(ghost-fn opt_below ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (w int)) bool
  (body (forall ((o (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int))
    (=> (and (is_spanning_tree g o) (and (<= -100000 t) (< t w)))
        (<= (cnt_le o t) (cnt_le es t))))))

(lemma nreps_range (params (c (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len c))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (nreps c k)) (<= (nreps c k) k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call nreps_range c (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma nreps_id (params (c (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len c)))
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len c))) (== (idx c x) x))))
  (ensures (== (nreps c k) k))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call nreps_id c (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma one_class (params (c (seq int)) (r int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len c)))
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len c))) (== (idx c x) r))))
  (ensures (== (nreps c k) (if (and (<= 0 r) (< r k)) 1 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call one_class c r (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma nreps_merge (params (c (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len c))) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len c))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len c)))
            (== (idx c a) a) (== (idx c b) b) (!= a b))
  (ensures (== (nreps (relabel c a b) k) (- (nreps c k) (if (< b k) 1 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call nreps_merge c a b (- k 1))
        (assert (== (idx (relabel c a b) (- k 1)) (if (== (idx c (- k 1)) b) a (idx c (- k 1))))))
      (block))))
(lemma relabel_ok (params (c (seq int)) (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (reps_ok c n) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)) (== (idx c a) a))
  (ensures (reps_ok (relabel c a b) n))
  (body))
(lemma coarser_relabel (params (c0 (seq int)) (c (seq int)) (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (coarser c0 c n))
  (ensures (coarser c0 (relabel c a b) n))
  (body))
(lemma joined_relabel (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (c (seq int)) (k int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (joined o c k))
  (ensures (joined o (relabel c a b) k))
  (body))
(lemma joined_ext (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (c (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (joined o c k) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len o)))
            (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx o k) 0)) (< (get (idx o k) 0) (len c)))
                 (and (<= 0 (get (idx o k) 1)) (< (get (idx o k) 1) (len c))))
            (== (idx c (get (idx o k) 0)) (idx c (get (idx o k) 1))))
  (ensures (joined o c (+ k 1)))
  (body))
(lemma end_at (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (n int) (k int))
  (requires (wfg g) (== (len g) n) (are_valid_edges g o) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len o))))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx o k) 0)) (< (get (idx o k) 0) n))
                (and (<= 0 (get (idx o k) 1)) (< (get (idx o k) 1) n))))
  (body
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx o k) 0) (get (idx o k) 1) (get (idx o k) 2)))
    (obtain ((ii int))
      (and (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx o k) 0)) (< (get (idx o k) 0) (len g)))
                (and (<= 0 ii) (< ii (len (idx g (get (idx o k) 0))))))
           (and (== (get (idx (idx g (get (idx o k) 0)) ii) 0) (get (idx o k) 1))
                (== (get (idx (idx g (get (idx o k) 0)) ii) 1) (get (idx o k) 2)))))))

(lemma conn_refl (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int))
  (ensures (edges_connected es x x))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-lit x))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es p))
    (assert (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x))) (path_follows_edges es p)))))
(lemma ein_push (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x (tuple int int int)) (p (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (len p) 1))) (edge_in_set es (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set (concat es (seq-lit x)) (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len es)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx es e) 0) (idx p k)) (== (get (idx es e) 1) (idx p (+ k 1))))
          (and (== (get (idx es e) 0) (idx p (+ k 1))) (== (get (idx es e) 1) (idx p k))))))
    (assert (== (idx (concat es (seq-lit x)) e) (idx es e)))))
(lemma path_push (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x (tuple int int int)) (p (seq int)))
  (requires (path_follows_edges es p))
  (ensures (path_follows_edges (concat es (seq-lit x)) p))
  (body (forall ((k int)) (call ein_push es x p k))))
(lemma conn_push (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x (tuple int int int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (edges_connected es a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected (concat es (seq-lit x)) a b))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (call path_push es x p)
    (assert (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges (concat es (seq-lit x)) p)))))
(lemma conn_edge (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int) (wt int))
  (ensures (edges_connected (concat es (seq-lit (tuple u v wt))) u v)
           (edges_connected (concat es (seq-lit (tuple u v wt))) v u))
  (body
    (ghost-let e1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat es (seq-lit (tuple u v wt))))
    (assert (== (len e1) (+ (len es) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx e1 (len es)) (tuple u v wt)))
    (assert (edge_in_set e1 u v))
    (assert (edge_in_set e1 v u))
    (ghost-let p1 (seq int) (seq-lit u v))
    (ghost-let p2 (seq int) (seq-lit v u))
    (assert (path_follows_edges e1 p1))
    (assert (path_follows_edges e1 p2))
    (assert (and (and (> (len p1) 0) (and (== (idx p1 0) u) (== (idx p1 (- (len p1) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges e1 p1)))
    (assert (and (and (> (len p2) 0) (and (== (idx p2 0) v) (== (idx p2 (- (len p2) 1)) u))) (path_follows_edges e1 p2)))))
(lemma cat_at (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (> (len p) 0) (> (len q) 0) (path_follows_edges es p) (path_follows_edges es q)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (idx q 0))
            (and (<= 0 k) (< k (- (+ (len p) (len q)) 2))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set es (idx (concat p (drop q 1)) k) (idx (concat p (drop q 1)) (+ k 1))))
  (body
    (if (< k (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (drop q 1)) k) (idx p k)))
        (assert (== (idx (concat p (drop q 1)) (+ k 1)) (idx p (+ k 1))))
        (assert (edge_in_set es (idx p k) (idx p (+ k 1)))))
      (if (== k (- (len p) 1))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx (concat p (drop q 1)) k) (idx q 0)))
          (assert (== (idx (concat p (drop q 1)) (+ k 1)) (idx q 1)))
          (assert (edge_in_set es (idx q 0) (idx q 1))))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx (concat p (drop q 1)) k) (idx q (+ (- k (len p)) 1))))
          (assert (== (idx (concat p (drop q 1)) (+ k 1)) (idx q (+ (- k (len p)) 2))))
          (assert (edge_in_set es (idx q (+ (- k (len p)) 1)) (idx q (+ (- k (len p)) 2)))))))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int) (z int))
  (requires (edges_connected es x y) (edges_connected es y z))
  (ensures (edges_connected es x z))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) y) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) z))) (path_follows_edges es q)))
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (concat p (drop q 1)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call cat_at es p q k))
    (assert (== (len r) (- (+ (len p) (len q)) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) x))
    (if (> (len q) 1)
      (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) (idx q (- (len q) 1))))
      (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) z))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es r))
    (assert (and (and (> (len r) 0) (and (== (idx r 0) x) (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) z))) (path_follows_edges es r)))))
(lemma conn_merge_at (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (c0 (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (v int) (wt int) (x int))
  (requires (reps_ok c0 n) (conn_rep es c0 n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)))
  (ensures
    (and (edges_connected (concat es (seq-lit (tuple u v wt))) (idx (relabel c0 (idx c0 u) (idx c0 v)) x) x)
         (edges_connected (concat es (seq-lit (tuple u v wt))) x (idx (relabel c0 (idx c0 u) (idx c0 v)) x))))
  (body
    (ghost-let a int (idx c0 u))
    (ghost-let b int (idx c0 v))
    (ghost-let e1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat es (seq-lit (tuple u v wt))))
    (assert (and (edges_connected es (idx c0 x) x) (edges_connected es x (idx c0 x))))
    (assert (and (edges_connected es a u) (edges_connected es u a)))
    (assert (and (edges_connected es b v) (edges_connected es v b)))
    (call conn_push es (tuple u v wt) (idx c0 x) x)
    (call conn_push es (tuple u v wt) x (idx c0 x))
    (assert (== (idx (relabel c0 a b) x) (if (== (idx c0 x) b) a (idx c0 x))))
    (if (== (idx c0 x) b)
      (block
        (call conn_push es (tuple u v wt) a u)
        (call conn_push es (tuple u v wt) u a)
        (call conn_push es (tuple u v wt) b v)
        (call conn_push es (tuple u v wt) v b)
        (call conn_edge es u v wt)
        (call conn_trans e1 a u v)
        (call conn_trans e1 a v b)
        (call conn_trans e1 a b x)
        (call conn_trans e1 x b v)
        (call conn_trans e1 x v u)
        (call conn_trans e1 x u a))
      (block))))
(lemma conn_merge (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (c0 (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (v int) (wt int))
  (requires (reps_ok c0 n) (conn_rep es c0 n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (conn_rep (concat es (seq-lit (tuple u v wt))) (relabel c0 (idx c0 u) (idx c0 v)) n))
  (body (forall ((xx int)) (call conn_merge_at es c0 n u v wt xx))))
(lemma span_pair (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (c (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (== (len c) n) (conn_rep es c n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (== (idx c u) (idx c v)))
  (ensures (edges_connected es u v))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected es u (idx c u)))
    (assert (edges_connected es (idx c v) v))
    (call conn_trans es u (idx c u) v)))
(lemma spanning (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (c (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (== (len g) n) (== (len c) n) (> n 0) (conn_rep es c n)
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (== (idx c x) (idx c 0)))))
  (ensures (is_spanning g es))
  (body (forall ((uu int) (vv int)) (call span_pair es c n uu vv))))
(lemma path_joined (params (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (c (seq int)) (n int) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (== (len c) n) (ends_in o n) (joined o c (len o)) (path_follows_edges o p)
            (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))) (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) n)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p m)) (< (idx p m) n)) (== (idx c (idx p m)) (idx c (idx p 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call path_joined o c n p (- m 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set o (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
        (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len o)))
          (or (and (== (get (idx o e) 0) (idx p (- m 1))) (== (get (idx o e) 1) (idx p m)))
              (and (== (get (idx o e) 0) (idx p m)) (== (get (idx o e) 1) (idx p (- m 1))))))))
      (block))))
(lemma conn_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (o (seq (tuple int int int))) (c (seq int)) (n int) (x int))
  (requires (== (len g) n) (== (len c) n) (is_spanning g o) (ends_in o n) (joined o c (len o)) (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)))
  (ensures (== (idx c x) (idx c 0)))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected o 0 x))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x))) (path_follows_edges o p)))
    (call path_joined o c n p (- (len p) 1))))

(lemma valid_push (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (i int) (v int) (wt int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g es) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) wt))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g (concat es (seq-lit (tuple u v wt)))))
  (body
    (assert (has_edge g u v wt))
    (assert (== (idx (concat es (seq-lit (tuple u v wt))) (len es)) (tuple u v wt)))))
(lemma wlt_push (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x (tuple int int int)) (w int))
  (requires (wlt es w) (< (get x 2) w))
  (ensures (wlt (concat es (seq-lit x)) w))
  (body))
(lemma cnt_push (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x (tuple int int int)) (t int))
  (ensures (== (cnt_le (concat es (seq-lit x)) t) (+ (cnt_le es t) (if (<= (get x 2) t) 1 0))))
  (decreases (len es))
  (body
    (if (> (len es) 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (drop (concat es (seq-lit x)) 1) (concat (drop es 1) (seq-lit x))))
        (assert (== (idx (concat es (seq-lit x)) 0) (idx es 0)))
        (call cnt_push (drop es 1) x t))
      (block
        (assert (== (len (concat es (seq-lit x))) 1))
        (assert (== (idx (concat es (seq-lit x)) 0) x))
        (assert (== (len (drop (concat es (seq-lit x)) 1)) 0))
        (assert (== (cnt_le (drop (concat es (seq-lit x)) 1) t) 0))))))
(lemma cnt_all (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int))
  (requires (wlt es (+ t 1)))
  (ensures (== (cnt_le es t) (len es)))
  (decreases (len es))
  (body (if (> (len es) 0) (block (assert (wlt (drop es 1) (+ t 1))) (call cnt_all (drop es 1) t)) (block))))
(lemma below_push (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x (tuple int int int)) (w int))
  (requires (opt_below g es w) (>= (get x 2) w))
  (ensures (opt_below g (concat es (seq-lit x)) w))
  (body (forall ((tt int)) (call cnt_push es x tt))))

(lemma entry_bound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (weights_bounded g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (and (<= -100000 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)) (<= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 100000)))
  (body (assert (has_edge g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
(lemma init_closed (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)))
  (requires (weights_bounded g))
  (ensures (closed_upto g c -100000 0 0))
  (body (forall ((uu int) (ii int)) (call entry_bound g uu ii))))
(lemma closed_ext (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (w int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (wfg g) (== (len c) (len g)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (closed_upto g c w u i)
            (=> (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w) (== (idx c u) (idx c (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))
  (ensures (closed_upto g c w u (+ i 1)))
  (body))
(lemma closed_relabel (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (w int) (u0 int) (i0 int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (closed_upto g c w u0 i0))
  (ensures (closed_upto g (relabel c a b) w u0 i0))
  (body))
(lemma closed_row (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (w int) (u int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (closed_upto g c w u (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (closed_upto g c w (+ u 1) 0))
  (body))
(lemma closed_w (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (w int))
  (requires (closed_upto g c w (len g) 0))
  (ensures (closed_upto g c (+ w 1) 0 0))
  (body))
(lemma gpath_same (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (n int) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (wfg g) (== (len g) n) (== (len c) n) (weights_bounded g) (closed_upto g c 100001 0 0)
            (path_follows_graph g p) (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))) (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) n)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p m)) (< (idx p m) n)) (== (idx c (idx p m)) (idx c (idx p 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call gpath_same g c n p (- m 1))
        (assert (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
        (obtain ((ii int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (idx p (- m 1))) (< (idx p (- m 1)) (len g)))
                                     (and (<= 0 ii) (< ii (len (idx g (idx p (- m 1)))))))
                                (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- m 1))) ii) 0) (idx p m))))
        (call entry_bound g (idx p (- m 1)) ii))
      (block))))
(lemma same_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (n int) (x int))
  (requires (wfg g) (== (len g) n) (== (len c) n) (weights_bounded g) (graph_is_connected g)
            (closed_upto g c 100001 0 0) (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)))
  (ensures (== (idx c x) (idx c 0)))
  (body
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 x))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x))) (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (call gpath_same g c n p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma all_same (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c (seq int)) (n int))
  (requires (wfg g) (== (len g) n) (== (len c) n) (> n 0) (weights_bounded g) (graph_is_connected g)
            (closed_upto g c 100001 0 0))
  (ensures (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (== (idx c x) (idx c 0)))))
  (body (forall ((xx int)) (call same_one g c n xx))))

(lemma cut_bound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (c0 (seq int)) (n int) (t int) (o (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (wfg g) (== (len g) n) (> n 0) (reps_ok c0 n) (closed_upto g c0 (+ t 1) 0 0) (is_spanning_tree g o))
  (ensures (>= (- (len o) (cnt_le o t)) (- (nreps c0 n) 1)))
  (body
    (assert (are_valid_edges g o))
    (assert (is_spanning g o))
    (forall ((jj int)) (call end_at g o n jj))
    (assert (ends_in o n))
    (ghost-let-mut c (seq int) c0)
    (ghost-let-mut k int 0)
    (assert (== (len (take o 0)) 0))
    (assert (== (cnt_le (take o 0) t) 0))
    (assert (coarser c0 c n))
    (assert (joined o c 0))
    (while (< k (len o))
      (invariant (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len o))))
      (invariant (reps_ok c n))
      (invariant (coarser c0 c n))
      (invariant (joined o c k))
      (invariant (>= (nreps c n) (- (nreps c0 n) (- k (cnt_le (take o k) t)))))
      (decreases (- (len o) k))
      (ghost-let x int (get (idx o k) 0))
      (ghost-let y int (get (idx o k) 1))
      (ghost-let wt int (get (idx o k) 2))
      (call cnt_push (take o k) (idx o k) t)
      (assert (== (take o (+ k 1)) (concat (take o k) (seq-lit (idx o k)))))
      (if (!= (idx c x) (idx c y))
        (block
          (assert (has_edge g x y wt))
          (obtain ((ii int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 ii) (< ii (len (idx g x)))))
                                  (and (== (get (idx (idx g x) ii) 0) y) (== (get (idx (idx g x) ii) 1) wt))))
          (assert (> wt t))
          (ghost-let a int (idx c x))
          (ghost-let b int (idx c y))
          (call nreps_merge c a b n)
          (call relabel_ok c n a b)
          (call coarser_relabel c0 c n a b)
          (call joined_relabel o c k a b)
          (ghost-set c (relabel c a b)))
        (block))
      (call joined_ext o c k)
      (ghost-set k (+ k 1)))

- `len c` is `n`;
- `a` and `b` are in range and are their own representatives.

Everything else is unchanged.

  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call nreps_range c (- k 1)) (block))))

            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len c))) (== (idx c x) x))))
  (ensures (== (nreps c k) k))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call nreps_id c (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma one_class (params (c (seq int)) (r int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len c)))
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len c))) (== (idx c x) r))))
  (ensures (== (nreps c k) (if (and (<= 0 r) (< r k)) 1 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call one_class c r (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma nreps_merge (params (c (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len c))) (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len c))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len c)))
            (== (idx c a) a) (== (idx c b) b) (!= a b))
  (ensures (== (nreps (relabel c a b) k) (- (nreps c k) (if (< b k) 1 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call nreps_merge c a b (- k 1))
        (assert (== (idx (relabel c a b) (- k 1)) (if (== (idx c (- k 1)) b) a (idx c (- k 1))))))
      (block))))

(lemma conn_trans (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (x int) (y int) (z int))
  (requires (edges_connected es x y) (edges_connected es y z))
  (ensures (edges_connected es x z))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) x) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) y))) (path_follows_edges es p)))
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) y) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) z))) (path_follows_edges es q)))
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (concat p (drop q 1)))
    (forall ((k int)) (call cat_at es p q k))
    (assert (== (len r) (- (+ (len p) (len q)) 1)))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) x))
    (if (> (len q) 1)
      (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) (idx q (- (len q) 1))))
      (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) (idx p (- (len p) 1)))))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) z))
    (assert (path_follows_edges es r))
    (assert (and (and (> (len r) 0) (and (== (idx r 0) x) (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) z))) (path_follows_edges es r)))))
(lemma conn_merge_at (params (es (seq (tuple int int int))) (c0 (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (v int) (wt int) (x int))
  (requires (reps_ok c0 n) (conn_rep es c0 n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)))
  (ensures
    (and (edges_connected (concat es (seq-lit (tuple u v wt))) (idx (relabel c0 (idx c0 u) (idx c0 v)) x) x)
         (edges_connected (concat es (seq-lit (tuple u v wt))) x (idx (relabel c0 (idx c0 u) (idx c0 v)) x))))
  (body
    (ghost-let a int (idx c0 u))
    (ghost-let b int (idx c0 v))
    (ghost-let e1 (seq (tuple int int int)) (concat es (seq-lit (tuple u v wt))))
    (assert (and (edges_connected es (idx c0 x) x) (edges_connected es x (idx c0 x))))
    (assert (and (edges_connected es a u) (edges_connected es u a)))
    (assert (and (edges_connected es b v) (edges_connected es v b)))
    (call conn_push es (tuple u v wt) (idx c0 x) x)
    (call conn_push es (tuple u v wt) x (idx c0 x))
    (assert (== (idx (relabel c0 a b) x) (if (== (idx c0 x) b) a (idx c0 x))))
    (if (== (idx c0 x) b)
      (block
        (call conn_push es (tuple u v wt) a u)
        (call conn_push es (tuple u v wt) u a)
        (call conn_push es (tuple u v wt) b v)
        (call conn_push es (tuple u v wt) v b)
        (call conn_edge es u v wt)
        (call conn_trans e1 a u v)
        (call conn_trans e1 a v b)
        (call conn_trans e1 a b x)
        (call conn_trans e1 x b v)
        (call conn_trans e1 x v u)
        (call conn_trans e1 x u a))
      (block))))
