      (and (and (<= 0 (idx l x)) (< (idx l x) n)) (== (idx l (idx l x)) (idx l x))))))))
(ghost-fn closed ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (t int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (i int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
             (and (and (< u (len l)) (<= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) t))
                  (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len l)))))
        (== (idx l u) (idx l (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))))
(ghost-fn done_upto ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (t int) (cu int) (ci int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (i int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
             (and (and (or (< u cu) (and (== u cu) (< i ci))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) t))
                  (and (< u (len l)) (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (len l))))))
        (== (idx l u) (idx l (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))))
(ghost-fn nx_upto ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t int) (nx int) (cu int) (ci int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (i int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
             (and (or (< u cu) (and (== u cu) (< i ci))) (> (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) t)))
        (<= nx (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))))
(ghost-fn reps_upto ((l (seq int)) (k int)) int
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len l))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (== k 0) 0 (+ (reps_upto l (- k 1)) (if (== (idx l (- k 1)) (- k 1)) 1 0)))))
(ghost-fn is_merge ((l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len l1) (len l0))
    (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l0))) (== (idx l1 x) (if (== (idx l0 x) b) a (idx l0 x))))))))
(ghost-fn merged ((l (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) (seq int)
  (body (seq-build (len l) (fn (x) (if (== (idx l x) b) a (idx l x))))))
(ghost-fn app ((k0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (k1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int) (w int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len k1) (+ (len k0) 1))
    (and (and (== (get (idx k1 (len k0)) 0) u) (and (== (get (idx k1 (len k0)) 1) v) (== (get (idx k1 (len k0)) 2) w)))
         (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len k0))) (== (idx k1 j) (idx k0 j))))))))
(ghost-fn prefix ((k0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (k1 (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (and (<= (len k0) (len k1))
    (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len k0))) (== (idx k1 j) (idx k0 j)))))))
(ghost-fn kw_le ((k (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int)) bool
  (body (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len k))) (<= (get (idx k j) 2) t)))))
(ghost-fn wts_in ((e (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len e)))
    (and (<= -100000 (get (idx e j) 2)) (<= (get (idx e j) 2) 100000))))))
(ghost-fn cnt_le ((e (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int)) int (decreases (len e))
  (body (if (== (len e) 0) 0 (+ (if (<= (get (idx e 0) 2) t) 1 0) (cnt_le (drop e 1) t)))))
(ghost-fn cnt_gt ((e (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int)) int (decreases (len e))
  (body (if (== (len e) 0) 0 (+ (if (> (get (idx e 0) 2) t) 1 0) (cnt_gt (drop e 1) t)))))
(ghost-fn ssum ((e (seq (tuple int int int))) (lo int) (hi int)) int (decreases (- hi lo))
  (body (if (<= hi lo) 0 (+ (ssum e lo (- hi 1)) (cnt_gt e (- hi 1))))))
(ghost-fn ind ((w int) (lo int) (hi int)) int (decreases (- hi lo))
  (body (if (<= hi lo) 0 (+ (ind w lo (- hi 1)) (if (> w (- hi 1)) 1 0)))))
(ghost-fn cut_ok ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (t int) (k (seq (tuple int int int)))) bool
  (body (and (lab_ok l (len g)) (and (closed g l t) (== (+ (reps_upto l (len g)) (cnt_le k t)) (len g))))))
(ghost-fn has_cut ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (k (seq (tuple int int int))) (tt int)) bool
  (body (exists ((l (seq int))) (cut_ok g l tt k))))
(ghost-fn covered ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (k (seq (tuple int int int))) (lo int) (hi int)) bool
  (body (forall ((tt int)) (=> (and (<= lo tt) (< tt hi)) (has_cut g k tt)))))
(ghost-fn linked ((k (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l))) (edges_connected k x (idx l x))))))
(ghost-fn is_rev ((p (seq int)) (r (seq int))) bool
  (body (and (== (len r) (len p))
    (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len p))) (== (idx r i) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) i))))))))
(ghost-fn is_cat ((p (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (r (seq int))) bool
  (body (and (and (> (len p) 0) (> (len q) 0))
    (and (== (len r) (- (+ (len p) (len q)) 1))
      (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len r)))
        (== (idx r i) (if (< i (len p)) (idx p i) (idx q (+ (- i (len p)) 1))))))))))
(ghost-fn internal_upto ((l (seq int)) (tr (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int)) bool
  (body (forall ((j int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (< j (len tr)))
             (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx tr j) 0)) (< (get (idx tr j) 0) (len l)))
                  (and (<= 0 (get (idx tr j) 1)) (< (get (idx tr j) 1) (len l)))))
        (== (idx l (get (idx tr j) 0)) (idx l (get (idx tr j) 1)))))))

(lemma wb_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (weights_bounded g) (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))))
  (ensures (and (<= -100000 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)) (<= (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) 100000)))
  (body (assert (has_edge g u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
(lemma wb_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))))
  (requires (weights_bounded g))
  (ensures (wbe g))
  (body (forall ((u int) (i int)) (call wb_one g u i))))

(lemma lab_rng (params (l (seq int)) (n int) (x int))
  (requires (lab_ok l n) (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx l x)) (< (idx l x) n)) (== (idx l (idx l x)) (idx l x)))
  (body (assert (== (len l) n))))
(lemma reps_ident (params (l (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len l))) (== (idx l x) x))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len l))))
  (ensures (== (reps_upto l k) k))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block (call reps_ident l (- k 1))
      (assert (== (reps_upto l k) (+ (reps_upto l (- k 1)) (if (== (idx l (- k 1)) (- k 1)) 1 0)))))
    (assert (== (reps_upto l k) 0)))))
(lemma reps_nonneg (params (l (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len l))))
  (ensures (>= (reps_upto l k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block (call reps_nonneg l (- k 1))
      (assert (== (reps_upto l k) (+ (reps_upto l (- k 1)) (if (== (idx l (- k 1)) (- k 1)) 1 0)))))
    (assert (== (reps_upto l k) 0)))))
(lemma reps_single (params (l (seq int)) (n int) (r int) (k int))
  (requires (lab_ok l n) (and (<= 0 r) (< r n))
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (== (idx l x) r)))
            (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (== (reps_upto l k) (if (< r k) 1 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block (call reps_single l n r (- k 1))
      (assert (== (reps_upto l k) (+ (reps_upto l (- k 1)) (if (== (idx l (- k 1)) (- k 1)) 1 0)))))
    (assert (== (reps_upto l k) 0)))))
(lemma reps_merge (params (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (n int) (k int))
  (requires (lab_ok l0 n) (is_merge l0 l1 a b) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
            (== (idx l0 a) a) (== (idx l0 b) b) (!= a b) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (== (reps_upto l1 k) (- (reps_upto l0 k) (if (< b k) 1 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block
      (call reps_merge l0 l1 a b n (- k 1))
      (assert (== (reps_upto l0 k) (+ (reps_upto l0 (- k 1)) (if (== (idx l0 (- k 1)) (- k 1)) 1 0))))
      (assert (== (reps_upto l1 k) (+ (reps_upto l1 (- k 1)) (if (== (idx l1 (- k 1)) (- k 1)) 1 0)))))
    (block
      (assert (== (reps_upto l0 k) 0))
      (assert (== (reps_upto l1 k) 0))))))
(lemma merge_one (params (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (n int) (x int))
  (requires (lab_ok l0 n) (is_merge l0 l1 a b) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
            (== (idx l0 a) a) (== (idx l0 b) b) (!= a b) (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 (idx l1 x)) (< (idx l1 x) n)) (== (idx l1 (idx l1 x)) (idx l1 x))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len l0) n))
    (assert (== (len l1) n))
    (assert (and (<= 0 (idx l0 x)) (< (idx l0 x) n)))
    (assert (== (idx l0 (idx l0 x)) (idx l0 x)))
    (assert (== (idx l1 x) (if (== (idx l0 x) b) a (idx l0 x))))
    (if (== (idx l0 x) b)
      (block
        (assert (== (idx l1 a) (if (== (idx l0 a) b) a (idx l0 a))))
        (assert (== (idx l1 a) a)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx l1 (idx l0 x)) (if (== (idx l0 (idx l0 x)) b) a (idx l0 (idx l0 x)))))
        (assert (== (idx l1 (idx l0 x)) (idx l0 x)))))))
(lemma merge_props (params (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (n int))
  (requires (lab_ok l0 n) (is_merge l0 l1 a b) (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))
            (== (idx l0 a) a) (== (idx l0 b) b) (!= a b))
  (ensures (lab_ok l1 n) (== (reps_upto l1 n) (- (reps_upto l0 n) 1)))
  (body
    (assert (== (len l0) n))
    (assert (== (len l1) n))
    (forall ((x int)) (call merge_one l0 l1 a b n x))
    (assert (lab_ok l1 n))
    (call reps_merge l0 l1 a b n n)))
(lemma coarse_closed (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (t int))
  (requires (is_merge l0 l1 a b) (closed g l0 t))
  (ensures (closed g l1 t))
  (body))
(lemma coarse_done (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (t int) (cu int) (ci int))
  (requires (is_merge l0 l1 a b) (done_upto g l0 t cu ci))
  (ensures (done_upto g l1 t cu ci))
  (body))
(lemma coarse_internal (params (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int)) (tr (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (k int))
  (requires (is_merge l0 l1 a b) (internal_upto l0 tr k) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len tr)))
            (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx tr k) 0)) (< (get (idx tr k) 0) (len l0)))
                 (and (<= 0 (get (idx tr k) 1)) (< (get (idx tr k) 1) (len l0))))
            (== (idx l0 (get (idx tr k) 0)) a) (== (idx l0 (get (idx tr k) 1)) b) (!= a b))
  (ensures (internal_upto l1 tr (+ k 1)))
  (body))
(lemma done_next (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (t int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (wfg g) (== (len l) (len g)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (done_upto g l t u i)
            (=> (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) t) (== (idx l u) (idx l (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))
  (ensures (done_upto g l t u (+ i 1)))
  (body))
(lemma nx_next (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t int) (nx0 int) (nx1 int) (u int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
            (nx_upto g t nx0 u i) (<= nx1 nx0)
            (=> (> (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) t) (<= nx1 (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
  (ensures (nx_upto g t nx1 u (+ i 1)))
  (body))
(lemma row_next (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (done_upto g l t u (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (done_upto g l t (+ u 1) 0))
  (body))
(lemma nx_row (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (t int) (nx int) (u int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (nx_upto g t nx u (len (idx g u))))
  (ensures (nx_upto g t nx (+ u 1) 0))
  (body))
(lemma close_level (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (t int))
  (requires (closed g l (- t 1)) (done_upto g l t (len g) 0))
  (ensures (closed g l t))
  (body))
(lemma close_skip (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (t int) (nx int) (tt int))
  (requires (closed g l t) (nx_upto g t nx (len g) 0) (and (<= t tt) (< tt nx)))
  (ensures (closed g l tt))
  (body))
(lemma kw_step (params (k0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (k1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int) (w int) (t int))
  (requires (kw_le k0 t) (app k0 k1 u v w) (<= w t))
  (ensures (kw_le k1 t))
  (body))
(lemma kw_mono (params (k (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int) (nx int))
  (requires (kw_le k t) (<= t nx))
  (ensures (kw_le k nx))
  (body))
(lemma step_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (k0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (k1 (seq (tuple int int int)))
                          (u int) (v int) (w int) (i int))
  (requires (are_valid_edges g k0) (app k0 k1 u v w)
            (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) w))
  (ensures (are_valid_edges g k1))
  (body (assert (has_edge g u v w))))

(lemma conn_refl (params (k (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int))
  (ensures (edges_connected k a a))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-lit a))
    (assert (path_follows_edges k p))
    (assert (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) a))) (path_follows_edges k p)))))
(lemma conn_edge (params (k (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int) (e int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len k))) (== (get (idx k e) 0) u) (== (get (idx k e) 1) v))
  (ensures (edges_connected k u v))
  (body
    (ghost-let p (seq int) (seq-lit u v))
    (assert (edge_in_set k u v))
    (assert (path_follows_edges k p))
    (assert (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) u) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) v))) (path_follows_edges k p)))))
(lemma mono_step (params (k0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (k1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (j int))
  (requires (prefix k0 k1) (path_follows_edges k0 p) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len p) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set k1 (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))
  (body
    (assert (edge_in_set k0 (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))
    (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len k0)))
      (or (and (== (get (idx k0 e) 0) (idx p j)) (== (get (idx k0 e) 1) (idx p (+ j 1))))
          (and (== (get (idx k0 e) 0) (idx p (+ j 1))) (== (get (idx k0 e) 1) (idx p j))))))
    (assert (== (idx k1 e) (idx k0 e)))))
(lemma conn_mono (params (k0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (k1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (prefix k0 k1) (edges_connected k0 a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected k1 a b))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges k0 p)))
    (forall ((j int)) (call mono_step k0 k1 p j))
    (assert (path_follows_edges k1 p))))
(lemma rev_step (params (k (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (r (seq int)) (j int))
  (requires (path_follows_edges k p) (is_rev p r) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len r) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set k (idx r j) (idx r (+ j 1))))
  (body
    (assert (edge_in_set k (idx p (- (- (len p) 2) j)) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) j))))
    (assert (== (idx r j) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) j))))
    (assert (== (idx r (+ j 1)) (idx p (- (- (len p) 2) j))))))
(lemma conn_sym (params (k (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (edges_connected k a b))
  (ensures (edges_connected k b a))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges k p)))
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (seq-build (len p) (fn (j) (idx p (- (- (len p) 1) j)))))
    (assert (is_rev p r))
    (forall ((j2 int)) (call rev_step k p r j2))
    (assert (path_follows_edges k r))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) b))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) a))))
(lemma cat_step (params (k (seq (tuple int int int))) (p (seq int)) (q (seq int)) (r (seq int)) (j int))
  (requires (is_cat p q r) (path_follows_edges k p) (path_follows_edges k q)
            (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (idx q 0)) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (- (len r) 1))))
  (ensures (edge_in_set k (idx r j) (idx r (+ j 1))))
  (body
    (if (< j (- (len p) 1))
      (block
        (assert (edge_in_set k (idx p j) (idx p (+ j 1))))
        (assert (== (idx r j) (idx p j)))
        (assert (== (idx r (+ j 1)) (idx p (+ j 1)))))
      (block
        (assert (edge_in_set k (idx q (+ (- j (len p)) 1)) (idx q (+ (- j (len p)) 2))))
        (assert (== (idx r j) (idx q (+ (- j (len p)) 1))))
        (assert (== (idx r (+ j 1)) (idx q (+ (- j (len p)) 2))))))))
(lemma conn_trans (params (k (seq (tuple int int int))) (a int) (b int) (c int))
  (requires (edges_connected k a b) (edges_connected k b c))
  (ensures (edges_connected k a c))
  (body
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) a) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) b))) (path_follows_edges k p)))
    (obtain ((q (seq int))) (and (and (> (len q) 0) (and (== (idx q 0) b) (== (idx q (- (len q) 1)) c))) (path_follows_edges k q)))
    (ghost-let r (seq int) (seq-build (- (+ (len p) (len q)) 1)
      (fn (j) (if (< j (len p)) (idx p j) (idx q (+ (- j (len p)) 1))))))
    (assert (is_cat p q r))
    (assert (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) (idx q 0)))
    (forall ((j2 int)) (call cat_step k p q r j2))
    (assert (path_follows_edges k r))
    (assert (== (idx r 0) a))
    (assert (== (idx r (- (len r) 1)) c))))
(lemma link_one (params (k0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (k1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int))
                        (u int) (v int) (w int) (n int) (x int))
  (requires (lab_ok l0 n) (linked k0 l0) (app k0 k1 u v w) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (is_merge l0 l1 (idx l0 u) (idx l0 v)) (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)))
  (ensures (edges_connected k1 x (idx l1 x)))
  (body
    (ghost-let a int (idx l0 u))
    (ghost-let b int (idx l0 v))
    (assert (prefix k0 k1))
    (assert (edges_connected k0 x (idx l0 x)))
    (call conn_mono k0 k1 x (idx l0 x))
    (if (== (idx l0 x) b)
      (block
        (assert (edges_connected k0 v b))
        (assert (edges_connected k0 u a))
        (call conn_mono k0 k1 v b)
        (call conn_mono k0 k1 u a)
        (call conn_sym k1 v b)
        (call conn_edge k1 u v (len k0))
        (call conn_sym k1 u v)
        (call conn_trans k1 x b v)
        (call conn_trans k1 x v u)
        (call conn_trans k1 x u a)
        (assert (== (idx l1 x) a)))
      (assert (== (idx l1 x) (idx l0 x))))))
(lemma step_linked (params (k0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (k1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (l0 (seq int)) (l1 (seq int))
                           (u int) (v int) (w int) (n int))
  (requires (lab_ok l0 n) (linked k0 l0) (app k0 k1 u v w) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))
            (is_merge l0 l1 (idx l0 u) (idx l0 v)))
  (ensures (linked k1 l1))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call link_one k0 k1 l0 l1 u v w n x))))
(lemma span_pair (params (k (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (linked k l) (== (len l) n) (> n 0)
            (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (== (idx l x) (idx l 0))))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
  (ensures (edges_connected k u v))
  (body
    (assert (edges_connected k u (idx l u)))
    (assert (edges_connected k v (idx l v)))
    (call conn_sym k v (idx l 0))
    (call conn_trans k u (idx l 0) v)))

(lemma cnt_split (params (e (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int))
  (ensures (== (+ (cnt_le e t) (cnt_gt e t)) (len e)))
  (decreases (len e))
  (body
    (if (> (len e) 0)
      (block
        (call cnt_split (drop e 1) t)
        (assert (== (cnt_le e t) (+ (if (<= (get (idx e 0) 2) t) 1 0) (cnt_le (drop e 1) t))))
        (assert (== (cnt_gt e t) (+ (if (> (get (idx e 0) 2) t) 1 0) (cnt_gt (drop e 1) t)))))
      (block (assert (== (cnt_le e t) 0)) (assert (== (cnt_gt e t) 0))))))
(lemma cnt_le_all (params (k (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int))
  (requires (kw_le k t))
  (ensures (== (cnt_le k t) (len k)))
  (decreases (len k))
  (body
    (if (> (len k) 0)
      (block
        (assert (kw_le (drop k 1) t))
        (call cnt_le_all (drop k 1) t)
        (assert (== (cnt_le k t) (+ (if (<= (get (idx k 0) 2) t) 1 0) (cnt_le (drop k 1) t)))))
      (assert (== (cnt_le k t) 0)))))
(lemma cnt_le_app (params (k0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (k1 (seq (tuple int int int))) (u int) (v int) (w int) (tt int))
  (requires (app k0 k1 u v w))
  (ensures (== (cnt_le k1 tt) (+ (cnt_le k0 tt) (if (<= w tt) 1 0))))
  (decreases (len k0))
  (body
    (assert (== (cnt_le k1 tt) (+ (if (<= (get (idx k1 0) 2) tt) 1 0) (cnt_le (drop k1 1) tt))))
    (if (== (len k0) 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (len (drop k1 1)) 0))
        (assert (== (cnt_le (drop k1 1) tt) 0))
        (assert (== (cnt_le k0 tt) 0)))
      (block
        (assert (== (idx k1 0) (idx k0 0)))
        (assert (== (cnt_le k0 tt) (+ (if (<= (get (idx k0 0) 2) tt) 1 0) (cnt_le (drop k0 1) tt))))
        (assert (app (drop k0 1) (drop k1 1) u v w))
        (call cnt_le_app (drop k0 1) (drop k1 1) u v w tt)))))
(lemma cov_app (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (k0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (k1 (seq (tuple int int int)))
                       (lo int) (t int) (u int) (v int) (w int) (tt int))
  (requires (covered g k0 lo t) (app k0 k1 u v w) (>= w t) (and (<= lo tt) (< tt t)))
  (ensures (has_cut g k1 tt))
  (body
    (assert (covered g k0 lo t))
    (assert (has_cut g k0 tt))
    (obtain ((l3 (seq int))) (cut_ok g l3 tt k0))
    (call cnt_le_app k0 k1 u v w tt)
    (assert (cut_ok g l3 tt k1))
    (assert (has_cut g k1 tt))))
(lemma step_covered (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (k0 (seq (tuple int int int))) (k1 (seq (tuple int int int)))
                            (lo int) (t int) (u int) (v int) (w int))
  (requires (covered g k0 lo t) (app k0 k1 u v w) (>= w t))
  (ensures (covered g k1 lo t))
  (body (forall ((tt int)) (call cov_app g k0 k1 lo t u v w tt))))
(lemma cov_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (k (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int))
                      (lo int) (t int) (nx int) (tt int))
  (requires (covered g k lo t) (lab_ok l (len g)) (closed g l t) (nx_upto g t nx (len g) 0) (kw_le k t)
            (== (+ (reps_upto l (len g)) (len k)) (len g)) (and (<= lo t) (< t nx)) (and (<= lo tt) (< tt nx)))
  (ensures (has_cut g k tt))
  (body
    (if (< tt t)
      (block
        (assert (covered g k lo t))
        (assert (has_cut g k tt)))
      (block
        (call close_skip g l t nx tt)
        (call kw_mono k t tt)
        (call cnt_le_all k tt)
        (assert (cut_ok g l tt k))
        (assert (has_cut g k tt))))))
(lemma cov_extend (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (k (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int))
                          (lo int) (t int) (nx int))
  (requires (covered g k lo t) (lab_ok l (len g)) (closed g l t) (nx_upto g t nx (len g) 0) (kw_le k t)
            (== (+ (reps_upto l (len g)) (len k)) (len g)) (and (<= lo t) (< t nx)))
  (ensures (covered g k lo nx))
  (body (forall ((tt int)) (call cov_pt g k l lo t nx tt))))

(lemma gpath (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (wfg g) (wbe g) (lab_ok l (len g)) (closed g l 100000)
            (> (len p) 0) (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) (len g))) (path_follows_graph g p)
            (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p m)) (< (idx p m) (len g))) (== (idx l (idx p m)) (idx l (idx p 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call gpath g l p (- m 1))
        (assert (graph_has_any_edge g (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 (idx p (- m 1))) (< (idx p (- m 1)) (len g)))
                                    (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g (idx p (- m 1)))))))
                               (== (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- m 1))) i) 0) (idx p m))))
        (assert (<= (get (idx (idx g (idx p (- m 1))) i) 1) 100000)))
      (block))))
(lemma lab_same (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (l (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (wfg g) (wbe g) (> (len g) 0) (lab_ok l (len g)) (closed g l 100000) (graph_is_connected g)
            (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))))
  (ensures (== (idx l x) (idx l 0)))
  (body
    (assert (graph_is_connected g))
    (assert (nodes_have_path g 0 x))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x))) (path_follows_graph g p)))
    (call gpath g l p (- (len p) 1))))

(lemma edge_range (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (tr (seq (tuple int int int))) (k int))
  (requires (wfg g) (are_valid_edges g tr) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len tr))))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx tr k) 0)) (< (get (idx tr k) 0) (len g)))
                (and (<= 0 (get (idx tr k) 1)) (< (get (idx tr k) 1) (len g)))))
  (body
    (ghost-let a int (get (idx tr k) 0))
    (ghost-let b int (get (idx tr k) 1))
    (ghost-let w int (get (idx tr k) 2))
    (assert (has_edge g a b w))
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g a)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0) b) (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1) w))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))))))
(lemma edge_closed (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (tr (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)) (t int) (k int))
  (requires (wfg g) (are_valid_edges g tr) (== (len l) (len g)) (closed g l t) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len tr))))
  (ensures (and (and (<= 0 (get (idx tr k) 0)) (< (get (idx tr k) 0) (len g)))
                (and (<= 0 (get (idx tr k) 1)) (< (get (idx tr k) 1) (len g))))
           (=> (<= (get (idx tr k) 2) t) (== (idx l (get (idx tr k) 0)) (idx l (get (idx tr k) 1)))))
  (body
    (ghost-let a int (get (idx tr k) 0))
    (ghost-let b int (get (idx tr k) 1))
    (ghost-let w int (get (idx tr k) 2))
    (assert (has_edge g a b w))
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g a)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 0) b) (== (get (idx (idx g a) i) 1) w))))
    (assert (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))))))
(lemma path_int (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (tr (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)) (p (seq int)) (m int))
  (requires (wfg g) (are_valid_edges g tr) (lab_ok l (len g)) (internal_upto l tr (len tr))
            (> (len p) 0) (and (<= 0 (idx p 0)) (< (idx p 0) (len g))) (path_follows_edges tr p)
            (and (<= 0 m) (< m (len p))))
  (ensures (and (<= 0 (idx p m)) (< (idx p m) (len g))) (== (idx l (idx p m)) (idx l (idx p 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call path_int g tr l p (- m 1))
        (assert (edge_in_set tr (idx p (- m 1)) (idx p m)))
        (obtain ((e int)) (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e (len tr)))
          (or (and (== (get (idx tr e) 0) (idx p (- m 1))) (== (get (idx tr e) 1) (idx p m)))
              (and (== (get (idx tr e) 0) (idx p m)) (== (get (idx tr e) 1) (idx p (- m 1)))))))
        (call edge_range g tr e))
      (block))))
(lemma same_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (tr (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)) (x int))
  (requires (wfg g) (are_valid_edges g tr) (is_spanning g tr) (> (len g) 0) (lab_ok l (len g))
            (internal_upto l tr (len tr)) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))))
  (ensures (== (idx l x) (idx l 0)))
  (body
    (assert (is_spanning g tr))
    (assert (edges_connected tr 0 x))
    (obtain ((p (seq int))) (and (and (> (len p) 0) (and (== (idx p 0) 0) (== (idx p (- (len p) 1)) x))) (path_follows_edges tr p)))
    (call path_int g tr l p (- (len p) 1))))
(lemma all_internal_same (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (tr (seq (tuple int int int))) (l (seq int)))
  (requires (wfg g) (are_valid_edges g tr) (is_spanning g tr) (> (len g) 0) (lab_ok l (len g))
            (internal_upto l tr (len tr)))
  (ensures (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (== (idx l x) (idx l 0)))))
  (body (forall ((x int)) (call same_one g tr l x))))
(lemma tree_lower (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (tr (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int) (l (seq int)) (k int))
  (requires (wfg g) (are_valid_edges g tr) (is_spanning g tr) (> (len g) 0)
            (lab_ok l (len g)) (closed g l t) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len tr))) (internal_upto l tr k))
  (ensures (>= (+ (cnt_gt (drop tr k) t) 1) (reps_upto l (len g))))
  (decreases (- (len tr) k))
  (body
    (if (== k (len tr))
      (block
        (call all_internal_same g tr l)
        (call reps_single l (len g) (idx l 0) (len g))
        (assert (== (len (drop tr k)) 0))
        (assert (== (cnt_gt (drop tr k) t) 0)))
      (block
        (call edge_closed g tr l t k)
        (assert (== (idx (drop tr k) 0) (idx tr k)))
        (assert (== (drop (drop tr k) 1) (drop tr (+ k 1))))
        (assert (== (cnt_gt (drop tr k) t)
                    (+ (if (> (get (idx (drop tr k) 0) 2) t) 1 0) (cnt_gt (drop (drop tr k) 1) t))))
        (if (== (idx l (get (idx tr k) 0)) (idx l (get (idx tr k) 1)))
          (call tree_lower g tr t l (+ k 1))
          (block
            (call lab_rng l (len g) (get (idx tr k) 0))
            (call lab_rng l (len g) (get (idx tr k) 1))
            (ghost-let a int (idx l (get (idx tr k) 0)))
            (ghost-let b int (idx l (get (idx tr k) 1)))
            (assert (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))))
            (assert (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g))))
            (assert (== (idx l a) a))
            (assert (== (idx l b) b))
            (ghost-let l1 (seq int) (merged l a b))
            (assert (is_merge l l1 a b))
            (call merge_props l l1 a b (len g))
            (call coarse_closed g l l1 a b t)
            (call coarse_internal l l1 tr a b k)
            (call tree_lower g tr t l1 (+ k 1))))))))
(lemma pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (kk (seq (tuple int int int))) (tr (seq (tuple int int int))) (t int))
  (requires (wfg g) (> (len g) 0) (are_valid_edges g tr) (is_spanning g tr)
            (== (len kk) (- (len g) 1)) (covered g kk -100000 100001) (and (<= -100000 t) (< t 100001)))
  (ensures (<= (cnt_gt kk t) (cnt_gt tr t)))
  (body
    (assert (covered g kk -100000 100001))
    (assert (has_cut g kk t))
    (obtain ((l (seq int))) (cut_ok g l t kk))
    (assert (lab_ok l (len g)))
    (assert (closed g l t))
    (assert (== (+ (reps_upto l (len g)) (cnt_le kk t)) (len g)))
    (assert (internal_upto l tr 0))
    (call tree_lower g tr t l 0)
    (assert (== (drop tr 0) tr))
    (call cnt_split kk t)))

(lemma w_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (e (seq (tuple int int int))) (j int))
  (requires (weights_bounded g) (are_valid_edges g e) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len e))))
  (ensures (and (<= -100000 (get (idx e j) 2)) (<= (get (idx e j) 2) 100000)))
  (body
    (assert (weights_bounded g))
    (assert (has_edge g (get (idx e j) 0) (get (idx e j) 1) (get (idx e j) 2)))))
(lemma weights_in (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (e (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (weights_bounded g) (are_valid_edges g e))
  (ensures (wts_in e))
  (body (forall ((j int)) (call w_one g e j))))
(lemma ssum_zero (params (e (seq (tuple int int int))) (lo int) (hi int))
  (requires (== (len e) 0))
  (ensures (== (ssum e lo hi) 0))
  (decreases (- hi lo))
  (body
    (if (> hi lo)
      (block
        (call ssum_zero e lo (- hi 1))
        (assert (== (cnt_gt e (- hi 1)) 0))
        (assert (== (ssum e lo hi) (+ (ssum e lo (- hi 1)) (cnt_gt e (- hi 1))))))
      (assert (== (ssum e lo hi) 0)))))
(lemma ssum_split (params (e (seq (tuple int int int))) (lo int) (hi int))
  (requires (> (len e) 0))
  (ensures (== (ssum e lo hi) (+ (ind (get (idx e 0) 2) lo hi) (ssum (drop e 1) lo hi))))
  (decreases (- hi lo))
  (body
    (if (> hi lo)
      (block
        (call ssum_split e lo (- hi 1))
        (assert (== (ssum e lo hi) (+ (ssum e lo (- hi 1)) (cnt_gt e (- hi 1)))))
        (assert (== (ssum (drop e 1) lo hi) (+ (ssum (drop e 1) lo (- hi 1)) (cnt_gt (drop e 1) (- hi 1)))))
        (assert (== (ind (get (idx e 0) 2) lo hi)
                    (+ (ind (get (idx e 0) 2) lo (- hi 1)) (if (> (get (idx e 0) 2) (- hi 1)) 1 0))))
        (assert (== (cnt_gt e (- hi 1))
                    (+ (if (> (get (idx e 0) 2) (- hi 1)) 1 0) (cnt_gt (drop e 1) (- hi 1))))))
      (block
        (assert (== (ssum e lo hi) 0))
        (assert (== (ssum (drop e 1) lo hi) 0))
        (assert (== (ind (get (idx e 0) 2) lo hi) 0))))))
(lemma ind_val (params (w int) (lo int) (hi int))
  (requires (<= lo hi))
  (ensures (== (ind w lo hi) (- (if (< w lo) lo (if (> w hi) hi w)) lo)))
  (decreases (- hi lo))
  (body
    (if (> hi lo)
      (block
        (call ind_val w lo (- hi 1))
        (assert (== (ind w lo hi) (+ (ind w lo (- hi 1)) (if (> w (- hi 1)) 1 0)))))
      (assert (== (ind w lo hi) 0)))))
(lemma layer (params (e (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (wts_in e))
  (ensures (== (total_weight e) (+ (* -100000 (len e)) (ssum e -100000 100000))))
  (decreases (len e))
  (body
    (if (> (len e) 0)
      (block
        (assert (wts_in (drop e 1)))
        (call layer (drop e 1))
        (call ssum_split e -100000 100000)
        (call ind_val (get (idx e 0) 2) -100000 100000)
        (assert (== (total_weight e) (+ (get (idx e 0) 2) (total_weight (drop e 1))))))
      (block
        (call ssum_zero e -100000 100000)
        (assert (== (total_weight e) 0))))))
(lemma sum_le (params (a (seq (tuple int int int))) (b (seq (tuple int int int))) (lo int) (hi int))
  (requires (forall ((t int)) (=> (and (<= lo t) (< t hi)) (<= (cnt_gt a t) (cnt_gt b t)))))
  (ensures (<= (ssum a lo hi) (ssum b lo hi)))
  (decreases (- hi lo))
  (body
    (if (> hi lo)
      (block
        (call sum_le a b lo (- hi 1))
        (assert (== (ssum a lo hi) (+ (ssum a lo (- hi 1)) (cnt_gt a (- hi 1)))))
        (assert (== (ssum b lo hi) (+ (ssum b lo (- hi 1)) (cnt_gt b (- hi 1))))))
      (block
        (assert (== (ssum a lo hi) 0))
        (assert (== (ssum b lo hi) 0))))))
(lemma beat (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (kk (seq (tuple int int int))) (tr (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (wfg g) (weights_bounded g) (> (len g) 0) (are_valid_edges g kk) (== (len kk) (- (len g) 1))
            (covered g kk -100000 100001) (is_spanning_tree g tr))
  (ensures (<= (total_weight kk) (total_weight tr)))
  (body
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g tr))
    (assert (covered g kk -100000 100001))
    (forall ((t int)) (call pt g kk tr t))
    (call sum_le kk tr -100000 100000)
    (call weights_in g kk)
    (call weights_in g tr)
    (call layer kk)
    (call layer tr)))
(lemma mst_final (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (k (seq (tuple int int int))))
  (requires (wfg g) (weights_bounded g) (> (len g) 0) (are_valid_edges g k) (is_spanning g k)
            (== (len k) (- (len g) 1)) (covered g k -100000 100001))
  (ensures (is_mst g k))
  (body
    (assert (is_spanning_tree g k))
    (forall ((other (seq (tuple int int int)))) (call beat g k other))
    (assert (is_mst g k))))

(def kruskal_mst
  (body
    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (assert (== g (field graph adj)))
    (assert (well_formed graph))
    (assert (wfg g))
    (assert (weights_bounded g))
    (assert (<= (len g) 100000))
    (assert (> (size graph) 0))
    (call wb_all g)
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (assert (== (len g) n))
    (assert (> n 0))
    (let-mut lab (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (x0) x0)))
    (let-mut kt (vec (tuple i64 i64 i64)) (vec-new))
    (call reps_ident lab n)
    (forall ((a0 int)) (call conn_refl kt a0))
    (assert (linked kt lab))
    (assert (closed g lab -100001))
    (assert (covered g kt -100000 -100000))
    (assert (kw_le kt -100000))
    (assert (are_valid_edges g kt))
    (let-mut t i64 -100000)
    (while (<= t 100000)
      (invariant (and (<= -100000 t) (<= t 100001)))
      (invariant (lab_ok lab n))
      (invariant (closed g lab (- t 1)))
      (invariant (== (+ (reps_upto lab n) (len kt)) n))
      (invariant (<= (len kt) n))
      (invariant (are_valid_edges g kt))
      (invariant (linked kt lab))
      (invariant (kw_le kt t))
      (invariant (covered g kt -100000 t))
      (decreases (- 100001 t))
      (let-mut nxt i64 100001)
      (let-mut u i64 0)
      (while (< u n)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
        (invariant (and (and (<= -100000 t) (<= t 100000)) (and (< t nxt) (<= nxt 100001))))
        (invariant (lab_ok lab n))
        (invariant (closed g lab (- t 1)))
        (invariant (== (+ (reps_upto lab n) (len kt)) n))
        (invariant (<= (len kt) n))
        (invariant (are_valid_edges g kt))
        (invariant (linked kt lab))
        (invariant (kw_le kt t))
        (invariant (covered g kt -100000 t))
        (invariant (done_upto g lab t u 0))
        (invariant (nx_upto g t nxt u 0))
        (decreases (- n u))
        (let deg i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) u)))
        (let-mut i i64 0)
        (while (< i deg)
          (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i deg)))
          (invariant (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (== deg (len (idx g u)))))
          (invariant (and (and (<= -100000 t) (<= t 100000)) (and (< t nxt) (<= nxt 100001))))
          (invariant (lab_ok lab n))
          (invariant (closed g lab (- t 1)))
          (invariant (== (+ (reps_upto lab n) (len kt)) n))
          (invariant (<= (len kt) n))
          (invariant (are_valid_edges g kt))
          (invariant (linked kt lab))
          (invariant (kw_le kt t))
          (invariant (covered g kt -100000 t))
          (invariant (done_upto g lab t u i))
          (invariant (nx_upto g t nxt u i))
          (decreases (- deg i))
          (let ed (tuple i64 i64) (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i))
          (let v i64 (get ed 0))
          (let w i64 (get ed 1))
          (assert (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
          (assert (and (<= -100000 w) (<= w 100000)))
          (ghost-let nxt0 int nxt)
          (if (== w t)
            (block
              (call lab_rng lab n u)
              (call lab_rng lab n v)
              (let a i64 (idx lab u))
              (let b i64 (idx lab v))
              (assert (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)))
              (assert (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
              (assert (== (idx lab a) a))
              (assert (== (idx lab b) b))
              (if (!= a b)
                (block
                  (ghost-let lab0 (seq int) lab)
                  (ghost-let kt0 (seq (tuple int int int)) kt)
                  (let nl (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (x1) (if (== (idx lab x1) b) a (idx lab x1)))))
                  (set lab nl)
                  (push kt (tuple u v w))
                  (assert (is_merge lab0 lab a b))
                  (assert (app kt0 kt u v w))
                  (call merge_props lab0 lab a b n)
                  (call reps_nonneg lab n)
                  (call coarse_closed g lab0 lab a b (- t 1))
                  (call coarse_done g lab0 lab a b t u i)
                  (call step_valid g kt0 kt u v w i)
                  (call kw_step kt0 kt u v w t)
                  (call step_linked kt0 kt lab0 lab u v w n)
                  (call step_covered g kt0 kt -100000 t u v w)
                  (assert (== (idx lab u) (idx lab v))))
                (block)))
            (if (> w t)

  (body (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
        (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0)))))
(ghost-fn allzero ((f (seq (seq int)))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
        (== (idx (idx f u) v) 0)))))
(ghost-fn dims ((f (seq (seq int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (== (len f) n) (forall ((r int)) (=> (and (<= 0 r) (< r n)) (== (len (idx f r)) n))))))
(ghost-fn ins ((st (seq int)) (u int)) bool
  (body (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len st))) (>= (idx st u) 0))))
(ghost-fn rs ((h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (rs h u (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1))))))
(ghost-fn rowx ((h (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (u int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (rowx h st u (- m 1)) (if (ins st (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0)))))
(ghost-fn cterm ((h (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (u int) (v int)) int
  (body (if (and (ins st u) (not (ins st v))) (get_flow h u v)
          (if (and (not (ins st u)) (ins st v)) (neg (get_flow h u v)) 0))))
(ghost-fn rowt ((h (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (u int) (m int)) int (decreases m)
  (body (if (<= m 0) 0 (+ (rowt h st u (- m 1)) (cterm h st u (- m 1))))))
(ghost-fn tt ((h (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (tt h st (- a 1) n) (rowt h st (- a 1) n)))))
(ghost-fn snn ((h (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (a int) (n int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (snn h st (- a 1) n) (if (ins st (- a 1)) (rs h (- a 1) n) 0)))))
(ghost-fn xx ((h (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (a int) (b int)) int (decreases a)
  (body (if (<= a 0) 0 (+ (xx h st (- a 1) b) (rowx h st (- a 1) b)))))
(ghost-fn cc ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (k int) (b int)) int (decreases b)
  (body (if (<= b 0) 0 (+ (cc g h st k (- b 1)) (if (ins st (- b 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- b 1) k) 0)))))
(ghost-fn ek ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) 0
    (+ (ek g h u (- k 1) m)
       (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u))) (< (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) m)))
           (get_flow h u (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0))
           0)))))
(ghost-fn cnt ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int)) int (decreases k)
  (body (if (<= k 0) 0
    (+ (cnt g h u (- k 1) m)
       (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) m)))
           (get_flow h u m)
           0)))))
(ghost-fn dom ((h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
        (<= (cterm h st u v) (cterm f st u v))))))
(ghost-fn cutf ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (i int))
    (=> (and (and (ins st u) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
             (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (not (ins st (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))
        (>= (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))))
(ghost-fn cutb ((f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len st))) (not (ins st u))) (ins st v))
        (<= (get_flow f u v) 0)))))
(ghost-fn st_ok ((st (seq int)) (q (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len st)))
        (and (>= (idx st w) -1)
             (=> (>= (idx st w) 0) (and (< (idx st w) (len q)) (== (idx q (idx st w)) w))))))))
(ghost-fn qu_ok ((st (seq int)) (q (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((k int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len q)))
        (and (and (<= 0 (idx q k)) (< (idx q k) (len st))) (== (idx st (idx q k)) k))))))
(ghost-fn tree ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (pe (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len st))) (and (< w (len par)) (< w (len pe)))) (> (idx st w) 0))
        (and (and (and (<= 0 (idx par w)) (< (idx par w) (len st)))
                  (and (< (idx par w) (len g)) (and (<= 0 (idx st (idx par w))) (< (idx st (idx par w)) (idx st w)))))
             (and (=> (>= (idx pe w) 0)
                      (and (< (idx pe w) (len (idx g (idx par w))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g (idx par w)) (idx pe w)) 0) w)
                                (< (get_flow f (idx par w) w) (get (idx (idx g (idx par w)) (idx pe w)) 1)))))
                  (=> (< (idx pe w) 0) (> (get_flow f w (idx par w)) 0))))))))
(ghost-fn closed ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (hd int)) bool
  (body (and
    (forall ((u int) (i int))
      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (< u (len st)))
               (and (and (<= 0 (idx st u)) (< (idx st u) hd)) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))))
          (or (ins st (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
              (>= (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len st))) (and (<= 0 (idx st u)) (< (idx st u) hd))) (and (
<= 0 v) (< v (len st))))
          (or (ins st v) (<= (get_flow f v u) 0)))))))
(ghost-fn fcl ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (x int) (i int)) bool
  (body (forall ((e int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e i)) (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (< e (len (idx g x)))))
        (or (ins st (get (idx (idx g x) e) 0))
            (>= (get_flow f x (get (idx (idx g x) e) 0)) (get (idx (idx g x) e) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn bcl ((f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (x int) (yb int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y yb)) (< y (len st)))
        (or (ins st y) (<= (get_flow f y x) 0))))))
(ghost-fn upd ((s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (v int) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s1) (len s0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s0))))
             (and (== (idx s1 v) x) (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len s0))) (!= w v)) (== (idx s1 w) (idx s0 w))))))))
(ghost-fn appended ((q0 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (v int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len q1) (+ (len q0) 1)) (== (idx q1 (len q0)) v))
             (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len q0))) (== (idx q1 k) (idx q0 k)))))))
(ghost-fn upd2 ((f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len f1) (len f0)) (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len f0))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx f0 a))))))
    (forall ((r int) (c int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len f0)))
          (and (== (len (idx f1 r)) (len (idx f0 r)))
               (=> (and (<= 0 c) (< c (len (idx f0 r))))
                   (== (idx (idx f1 r) c) (+ (idx (idx f0 r) c) (if (and (== r a) (== c b)) d 0))))))))))
(ghost-fn frame ((f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (lim int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len st))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len st))))
             (and (and (<= 0 (idx st a)) (<= (idx st a) lim)) (and (<= 0 (idx st b)) (<= (idx st b) lim))))
        (== (get_flow f1 a b) (get_flow f0 a b))))))
(ghost-fn netrel ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (cur int) (t int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len g)))
        (== (- (rs f1 w (len g)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f1 w (len g)))
            (+ (- (- (rs f0 w (len g)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f0 w (len g))) (if (== w t) 1 0)) (if (== w cur) 1 0)))))))

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))

(lemma z_out (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (allzero f))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call z_out g f u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma z_in (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (allzero f))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call z_in g f u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma zero_ok (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (allzero f))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f) (nng f) (is_conserved g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) 0))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (k int)) (call z_out g f u k))
    (forall ((u int) (k int)) (call z_in g f u k))
    (assert (== (total_flow_out g f s) 0))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f s) 0))))

(lemma gf_pt (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (upd2 f0 f1 a b d))
  (ensures (== (get_flow f1 x y) (+ (get_flow f0 x y) (if (and (== x a) (== y b)) d 0))))
  (body))
(lemma rs_upd (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (upd2 f0 f1 a b d) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (rs f1 u m) (+ (rs f0 u m) (if (and (== u a) (< b m)) d 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (block (call rs_upd f0 f1 a b d u (- m 1)) (call gf_pt f0 f1 a b d u (- m 1))) (block))))
(lemma sfi_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (upd2 f0 f1 a b d) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f1 u k) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g f0 u k) (if (and (== u b) (< a k)) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (block (call sfi_upd g f0 f1 a b d u (- k 1)) (call gf_pt f0 f1 a b d (- k 1) u)) (block))))
(lemma dims_upd (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (n int))
  (requires (dims f0 n) (upd2 f0 f1 a b d))
  (ensures (dims f1 n))
  (body))
(lemma nng_upd (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (nng f0) (upd2 f0 f1 a b d) (>= (+ (get_flow f0 a b) d) 0))
  (ensures (nng f1))
  (body))
(lemma rc_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (c int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g f0) (upd2 f0 f1 a b d)
            (or (<= d 0) (and (has_capacity g a b c) (<= (+ (get_flow f0 a b) d) c))))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f1))
  (body))
(lemma frame_step (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (fa (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (d int) (cur int) (p int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 cur) (< cur (len st))) (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len st)))
            (and (<= 0 (idx st p)) (< (idx st p) (idx st cur)))
            (frame f0 fa st (idx st cur)) (upd2 fa f1 a b d)
            (or (and (== a p) (== b cur)) (and (== a cur) (== b p))))
  (ensures (frame f0 f1 st (idx st p)))
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call gf_pt fa f1 a b d x y))))
(lemma walk_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (fa (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (cur int) (p int) (t int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 cur) (< cur (len g))) (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len g))) (!= p cur)
            (netrel g f0 fa cur t) (upd2 fa f1 a b d)
            (or (and (and (== a p) (== b cur)) (== d 1)) (and (and (== a cur) (== b p)) (== d -1))))
  (ensures (netrel g f0 f1 p t))
  (body
    (forall ((w int)) (call rs_upd fa f1 a b d w (len g)))
    (forall ((w int)) (call sfi_upd g fa f1 a b d w (len g)))))

(lemma sup_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g h) (nng h) (!= (get_flow h u v) 0))
  (ensures (istgt g u v))
  (body
    (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (get_flow h u v) c)))
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))))
(lemma ek0 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wfg g) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (ek g h u k 0) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call ek0 g h u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma ek_split (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (>= k 0) (>= m 1))
  (ensures (== (ek g h u k m) (+ (ek g h u k (- m 1)) (cnt g h u k (- m 1)))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call ek_split g h u (- k 1) m) (block))))
(lemma cnt_hit (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (j int) (m int) (k int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) m) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (cnt g h u k m) (if (< j k) (get_flow h u m) 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
          (block
            (call cnt_hit g h u j m (- k 1))
            (if (!= (- k 1) j) (assert (!= (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) m)) (block)))
          (block))))
(lemma cnt_miss (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int) (k int))
  (requires (not (istgt g u m)) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (cnt g h u k m) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call cnt_miss g h u m (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma sfo_ek (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wfg g) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k) (ek g h u k (len g))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call sfo_ek g h u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma rs_ek (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (respects_capacity g h) (nng h) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (rs h u m) (ek g h u (len (idx g u)) m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call rs_ek g h u (- m 1))
        (call ek_split g h u (len (idx g u)) m)
        (if (istgt g u (- m 1))
          (block
            (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
                                   (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) (- m 1))))
            (call cnt_hit g h u j (- m 1) (len (idx g u))))
          (block
            (if (!= (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0) (call sup_pt g h u (- m 1)) (block))
            (call cnt_miss g h u (- m 1) (len (idx g u))))))
      (call ek0 g h u (len (idx g u))))))
(lemma oute (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (respects_capacity g h) (nng h))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g h u) (rs h u (len g))))
  (body (call sfo_ek g h u (len (idx g u))) (call rs_ek g h u (len g))))

(lemma aw_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (!= u s) (!= u t)
            (respects_capacity g f0) (nng f0) (respects_capacity g f1) (nng f1)
            (is_conserved g f0 s t) (netrel g f0 f1 s t))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in g f1 u) (total_flow_out g f1 u)))
  (body
    (call oute g f0 u)
    (call oute g f1 u)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f0 u) (total_flow_out g f0 u)))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f0 u) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f0 u (len g))))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f1 u) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f1 u (len g))))))
(lemma after_walk (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))) (!= s t)
            (respects_capacity g f0) (nng f0) (respects_capacity g f1) (nng f1)
            (is_conserved g f0 s t) (netrel g f0 f1 s t))
  (ensures (is_conserved g f1 s t) (== (flow_val g f1 s) (+ (flow_val g f0 s) 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((u int)) (call aw_pt g f0 f1 s t u))
    (call oute g f0 s)
    (call oute g f1 s)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f0 s) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f0 s (len g))))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f1 s) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f1 s (len g))))
    (assert (== (flow_val g f0 s) (- (total_flow_out g f0 s) (total_flow_in g f0 s))))
    (assert (== (flow_val g f1 s) (- (total_flow_out g f1 s) (total_flow_in g f1 s))))))

(lemma gf_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (capacities_bounded g) (respects_capacity g h))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow h u v) 100000))
  (body
    (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
      (block
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (get_flow h u v) c)))
        (assert (<= (get_flow h u v) 100000)))
      (block))))
(lemma rs_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (capacities_bounded g) (respects_capacity g h) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (<= (rs h u m) (* 100000 m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (block (call rs_le g h u (- m 1)) (call gf_le g h u (- m 1))) (block))))
(lemma sfi_nn (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (nng h))
  (ensures (>= (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call sfi_nn g h u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma val_bound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int))
  (requires (capacities_bounded g) (wfg g) (respects_capacity g h) (nng h) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))))
  (ensures (<= (flow_val g h s) 100000000))
  (body
    (call oute g h s)
    (call rs_le g h s (len g))
    (call sfi_nn g h s (len g))
    (assert (<= (len g) 1000))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h s) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h s (len g))))
    (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (- (total_flow_out g h s) (total_flow_in g h s))))))

(lemma rowt_split (params (h (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (rowt h st u m) (- (if (ins st u) (rs h u m) 0) (rowx h st u m))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (call rowt_split h st u (- m 1)) (block))))
(lemma tt_split (params (h (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= n 0))
  (ensures (== (tt h st a n) (- (snn h st a n) (xx h st a n))))

       (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) m)))
           (get_flow h u m)
           0)))))
(ghost-fn dom ((h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)))
        (<= (cterm h st u v) (cterm f st u v))))))
(ghost-fn cutf ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (i int))
    (=> (and (and (ins st u) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
             (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (not (ins st (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)))))
        (>= (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))))
(ghost-fn cutb ((f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len st))) (not (ins st u))) (ins st v))
        (<= (get_flow f u v) 0)))))
(ghost-fn st_ok ((st (seq int)) (q (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len st)))
        (and (>= (idx st w) -1)
             (=> (>= (idx st w) 0) (and (< (idx st w) (len q)) (== (idx q (idx st w)) w))))))))
(ghost-fn qu_ok ((st (seq int)) (q (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((k int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len q)))
        (and (and (<= 0 (idx q k)) (< (idx q k) (len st))) (== (idx st (idx q k)) k))))))
(ghost-fn tree ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (pe (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len st))) (and (< w (len par)) (< w (len pe)))) (> (idx st w) 0))
        (and (and (and (<= 0 (idx par w)) (< (idx par w) (len st)))
                  (and (< (idx par w) (len g)) (and (<= 0 (idx st (idx par w))) (< (idx st (idx par w)) (idx st w)))))
             (and (=> (>= (idx pe w) 0)
                      (and (< (idx pe w) (len (idx g (idx par w))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g (idx par w)) (idx pe w)) 0) w)
                                (< (get_flow f (idx par w) w) (get (idx (idx g (idx par w)) (idx pe w)) 1)))))
                  (=> (< (idx pe w) 0) (> (get_flow f w (idx par w)) 0))))))))
(ghost-fn closed ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (hd int)) bool
  (body (and
    (forall ((u int) (i int))
      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (< u (len st)))
               (and (and (<= 0 (idx st u)) (< (idx st u) hd)) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))))
          (or (ins st (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
              (>= (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len st))) (and (<= 0 (idx st u)) (< (idx st u) hd))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len st))))
          (or (ins st v) (<= (get_flow f v u) 0)))))))
(ghost-fn fcl ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (x int) (i int)) bool
  (body (forall ((e int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e i)) (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (< e (len (idx g x)))))
        (or (ins st (get (idx (idx g x) e) 0))
            (>= (get_flow f x (get (idx (idx g x) e) 0)) (get (idx (idx g x) e) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn bcl ((f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (x int) (yb int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y yb)) (< y (len st)))
        (or (ins st y) (<= (get_flow f y x) 0))))))
(ghost-fn upd ((s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (v int) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s1) (len s0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s0))))
             (and (== (idx s1 v) x) (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len s0))) (!= w v)) (== (idx s1 w) (idx s0 w))))))))
(ghost-fn appended ((q0 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (v int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len q1) (+ (len q0) 1)) (== (idx q1 (len q0)) v))
             (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len q0))) (== (idx q1 k) (idx q0 k)))))))
(ghost-fn upd2 ((f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len f1) (len f0)) (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len f0))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx f0 a))))))
    (forall ((r int) (c int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len f0)))
          (and (== (len (idx f1 r)) (len (idx f0 r)))
               (=> (and (<= 0 c) (< c (len (idx f0 r))))
                   (== (idx (idx f1 r) c) (+ (idx (idx f0 r) c) (if (and (== r a) (== c b)) d 0))))))))))
(ghost-fn frame ((f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (lim int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len st))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len st))))
             (and (and (<= 0 (idx st a)) (<= (idx st a) lim)) (and (<= 0 (idx st b)) (<= (idx st b) lim))))
        (== (get_flow f1 a b) (get_flow f0 a b))))))
(ghost-fn netrel ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (cur int) (t int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len g)))
        (== (- (rs f1 w (len g)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f1 w (len g)))
            (+ (- (- (rs f0 w (len g)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f0 w (len g))) (if (== w t) 1 0)) (if (== w cur) 1 0)))))))

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))

(lemma z_out (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (allzero f))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call z_out g f u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma z_in (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (allzero f))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call z_in g f u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma zero_ok (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (allzero f))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f) (nng f) (is_conserved g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) 0))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (k int)) (call z_out g f u k))
    (forall ((u int) (k int)) (call z_in g f u k))
    (assert (== (total_flow_out g f s) 0))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f s) 0))))

(lemma gf_pt (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (upd2 f0 f1 a b d))
  (ensures (== (get_flow f1 x y) (+ (get_flow f0 x y) (if (and (== x a) (== y b)) d 0))))
  (body))
(lemma rs_upd (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (upd2 f0 f1 a b d) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (rs f1 u m) (+ (rs f0 u m) (if (and (== u a) (< b m)) d 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (block (call rs_upd f0 f1 a b d u (- m 1)) (call gf_pt f0 f1 a b d u (- m 1))) (block))))
(lemma sfi_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (upd2 f0 f1 a b d) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f1 u k) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g f0 u k) (if (and (== u b) (< a k)) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (block (call sfi_upd g f0 f1 a b d u (- k 1)) (call gf_pt f0 f1 a b d (- k 1) u)) (block))))
(lemma dims_upd (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (n int))
  (requires (dims f0 n) (upd2 f0 f1 a b d))
  (ensures (dims f1 n))
  (body))
(lemma nng_upd (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (nng f0) (upd2 f0 f1 a b d) (>= (+ (get_flow f0 a b) d) 0))
  (ensures (nng f1))
  (body))
(lemma rc_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (c int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g f0) (upd2 f0 f1 a b d)
            (or (<= d 0) (and (has_capacity g a b c) (<= (+ (get_flow f0 a b) d) c)))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f1))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f1 u))))
            (> (idx (idx f1 u) v) 0))
  (ensures (exists ((c2 int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c2) (<= (idx (idx f1 u) v) c2))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len f1) (len f0)))
    (assert (== (len (idx f1 u)) (len (idx f0 u))))
    (assert (== (idx (idx f1 u) v) (+ (idx (idx f0 u) v) (if (and (== u a) (== v b)) d 0))))
    (if (and (and (== u a) (== v b)) (> d 0))
      (block
        (assert (== (get_flow f0 a b) (idx (idx f0 u) v)))
        (assert (has_capacity g u v c))
        (assert (<= (idx (idx f1 u) v) c))
        (assert (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f1 u) v) c))))
      (block
        (assert (<= (idx (idx f1 u) v) (idx (idx f0 u) v)))
        (assert (> (idx (idx f0 u) v) 0))
        (obtain ((c3 int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c3) (<= (idx (idx f0 u) v) c3)))
        (assert (and (has_capacity g u v c3) (<= (idx (idx f1 u) v) c3)))))))
(lemma rc_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (c int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g f0) (upd2 f0 f1 a b d)
            (or (<= d 0) (and (has_capacity g a b c) (<= (+ (get_flow f0 a b) d) c))))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f1))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call rc_pt g f0 f1 a b d c u v))))
(lemma frame_step (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (fa (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (d int) (cur int) (p int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 cur) (< cur (len st))) (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len st)))
            (and (<= 0 (idx st p)) (< (idx st p) (idx st cur)))
            (frame f0 fa st (idx st cur)) (upd2 fa f1 a b d)
            (or (and (== a p) (== b cur)) (and (== a cur) (== b p))))
  (ensures (frame f0 f1 st (idx st p)))
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call gf_pt fa f1 a b d x y))))
(lemma walk_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (fa (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (cur int) (p int) (t int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 cur) (< cur (len g))) (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len g))) (!= p cur)
            (netrel g f0 fa cur t) (upd2 fa f1 a b d)
            (or (and (and (== a p) (== b cur)) (== d 1)) (and (and (== a cur) (== b p)) (== d -1))))
  (ensures (netrel g f0 f1 p t))
  (body
    (forall ((w int)) (call rs_upd fa f1 a b d w (len g)))
    (forall ((w int)) (call sfi_upd g fa f1 a b d w (len g)))))

(lemma sup_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g h) (nng h) (!= (get_flow h u v) 0))
  (ensures (istgt g u v))
  (body
    (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (get_flow h u v) c)))
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))))
(lemma ek0 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wfg g) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (ek g h u k 0) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call ek0 g h u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma ek_split (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (>= k 0) (>= m 1))
  (ensures (== (ek g h u k m) (+ (ek g h u k (- m 1)) (cnt g h u k (- m 1)))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call ek_split g h u (- k 1) m) (block))))
(lemma cnt_hit (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (j int) (m int) (k int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) m) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (cnt g h u k m) (if (< j k) (get_flow h u m) 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
          (block
            (call cnt_hit g h u j m (- k 1))
            (if (!= (- k 1) j) (assert (!= (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) m)) (block)))
          (block))))
(lemma cnt_miss (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int) (k int))
  (requires (not (istgt g u m)) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (cnt g h u k m) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call cnt_miss g h u m (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma sfo_ek (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wfg g) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k) (ek g h u k (len g))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call sfo_ek g h u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma rs_ek (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (respects_capacity g h) (nng h) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (rs h u m) (ek g h u (len (idx g u)) m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call rs_ek g h u (- m 1))
        (call ek_split g h u (len (idx g u)) m)
        (if (istgt g u (- m 1))
          (block
            (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
                                   (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) (- m 1))))
            (call cnt_hit g h u j (- m 1) (len (idx g u))))
          (block
            (if (!= (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0) (call sup_pt g h u (- m 1)) (block))
            (call cnt_miss g h u (- m 1) (len (idx g u))))))
      (call ek0 g h u (len (idx g u))))))
(lemma oute (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (respects_capacity g h) (nng h))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g h u) (rs h u (len g))))
  (body (call sfo_ek g h u (len (idx g u))) (call rs_ek g h u (len g))))

(lemma aw_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (!= u s) (!= u t)
            (respects_capacity g f0) (nng f0) (respects_capacity g f1) (nng f1)
            (is_conserved g f0 s t) (netrel g f0 f1 s t))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in g f1 u) (total_flow_out g f1 u)))
  (body
    (call oute g f0 u)
    (call oute g f1 u)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f0 u) (total_flow_out g f0 u)))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f0 u) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f0 u (len g))))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f1 u) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f1 u (len g))))))
(lemma after_walk (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))) (!= s t)
            (respects_capacity g f0) (nng f0) (respects_capacity g f1) (nng f1)
            (is_conserved g f0 s t) (netrel g f0 f1 s t))
  (ensures (is_conserved g f1 s t) (== (flow_val g f1 s) (+ (flow_val g f0 s) 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((u int)) (call aw_pt g f0 f1 s t u))
    (call oute g f0 s)
    (call oute g f1 s)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f0 s) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f0 s (len g))))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f1 s) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f1 s (len g))))
    (assert (== (flow_val g f0 s) (- (total_flow_out g f0 s) (total_flow_in g f0 s))))
    (assert (== (flow_val g f1 s) (- (total_flow_out g f1 s) (total_flow_in g f1 s))))))

(lemma gf_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (capacities_bounded g) (respects_capacity g h))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow h u v) 100000))
  (body
    (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
      (block
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (get_flow h u v) c)))
        (assert (<= (get_flow h u v) 100000)))
      (block))))
(lemma rs_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (capacities_bounded g) (respects_capacity g h) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (<= (rs h u m) (* 100000 m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (block (call rs_le g h u (- m 1)) (call gf_le g h u (- m 1))) (block))))
(lemma sfi_nn (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (nng h))
  (ensures (>= (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call sfi_nn g h u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma val_bound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int))
  (requires (capacities_bounded g) (wfg g) (respects_capacity g h) (nng h) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))))
  (ensures (<= (flow_val g h s) 100000000))
  (body
    (call oute g h s)
    (call rs_le g h s (len g))
    (call sfi_nn g h s (len g))
    (assert (<= (len g) 1000))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h s) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h s (len g))))
    (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (- (total_flow_out g h s) (total_flow_in g h s))))))

(lemma rowt_split (params (h (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (rowt h st u m) (- (if (ins st u) (rs h u m) 0) (rowx h st u m))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (call rowt_split h st u (- m 1)) (block))))
(lemma tt_split (params (h (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= n 0))
  (ensures (== (tt h st a n) (- (snn h st a n) (xx h st a n))))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0) (block (call tt_split h st (- a 1) n) (call rowt_split h st (- a 1) n)) (block))))
(lemma cc_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (cc g h st 0 b) 0))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0) (call cc_zero g h st (- b 1)) (block))))
(lemma cc_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 1) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (cc g h st a b) (+ (cc g h st (- a 1) b) (rowx h st (- a 1) b))))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0) (call cc_step g h st a (- b 1)) (block))))
(lemma swap (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (xx h st a b) (cc g h st a b)))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0) (block (call swap g h st (- a 1) b) (call cc_step g h st a b)) (call cc_zero g h st b))))
(lemma net (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (a int))
  (requires (wfg g) (ins st s) (not (ins st t)) (respects_capacity g h) (nng h) (is_conserved g h s t)
            (and (<= 0 a) (<= a (len g))))
  (ensures (== (- (snn h st a (len g)) (cc g h st (len g) a)) (if (< s a) (flow_val g h s) 0)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call net g h st s t (- a 1))
