             (=> (>= (idx st w) 0) (and (< (idx st w) (len q)) (== (idx q (idx st w)) w))))))))
(ghost-fn qu_ok ((st (seq int)) (q (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((k int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len q)))
        (and (and (<= 0 (idx q k)) (< (idx q k) (len st))) (== (idx st (idx q k)) k))))))
(ghost-fn tree ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (pe (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len st))) (and (< w (len par)) (< w (len pe)))) (> (idx st w) 0))
        (and (and (and (<= 0 (idx par w)) (< (idx par w) (len st)))
                  (and (< (idx par w) (len g)) (and (<= 0 (idx st (idx par w))) (< (idx st (idx par w)) (idx st w)))))
             (and (=> (>= (idx pe w) 0)
                      (and (< (idx pe w) (len (idx g (idx par w))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g (idx par w)) (idx pe w)) 0) w)
                                (< (get_flow f (idx par w) w) (get (idx (idx g (idx par w)) (idx pe w)) 1)))))
                  (=> (< (idx pe w) 0) (> (get_flow f w (idx par w)) 0))))))))
(ghost-fn closed ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (hd int)) bool
  (body (and
    (forall ((u int) (i int))
      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (< u (len st)))
               (and (and (<= 0 (idx st u)) (< (idx st u) hd)) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))))
          (or (ins st (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0))
              (>= (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0)) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))))
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len st))) (and (<= 0 (idx st u)) (< (idx st u) hd))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len st))))
          (or (ins st v) (<= (get_flow f v u) 0)))))))
(ghost-fn fcl ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (x int) (i int)) bool
  (body (forall ((e int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 e) (< e i)) (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (< e (len (idx g x)))))
        (or (ins st (get (idx (idx g x) e) 0))
            (>= (get_flow f x (get (idx (idx g x) e) 0)) (get (idx (idx g x) e) 1)))))))
(ghost-fn bcl ((f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (x int) (yb int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int))
    (=> (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y yb)) (< y (len st)))
        (or (ins st y) (<= (get_flow f y x) 0))))))
(ghost-fn upd ((s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (v int) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s1) (len s0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s0))))
             (and (== (idx s1 v) x) (forall ((w int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len s0))) (!= w v)) (== (idx s1 w) (idx s0 w))))))))
(ghost-fn appended ((q0 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (v int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len q1) (+ (len q0) 1)) (== (idx q1 (len q0)) v))
             (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len q0))) (== (idx q1 k) (idx q0 k)))))))
(ghost-fn upd2 ((f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len f1) (len f0)) (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len f0))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx f0 a))))))
    (forall ((r int) (c int))
      (=> (and (<= 0 r) (< r (len f0)))
          (and (== (len (idx f1 r)) (len (idx f0 r)))
               (=> (and (<= 0 c) (< c (len (idx f0 r))))
                   (== (idx (idx f1 r) c) (+ (idx (idx f0 r) c) (if (and (== r a) (== c b)) d 0))))))))))
(ghost-fn frame ((f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (lim int)) bool
  (body (forall ((a int) (b int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len st))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len st))))
             (and (and (<= 0 (idx st a)) (<= (idx st a) lim)) (and (<= 0 (idx st b)) (<= (idx st b) lim))))
        (== (get_flow f1 a b) (get_flow f0 a b))))))
(ghost-fn netrel ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (cur int) (t int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int))
    (=> (and (<= 0 w) (< w (len g)))
        (== (- (rs f1 w (len g)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f1 w (len g)))
            (+ (- (- (rs f0 w (len g)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f0 w (len g))) (if (== w t) 1 0)) (if (== w cur) 1 0)))))))

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))

(lemma z_out (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (allzero f))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call z_out g f u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma z_in (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (allzero f))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call z_in g f u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma zero_ok (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (allzero f))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f) (nng f) (is_conserved g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) 0))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (k int)) (call z_out g f u k))
    (forall ((u int) (k int)) (call z_in g f u k))
    (assert (== (total_flow_out g f s) 0))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f s) 0))))

(lemma gf_pt (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (upd2 f0 f1 a b d))
  (ensures (== (get_flow f1 x y) (+ (get_flow f0 x y) (if (and (== x a) (== y b)) d 0))))
  (body))
(lemma rs_upd (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (upd2 f0 f1 a b d) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (rs f1 u m) (+ (rs f0 u m) (if (and (== u a) (< b m)) d 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (block (call rs_upd f0 f1 a b d u (- m 1)) (call gf_pt f0 f1 a b d u (- m 1))) (block))))
(lemma sfi_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (upd2 f0 f1 a b d) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f1 u k) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g f0 u k) (if (and (== u b) (< a k)) d 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (block (call sfi_upd g f0 f1 a b d u (- k 1)) (call gf_pt f0 f1 a b d (- k 1) u)) (block))))
(lemma dims_upd (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (n int))
  (requires (dims f0 n) (upd2 f0 f1 a b d))
  (ensures (dims f1 n))
  (body))
(lemma nng_upd (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (nng f0) (upd2 f0 f1 a b d) (>= (+ (get_flow f0 a b) d) 0))
  (ensures (nng f1))
  (body))
(lemma rc_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (c int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g f0) (upd2 f0 f1 a b d)
            (or (<= d 0) (and (has_capacity g a b c) (<= (+ (get_flow f0 a b) d) c)))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f1))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f1 u))))
            (> (idx (idx f1 u) v) 0))
  (ensures (exists ((c2 int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c2) (<= (idx (idx f1 u) v) c2))))
  (body
    (assert (== (len f1) (len f0)))
    (assert (== (len (idx f1 u)) (len (idx f0 u))))
    (assert (== (idx (idx f1 u) v) (+ (idx (idx f0 u) v) (if (and (== u a) (== v b)) d 0))))
    (if (and (and (== u a) (== v b)) (> d 0))
      (block
        (assert (== (get_flow f0 a b) (idx (idx f0 u) v)))
        (assert (has_capacity g u v c))
        (assert (<= (idx (idx f1 u) v) c))
        (assert (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f1 u) v) c))))
      (block
        (assert (<= (idx (idx f1 u) v) (idx (idx f0 u) v)))
        (assert (> (idx (idx f0 u) v) 0))
        (obtain ((c3 int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c3) (<= (idx (idx f0 u) v) c3)))
        (assert (and (has_capacity g u v c3) (<= (idx (idx f1 u) v) c3)))))))
(lemma rc_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (c int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g f0) (upd2 f0 f1 a b d)
            (or (<= d 0) (and (has_capacity g a b c) (<= (+ (get_flow f0 a b) d) c))))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f1))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call rc_pt g f0 f1 a b d c u v))))
(lemma frame_step (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (fa (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (a int) (b int) (d int) (cur int) (p int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 cur) (< cur (len st))) (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len st)))
            (and (<= 0 (idx st p)) (< (idx st p) (idx st cur)))
            (frame f0 fa st (idx st cur)) (upd2 fa f1 a b d)
            (or (and (== a p) (== b cur)) (and (== a cur) (== b p))))
  (ensures (frame f0 f1 st (idx st p)))
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call gf_pt fa f1 a b d x y))))
(lemma walk_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (fa (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (cur int) (p int) (t int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 cur) (< cur (len g))) (and (<= 0 p) (< p (len g))) (!= p cur)
            (netrel g f0 fa cur t) (upd2 fa f1 a b d)
            (or (and (and (== a p) (== b cur)) (== d 1)) (and (and (== a cur) (== b p)) (== d -1))))
  (ensures (netrel g f0 f1 p t))
  (body
    (forall ((w int)) (call rs_upd fa f1 a b d w (len g)))
    (forall ((w int)) (call sfi_upd g fa f1 a b d w (len g)))))

(lemma sup_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g h) (nng h) (!= (get_flow h u v) 0))
  (ensures (istgt g u v))
  (body
    (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (get_flow h u v) c)))
    (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                           (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))))
(lemma ek0 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wfg g) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (ek g h u k 0) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call ek0 g h u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma ek_split (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (>= k 0) (>= m 1))
  (ensures (== (ek g h u k m) (+ (ek g h u k (- m 1)) (cnt g h u k (- m 1)))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call ek_split g h u (- k 1) m) (block))))
(lemma cnt_hit (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (j int) (m int) (k int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) m) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (cnt g h u k m) (if (< j k) (get_flow h u m) 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
          (block
            (call cnt_hit g h u j m (- k 1))
            (if (!= (- k 1) j) (assert (!= (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) m)) (block)))
          (block))))
(lemma cnt_miss (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int) (k int))
  (requires (not (istgt g u m)) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (cnt g h u k m) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call cnt_miss g h u m (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma sfo_ek (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wfg g) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k) (ek g h u k (len g))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call sfo_ek g h u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma rs_ek (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (respects_capacity g h) (nng h) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (rs h u m) (ek g h u (len (idx g u)) m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call rs_ek g h u (- m 1))
        (call ek_split g h u (len (idx g u)) m)
        (if (istgt g u (- m 1))
          (block
            (obtain ((j int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx g u)))))
                                   (== (get (idx (idx g u) j) 0) (- m 1))))
            (call cnt_hit g h u j (- m 1) (len (idx g u))))
          (block
            (if (!= (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0) (call sup_pt g h u (- m 1)) (block))
            (call cnt_miss g h u (- m 1) (len (idx g u))))))
      (call ek0 g h u (len (idx g u))))))
(lemma oute (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (respects_capacity g h) (nng h))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g h u) (rs h u (len g))))
  (body (call sfo_ek g h u (len (idx g u))) (call rs_ek g h u (len g))))

(lemma aw_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (!= u s) (!= u t)
            (respects_capacity g f0) (nng f0) (respects_capacity g f1) (nng f1)
            (is_conserved g f0 s t) (netrel g f0 f1 s t))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_in g f1 u) (total_flow_out g f1 u)))
  (body
    (call oute g f0 u)
    (call oute g f1 u)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f0 u) (total_flow_out g f0 u)))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f0 u) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f0 u (len g))))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f1 u) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f1 u (len g))))))
(lemma after_walk (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wfg g) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))) (!= s t)
            (respects_capacity g f0) (nng f0) (respects_capacity g f1) (nng f1)
            (is_conserved g f0 s t) (netrel g f0 f1 s t))
  (ensures (is_conserved g f1 s t) (== (flow_val g f1 s) (+ (flow_val g f0 s) 1)))
  (body
    (forall ((u int)) (call aw_pt g f0 f1 s t u))
    (call oute g f0 s)
    (call oute g f1 s)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f0 s) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f0 s (len g))))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f1 s) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f1 s (len g))))
    (assert (== (flow_val g f0 s) (- (total_flow_out g f0 s) (total_flow_in g f0 s))))
    (assert (== (flow_val g f1 s) (- (total_flow_out g f1 s) (total_flow_in g f1 s))))))

(lemma gf_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (capacities_bounded g) (respects_capacity g h))
  (ensures (<= (get_flow h u v) 100000))
  (body
    (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
      (block
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (get_flow h u v) c)))
        (assert (<= (get_flow h u v) 100000)))
      (block))))
(lemma rs_le (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (capacities_bounded g) (respects_capacity g h) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (<= (rs h u m) (* 100000 m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (block (call rs_le g h u (- m 1)) (call gf_le g h u (- m 1))) (block))))
(lemma sfi_nn (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (nng h))
  (ensures (>= (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call sfi_nn g h u (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma val_bound (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int))
  (requires (capacities_bounded g) (wfg g) (respects_capacity g h) (nng h) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))))
  (ensures (<= (flow_val g h s) 100000000))
  (body
    (call oute g h s)
    (call rs_le g h s (len g))
    (call sfi_nn g h s (len g))
    (assert (<= (len g) 1000))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h s) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h s (len g))))
    (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (- (total_flow_out g h s) (total_flow_in g h s))))))

(lemma rowt_split (params (h (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (rowt h st u m) (- (if (ins st u) (rs h u m) 0) (rowx h st u m))))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (call rowt_split h st u (- m 1)) (block))))
(lemma tt_split (params (h (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (a int) (n int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= n 0))
  (ensures (== (tt h st a n) (- (snn h st a n) (xx h st a n))))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0) (block (call tt_split h st (- a 1) n) (call rowt_split h st (- a 1) n)) (block))))
(lemma cc_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (b int))
  (requires (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (cc g h st 0 b) 0))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0) (call cc_zero g h st (- b 1)) (block))))
(lemma cc_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 1) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (cc g h st a b) (+ (cc g h st (- a 1) b) (rowx h st (- a 1) b))))
  (decreases b)
  (body (if (> b 0) (call cc_step g h st a (- b 1)) (block))))
(lemma swap (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (>= a 0) (>= b 0))
  (ensures (== (xx h st a b) (cc g h st a b)))
  (decreases a)
  (body (if (> a 0) (block (call swap g h st (- a 1) b) (call cc_step g h st a b)) (call cc_zero g h st b))))
(lemma net (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (s int) (t int) (a int))
  (requires (wfg g) (ins st s) (not (ins st t)) (respects_capacity g h) (nng h) (is_conserved g h s t)
            (and (<= 0 a) (<= a (len g))))
  (ensures (== (- (snn h st a (len g)) (cc g h st (len g) a)) (if (< s a) (flow_val g h s) 0)))
  (decreases a)
  (body
    (if (> a 0)
      (block
        (call net g h st s t (- a 1))
        (if (ins st (- a 1))
          (block
            (call oute g h (- a 1))
            (assert (== (total_flow_in g h (- a 1)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h (- a 1) (len g))))
            (if (== (- a 1) s)
              (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (- (total_flow_out g h s) (total_flow_in g h s))))
              (block
                (assert (!= (- a 1) t))
                (assert (== (total_flow_in g h (- a 1)) (total_flow_out g h (- a 1)))))))
          (block)))
      (block))))
(lemma cut_id (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wfg g) (== (len st) (len g)) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g)))
            (ins st s) (not (ins st t)) (respects_capacity g h) (nng h) (is_conserved g h s t))
  (ensures (== (tt h st (len g) (len g)) (flow_val g h s)))
  (body
    (call tt_split h st (len g) (len g))
    (call swap g h st (len g) (len g))
    (call net g h st s t (len g))))
(lemma rowt_mono (params (h (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (st (seq int)) (u int) (m int) (n int))
  (requires (dom h f st n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m n)))

  (ensures (< (cntb a m) (cntb b m))) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m (+ k 1)) (call cnt_strict a b (- m 1) k) (call cnt_mono a b (- m 1)))))
(spec aug
  (params (fl (vec (vec i64))) (vis (vec bool)) (cm (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (u i64) (t i64))
  (returns (fo (vec (vec i64))) (vo (vec bool)) (found bool))
  (requires (mat_ok cm (len cm)) (mat_ok fl (len cm)) (bounded cm fl) (== (len vis) (len cm))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len cm))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len cm)))
            (not (ins vis u)) (not (ins vis t)))
  (ensures (mat_ok fo (len cm)) (bounded cm fo) (superset vis vo) (unch vis fl fo)
           (=> found (shift fl fo u t (len cm)))
           (=> (not found) (and (and (== fo fl) (ins vo u)) (and (not (ins vo t)) (closed_new cm fo vis vo (len cm))))))
  (effects))
(def aug (decreases (- (len vis) (cntb vis (len vis))))
  (body
    (if (== u t) (return fl vis true) (block))
    (let n i64 (len cm))
    (let-mut f (vec (vec i64)) fl)
    (let-mut vs (vec bool) vis)
    (set-idx vs u true)
    (call cnt_strict vis vs n u)
    (let-mut v i64 0)
    (while (< v n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 v) (<= v n)))
      (invariant (== f fl))
      (invariant (superset vis vs))
      (invariant (ins vs u))
      (invariant (not (ins vs t)))
      (invariant (> (cntb vs n) (cntb vis n)))
      (invariant (closed_ex cm f vis vs u n))
      (invariant (partial_u cm f vs u v))
      (decreases (- n v))
      (if (and (not (idx vs v)) (or (< (idx (idx f u) v) (idx (idx cm u) v)) (> (idx (idx f v) u) 0)))
        (block
          (call cnt_le vs n)
          (let ((f1 (vec (vec i64))) (vs1 (vec bool)) (fd bool)) (call aug f vs cm v t))
          (if fd
            (block
              (assert (== (get_flow f1 u v) (get_flow f u v)))
              (assert (== (get_flow f1 v u) (get_flow f v u)))
              (let-mut f2 (vec (vec i64)) f1)
              (if (< (idx (idx f2 u) v) (idx (idx cm u) v))
                (block
                  (set-idx (idx f2 u) v (+ (idx (idx f2 u) v) 1))
                  (assert (upd2 f1 f2 u v 1))
                  (call step_excess f1 f2 n u v 1)
                  (call unch_step vis vs f f1 f2 u v 1))
                (block
                  (set-idx (idx f2 v) u (- (idx (idx f2 v) u) 1))
                  (assert (upd2 f1 f2 v u -1))
                  (call step_excess f1 f2 n v u -1)
                  (call unch_step vis vs f f1 f2 v u -1)))
              (return f2 vs1 true))
            (block
              (call cnt_mono vs vs1 n)
              (set f f1)
              (set vs vs1))))
        (block))
      (set v (+ v 1)))
    (return f vs false)))

  (requires (mat_ok cm n) (cmb cm) (mat_ok f n) (bounded cm f) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m n)))
  (ensures (<= (rsum f u m) (* 100000 m))) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block (call rsum_le cm f n u (- m 1))
           (assert (<= (get_flow f u (- m 1)) (idx (idx cm u) (- m 1))))
           (assert (<= (idx (idx cm u) (- m 1)) 100000)))
    (block))))

        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))

  (decreases m)

  (requires (wf2 g) (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg f) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g f u) (rsum f u (len g))) (== (total_flow_in g f u) (colsum f u (len g))))
  (body
    (call colsum_eq g f u (len g))
    (call out_frs g f u (len (idx g u)))
    (call frs_full g f u (len g))))

(lemma val_cut (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (sv (seq bool)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf2 g) (is_valid_flow g f s t) (== (len sv) (len g)) (ins sv s) (not (ins sv t))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g f s) (- (rcut f sv false (len g) (len g)) (ccut f sv false (len g) (len g)))))
  (body
    (assert (respects_capacity g f))
    (assert (nonneg f))
    (forall ((u int)) (call conv g f u))
    (assert (cons_ok f s t (len g)))
    (call exsplit f sv (len g) (len g))
    (call fubini f sv (len g) (len g))

    (if (== u t) (return fl vis true) (block))
    (let n i64 (len cm))
    (let-mut f (vec (vec i64)) fl)
    (let-mut vs (vec bool) vis)
    (set-idx vs u true)
    (call cnt_strict vis vs n u)
    (let-mut v i64 0)
    (while (< v n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 v) (<= v n)))
      (invariant (== f fl))
      (invariant (superset vis vs))
      (invariant (ins vs u))
      (invariant (not (ins vs t)))
      (invariant (> (cntb vs n) (cntb vis n)))
      (invariant (closed_ex cm f vis vs u n))
      (invariant (partial_u cm f vs u v))
      (decreases (- n v))
      (if (and (not (idx vs v)) (or (< (idx (idx f u) v) (idx (idx cm u) v)) (> (idx (idx f v) u) 0)))
        (block
          (call cnt_le vs n)
          (let ((f1 (vec (vec i64))) (vs1 (vec bool)) (fd bool)) (call aug f vs cm v t))
          (if fd
            (block
              (assert (== (get_flow f1 u v) (get_flow f u v)))
              (assert (== (get_flow f1 v u) (get_flow f v u)))
              (let-mut f2 (vec (vec i64)) f1)
              (if (< (idx (idx f2 u) v) (idx (idx cm u) v))
                (block
                  (set-idx (idx f2 u) v (+ (idx (idx f2 u) v) 1))
                  (assert (upd2 f1 f2 u v 1))
                  (call step_excess f1 f2 n u v 1)
                  (call unch_step vis vs f f1 f2 u v 1))
                (block
                  (set-idx (idx f2 v) u (- (idx (idx f2 v) u) 1))
                  (assert (upd2 f1 f2 v u -1))
                  (call step_excess f1 f2 n v u -1)
                  (call unch_step vis vs f f1 f2 v u -1)))
              (return f2 vs1 true))
            (block
              (call cnt_mono vs vs1 n)
              (set f f1)
              (set vs vs1))))
        (block))
      (set v (+ v 1)))
    (return f vs false)))
(lemma rsum_le (params (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (mat_ok cm n) (cmb cm) (mat_ok f n) (bounded cm f) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m n)))
  (ensures (<= (rsum f u m) (* 100000 m))) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block (call rsum_le cm f n u (- m 1))
           (assert (<= (get_flow f u (- m 1)) (idx (idx cm u) (- m 1))))
           (assert (<= (idx (idx cm u) (- m 1)) 100000)))
    (block))))
(lemma colsum_ge (params (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (v int) (m int))
  (requires (mat_ok cm n) (mat_ok f n) (bounded cm f) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (>= (colsum f v m) 0)) (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (block (call colsum_ge cm f n v (- m 1)) (assert (>= (get_flow f (- m 1) v) 0))) (block))))
(lemma ex_bound (params (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (s int))
  (requires (mat_ok cm n) (cmb cm) (mat_ok f n) (bounded cm f) (<= n 1000) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
  (ensures (<= (ex f s n) 100000000))
  (body (call rsum_le cm f n s n) (call colsum_ge cm f n s n)))

(lemma colsum_zero (params (f (seq (seq int))) (v int) (m int)) (requires (zeros f) (>= m 0))

(lemma zero_ex (params (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int))
  (requires (mat_ok f n) (zeros f))
  (ensures (cons_ok f s t n) (== (ex f s n) 0))
  (body
    (forall ((w int)) (call rsum_zero f w n))
    (forall ((w int)) (call colsum_zero f w n))))

(lemma frs_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (wf2 g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u)))) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (frs g f u (+ k 1) m)
               (+ (frs g f u k m) (if (< (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) m) (get_flow f u (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)) 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body

(lemma out_frs (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))

  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g f u k) (frs g f u k (len g))))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block (call out_frs g f u (- k 1)) (call frs_step g f u (- k 1) (len g)))
    (call frs_zero g f u (len g)))))
(lemma offz (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg f) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (or (isdst g u (len (idx g u)) v) (== (get_flow f u v) 0)))
  (body
    (if (> (get_flow f u v) 0)
      (block
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c)))
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                               (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))
        (assert (isdst g u (len (idx g u)) v)))
      (assert (>= (get_flow f u v) 0)))))
(lemma frs_full (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg f) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (frs g f u (len (idx g u)) m) (rsum f u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0) (block (call frs_full g f u (- m 1)) (call offz g f u (- m 1))) (block))))
(lemma conv (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wf2 g) (respects_capacity g f) (nonneg f) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g f u) (rsum f u (len g))) (== (total_flow_in g f u) (colsum f u (len g))))
  (body
    (call colsum_eq g f u (len g))
    (call out_frs g f u (len (idx g u)))
    (call frs_full g f u (len g))))
(lemma resp1 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))

  (body (if (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))) (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0))

  (ensures (== (exs f sv m n) (if (< s m) (ex f s n) 0)))

(lemma val_cut (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (sv (seq bool)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf2 g) (is_valid_flow g f s t) (== (len sv) (len g)) (ins sv s) (not (ins sv t))
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g f s) (- (rcut f sv false (len g) (len g)) (ccut f sv false (len g) (len g)))))
  (body
    (assert (respects_capacity g f))
    (assert (nonneg f))
    (forall ((u int)) (call conv g f u))
    (assert (cons_ok f s t (len g)))
    (call exsplit f sv (len g) (len g))
    (call fubini f sv (len g) (len g))
    (call exsum f sv s t (len g) (len g))
    (assert (== (total_flow_out g f s) (rsum f s (len g))))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f s) (colsum f s (len g))))))
(ghost-fn le_cut ((o (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (sv (seq bool)) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))) (and (ins sv u) (not (ins sv v))))
        (<= (get_flow o u v) (get_flow f u v))))))
(ghost-fn le_rev ((f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq (seq int))) (sv (seq bool)) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((w int) (u int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))) (and (not (ins sv w)) (ins sv u)))
        (<= (get_flow f w u) (get_flow o w u))))))
(lemma pw1 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (sv (seq bool))
                   (o (seq (seq int))) (n int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (cmok g cm n) (mat_ok f n) (bounded cm f) (closed cm f sv n) (respects_capacity g o))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))) (and (ins sv u) (not (ins sv v))))
               (<= (get_flow o u v) (get_flow f u v))))
  (body
    (if (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))) (and (ins sv u) (not (ins sv v))))
      (block
        (assert (not (resid cm f u v)))
        (assert (>= (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx cm u) v)))
        (assert (>= (idx (idx cm u) v) 0))
        (if (> (get_flow o u v) 0)
          (block
            (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx o u) v) c)))
            (assert (== (idx (idx cm u) v) c)))
          (block)))
      (block))))
(lemma pw2 (params (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (sv (seq bool)) (o (seq (seq int))) (n int) (w int) (u int))
  (requires (closed cm f sv n) (nonneg o))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))) (and (not (ins sv w)) (ins sv u)))
               (<= (get_flow f w u) (get_flow o w u))))
  (body
    (if (and (and (and (<= 0 w) (< w n)) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n))) (and (not (ins sv w)) (ins sv u)))
      (block (assert (not (resid cm f u w))) (assert (>= (get_flow o w u) 0)))
      (block))))
(lemma rsel_mono (params (o (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (sv (seq bool)) (n int) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (le_cut o f sv n) (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (ins sv u) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (<= (rsel o u sv false k) (rsel f u sv false k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block (call rsel_mono o f sv n u (- k 1))
           (assert (=> (not (ins sv (- k 1))) (<= (get_flow o u (- k 1)) (get_flow f u (- k 1))))))
    (block))))
(lemma rcut_mono (params (o (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (sv (seq bool)) (n int) (m int))
  (requires (le_cut o f sv n) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m n)))
  (ensures (<= (rcut o sv false m n) (rcut f sv false m n)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block (call rcut_mono o f sv n (- m 1))
           (if (ins sv (- m 1)) (call rsel_mono o f sv n (- m 1) n) (block)))
    (block))))
(lemma csel_mono (params (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq (seq int))) (sv (seq bool)) (n int) (v int) (k int))
  (requires (le_rev f o sv n) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (ins sv v) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k n)))
  (ensures (<= (csel f v sv false k) (csel o v sv false k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0)
    (block (call csel_mono f o sv n v (- k 1))
           (assert (=> (not (ins sv (- k 1))) (<= (get_flow f (- k 1) v) (get_flow o (- k 1) v)))))
    (block))))
(lemma ccut_mono (params (f (seq (seq int))) (o (seq (seq int))) (sv (seq bool)) (n int) (m int))
  (requires (le_rev f o sv n) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m n)))
  (ensures (<= (ccut f sv false m n) (ccut o sv false m n)))
  (decreases m)
  (body (if (> m 0)
    (block (call ccut_mono f o sv n (- m 1))
           (if (ins sv (- m 1)) (call csel_mono f o sv n (- m 1) n) (block)))
    (block))))
(lemma max_f (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (sv (seq bool))
                     (s int) (t int) (n int) (o (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (wf2 g) (== (len g) n) (cmok g cm n) (mat_ok f n) (bounded cm f) (is_valid_flow g f s t)
            (cut_ok cm f sv s t n) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)) (is_valid_flow g o s t))
  (ensures (<= (flow_val g o s) (flow_val g f s)))
  (body
    (call val_cut g f sv s t)
    (call val_cut g o sv s t)
    (assert (respects_capacity g o))
    (assert (nonneg o))
    (assert (closed cm f sv n))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call pw1 g cm f sv o n u v))
    (forall ((w int) (u int)) (call pw2 cm f sv o n w u))
    (assert (le_cut o f sv n))
    (assert (le_rev f o sv n))
    (call rcut_mono o f sv n n)
    (call ccut_mono f o sv n n)))
(def max_flow_value
  (body
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (ghost-let g (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (call wf_intro graph)
    (assert (== g (field graph adj)))
    (assert (and (== (len g) n) (<= n 1000)))
    (let-mut cm (vec (vec i64)) (vec-new))
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (== (len cm) u))
      (invariant (rows_ok g cm u n))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let deg i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) u)))
      (let-mut row (vec i64) (seq-build n (fn (b) 0)))
      (let-mut i i64 0)
      (while (< i deg)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i deg)))
        (invariant (== (len row) n))
        (invariant (rowcap g row u i))
        (decreases (- deg i))
        (let e (tuple i64 i64) (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i))
        (call cap_bound g u i)
        (set-idx row (get e 0) (get e 1))
        (set i (+ i 1)))
      (push cm row)
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (call cm_props g cm n)
    (assert (cmok g cm n))
    (let-mut f (vec (vec i64)) (seq-build n (fn (a) (seq-build n (fn (b2) 0)))))
    (assert (mat_ok f n))
    (assert (zeros f))
    (call zero_ex f s t n)
    (let-mut val i64 0)
    (let-mut go bool true)
    (ghost-let-mut cut (seq bool) (seq-lit))
    (while go
      (invariant (<= n 1000))
      (invariant (cmok g cm n))
      (invariant (mat_ok f n))
      (invariant (bounded cm f))
      (invariant (cons_ok f s t n))
      (invariant (== val (ex f s n)))
      (invariant (<= val 100000000))
      (invariant (=> (not go) (cut_ok cm f cut s t n)))
      (decreases (+ (- 100000000 val) (if go 1 0)))
      (let vis (vec bool) (seq-build n (fn (j) false)))
      (ghost-let f0 (seq (seq int)) f)
      (let ((f1 (vec (vec i64))) (vs1 (vec bool)) (fd bool)) (call aug f vis (borrow cm) s t))
      (set f f1)
      (if fd
        (block
          (call ex_bound cm f n s)
          (set val (+ val 1)))
        (block
          (ghost-set cut vs1)
          (set go false))))
    (ghost-let fv (seq (seq int)) f)
    (call valid_f g cm fv s t n)
    (forall ((o (seq (seq int)))) (call max_f g cm fv cut s t n o))
    (assert (is_max_flow g fv s t))

(spec aug
  (params (fl (vec (vec i64))) (vis (vec bool)) (cm (ref (slice (vec i64)))) (u i64) (t i64))
  (returns (fo (vec (vec i64))) (vo (vec bool)) (found bool))
  (requires (mat_ok cm (len cm)) (mat_ok fl (len cm)) (bounded cm fl) (== (len vis) (len cm))
            (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len cm))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len cm)))
            (not (ins vis u)) (not (ins vis t)))
  (ensures (mat_ok fo (len cm)) (bounded cm fo) (superset vis vo) (unch vis fl fo)
           (=> found (shift fl fo u t (len cm)))
           (=> (not found) (and (and (== fo fl) (ins vo u)) (and (not (ins vo t)) (closed_new cm fo vis vo (len cm))))))
  (effects))
(def aug (decreases (- (len vis) (cntb vis (len vis))))
  (body
    (if (== u t) (return fl vis true) (block))
    (let n i64 (len cm))
    (let-mut f (vec (vec i64)) fl)
    (let-mut vs (vec bool) vis)
    (set-idx vs u true)
    (call cnt_strict vis vs n u)
    (let-mut v i64 0)
    (while (< v n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 v) (<= v n)))
      (invariant (== f fl))
      (invariant (superset vis vs))
      (invariant (ins vs u))
      (invariant (not (ins vs t)))
      (invariant (> (cntb vs n) (cntb vis n)))
      (invariant (closed_ex cm f vis vs u n))
      (invariant (partial_u cm f vs u v))
      (decreases (- n v))
      (if (and (not (idx vs v)) (or (< (idx (idx f u) v) (idx (idx cm u) v)) (> (idx (idx f v) u) 0)))
        (block
          (call cnt_le vs n)
          (let ((f1 (vec (vec i64))) (vs1 (vec bool)) (fd bool)) (call aug f vs cm v t))
          (if fd
            (block
              (assert (== (get_flow f1 u v) (get_flow f u v)))
              (assert (== (get_flow f1 v u) (get_flow f v u)))
              (let-mut f2 (vec (vec i64)) f1)
              (if (< (idx (idx f2 u) v) (idx (idx cm u) v))
                (block
                  (set-idx (idx f2 u) v (+ (idx (idx f2 u) v) 1))
                  (assert (upd2 f1 f2 u v 1))
                  (call step_excess f1 f2 n u v 1)
                  (call unch_step vis vs f f1 f2 u v 1))
                (block
                  (set-idx (idx f2 v) u (- (idx (idx f2 v) u) 1))
                  (assert (upd2 f1 f2 v u -1))
                  (call step_excess f1 f2 n v u -1)
                  (call unch_step vis vs f f1 f2 v u -1)))
              (return f2 vs1 true))
            (block
              (call cnt_mono vs vs1 n)
              (set f f1)
              (set vs vs1))))
        (block))
      (set v (+ v 1)))
    (return f vs false)))

  (ensures (<= (rsum f u m) (* 100000 m))) (decreases m)

    (block (call rsum_le cm f n u (- m 1))
           (assert (<= (get_flow f u (- m 1)) (idx (idx cm u) (- m 1))))
           (assert (<= (idx (idx cm u) (- m 1)) 100000)))
    (block))))

            (assert (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u))))))
            (assert (== (get_flow h u v) (idx (idx h u) v)))
            (assert (respects_capacity g h))
            (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) c)))

  (requires (wf g) (capacities_bounded g) (capok g cm) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (inw w s) (not (inw w t))

  (ensures (<= (flow_val g other s) (orow cm w false (len g) (len g))))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call off_valid g other s t u v))
    (assert (offz g other))

    (call cut_val g other w s t)
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call le_cap g cm other s t u v))
    (call orow_mono other cm w false (len g) (len g))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call nn_valid g other s t u v))
    (ghost-let z (seq (seq int)) (seq-lit))

    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g))))
      (and (<= 0 (get_flow f x y)) (<= (get_flow f x y) (get_flow cm x y))))))))
(ghost-fn consv ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (!= x s) (!= x t)))
    (== (rall f x (len g)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f x (len g)))))))
(ghost-fn sat ((cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u n)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v n))) (and (inw w u) (not (inw w v))))
        (and (== (get_flow f u v) (get_flow cm u v)) (== (get_flow f v u) 0))))))
(ghost-fn upd2 ((f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (== (get_flow f1 x y) (+ (get_flow f0 x y) (if (and (== x a) (== y b)) d 0))))))

(ghost-fn upd ((s0 (seq int)) (s1 (seq int)) (v int) (x int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len s1) (len s0)) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len s0))))
             (and (== (idx s1 v) x)
                  (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len s0))) (!= j v)) (== (idx s1 j) (idx s0 j))))))))
(ghost-fn appended ((q0 (seq int)) (q1 (seq int)) (v int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len q1) (+ (len q0) 1)) (== (idx q1 (len q0)) v))
             (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len q0))) (== (idx q1 k) (idx q0 k)))))))
(ghost-fn gem1 ((lvl (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len lvl))) (>= (idx lvl x) -1)))))
(ghost-fn qinv ((queue (seq int)) (lvl (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len queue)))
    (and (and (<= 0 (idx queue k)) (< (idx queue k) (len lvl)))
         (and (>= (idx lvl (idx queue k)) 0) (<= (idx lvl (idx queue k)) k)))))))
(ghost-fn pinv ((lvl (seq int)) (pos (seq int)) (queue (seq int))) bool
  (body (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len lvl))) (< x (len pos))) (>= (idx lvl x) 0))
    (and (and (<= 0 (idx pos x)) (< (idx pos x) (len queue))) (== (idx queue (idx pos x)) x))))))
(ghost-fn parinv ((cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (lvl (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len lvl))) (< x (len par))) (and (>= (idx lvl x) 0) (!= x s)))
    (and (and (<= 0 (idx par x)) (< (idx par x) (len lvl)))
         (and (and (>= (idx lvl (idx par x)) 0) (< (idx lvl (idx par x)) (idx lvl x))) (> (res cm f (idx par x) x) 0)))))))
(ghost-fn clos ((cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (lvl (seq int)) (queue (seq int)) (head int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((k int) (y int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 k) (< k head)) (< k (len queue)))
             (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y n)) (< y (len lvl))) (> (res cm f (idx queue k) y) 0)))
        (>= (idx lvl y) 0)))))
(ghost-fn part ((cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (lvl (seq int)) (bu int) (bv int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y bv)) (< y (len lvl))) (> (res cm f bu y) 0)) (>= (idx lvl y) 0)))))
(ghost-fn ptree ((lvl (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len lvl))) (< y (len par))) (and (>= (idx lvl y) 0) (!= y s)))
    (and (and (<= 0 (idx par y)) (< (idx par y) (len lvl)))
         (and (>= (idx lvl (idx par y)) 0) (< (idx lvl (idx par y)) (idx lvl y))))))))
(ghost-fn pres ((cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (lvl (seq int)) (par (seq int)) (s int) (top int)) bool
  (body (forall ((y int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len lvl))) (< y (len par))) (and (and (>= (idx lvl y) 0) (!= y s)) (<= (idx lvl y) top)))
        (> (res cm f (idx par y) y) 0)))))
(ghost-fn bal ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (t int) (cur int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
    (== (- (rall f x n) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f x n))
        (+ (- (rall f0 x n) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f0 x n)) (- (if (== x cur) 1 0) (if (== x t) 1 0))))))))
(ghost-fn wdef ((w (seq bool)) (lvl (seq int)) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len w) n) (== (len lvl) n))
             (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (<= 0 j) (< j n)) (== (idx w j) (>= (idx lvl j) 0)))))))

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma count_member (params (s (seq int)) (j int) (k int))
  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))

(lemma split_r (params (h (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (+ (rsf h w true u m) (rsf h w false u m)) (rall h u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call split_r h w u (- m 1))
        (assert (== (rsf h w true u m) (+ (rsf h w true u (- m 1)) (if (== (inw w (- m 1)) true) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (rsf h w false u m) (+ (rsf h w false u (- m 1)) (if (== (inw w (- m 1)) false) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (rall h u m) (+ (rall h u (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1))))))
      (block
        (assert (== (rsf h w true u m) 0))
        (assert (== (rsf h w false u m) 0))
        (assert (== (rall h u m) 0))))))
(lemma split_c (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (v int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (+ (csf h w true v m) (csf h w false v m)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h v m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call split_c g h w v (- m 1))
        (assert (== (csf h w true v m) (+ (csf h w true v (- m 1)) (if (== (inw w (- m 1)) true) (get_flow h (- m 1) v) 0))))
        (assert (== (csf h w false v m) (+ (csf h w false v (- m 1)) (if (== (inw w (- m 1)) false) (get_flow h (- m 1) v) 0))))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h v m) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g h v (- m 1)) (get_flow h (- m 1) v)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (csf h w true v m) 0))
        (assert (== (csf h w false v m) 0))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h v m) 0))))))
(lemma orow_zero (params (h (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (orow h w true 0 k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call orow_zero h w (- k 1))
        (assert (== (rsf h w true (- k 1) 0) 0))
        (assert (== (orow h w true 0 k) (+ (orow h w true 0 (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (rsf h w true (- k 1) 0) 0)))))
      (assert (== (orow h w true 0 k) 0)))))
(lemma swap_step (params (h (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (m int) (k int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (orow h w true (+ m 1) k) (+ (orow h w true m k) (if (inw w m) (csf h w true m k) 0))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call swap_step h w m (- k 1))
        (assert (== (orow h w true (+ m 1) k) (+ (orow h w true (+ m 1) (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (rsf h w true (- k 1) (+ m 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (rsf h w true (- k 1) (+ m 1)) (+ (rsf h w true (- k 1) m) (if (== (inw w m) true) (get_flow h (- k 1) m) 0))))
        (assert (== (orow h w true m k) (+ (orow h w true m (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (rsf h w true (- k 1) m) 0))))
        (assert (== (csf h w true m k) (+ (csf h w true m (- k 1)) (if (== (inw w (- k 1)) true) (get_flow h (- k 1) m) 0)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (orow h w true (+ m 1) k) 0))
        (assert (== (orow h w true m k) 0))
        (assert (== (csf h w true m k) 0))))))
(lemma swap (params (h (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (m int) (k int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (orow h w true m k) (ocol h w true k m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call swap h w (- m 1) k)
        (call swap_step h w (- m 1) k)
        (assert (== (ocol h w true k m) (+ (ocol h w true k (- m 1)) (if (inw w (- m 1)) (csf h w true (- m 1) k) 0)))))
      (block
        (assert (== m 0))
        (call orow_zero h w k)
        (assert (== (ocol h w true k m) 0))))))

(lemma rsf_mono (params (h1 (seq (seq int))) (h2 (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (b bool) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0)
    (forall ((v int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v m)) (== (inw w v) b)) (<= (get_flow h1 u v) (get_flow h2 u v)))))
  (ensures (<= (rsf h1 w b u m) (rsf h2 w b u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call rsf_mono h1 h2 w b u (- m 1))
        (assert (== (rsf h1 w b u m) (+ (rsf h1 w b u (- m 1)) (if (== (inw w (- m 1)) b) (get_flow h1 u (- m 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (rsf h2 w b u m) (+ (rsf h2 w b u (- m 1)) (if (== (inw w (- m 1)) b) (get_flow h2 u (- m 1)) 0)))))
      (block (assert (== (rsf h1 w b u m) 0)) (assert (== (rsf h2 w b u m) 0))))))
(lemma orow_mono (params (h1 (seq (seq int))) (h2 (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (b bool) (n int) (k int))
  (requires (>= n 0) (>= k 0)
    (forall ((u int) (v int))
      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u k)) (inw w u)) (and (and (<= 0 v) (< v n)) (== (inw w v) b)))
          (<= (get_flow h1 u v) (get_flow h2 u v)))))
  (ensures (<= (orow h1 w b n k) (orow h2 w b n k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call orow_mono h1 h2 w b n (- k 1))
        (if (inw w (- k 1)) (call rsf_mono h1 h2 w b (- k 1) n) (block))
        (assert (== (orow h1 w b n k) (+ (orow h1 w b n (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (rsf h1 w b (- k 1) n) 0))))
        (assert (== (orow h2 w b n k) (+ (orow h2 w b n (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (rsf h2 w b (- k 1) n) 0)))))
      (block (assert (== (orow h1 w b n k) 0)) (assert (== (orow h2 w b n k) 0))))))
(lemma csf_mono (params (h1 (seq (seq int))) (h2 (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (b bool) (v int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0)
    (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j m)) (== (inw w j) b)) (<= (get_flow h1 j v) (get_flow h2 j v)))))
  (ensures (<= (csf h1 w b v m) (csf h2 w b v m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call csf_mono h1 h2 w b v (- m 1))
        (assert (== (csf h1 w b v m) (+ (csf h1 w b v (- m 1)) (if (== (inw w (- m 1)) b) (get_flow h1 (- m 1) v) 0))))
        (assert (== (csf h2 w b v m) (+ (csf h2 w b v (- m 1)) (if (== (inw w (- m 1)) b) (get_flow h2 (- m 1) v) 0)))))
      (block (assert (== (csf h1 w b v m) 0)) (assert (== (csf h2 w b v m) 0))))))
(lemma ocol_mono (params (h1 (seq (seq int))) (h2 (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (b bool) (n int) (k int))
  (requires (>= n 0) (>= k 0)
    (forall ((u int) (j int))
      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u k)) (inw w u)) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j n)) (== (inw w j) b)))
          (<= (get_flow h1 j u) (get_flow h2 j u)))))
  (ensures (<= (ocol h1 w b n k) (ocol h2 w b n k)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call ocol_mono h1 h2 w b n (- k 1))
        (if (inw w (- k 1)) (call csf_mono h1 h2 w b (- k 1) n) (block))
        (assert (== (ocol h1 w b n k) (+ (ocol h1 w b n (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (csf h1 w b (- k 1) n) 0))))
        (assert (== (ocol h2 w b n k) (+ (ocol h2 w b n (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (csf h2 w b (- k 1) n) 0)))))
      (block (assert (== (ocol h1 w b n k) 0)) (assert (== (ocol h2 w b n k) 0))))))
(lemma csf_z (params (z (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (b bool) (v int) (m int))
  (requires (== (len z) 0) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (csf z w b v m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call csf_z z w b v (- m 1))
        (assert (== (get_flow z (- m 1) v) 0))
        (assert (== (csf z w b v m) (+ (csf z w b v (- m 1)) (if (== (inw w (- m 1)) b) (get_flow z (- m 1) v) 0)))))
      (assert (== (csf z w b v m) 0)))))
(lemma ocol_z (params (z (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (b bool) (n int) (k int))
  (requires (== (len z) 0) (>= n 0) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (ocol z w b n k) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call ocol_z z w b n (- k 1))
        (call csf_z z w b (- k 1) n)
        (assert (== (ocol z w b n k) (+ (ocol z w b n (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (csf z w b (- k 1) n) 0)))))
      (assert (== (ocol z w b n k) 0)))))

(lemma mask_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (rmask g h u 0 m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call mask_zero g h u (- m 1))
        (assert (not (istgt g u (- m 1) 0)))
        (assert (== (rmask g h u 0 m) (+ (rmask g h u 0 (- m 1)) (if (istgt g u (- m 1) 0) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0)))))
      (assert (== (rmask g h u 0 m) 0)))))
(lemma mask_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u)))) (>= m 0)
            (not (istgt g u (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) k)))
  (ensures (== (rmask g h u (+ k 1) m)
               (+ (rmask g h u k m)
                  (if (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) m)) (get_flow h u (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)) 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call mask_step g h u k (- m 1))
        (assert (== (istgt g u (- m 1) (+ k 1)) (or (istgt g u (- m 1) k) (== (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) (- m 1)))))
        (assert (== (rmask g h u (+ k 1) m) (+ (rmask g h u (+ k 1) (- m 1)) (if (istgt g u (- m 1) (+ k 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (rmask g h u k m) (+ (rmask g h u k (- m 1)) (if (istgt g u (- m 1) k) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0)))))
      (block
        (assert (== m 0))
        (assert (== (rmask g h u (+ k 1) m) 0))
        (assert (== (rmask g h u k m) 0))))))
(lemma distinct_ist (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (j int))
  (requires (wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u)))) (and (<= 0 j) (<= j k)))
  (ensures (not (istgt g u (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) j)))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (if (> j 0)
      (block
        (call distinct_ist g u k (- j 1))
        (assert (!= (get (idx (idx g u) (- j 1)) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)))
        (assert (== (istgt g u (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) j)
                    (or (istgt g u (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) (- j 1))
                        (== (get (idx (idx g u) (- j 1)) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))))))
      (assert (not (istgt g u (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) j))))))
(lemma out_mask (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k) (rmask g h u k (len g))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call out_mask g h u (- k 1))
        (call distinct_ist g u (- k 1) (- k 1))
        (call mask_step g h u (- k 1) (len g))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) (len g))))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k)
                    (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u (- k 1)) (get_flow h u (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0))))))
      (block
        (assert (== k 0))
        (call mask_zero g h u (len g))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k) 0))))))
(lemma mask_full (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (offz g h) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len g))))
  (ensures (== (rmask g h u (len (idx g u)) m) (rall h u m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call mask_full g h u (- m 1))
        (assert (== (rmask g h u (len (idx g u)) m)
                    (+ (rmask g h u (len (idx g u)) (- m 1)) (if (istgt g u (- m 1) (len (idx g u))) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (rall h u m) (+ (rall h u (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1)))))
        (assert (=> (not (istgt g u (- m 1) (len (idx g u)))) (== (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0))))
      (block
        (assert (== (rmask g h u (len (idx g u)) m) 0))
        (assert (== (rall h u m) 0))))))
(lemma out_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int))
  (requires (wf g) (offz g h) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (total_flow_out g h u) (rall h u (len g))))
  (body
    (call out_mask g h u (len (idx g u)))
    (call mask_full g h u (len g))
    (assert (== (total_flow_out g h u) (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u (len (idx g u)))))))

(lemma ist_of (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (i int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (<= k (len (idx g u))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v))
  (ensures (istgt g u v k))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (assert (== (istgt g u v k)
                (or (istgt g u v (- k 1))
                    (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u))))
                         (== (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) v)))))
    (if (< i (- k 1)) (call ist_of g u v i (- k 1)) (block))))
(lemma ist_wit (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0) (istgt g u v k))
  (ensures (exists ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i k))
    (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v)))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (assert (== (istgt g u v k)
                    (or (istgt g u v (- k 1))
                        (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u))))
                             (== (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) v)))))
        (if (istgt g u v (- k 1))
          (block
            (call ist_wit g u v (- k 1))
            (obtain ((i0 int)) (and (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 (- k 1)))
              (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (< i0 (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 0) v))))
            (assert (and (and (<= 0 i0) (< i0 k))
              (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (< i0 (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i0) 0) v)))))
          (assert (and (and (<= 0 (- k 1)) (< (- k 1) k))
            (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) v))))))
      (assert (not (istgt g u v k))))))

(lemma cupto0 (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (y int))

(lemma cupto_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (y int) (i int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))

               (if (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) y) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) (cupto g u y i))))

(lemma capm_eq (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (y int))

(lemma cupto_none (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (k int))
  (requires (>= k 0) (not (istgt g u v k)))

  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block

                    (or (istgt g u v (- k 1))
                        (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u))))
                             (== (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) v)))))
        (call cupto_none g u v (- k 1))
        (assert (== (cupto g u v k)
                    (if (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u))))
                             (== (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) v))
                        (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 1) (cupto g u v (- k 1))))))
      (assert (== (cupto g u v k) 0)))))
(lemma cupto_has (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (i int) (k int))
  (requires (wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i k)) (<= k (len (idx g u))))
            (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v))
  (ensures (== (cupto g u v k) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
  (decreases k)

    (assert (== (cupto g u v k)
                (if (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u))))
                         (== (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) v))
                    (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 1) (cupto g u v (- k 1)))))
    (if (< i (- k 1))

(lemma cupto_bounds (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (k int))
  (requires (capacities_bounded g) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (and (>= (cupto g u v k) 0) (<= (cupto g u v k) 100000)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call cupto_bounds g u v (- k 1))
        (assert (== (cupto g u v k)
                    (if (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u))))
                             (== (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) v))
                        (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 1) (cupto g u v (- k 1)))))
        (if (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (< (- k 1) (len (idx g u))))
                 (== (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) v))
          (assert (has_capacity g u v (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 1)))
          (block)))

(lemma capm_bounds (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (capacities_bounded g))

  (body

    (if (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (call cupto_bounds g u v (len (idx g u))) (block))))

(lemma net_split (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (u int))
  (requires (wf g) (offz g h) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (- (total_flow_out g h u) (total_flow_in g h u))
               (- (+ (rsf h w true u (len g)) (rsf h w false u (len g)))
                  (+ (csf h w true u (len g)) (csf h w false u (len g))))))
  (body
    (call out_eq g h u)
    (call split_r h w u (len g))
    (call split_c g h w u (len g))
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g h u) (sum_flow_in_recursive g h u (len g))))))
(lemma esum_cons (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (s int) (t int) (k int))
  (requires (is_conserved g h s t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (inw w s) (not (inw w t)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len g))))
  (ensures (== (esum g h w k) (if (< s k) (flow_val g h s) 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call esum_cons g h w s t (- k 1))
        (assert (== (esum g h w k) (+ (esum g h w (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (- (total_flow_out g h (- k 1)) (total_flow_in g h (- k 1))) 0))))
        (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (- (total_flow_out g h s) (total_flow_in g h s))))
        (assert (=> (and (inw w (- k 1)) (!= (- k 1) s)) (!= (- k 1) t)))
        (assert (=> (and (inw w (- k 1)) (!= (- k 1) s)) (== (total_flow_in g h (- k 1)) (total_flow_out g h (- k 1))))))
      (assert (== (esum g h w k) 0)))))
(lemma esum_split (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (k int))
  (requires (wf g) (offz g h) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len g))))
  (ensures (== (esum g h w k) (- (+ (orow h w true (len g) k) (orow h w false (len g) k))
                                 (+ (ocol h w true (len g) k) (ocol h w false (len g) k)))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call esum_split g h w (- k 1))
        (if (inw w (- k 1)) (call net_split g h w (- k 1)) (block))
        (assert (== (esum g h w k) (+ (esum g h w (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (- (total_flow_out g h (- k 1)) (total_flow_in g h (- k 1))) 0))))
        (assert (== (orow h w true (len g) k) (+ (orow h w true (len g) (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (rsf h w true (- k 1) (len g)) 0))))
        (assert (== (orow h w false (len g) k) (+ (orow h w false (len g) (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (rsf h w false (- k 1) (len g)) 0))))
        (assert (== (ocol h w true (len g) k) (+ (ocol h w true (len g) (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (csf h w true (- k 1) (len g)) 0))))
        (assert (== (ocol h w false (len g) k) (+ (ocol h w false (len g) (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (csf h w false (- k 1) (len g)) 0)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (esum g h w k) 0))
        (assert (== (orow h w true (len g) k) 0))
        (assert (== (orow h w false (len g) k) 0))
        (assert (== (ocol h w true (len g) k) 0))
        (assert (== (ocol h w false (len g) k) 0))))))
(lemma cut_val (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf g) (offz g h) (is_conserved g h s t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (inw w s) (not (inw w t)))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g h s) (- (orow h w false (len g) (len g)) (ocol h w false (len g) (len g)))))
  (body
    (call esum_cons g h w s t (len g))
    (call esum_split g h w (len g))
    (call swap h w (len g) (len g))))

(lemma nn_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (>= (get_flow h u v) 0))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow h u v)
                (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u))))) (idx (idx h u) v) 0)))))
(lemma off_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (wf g) (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))) (not (istgt g u v (len (idx g u)))))
               (== (get_flow h u v) 0)))
  (body
    (call nn_valid g h s t u v)
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (> (get_flow h u v) 0))
      (block
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u))))))
        (assert (== (get_flow h u v) (idx (idx h u) v)))
        (assert (respects_capacity g h))
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) c)))
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                               (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))
        (call ist_of g u v i (len (idx g u))))
      (block))))
(lemma le_cap (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (wf g) (capacities_bounded g) (capok g cm) (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))) (<= (get_flow h u v) (get_flow cm u v))))
  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
      (block
        (call capm_bounds g u v)
        (assert (== (get_flow cm u v) (capm g u v)))
        (assert (== (capm g u v) (cupto g u v (len (idx g u)))))
        (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
          (block
            (assert (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u))))))
            (assert (== (get_flow h u v) (idx (idx h u) v)))
            (assert (respects_capacity g h))
            (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) c)))
            (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                                   (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))
            (call cupto_has g u v i (len (idx g u))))
          (block)))
      (block))))
(lemma bound_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (s int) (t int) (other (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (wf g) (capacities_bounded g) (capok g cm) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (inw w s) (not (inw w t))
            (is_valid_flow g other s t))
  (ensures (<= (flow_val g other s) (orow cm w false (len g) (len g))))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call off_valid g other s t u v))
    (assert (offz g other))
    (assert (is_conserved g other s t))
    (call cut_val g other w s t)
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call le_cap g cm other s t u v))
    (call orow_mono other cm w false (len g) (len g))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call nn_valid g other s t u v))
    (ghost-let z (seq (seq int)) (seq-lit))
    (call ocol_mono z other w false (len g) (len g))
    (call ocol_z z w false (len g) (len g))))

(lemma off_f (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (capok g cm) (fok g cm f))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))) (not (istgt g u v (len (idx g u)))))
               (== (get_flow f u v) 0)))
  (body
    (if (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))) (not (istgt g u v (len (idx g u)))))
      (block
        (call cupto_none g u v (len (idx g u)))
        (assert (== (capm g u v) (cupto g u v (len (idx g u)))))
        (assert (== (get_flow cm u v) (capm g u v))))
      (block))))
(lemma resp_f (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (wf g) (capok g cm) (fok g cm f))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
               (=> (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0) (exists ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) c))))))
  (body
    (if (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u))))) (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
      (block
        (assert (and (< u (len g)) (< v (len g))))
        (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
        (assert (== (get_flow cm u v) (capm g u v)))
        (assert (== (capm g u v) (cupto g u v (len (idx g u)))))
        (if (istgt g u v (len (idx g u))) (block) (call cupto_none g u v (len (idx g u))))
        (call ist_wit g u v (len (idx g u)))
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
          (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v))))
        (call cupto_has g u v i (len (idx g u)))
        (assert (has_capacity g u v (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
        (assert (<= (idx (idx f u) v) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
      (block))))
(lemma cons_f (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wf g) (offz g f) (consv g f s t))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (!= u s) (!= u t))) (== (total_flow_in g f u) (total_flow_out g f u))))
  (body
    (if (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
      (block
        (call out_eq g f u)
        (assert (== (total_flow_in g f u) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u (len g)))))
      (block))))

(lemma resp_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (wf g) (capok g cm) (fok g cm f))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call resp_f g cm f u v))))
(lemma offz_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (capok g cm) (fok g cm f))
  (ensures (offz g f))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call off_f g cm f u v))))
(lemma cons_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf g) (offz g f) (consv g f s t))
  (ensures (is_conserved g f s t))
  (body (forall ((u int)) (call cons_f g f s t u))))
(lemma nn_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (fok g cm f))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u))))) (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0)))
  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
      (block
        (assert (< u (len g)))
        (assert (== (len (idx f u)) (len g)))
        (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
        (assert (<= 0 (get_flow f u v))))
      (block))))
(lemma valid_f (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf g) (capok g cm) (fok g cm f) (consv g f s t))
  (ensures (offz g f) (is_conserved g f s t) (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (body
    (call offz_all g cm f)
    (call resp_all g cm f)
    (call cons_all g f s t)
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call nn_pt g cm f u v))
    (assert (is_valid_flow g f s t))))
(lemma val_f (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (val int))
  (requires (wf g) (offz g f) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g)))
            (== val (- (rall f s (len g)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f s (len g)))))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g f s) val))
  (body
    (call out_eq g f s)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f s) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f s (len g))))
    (assert (== (flow_val g f s) (- (total_flow_out g f s) (total_flow_in g f s))))))
(lemma cut_f (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf g) (offz g f) (is_conserved g f s t) (fok g cm f) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g)))
            (inw w s) (not (inw w t)) (sat cm f w (len g)))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g f s) (orow cm w false (len g) (len g))))
  (body
    (call cut_val g f w s t)
    (call orow_mono f cm w false (len g) (len g))
    (call orow_mono cm f w false (len g) (len g))
    (ghost-let z (seq (seq int)) (seq-lit))
    (call ocol_mono f z w false (len g) (len g))
    (call ocol_mono z f w false (len g) (len g))
    (call ocol_z z w false (len g) (len g))))
(lemma max_f (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf g) (capacities_bounded g) (capok g cm) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (inw w s) (not (inw w t))
            (is_valid_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) (orow cm w false (len g) (len g))))
  (ensures (is_max_flow g f s t))
  (body
    (forall ((other (seq (seq int)))) (call bound_one g cm w s t other))
    (assert (is_max_flow g f s t))))
(lemma finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (s int) (t int) (val int))
  (requires (wf g) (capacities_bounded g)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))) (!= s t)
            (capok g cm) (fok g cm f) (consv g f s t)
            (== val (- (rall f s (len g)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f s (len g))))
            (inw w s) (not (inw w t)) (sat cm f w (len g)))
  (ensures (is_max_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) val))
  (body
    (call valid_f g cm f s t)
    (call val_f g f s val)
    (call cut_f g cm f w s t)
    (call max_f g cm f w s t)))

(lemma rall_upd (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (x int) (m int))
  (requires (upd2 f0 f1 a b d) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (rall f1 x m) (+ (rall f0 x m) (if (and (== x a) (and (<= 0 b) (< b m))) d 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call rall_upd f0 f1 a b d x (- m 1))
        (assert (== (get_flow f1 x (- m 1)) (+ (get_flow f0 x (- m 1)) (if (and (== x a) (== (- m 1) b)) d 0))))
        (assert (== (rall f1 x m) (+ (rall f1 x (- m 1)) (get_flow f1 x (- m 1)))))
        (assert (== (rall f0 x m) (+ (rall f0 x (- m 1)) (get_flow f0 x (- m 1))))))
      (block (assert (== (rall f1 x m) 0)) (assert (== (rall f0 x m) 0))))))
(lemma sfi_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (x int) (m int))
  (requires (upd2 f0 f1 a b d) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f1 x m)
               (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g f0 x m) (if (and (== x b) (and (<= 0 a) (< a m))) d 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call sfi_upd g f0 f1 a b d x (- m 1))
        (assert (== (get_flow f1 (- m 1) x) (+ (get_flow f0 (- m 1) x) (if (and (== (- m 1) a) (== x b)) d 0))))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f1 x m) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g f1 x (- m 1)) (get_flow f1 (- m 1) x))))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f0 x m) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g f0 x (- m 1)) (get_flow f0 (- m 1) x)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f1 x m) 0))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f0 x m) 0))))))
(lemma rall_z (params (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (forall ((a int) (b int)) (== (get_flow h a b) 0)))
  (ensures (== (rall h u m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call rall_z h u (- m 1))
        (assert (== (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0))
        (assert (== (rall h u m) (+ (rall h u (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1))))))
      (assert (== (rall h u m) 0)))))
(lemma sfi_z (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (v int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (forall ((a int) (b int)) (== (get_flow h a b) 0)))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h v m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call sfi_z g h v (- m 1))
        (assert (== (get_flow h (- m 1) v) 0))

      (block
        (assert (and (< u (len g)) (< v (len g))))
        (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
        (assert (== (get_flow cm u v) (capm g u v)))
        (assert (== (capm g u v) (cupto g u v (len (idx g u)))))
        (if (istgt g u v (len (idx g u))) (block) (call cupto_none g u v (len (idx g u))))
        (call ist_wit g u v (len (idx g u)))
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
          (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v))))
        (call cupto_has g u v i (len (idx g u)))
        (assert (has_capacity g u v (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
        (assert (<= (idx (idx f u) v) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1))))
      (block))))
(lemma cons_f (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wf g) (offz g f) (consv g f s t))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (!= u s) (!= u t))) (== (total_flow_in g f u) (total_flow_out g f u))))
  (body
    (if (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
      (block
        (call out_eq g f u)
        (assert (== (total_flow_in g f u) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u (len g)))))
      (block))))

(lemma resp_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (wf g) (capok g cm) (fok g cm f))

  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call resp_f g cm f u v))))
(lemma offz_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (capok g cm) (fok g cm f))
  (ensures (offz g f))

(lemma cons_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf g) (offz g f) (consv g f s t))

(lemma nn_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (fok g cm f))

  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
      (block
        (assert (< u (len g)))
        (assert (== (len (idx f u)) (len g)))
        (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
