(lemma valid_f (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf g) (capok g cm) (fok g cm f) (consv g f s t))
  (ensures (offz g f) (is_conserved g f s t) (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (body
    (call offz_all g cm f)
    (call resp_all g cm f)
    (call cons_all g f s t)
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call nn_pt g cm f u v))
    (assert (is_valid_flow g f s t))))
(lemma val_f (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (val int))
  (requires (wf g) (offz g f) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g)))
            (== val (- (rall f s (len g)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f s (len g)))))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g f s) val))
  (body
    (call out_eq g f s)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f s) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f s (len g))))
    (assert (== (flow_val g f s) (- (total_flow_out g f s) (total_flow_in g f s))))))
(lemma cut_f (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf g) (offz g f) (is_conserved g f s t) (fok g cm f) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g)))
            (inw w s) (not (inw w t)) (sat cm f w (len g)))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g f s) (orow cm w false (len g) (len g))))
  (body
    (call cut_val g f w s t)
    (call orow_mono f cm w false (len g) (len g))
    (call orow_mono cm f w false (len g) (len g))
    (ghost-let z (seq (seq int)) (seq-lit))
    (call ocol_mono f z w false (len g) (len g))
    (call ocol_mono z f w false (len g) (len g))
    (call ocol_z z w false (len g) (len g))))
(lemma max_f (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf g) (capacities_bounded g) (capok g cm) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (inw w s) (not (inw w t))
            (is_valid_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) (orow cm w false (len g) (len g))))
  (ensures (is_max_flow g f s t))
  (body
    (forall ((other (seq (seq int)))) (call bound_one g cm w s t other))
    (assert (is_max_flow g f s t))))
(lemma finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (s int) (t int) (val int))
  (requires (wf g) (capacities_bounded g)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))) (!= s t)
            (capok g cm) (fok g cm f) (consv g f s t)
            (== val (- (rall f s (len g)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f s (len g))))
            (inw w s) (not (inw w t)) (sat cm f w (len g)))
  (ensures (is_max_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) val))
  (body
    (call valid_f g cm f s t)
    (call val_f g f s val)
    (call cut_f g cm f w s t)
    (call max_f g cm f w s t)))

(lemma rall_upd (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (x int) (m int))
  (requires (upd2 f0 f1 a b d) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (rall f1 x m) (+ (rall f0 x m) (if (and (== x a) (and (<= 0 b) (< b m))) d 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call rall_upd f0 f1 a b d x (- m 1))
        (assert (== (get_flow f1 x (- m 1)) (+ (get_flow f0 x (- m 1)) (if (and (== x a) (== (- m 1) b)) d 0))))
        (assert (== (rall f1 x m) (+ (rall f1 x (- m 1)) (get_flow f1 x (- m 1)))))
        (assert (== (rall f0 x m) (+ (rall f0 x (- m 1)) (get_flow f0 x (- m 1))))))
      (block (assert (== (rall f1 x m) 0)) (assert (== (rall f0 x m) 0))))))
(lemma sfi_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (x int) (m int))
  (requires (upd2 f0 f1 a b d) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f1 x m)
               (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g f0 x m) (if (and (== x b) (and (<= 0 a) (< a m))) d 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call sfi_upd g f0 f1 a b d x (- m 1))
        (assert (== (get_flow f1 (- m 1) x) (+ (get_flow f0 (- m 1) x) (if (and (== (- m 1) a) (== x b)) d 0))))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f1 x m) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g f1 x (- m 1)) (get_flow f1 (- m 1) x))))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f0 x m) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g f0 x (- m 1)) (get_flow f0 (- m 1) x)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f1 x m) 0))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f0 x m) 0))))))
(lemma rall_z (params (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (forall ((a int) (b int)) (== (get_flow h a b) 0)))
  (ensures (== (rall h u m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body

      (block

        (assert (== (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0))
        (assert (== (rall h u m) (+ (rall h u (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1))))))
      (assert (== (rall h u m) 0)))))
(lemma sfi_z (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (v int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (forall ((a int) (b int)) (== (get_flow h a b) 0)))

  (decreases m)

(lemma rall_mono (params (h1 (seq (seq int))) (h2 (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (<= 0 y) (< y m)) (<= (get_flow h1 u y) (get_flow h2 u y)))))
  (ensures (<= (rall h1 u m) (rall h2 u m)))

(lemma sfi_nonneg (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (v int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k m)) (>= (get_flow h k v) 0))))
  (ensures (>= (sum_flow_in_recursive g h v m) 0))
  (decreases m)

        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h v m) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g h v (- m 1)) (get_flow h (- m 1) v)))))
      (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h v m) 0)))))
(lemma rall_bound (params (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (<= 0 y) (< y m)) (<= (get_flow h u y) 100000))))
  (ensures (<= (rall h u m) (* 100000 m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body

        (assert (<= (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 100000))
        (assert (== (rall h u m) (+ (rall h u (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1))))))
      (assert (== (rall h u m) 0)))))

(lemma cut_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (lvl (seq int)) (pos (seq int))
                      (queue (seq int)) (w (seq bool)) (head int) (n int) (a int) (b int))
  (requires (== (len g) n) (fok g cm f) (pinv lvl pos queue) (clos cm f lvl queue head n) (== head (len queue))
            (== (len pos) n) (wdef w lvl n))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))) (and (inw w a) (not (inw w b))))
               (and (== (get_flow f a b) (get_flow cm a b)) (== (get_flow f b a) 0))))
  (body
    (if (and (and (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n))) (and (inw w a) (not (inw w b))))
      (block
        (assert (== (len w) n))
        (assert (== (len lvl) n))
        (assert (== (idx w a) (>= (idx lvl a) 0)))
        (assert (== (idx w b) (>= (idx lvl b) 0)))
        (assert (>= (idx lvl a) 0))
        (assert (< (idx lvl b) 0))
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 (idx pos a)) (< (idx pos a) (len queue))) (== (idx queue (idx pos a)) a)))
        (assert (== (res cm f (idx queue (idx pos a)) b) (res cm f a b)))
        (assert (<= (res cm f a b) 0))
        (assert (== (res cm f a b) (+ (- (get_flow cm a b) (get_flow f a b)) (get_flow f b a))))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (get_flow f a b)) (<= (get_flow f a b) (get_flow cm a b))))
        (assert (>= (get_flow f b a) 0)))
      (block))))

            (== (len pos) n) (wdef w lvl n))

(lemma upd2_pt (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len f0))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx f0 a))))
            (== (len f1) (len f0))
            (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len f0))) (!= i a)) (== (idx f1 i) (idx f0 i))))
            (== (len (idx f1 a)) (len (idx f0 a)))
            (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j (len (idx f0 a)))) (!= j b)) (== (idx (idx f1 a) j) (idx (idx f0 a) j))))
            (== (idx (idx f1 a) b) (+ (idx (idx f0 a) b) d)))

  (body
    (if (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len f0)))
      (if (== x a)
        (block
          (assert (== (get_flow f1 x y) (if (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx f1 x)))) (idx (idx f1 x) y) 0)))
          (assert (== (get_flow f0 x y) (if (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx f0 x)))) (idx (idx f0 x) y) 0))))
        (block
          (assert (== (idx f1 x) (idx f0 x)))
          (assert (== (get_flow f1 x y) (if (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx f1 x)))) (idx (idx f1 x) y) 0)))
          (assert (== (get_flow f0 x y) (if (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len (idx f0 x)))) (idx (idx f0 x) y) 0)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (get_flow f1 x y) 0))
        (assert (== (get_flow f0 x y) 0))))))
(lemma upd2_of (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len f0))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len (idx f0 a))))
            (== (len f1) (len f0))
            (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len f0))) (!= i a)) (== (idx f1 i) (idx f0 i))))

            (== (idx (idx f1 a) b) (+ (idx (idx f0 a) b) d)))
  (ensures (upd2 f0 f1 a b d))
  (body (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call upd2_pt f0 f1 a b d x y))))
(lemma fok_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int))
  (requires (fok g cm f0) (== (len f0) (len g)) (upd2 f0 f1 a b d)
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a (len g))) (and (<= 0 b) (< b (len g)))
            (== (len f1) (len f0))
            (forall ((i int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len f0))) (!= i a)) (== (idx f1 i) (idx f0 i))))
            (== (len (idx f1 a)) (len (idx f0 a)))
            (and (<= 0 (+ (get_flow f0 a b) d)) (<= (+ (get_flow f0 a b) d) (get_flow cm a b))))

(lemma bal_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (fa (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int)))
                        (t int) (cur int) (pp int) (a int) (b int) (d int) (n int))
  (requires (bal g f0 fa t cur n) (upd2 fa f a b d)
            (or (and (and (== a cur) (== b pp)) (== d -1)) (and (and (== a pp) (== b cur)) (== d 1)))
            (and (<= 0 a) (< a n)) (and (<= 0 b) (< b n)))
  (ensures (bal g f0 f t pp n))
  (body
    (forall ((x int)) (call rall_upd fa f a b d x n))
    (forall ((x int)) (call sfi_upd g fa f a b d x n))))
(lemma bal_end (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (n int))
  (requires (== (len g) n) (bal g f0 f t s n) (consv g f0 s t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)) (!= s t))
  (ensures (consv g f s t)

  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call esum_cons g h w s t (- k 1))
        (assert (== (esum g h w k) (+ (esum g h w (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (- (total_flow_out g h (- k 1)) (total_flow_in g h (- k 1))) 0))))
        (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (- (total_flow_out g h s) (total_flow_in g h s))))
        (assert (=> (and (inw w (- k 1)) (!= (- k 1) s)) (!= (- k 1) t)))
        (assert (=> (and (inw w (- k 1)) (!= (- k 1) s)) (== (total_flow_in g h (- k 1)) (total_flow_out g h (- k 1))))))
      (assert (== (esum g h w k) 0)))))
(lemma esum_split (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (k int))
  (requires (wf g) (offz g h) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len g))))
  (ensures (== (esum g h w k) (- (+ (orow h w true (len g) k) (orow h w false (len g) k))
                                 (+ (ocol h w true (len g) k) (ocol h w false (len g) k)))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call esum_split g h w (- k 1))
        (if (inw w (- k 1)) (call net_split g h w (- k 1)) (block))
        (assert (== (esum g h w k) (+ (esum g h w (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (- (total_flow_out g h (- k 1)) (total_flow_in g h (- k 1))) 0))))
        (assert (== (orow h w true (len g) k) (+ (orow h w true (len g) (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (rsf h w true (- k 1) (len g)) 0))))
        (assert (== (orow h w false (len g) k) (+ (orow h w false (len g) (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (rsf h w false (- k 1) (len g)) 0))))
        (assert (== (ocol h w true (len g) k) (+ (ocol h w true (len g) (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (csf h w true (- k 1) (len g)) 0))))
        (assert (== (ocol h w false (len g) k) (+ (ocol h w false (len g) (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (csf h w false (- k 1) (len g)) 0)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (esum g h w k) 0))
        (assert (== (orow h w true (len g) k) 0))
        (assert (== (orow h w false (len g) k) 0))
        (assert (== (ocol h w true (len g) k) 0))
        (assert (== (ocol h w false (len g) k) 0))))))
(lemma cut_val (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf g) (offz g h) (is_conserved g h s t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (inw w s) (not (inw w t)))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g h s) (- (orow h w false (len g) (len g)) (ocol h w false (len g) (len g)))))
  (body
    (call esum_cons g h w s t (len g))
    (call esum_split g h w (len g))
    (call swap h w (len g) (len g))))

(lemma nn_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (>= (get_flow h u v) 0))
  (body
    (assert (== (get_flow h u v)
                (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u))))) (idx (idx h u) v) 0)))))
(lemma off_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (wf g) (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))) (not (istgt g u v (len (idx g u)))))
               (== (get_flow h u v) 0)))
  (body
    (call nn_valid g h s t u v)
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (> (get_flow h u v) 0))
      (block
        (assert (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u))))))
        (assert (== (get_flow h u v) (idx (idx h u) v)))
        (assert (respects_capacity g h))
        (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) c)))
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                               (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))
        (call ist_of g u v i (len (idx g u))))
      (block))))
(lemma le_cap (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (wf g) (capacities_bounded g) (capok g cm) (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))) (<= (get_flow h u v) (get_flow cm u v))))
  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
      (block
        (call capm_bounds g u v)
        (assert (== (get_flow cm u v) (capm g u v)))
        (assert (== (capm g u v) (cupto g u v (len (idx g u)))))
        (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
          (block
            (assert (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u))))))
            (assert (== (get_flow h u v) (idx (idx h u) v)))
            (assert (respects_capacity g h))
            (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) c)))
            (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))
                                   (and (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1) c))))
            (call cupto_has g u v i (len (idx g u))))
          (block)))
      (block))))
(lemma bound_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (s int) (t int) (other (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (wf g) (capacities_bounded g) (capok g cm) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (inw w s) (not (inw w t))
            (is_valid_flow g other s t))
  (ensures (<= (flow_val g other s) (orow cm w false (len g) (len g))))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call off_valid g other s t u v))
    (assert (offz g other))
    (assert (is_conserved g other s t))
    (call cut_val g other w s t)
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call le_cap g cm other s t u v))
    (call orow_mono other cm w false (len g) (len g))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call nn_valid g other s t u v))
    (ghost-let z (seq (seq int)) (seq-lit))
    (call ocol_mono z other w false (len g) (len g))
    (call ocol_z z w false (len g) (len g))))

(lemma off_f (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (capok g cm) (fok g cm f))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))) (not (istgt g u v (len (idx g u)))))
               (== (get_flow f u v) 0)))
  (body
    (if (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))) (not (istgt g u v (len (idx g u)))))
      (block
        (call cupto_none g u v (len (idx g u)))
        (assert (== (capm g u v) (cupto g u v (len (idx g u)))))
        (assert (== (get_flow cm u v) (capm g u v))))
      (block))))
(lemma resp_f (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (wf g) (capok g cm) (fok g cm f))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
               (=> (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0)
                   (and (has_capacity g u v (get_flow cm u v)) (<= (idx (idx f u) v) (get_flow cm u v))))))
  (body
    (if (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u))))) (> (idx (idx f u) v) 0))
      (block
        (assert (and (< u (len g)) (< v (len g))))
        (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
        (assert (== (get_flow cm u v) (capm g u v)))
        (assert (== (capm g u v) (cupto g u v (len (idx g u)))))
        (if (istgt g u v (len (idx g u))) (block) (call cupto_none g u v (len (idx g u))))
        (call ist_wit g u v (len (idx g u)))
        (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u))))
          (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (< i (len (idx g u)))) (== (get (idx (idx g u) i) 0) v))))
        (call cupto_has g u v i (len (idx g u)))
        (assert (has_capacity g u v (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
        (assert (== (get_flow cm u v) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))
        (assert (has_capacity g u v (get_flow cm u v)))
        (assert (<= (idx (idx f u) v) (get_flow cm u v))))
      (block))))
(lemma cons_f (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int))
  (requires (wf g) (offz g f) (consv g f s t))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (!= u s) (!= u t))) (== (total_flow_in g f u) (total_flow_out g f u))))
  (body
    (if (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g)))
      (block
        (call out_eq g f u)
        (assert (== (total_flow_in g f u) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f u (len g)))))
      (block))))

(lemma resp_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (wf g) (capok g cm) (fok g cm f))
  (ensures (respects_capacity g f))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call resp_f g cm f u v))))
(lemma offz_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (capok g cm) (fok g cm f))
  (ensures (offz g f))
  (body (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call off_f g cm f u v))))
(lemma cons_all (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf g) (offz g f) (consv g f s t))
  (ensures (is_conserved g f s t))
  (body (forall ((u int)) (call cons_f g f s t u))))
(lemma nn_pt (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (fok g cm f))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u))))) (>= (idx (idx f u) v) 0)))
  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len f))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx f u)))))
      (block
        (assert (< u (len g)))
        (assert (== (len (idx f u)) (len g)))
        (assert (== (get_flow f u v) (idx (idx f u) v)))
        (assert (<= 0 (get_flow f u v))))
      (block))))
(lemma valid_f (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf g) (capok g cm) (fok g cm f) (consv g f s t))
  (ensures (offz g f) (is_conserved g f s t) (is_valid_flow g f s t))
  (body
    (call offz_all g cm f)
    (call resp_all g cm f)
    (call cons_all g f s t)
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call nn_pt g cm f u v))
    (assert (is_valid_flow g f s t))))
(lemma val_f (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (val int))
  (requires (wf g) (offz g f) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g)))
            (== val (- (rall f s (len g)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f s (len g)))))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g f s) val))
  (body
    (call out_eq g f s)
    (assert (== (total_flow_in g f s) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f s (len g))))
    (assert (== (flow_val g f s) (- (total_flow_out g f s) (total_flow_in g f s))))))
(lemma cut_f (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf g) (offz g f) (is_conserved g f s t) (fok g cm f) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g)))
            (inw w s) (not (inw w t)) (sat cm f w (len g)))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g f s) (orow cm w false (len g) (len g))))
  (body
    (call cut_val g f w s t)
    (call orow_mono f cm w false (len g) (len g))
    (call orow_mono cm f w false (len g) (len g))
    (ghost-let z (seq (seq int)) (seq-lit))
    (call ocol_mono f z w false (len g) (len g))
    (call ocol_mono z f w false (len g) (len g))
    (call ocol_z z w false (len g) (len g))))
(lemma max_f (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf g) (capacities_bounded g) (capok g cm) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (inw w s) (not (inw w t))
            (is_valid_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) (orow cm w false (len g) (len g))))
  (ensures (is_max_flow g f s t))
  (body
    (forall ((other (seq (seq int)))) (call bound_one g cm w s t other))
    (assert (is_max_flow g f s t))))
(lemma finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (s int) (t int) (val int))
  (requires (wf g) (capacities_bounded g)
            (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))) (!= s t)
            (capok g cm) (fok g cm f) (consv g f s t)
            (== val (- (rall f s (len g)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f s (len g))))
            (inw w s) (not (inw w t)) (sat cm f w (len g)))
  (ensures (is_max_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) val))
  (body
    (call valid_f g cm f s t)
    (call val_f g f s val)
    (call cut_f g cm f w s t)
    (call max_f g cm f w s t)))

(lemma rall_upd (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (x int) (m int))
  (requires (upd2 f0 f1 a b d) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (rall f1 x m) (+ (rall f0 x m) (if (and (== x a) (and (<= 0 b) (< b m))) d 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call rall_upd f0 f1 a b d x (- m 1))
        (assert (== (get_flow f1 x (- m 1)) (+ (get_flow f0 x (- m 1)) (if (and (== x a) (== (- m 1) b)) d 0))))
        (assert (== (rall f1 x m) (+ (rall f1 x (- m 1)) (get_flow f1 x (- m 1)))))
        (assert (== (rall f0 x m) (+ (rall f0 x (- m 1)) (get_flow f0 x (- m 1))))))
      (block (assert (== (rall f1 x m) 0)) (assert (== (rall f0 x m) 0))))))
(lemma sfi_upd (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (x int) (m int))
  (requires (upd2 f0 f1 a b d) (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f1 x m)
               (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g f0 x m) (if (and (== x b) (and (<= 0 a) (< a m))) d 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call sfi_upd g f0 f1 a b d x (- m 1))
        (assert (== (get_flow f1 (- m 1) x) (+ (get_flow f0 (- m 1) x) (if (and (== (- m 1) a) (== x b)) d 0))))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f1 x m) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g f1 x (- m 1)) (get_flow f1 (- m 1) x))))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f0 x m) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g f0 x (- m 1)) (get_flow f0 (- m 1) x)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f1 x m) 0))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g f0 x m) 0))))))
(lemma rall_z (params (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (forall ((a int) (b int)) (== (get_flow h a b) 0)))
  (ensures (== (rall h u m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call rall_z h u (- m 1))
        (assert (== (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0))
        (assert (== (rall h u m) (+ (rall h u (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1))))))
      (assert (== (rall h u m) 0)))))
(lemma sfi_z (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (v int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (forall ((a int) (b int)) (== (get_flow h a b) 0)))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h v m) 0))

      (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h v m) 0)))))
(lemma rall_mono (params (h1 (seq (seq int))) (h2 (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (<= 0 y) (< y m)) (<= (get_flow h1 u y) (get_flow h2 u y)))))
  (ensures (<= (rall h1 u m) (rall h2 u m)))

        (assert (== (rall h2 u m) (+ (rall h2 u (- m 1)) (get_flow h2 u (- m 1))))))
      (block (assert (== (rall h1 u m) 0)) (assert (== (rall h2 u m) 0))))))
(lemma sfi_nonneg (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (v int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (forall ((k int)) (=> (and (<= 0 k) (< k m)) (>= (get_flow h k v) 0))))
  (ensures (>= (sum_flow_in_recursive g h v m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body

        (call sfi_nonneg g h v (- m 1))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h v m) (+ (sum_flow_in_recursive g h v (- m 1)) (get_flow h (- m 1) v)))))
      (assert (== (sum_flow_in_recursive g h v m) 0)))))
(lemma rall_bound (params (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (<= 0 y) (< y m)) (<= (get_flow h u y) 100000))))
  (ensures (<= (rall h u m) (* 100000 m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body

        (call rall_bound h u (- m 1))
        (assert (<= (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 100000))

      (assert (== (rall h u m) 0)))))

(lemma cmb_at (params (cm (seq (seq int))) (n int) (x int) (y int))
  (requires (cmb cm n) (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n)))
  (ensures (== (len cm) n) (== (len (idx cm x)) n) (== (get_flow cm x y) (idx (idx cm x) y))
           (and (<= 0 (idx (idx cm x) y)) (<= (idx (idx cm x) y) 100000)))
  (body))

  (requires (fok g cm f) (and (<= 0 x) (< x (len g))) (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len g))))
  (ensures (== (len f) (len g)) (== (len (idx f x)) (len g)) (== (get_flow f x y) (idx (idx f x) y))
           (and (<= 0 (idx (idx f x) y)) (<= (idx (idx f x) y) (get_flow cm x y))))

  (requires (parinv cm f l0 r0 s) (== (len r0) (len l0)) (upd l0 l1 v x) (upd r0 r1 v u)

(ghost-fn cmb ((cm (seq (seq int))) (n int)) bool
  (body (and (and (== (len cm) n) (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (== (len (idx cm x)) n))))

(ghost-fn consv ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int)) bool

  (body (forall ((y int))
    (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 y) (< y (len lvl))) (< y (len par))) (and (and (>= (idx lvl y) 0) (!= y s)) (<= (idx lvl y) top)))

(ghost-fn bal ((g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (t int) (cur int) (n int)) bool
  (body (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x n))
    (== (- (rall f x n) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f x n))

(lemma count_nonneg (params (s (seq int)) (x int) (k int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) x) 0))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k 0) (call count_nonneg s x (- k 1)) (block))))

  (requires (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j k)) (<= k (len s))))
  (ensures (>= (occurrences (take s k) (idx s j)) 1))
  (decreases k)
  (body (if (> k (+ j 1)) (call count_member s j (- k 1)) (call count_nonneg s (idx s j) j))))

(lemma split_r (params (h (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0))

  (decreases m)
  (body

        (assert (== (rsf h w true u m) (+ (rsf h w true u (- m 1)) (if (== (inw w (- m 1)) true) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (rsf h w false u m) (+ (rsf h w false u (- m 1)) (if (== (inw w (- m 1)) false) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (rall h u m) (+ (rall h u (- m 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1))))))

(lemma swap_step (params (h (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (m int) (k int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (>= k 0))

  (decreases k)

        (assert (== (orow h w true (+ m 1) k) (+ (orow h w true (+ m 1) (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (rsf h w true (- k 1) (+ m 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (rsf h w true (- k 1) (+ m 1)) (+ (rsf h w true (- k 1) m) (if (== (inw w m) true) (get_flow h (- k 1) m) 0))))
        (assert (== (orow h w true m k) (+ (orow h w true m (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (rsf h w true (- k 1) m) 0))))

      (block
        (assert (== (orow h w true (+ m 1) k) 0))
        (assert (== (orow h w true m k) 0))
        (assert (== (csf h w true m k) 0))))))
(lemma swap (params (h (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (m int) (k int))
  (requires (>= m 0) (>= k 0))
  (ensures (== (orow h w true m k) (ocol h w true k m)))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)

        (call swap_step h w (- m 1) k)
        (assert (== (ocol h w true k m) (+ (ocol h w true k (- m 1)) (if (inw w (- m 1)) (csf h w true (- m 1) k) 0)))))
      (block
        (assert (== m 0))
        (call orow_zero h w k)
        (assert (== (ocol h w true k m) 0))))))

(lemma rsf_mono (params (h1 (seq (seq int))) (h2 (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (b bool) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0)

  (decreases k)

        (assert (== (orow h1 w b n k) (+ (orow h1 w b n (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (rsf h1 w b (- k 1) n) 0))))
        (assert (== (orow h2 w b n k) (+ (orow h2 w b n (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (rsf h2 w b (- k 1) n) 0)))))
      (block (assert (== (orow h1 w b n k) 0)) (assert (== (orow h2 w b n k) 0))))))
(lemma csf_mono (params (h1 (seq (seq int))) (h2 (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (b bool) (v int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0)
    (forall ((j int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j m)) (== (inw w j) b)) (<= (get_flow h1 j v) (get_flow h2 j v)))))

  (requires (>= n 0) (>= k 0)

      (=> (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u k)) (inw w u)) (and (and (<= 0 j) (< j n)) (== (inw w j) b)))

  (decreases k)

        (if (inw w (- k 1)) (call csf_mono h1 h2 w b (- k 1) n) (block))
        (assert (== (ocol h1 w b n k) (+ (ocol h1 w b n (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (csf h1 w b (- k 1) n) 0))))
        (assert (== (ocol h2 w b n k) (+ (ocol h2 w b n (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (csf h2 w b (- k 1) n) 0)))))
      (block (assert (== (ocol h1 w b n k) 0)) (assert (== (ocol h2 w b n k) 0))))))
(lemma csf_z (params (z (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (b bool) (v int) (m int))

(lemma mask_zero (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (>= m 0))
  (ensures (== (rmask g h u 0 m) 0))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call mask_zero g h u (- m 1))
        (assert (not (istgt g u (- m 1) 0)))
        (assert (== (rmask g h u 0 m) (+ (rmask g h u 0 (- m 1)) (if (istgt g u (- m 1) 0) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0)))))
      (assert (== (rmask g h u 0 m) 0)))))
(lemma mask_step (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int) (m int))
  (requires (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u)))) (>= m 0)
            (not (istgt g u (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) k)))
  (ensures (== (rmask g h u (+ k 1) m)
               (+ (rmask g h u k m)
                  (if (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) m)) (get_flow h u (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)) 0))))
  (decreases m)
  (body
    (if (> m 0)
      (block
        (call mask_step g h u k (- m 1))
        (assert (== (istgt g u (- m 1) (+ k 1)) (or (istgt g u (- m 1) k) (== (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) (- m 1)))))
        (assert (== (rmask g h u (+ k 1) m) (+ (rmask g h u (+ k 1) (- m 1)) (if (istgt g u (- m 1) (+ k 1)) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0))))
        (assert (== (rmask g h u k m) (+ (rmask g h u k (- m 1)) (if (istgt g u (- m 1) k) (get_flow h u (- m 1)) 0)))))
      (block
        (assert (== m 0))
        (assert (== (rmask g h u (+ k 1) m) 0))
        (assert (== (rmask g h u k m) 0))))))
(lemma distinct_ist (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (k int) (j int))
  (requires (wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (< k (len (idx g u)))) (and (<= 0 j) (<= j k)))
  (ensures (not (istgt g u (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) j)))
  (decreases j)
  (body
    (if (> j 0)
      (block
        (call distinct_ist g u k (- j 1))
        (assert (!= (get (idx (idx g u) (- j 1)) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0)))
        (assert (== (istgt g u (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) j)
                    (or (istgt g u (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) (- j 1))
                        (== (get (idx (idx g u) (- j 1)) 0) (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0))))))
      (assert (not (istgt g u (get (idx (idx g u) k) 0) j))))))
(lemma out_mask (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (k int))
  (requires (wf g) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len (idx g u)))))
  (ensures (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k) (rmask g h u k (len g))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call out_mask g h u (- k 1))
        (call distinct_ist g u (- k 1) (- k 1))
        (call mask_step g h u (- k 1) (len g))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0)) (< (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0) (len g))))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k)
                    (+ (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u (- k 1)) (get_flow h u (get (idx (idx g u) (- k 1)) 0))))))
      (block
        (assert (== k 0))
        (call mask_zero g h u (len g))
        (assert (== (sum_flow_out_recursive g h u k) 0))))))
(lemma mask_full (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (u int) (m int))
  (requires (offz g h) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 m) (<= m (len g))))

(lemma ist_wit (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (u int) (v int) (k int))

(lemma net_split (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (u int))
  (requires (wf g) (offz g h) (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))))
  (ensures (== (- (total_flow_out g h u) (total_flow_in g h u))
               (- (+ (rsf h w true u (len g)) (rsf h w false u (len g)))
                  (+ (csf h w true u (len g)) (csf h w false u (len g))))))
  (body

    (call split_r h w u (len g))
    (call split_c g h w u (len g))

(lemma esum_cons (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (s int) (t int) (k int))
  (requires (is_conserved g h s t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (inw w s) (not (inw w t)) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len g))))
  (ensures (== (esum g h w k) (if (< s k) (flow_val g h s) 0)))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call esum_cons g h w s t (- k 1))
        (assert (== (esum g h w k) (+ (esum g h w (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (- (total_flow_out g h (- k 1)) (total_flow_in g h (- k 1))) 0))))
        (assert (== (flow_val g h s) (- (total_flow_out g h s) (total_flow_in g h s))))
        (assert (=> (and (inw w (- k 1)) (!= (- k 1) s)) (!= (- k 1) t)))
        (assert (=> (and (inw w (- k 1)) (!= (- k 1) s)) (== (total_flow_in g h (- k 1)) (total_flow_out g h (- k 1))))))
      (assert (== (esum g h w k) 0)))))
(lemma esum_split (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (k int))
  (requires (wf g) (offz g h) (and (<= 0 k) (<= k (len g))))
  (ensures (== (esum g h w k) (- (+ (orow h w true (len g) k) (orow h w false (len g) k))
                                 (+ (ocol h w true (len g) k) (ocol h w false (len g) k)))))
  (decreases k)
  (body
    (if (> k 0)
      (block
        (call esum_split g h w (- k 1))
        (if (inw w (- k 1)) (call net_split g h w (- k 1)) (block))
        (assert (== (esum g h w k) (+ (esum g h w (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (- (total_flow_out g h (- k 1)) (total_flow_in g h (- k 1))) 0))))
        (assert (== (orow h w true (len g) k) (+ (orow h w true (len g) (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (rsf h w true (- k 1) (len g)) 0))))
        (assert (== (orow h w false (len g) k) (+ (orow h w false (len g) (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (rsf h w false (- k 1) (len g)) 0))))
        (assert (== (ocol h w true (len g) k) (+ (ocol h w true (len g) (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (csf h w true (- k 1) (len g)) 0))))
        (assert (== (ocol h w false (len g) k) (+ (ocol h w false (len g) (- k 1)) (if (inw w (- k 1)) (csf h w false (- k 1) (len g)) 0)))))
      (block
        (assert (== (esum g h w k) 0))
        (assert (== (orow h w true (len g) k) 0))
        (assert (== (orow h w false (len g) k) 0))
        (assert (== (ocol h w true (len g) k) 0))
        (assert (== (ocol h w false (len g) k) 0))))))
(lemma cut_val (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (s int) (t int))
  (requires (wf g) (offz g h) (is_conserved g h s t) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (inw w s) (not (inw w t)))
  (ensures (== (flow_val g h s) (- (orow h w false (len g) (len g)) (ocol h w false (len g) (len g)))))
  (body
    (call esum_cons g h w s t (len g))
    (call esum_split g h w (len g))
    (call swap h w (len g) (len g))))

(lemma nn_valid (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))

(lemma le_cap (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (h (seq (seq int))) (s int) (t int) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (wf g) (capacities_bounded g) (capok g cm) (is_valid_flow g h s t))
  (ensures (=> (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g)))) (<= (get_flow h u v) (get_flow cm u v))))
  (body
    (if (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len g))))
      (block
        (call capm_bounds g u v)
        (assert (== (get_flow cm u v) (capm g u v)))
        (assert (== (capm g u v) (cupto g u v (len (idx g u)))))
        (if (> (get_flow h u v) 0)
          (block
            (assert (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len h))) (and (<= 0 v) (< v (len (idx h u))))))
            (assert (== (get_flow h u v) (idx (idx h u) v)))
            (assert (respects_capacity g h))
            (obtain ((c int)) (and (has_capacity g u v c) (<= (idx (idx h u) v) c)))
            (obtain ((i int)) (and (and (and (<= 0 u) (< u (len g))) (and (<= 0 i) (< i (len (idx g u)))))

(lemma bound_one (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (s int) (t int) (other (seq (seq int))))
  (requires (wf g) (capacities_bounded g) (capok g cm) (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (inw w s) (not (inw w t))
            (is_valid_flow g other s t))
  (ensures (<= (flow_val g other s) (orow cm w false (len g) (len g))))
  (body
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call off_valid g other s t u v))
    (assert (offz g other))
    (assert (is_conserved g other s t))
    (call cut_val g other w s t)
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call le_cap g cm other s t u v))
    (call orow_mono other cm w false (len g) (len g))
    (forall ((u int) (v int)) (call nn_valid g other s t u v))
    (ghost-let z (seq (seq int)) (seq-lit))
    (call ocol_mono z other w false (len g) (len g))
    (call ocol_z z w false (len g) (len g))))

(lemma off_f (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (u int) (v int))
  (requires (capok g cm) (fok g cm f))

        (if (istgt g u v (len (idx g u))) (block) (call cupto_none g u v (len (idx g u))))

        (assert (== (get_flow cm u v) (get (idx (idx g u) i) 1)))

(lemma max_f (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (s int) (t int))

(lemma finish (params (g (seq (seq (tuple int int)))) (cm (seq (seq int))) (f (seq (seq int))) (w (seq bool)) (s int) (t int) (val int))

            (and (<= 0 s) (< s (len g))) (and (<= 0 t) (< t (len g))) (!= s t)
            (capok g cm) (fok g cm f) (consv g f s t)
            (== val (- (rall f s (len g)) (sum_flow_in_recursive g f s (len g))))
            (inw w s) (not (inw w t)) (sat cm f w (len g)))
  (ensures (is_max_flow g f s t) (== (flow_val g f s) val))
  (body
    (call valid_f g cm f s t)
    (call val_f g f s val)
    (call cut_f g cm f w s t)
    (call max_f g cm f w s t)))

(lemma rall_upd (params (f0 (seq (seq int))) (f1 (seq (seq int))) (a int) (b int) (d int) (x int) (m int))

(def max_flow_value
  (body
    (ghost-let gv (seq (seq (tuple int int))) (view graph))
    (assert (wf gv))
    (assert (capacities_bounded gv))
    (let n i64 (len (field graph adj)))
    (assert (== n (len gv)))
    (assert (<= n 1000))
    (assert (and (<= 0 s) (< s n)))
    (assert (and (<= 0 t) (< t n)))
    (let-mut cm (vec (vec i64)) (seq-build n (fn (ja) (seq-build n (fn (jb) 0)))))
    (let-mut u i64 0)
    (while (< u n)
      (invariant (and (<= 0 u) (<= u n)))
      (invariant (== (len cm) n))
      (invariant (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (== (len (idx cm x)) n))))
      (invariant (forall ((x int) (y int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x u)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n))) (== (idx (idx cm x) y) (capm gv x y)))))
      (invariant (forall ((x int) (y int)) (=> (and (and (<= u x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n))) (== (idx (idx cm x) y) 0))))
      (decreases (- n u))
      (let deg i64 (len (idx (field graph adj) u)))
      (forall ((y int)) (call cupto0 gv u y))
      (let-mut i i64 0)
      (while (< i deg)
        (invariant (and (<= 0 i) (<= i deg)))
        (invariant (== (len cm) n))
        (invariant (forall ((x int)) (=> (and (<= 0 x) (< x n)) (== (len (idx cm x)) n))))
        (invariant (forall ((x int) (y int)) (=> (and (and (<= 0 x) (< x u)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n))) (== (idx (idx cm x) y) (capm gv x y)))))
        (invariant (forall ((x int) (y int)) (=> (and (and (< u x) (< x n)) (and (<= 0 y) (< y n))) (== (idx (idx cm x) y) 0))))
        (invariant (forall ((y int)) (=> (and (<= 0 y) (< y n)) (== (idx (idx cm u) y) (cupto gv u y i)))))
        (decreases (- deg i))
        (let e (tuple i64 i64) (idx (idx (field graph adj) u) i))
        (assert (and (<= 0 (get e 0)) (< (get e 0) n)))
        (forall ((y int)) (call cupto_step gv u y i))
        (set-idx (idx cm u) (get e 0) (get e 1))
        (set i (+ i 1)))
      (forall ((y int)) (call capm_eq gv u y))
      (set u (+ u 1)))
    (let cmf (vec (vec i64)) cm)
    (forall ((x int) (y int)) (call capm_bounds gv x y))
    (assert (capok gv cmf))
    (assert (cmb cmf n))
    (let-mut f (vec (vec i64)) (seq-build n (fn (jc) (seq-build n (fn (jd) 0)))))
    (assert (forall ((x int) (y int)) (== (get_flow f x y) 0)))

    (assert (fok gv cmf f))

    (ghost-let bnd int (rall cmf s n))

    (let-mut total i64 0)
    (while true
      (invariant (capok gv cmf))

      (invariant (fok gv cmf f))
